- Hudson Yards: 28 acres, 17 million sq ft, roughly 10th Ave to West Side Highway and 30th to 34th Sts; called the largest private real estate development in US history. Two platforms are built over 30 active LIRR tracks and rail tunnels; Tutor Perini is general contractor; about 300 caissons; Eastern Rail Yard platform to finish by October 2015, both platforms by 2016. Developer: Related Companies with Oxford Properties.
- Jan. 21, 2015: Mitsui Fudosan America partnered with Related and Oxford on full capitalization of 55 Hudson Yards and started groundbreaking.
- 10 Hudson Yards: 1.7M sq ft, 52 stories, 895 ft (KPF); tenants Coach, L'Oreal USA, SAP; Fairway Market.
- Retail center: 1M sq ft, 100 shops/restaurants (Elkus Manfredi); Neiman Marcus 250,000 sq ft, three levels, its first in NYC.
- 30 Hudson Yards: 2.6M sq ft, 92 stories, 1,284 ft, highest outdoor observation deck; Time Warner sold its Time Warner Center offices to Related for $1.3 billion and plans to move there (2018).
- 50 Hudson Yards: 2.3M sq ft, 62 stories, 1,068 ft, architect not yet announced; JPMorgan Chase reportedly stayed on the East Side after the city would not give the $1 billion tax break.
- 55 Hudson Yards: 51 stories, 1.3M sq ft, 780 ft (Kevin Roche with KPF), ready for fit-out by early 2018.
- Residential: 15 Hudson Yards (70 stories, 910 ft, 385 residences, Diller Scofidio + Renfro), 35 Hudson Yards (79 stories, 1,000 ft, 100 residences, 175-room hotel, SOM), West Tower on Western Rail Yards planned by 2024 (2M sq ft office, 4M residential, K-8 school).
- Culture Shed (DS+R/Rockwell): ETFE retractable canopy, completion 2018; Alex Poots named CEO and artistic director Nov. 24, 2014. The High Line has more than four million annual visitors and stimulated $5 billion in development.

wikis.title: Hudson Yards development: overview and Phase 1 buildings (Wikipedia, part 1)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's opening of the Hudson Yards development article: a 28-acre Manhattan development, its phases, and the individual towers and The Shed.
wikis.body:
- 28-acre (11 ha) development in Manhattan between Chelsea and Hell's Kitchen on the Hudson waterfront; cost given as US$25 billion; groundbreaking December 4, 2012; status "Under construction"; first phase opened March 15, 2019.
- Developers: Related Companies and Oxford Properties. Master plan: Kohn Pedersen Fox; other architects: SOM, Thomas Heatherwick, Foster + Partners, Roche-Dinkeloo, Diller Scofidio + Renfro. Major office tenants: Tapestry, BCG, Warner Bros. Discovery, L'Oreal, Wells Fargo, KKR.
- Built on a platform over the West Side Yard (LIRR storage yard). Phase 1 (east, between Tenth and Eleventh Aves) has three office towers, a retail podium, The Shed, a public plaza, the Vessel and three residential towers; Phase 2 (west, Eleventh-Twelfth Aves) is planned.
- 10 Hudson Yards: 52 stories, 895 ft, opened May 31, 2016, first occupied; tenants include L'Oreal, BCG, Coach, SAP.
- 15 Hudson Yards: construction began December 2014, topped out February 2018, opened early 2019, 285 residential units.
- The Shed: arts center in the Bloomberg Building with retractable shell, opened April 5, 2019.
- 30 Hudson Yards: 103 stories, 2.6M sq ft, 1,296 ft, opened March 15, 2019; Edge observation deck on the 100th floor opened March 2020; tenants include KKR, Wells Fargo, Warner Bros. Discovery and CNN.

wikis.title: Air Force cancels $24 million Air Force One refrigerator order
wikis.summary: Air Force Times report that a $24 million Boeing order for two Air Force One refrigeration units was canceled ahead of the new presidential jets.
wikis.body:
- Source: Air Force Times, Noah Nash, Jun 5, 2018.
- A $24 million order for two refrigerators from Boeing for Air Force One was canceled by the Air Force and the White House Military Office; announced Monday by Rep. Joe Courtney (per CNN) and confirmed by an Air Force spokesperson.
- Ordered in December (2017) to replace two of the five refrigeration units aboard the president's jet. Spokeswoman Ann Stefanek said reliability had decreased "especially in hot/humid environments"; units in use since 1990.
- Galley must carry 3,000 meals to feed passengers and crew for up to four weeks. The price included unique FAA testing for the one-of-a-kind aircraft.
- Cancellation attributed to the coming new presidential jets: two 747-8s bought from Boeing (deal announced 2017), starting transition to Air Force One configuration in 2019, initial operational capacity slated for 2024.
- Air Force Secretary Heather Wilson: "mitigation options exist to ensure food security" until then.

wikis.title: White House cuts $3.9 billion deal with Boeing for two new Air Force Ones
wikis.summary: CNBC report (Feb 27, 2018) on an informal fixed-price deal of about $3.9 billion for two new Air Force One planes.
wikis.body:
- Source: CNBC / NBC News, published Feb 27, 2018.
- White House spokesman: "President Trump has reached an informal deal with Boeing on a fixed price contract for the new Air Force One Program"; the contract "will save the taxpayers more than $1.4 Billion". Deal expected to total $3.9 billion. Pentagon deferred to the White House.
- Air Force told CNBC the two planes were originally to be sold to Russia; when that fell through the Air Force acquired them at a slightly discounted price; they never left US soil.
- In December 2016 Trump tweeted costs were "out of control, more than $4 billion. Cancel order!" The article notes the new deal is barely below $4 billion and the $1.4 billion savings appears to come from a different estimate of over $5 billion.
- Deal covers the two planes, development program and a new hangar. Boeing CEO Muilenberg had given Trump a "personal commitment" to lower costs below $4 billion.
- Richard Aboulafia (Teal Group): planes are about a fifth of the cost; most goes to presidential outfitting.
- 747-8 was selected January 2015; the aircraft are VC-25Bs.

wikis.title: Trump and Boeing reach handshake deal capping Air Force One at $3.9 billion
wikis.summary: Defense News report of a Feb 27, 2018 informal agreement capping development and production of two new Air Force One aircraft at $3.9 billion.
wikis.body:
- Source: Defense News, Valerie Insinna, Feb 27, 2018.
- White House and Boeing reached an informal, fixed-price deal capping development and production at $3.9 billion, per CNBC and Fox News, confirmed by officials.
- A Boeing official: the price includes previously definitized contracts, including a $600 million design contract and a still-undisclosed contract for two Boeing 747s, plus the engineering, manufacturing and design contract not yet awarded.
- White House claims $1.4 billion savings against an original estimate of more than $5 billion; article says it is unclear where $5 billion came from. Trump's December 2016 tweet said the program was worth more than $4 billion and experts said that was accurate. Trump claimed in Feb 2017 to have shaved $1 billion; Defense One reported cuts including dropping mid-air refueling capability and buying two 747s built for, but never owned by, a Russian airliner.
- Price driven by converting two airliners into hardened flying White Houses. Boeing expected to start modifications in 2019; new planes could begin replacing the VC-25A as early as 2024.
- Boeing statement: "President Trump negotiated a good deal on behalf of the American people."

wikis.title: Momentum Machines BurgerBot: 400 burgers an hour (Interesting Engineering, 2017)
wikis.summary: Article on Momentum Machines' automated burger robot, its $18 million funding round and planned Bay Area robot burger restaurant.
wikis.body:
- Source: Interesting Engineering, Jessica Miley, Jun 19, 2017.
- Momentum Machines' BurgerBot is a fully automated burger maker that can make 400 burgers an hour with fresh ground beef, salad and a toasted bun.
- The company had just completed a funding round of $18 million and is "on the verge" of opening the world's first robot hamburger restaurant in the Bay Area. Concept first released in 2012.
- Co-founder Alexandros Vardakostas (2012): "Our device isn't meant to make employees more efficient, it's meant to completely obviate them."
- The robot's outlay is given as $30,000; Xconomy reported the prototype could save a fast-food restaurant up to $90,000 a year in training, salaries and overhead.
- Article notes a prediction that 1 in 7 jobs will be automated by 2025, and quotes Momentum Machines arguing that technology like theirs increases employment.

wikis.title: Momentum Machines robot that makes 360 gourmet burgers per hour (Vice, 2012)
wikis.summary: Vice Motherboard piece on Momentum Machines' burger-making robot and proposed chain of human-free restaurants.
wikis.body:
- Source: Vice, Brian Merchant, November 21, 2012.
- A 24-square-foot robot built by San Francisco-based Momentum Machines, debuted the previous year, makes about 360 hamburgers per hour, takes custom orders and slices toppings just before placing them.
- Momentum proposes a chain of "smart restaurants" without human cooks. Its release: "With our technology, a restaurant can offer gourmet quality burgers at fast food prices. Our alpha machine replaces all of the hamburger line cooks in a restaurant."
- Custom grinds per customer (e.g. 1/3 pork, 2/3 bison); company claims labor savings let a restaurant spend about twice as much on ingredients.
- The author warns of structural unemployment unless work is rethought.

wikis.title: Momentum Machines raises $18M for robot burger restaurant (PYMNTS, 2017)
wikis.summary: PYMNTS report on Momentum Machines' $18 million round and planned San Francisco restaurant at 680 Folsom Street.
wikis.body:
- Source: PYMNTS, June 15, 2017.
- Momentum Machines introduced its autonomous burger bot in 2012; an $18 million venture round moves it toward its flagship San Francisco restaurant. Google-backed; staff from Berkeley, Stanford, Tesla and NASA; former Fat Duck R&D head an adviser. McDonald's reportedly has "an eye on it".
- Robot cost given as $35,000; could replace two to three full-time line cooks and save $90,000 in training, salaries and overhead per franchise per year. Former McDonald's CEO Ed Rensi: "It's cheaper to buy a $35,000 robotic arm than it is to hire an employee..." at $15 an hour.
- 24-square-foot bot makes almost 400 burgers an hour, one every 10 seconds; beef, pork or bison blends, toasted brioche bun, wraps and bags them.
- Building permit applied for last June to convert ground-floor retail at 680 Folsom Street (SoMa); a Craigslist ad sought a "restaurant generalist".

wikis.title: Nanobots in the bloodstream by 2030 (Interesting Engineering, 2020)
wikis.summary: Article on Ray Kurzweil's claim that nanobots will be in bloodstreams by 2030 and on current nanorobotics research and hurdles.
wikis.body:
- Source: Interesting Engineering, Trevor English, Nov 20, 2020.
- Ray Kurzweil, described as a Google futurist, claimed in an interview with Neil deGrasse (Tyson) that nanobots in the bloodstream will prevent us from dying in 2030, protecting biological systems at a molecular level.
- IFL Science is cited saying DNA robots are already being tested in animals to seek and destroy cancer cells, delivering blood-clotting drugs around tumors; human trials have not happened yet. Nanobots might also deliver micro-dosages of drugs, reduce vein plaque and monitor the body, sending data to a cloud. Transmitting thoughts to the cloud is called "probably the most far-fetched" use.
- Harvard Wyss Institute/HMS research (ScienceMag) used nanorobots loaded with antibody fragments for cell signaling in tissue culture, as a proof of principle.
- Background: nanometer = 10^-9 m; Feynman's 1959 Caltech talk "There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom"; scanning tunnelling microscopes in 1981.
- Some researchers predict about 10 years to overcome challenges before nanobots are used in some surgery; others doubt it is the best use of limited healthcare money, as robot-assisted surgery is already more expensive.
- Kurzweil in 2019 (Engadget): medical nanorobots would extend the immune system and connect the neocortex to a synthetic neocortex in the cloud.

wikis.title: New ceramic coating for hypersonic flight (Interesting Engineering, 2017)
wikis.summary: Article on a Manchester/Central South University carbide ceramic coating said to be 12 times more effective than existing ceramics, plus hypersonic airliner plans.
wikis.body:
- Source: Interesting Engineering, Jessica Miley, Jul 11, 2017.
- Mach 5 flight generates temperatures of "up to 3,600F to 5400F". A team of Chinese and British scientists (University of Manchester, Royce Institute, Central South University) developed a carbide-based ceramic coating, 12 times more effective than current ceramics such as zirconium carbide (ZrC), made with "reactive melt infiltration" and reinforced with a carbon-carbon composite.
- Could also make spacecraft re-entry safer. "Workable hypersonic vehicles are still a distant dream."
- Lockheed Martin and DARPA have announced plans to revive hypersonic vehicle development. Boeing CEO Dennis Muilenburg: "in the next decade or two you're going to see them become a reality"; Shanghai to New York cut from 15 hours to two.
- Boom (Colorado) is developing a commercial supersonic jet; five airlines are thought to have placed orders after the Paris Airshow. Commercial viability is uncertain given high operating costs.

wikis.title: University of Manchester: new ceramic coating for hypersonic travel (2017)
wikis.summary: Manchester press release on a carbide coating from Manchester and Central South University that resists temperatures up to 3,000 C, reported to be 12 times better than ZrC.
wikis.body:
- Source: University of Manchester news, 06 July 2017.
- Researchers at Manchester, with Central South University (CSU), China, created a ceramic coating that could serve hypersonic air, space and defense uses. Hypersonic = Mach 5 or above; temperatures can reach 2,000 to 3,000 C, causing oxidation and ablation.
- Ultra-high temperature ceramics (UHTCs) are needed; conventional ones "can't currently satisfy the associated ablation requirements". The new carbide coating resists up to 3,000 C and is reported to be 12 times better than zirconium carbide (ZrC).
- Made by reactive melt infiltration (RMI), which reduces production time, reinforced with carbon-carbon composite; manufactured at CSU's Powder Metallurgy Institute and studied at Manchester's School of Materials.
- Prof. Philip Withers: a hypersonic plane could fly London to New York in two hours. Prof. Ping Xiao led the study.
- Reference: "Ablation-resistant carbide Zr0.8Ti0.2C0.74B0.26 for oxidizing environments up to 3,000 C", Nature Communications 15836 (2017).

wikis.title: EIA Annual Energy Outlook 2017: renewables and coal (Ars Technica)
wikis.summary: Ars Technica's read of the EIA's 2017 energy outlook, projecting natural gas dominance, renewables passing coal by the 2030s, and criticising its conservative wind projection.
wikis.body:
- Source: Ars Technica, John Timmer, Jan 6, 2017. Reports the US Energy Information Administration's 2017 outlook, released the day before, projecting out to 2040.
- Coal keeps declining; natural gas becomes the dominant US energy source, followed by renewables. Energy production growth far outstrips sluggish demand growth, making the US a net energy exporter by the 2030s (most scenarios in the 2020s).
- The author says EIA reports are "notoriously conservative": earlier ones missed the drop in photovoltaic prices; this one has wind installation essentially stopping once tax incentives expire in the early 2020s.
- On the grid, natural gas and renewables pass coal in the 2030s; renewables become the largest electricity source in the 2030s if gas extraction hits hiccups. Coal is pushed to fourth in energy production late in the 2030s; its decline slows or stabilises if the Clean Power Plan ends.
- Emissions decline slightly then inch up in the 2030s; flat without the Clean Power Plan. EIA projects a 0.2 percent annual fall versus 1.4 percent average annual fall in the last decade. Transportation became the largest emissions source last year.
- The EIA is optimistic about solar (grid-scale and distributed).

wikis.title: Carbon Brief analysis of IEA World Energy Outlook 2024: solar surge and coal decline
wikis.summary: Carbon Brief analysis (Oct 18, 2024) of IEA World Energy Outlook 2024 data: solar quadruples by 2030, coal falls, and the 'age of electricity'.
wikis.body:
- Source: Carbon Brief, Simon Evans and Verner Viisainen, 18.10.24.
- Global solar generation will quadruple by 2030; solar overtakes nuclear, wind, hydro, gas and coal to become the world's largest electricity source by 2033. Energy-related CO2 emissions reach a peak "imminently", turning point in 2025 per IEA data.
- Renewables grow 2.7-fold by 2030, short of the COP28 tripling goal. Low-carbon energy grows 44% by 2030 (adds 48 EJ) versus energy demand up 34 EJ (5%). Clean energy overtakes coal, gas and then oil "in the mid-2030s".
- EVs are expected to displace 6 mb/d of oil by 2030, up from 4 mb/d in last year's outlook.
- Emissions only 4% below 2023 levels by 2030, giving 2.4C of warming; the 1.5C path is "increasingly narrow, but still achievable", requiring a 33% cut in emissions by 2030.
- Scenarios: NZE, APS, STEPS. 38 countries responsible for a third of energy CO2 have introduced new clean-energy measures.
- IEA's Fatih Birol calls it the "age of electricity"; the WEO answers US criticism of its 2023 view that fossil demand peaks before 2030. Sensitivities: combined, oil demand still peaks and declines by 2035; 2030 CO2 less than 2% higher.

wikis.title: EIA AEO2020: renewables to pass nuclear and coal generation
wikis.summary: EIA Today in Energy note (Jan 30, 2020) on AEO2020 projections that renewable electricity passes nuclear and coal by 2021 and natural gas in 2045.
wikis.body:
- Source: US EIA Today in Energy, January 30, 2020, on the Annual Energy Outlook 2020 (AEO2020) Reference case.
- Renewable generation (wind, solar) is projected to surpass nuclear and coal by 2021 and natural gas in 2045. Renewables share of US generation rises from 19% in 2019 to 38% in 2050.
- Wind and solar are about half of renewable generation today and nearly 80% in 2050. New wind additions continue at much lower levels after production tax credits expire in the early 2020s; solar PV keeps growing through 2050 as costs decline. Conventional hydro stays roughly unchanged.
- Scenarios: even in High Oil and Gas Supply and High Renewables Cost cases, renewable generation nearly doubles from current levels by 2050. Low Renewables Cost assumes overnight capital costs 40% lower by 2050; High holds them at 2019 levels.
- Wind grows most in the West and Mid-Continent, solar in the Southeast; offshore wind only off the Northeast and PJM.

wikis.title: 3D printing entire superyachts by 2030 (3ders.org, 2017)
wikis.summary: 3ders article on naval architect Greg Marshall's Superyacht Design Symposium talk predicting 3D-printed metal yachts around 2030.
wikis.body:
- Source: 3ders.org, Jul 14, 2017 (citing Digital Trends). Greg Marshall (Canadian naval architect) spoke at the Superyacht Design Symposium in February 2017, Kitzbuhel, Austria.
- Conventional shipbuilding wastes 15-20 percent of raw materials; 3D printing could cut this to as little as 2 percent, also reducing labour costs.
- Yachts will likely be printed in titanium: lighter than steel, melting point 300 degrees higher, less prone to corrosion. Interiors could be printed then covered with wood veneers and stone.
- An industrial-scale printer for large yacht parts should be complete in late 2017, and an even larger one by 2020. By the mid 20s the industry could print entire six-metre (19.6 ft) tenders; Marshall: "by 2030 we'll probably be fairly close to 3D printing full-scale metal structures on boats and interiors will come after that."
- A 45-metre yacht that takes two to three years could be finished in as little as 90 days.

wikis.title: Fox News: naval architect predicts 3D-printed yachts by 2030
wikis.summary: Fox News reprint (Jul 14, 2017) of Digital Trends' report on Greg Marshall's prediction that 3D printing could build superyachts by 2030.
wikis.body:
- Source: Fox News, July 14, 2017; text matches the Digital Trends article.
- Greg Marshall says the technology for 3D-printed yachts and superyachts could be in place by 2030; it is a matter of scaling up. Views come from an article in Futureyachts (Boat International bookazine), from his 2017 Superyacht Design Symposium presentation.
- Waste: "about 15 to 20 percent raw material wastage" in a shipyard versus around 2 percent with 3D printing.
- Titanium is lighter than steel (higher speed with less power), melts about 300 degrees C higher, does not corrode and is bio-compatible.
- Timeline: next-generation printer for large-scale parts in late 2017; a larger one online in 2020; entire six-metre (19.6 ft) tenders printed in one step by the mid 20's; "by 2030 we'll probably be fairly close to 3D printing full-scale metal structures on boats and interiors will come after that."

wikis.title: Digital Trends: 3D-printed yachts lighter, faster and fireproof within a decade
wikis.summary: Digital Trends (Jul 13, 2017) on Greg Marshall's forecast of 3D-printed titanium yachts and superyachts by 2030.
wikis.body:
- Source: Digital Trends, Bruce Brown, July 13, 2017.
- Naval architect Greg Marshall (interview in Futureyachts, Boat International bookazine, from his 2017 Superyacht Design Symposium talk): entire superyachts, including interiors, could be 3D printed by 2030.
- Waste 15 to 20 percent in a shipyard versus around 2 percent with printing, saving material and labour; smaller carbon footprints.
- Titanium: lighter than steel, melting point about 300 C higher (fire protection), no corrosion, bio-compatible (used in bone implants).
- Marshall says titanium printing exists now but must scale up: a next-generation printer in late 2017, a much larger one in 2020, entire six-meter (19.6 feet) tenders in the mid 20's, "by 2030... full-scale metal structures on boats", interiors after.

wikis.title: UN: world population expected to rise to 9.7 billion in 2050 (AP)
wikis.summary: AP report (Jun 17, 2019) on the UN's World Population Prospects 2019: slower but continued growth, ageing and falling fertility.
wikis.body:
- Source: Associated Press (Edith M. Lederer) via Fox 11, Mon June 17, 2019.
- World population is to rise from 7.7 billion to 9.7 billion in 2050 and could peak at nearly 11 billion around the end of the century; Population Division director John Wilmoth says that peak "is not certain".
- Nine countries account for more than half of growth to 2050: India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Congo, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Indonesia, Egypt, United States. Sub-Saharan Africa population projected to nearly double.
- Global fertility fell from 3.2 births per woman in 1990 to 2.5 in 2019 and is projected at 2.2 by 2050; replacement needs 2.1. Sub-Saharan Africa 4.6 in 2019.
- Since 2010, 27 countries or areas lost one percent or more of population; between 2019 and 2050 populations are projected to fall by 1% or more in 55 countries, 26 by at least 10 percent. China projected to fall by 31.4 million, about 2.2 percent.
- Migration: 14 countries will see net inflow over one million migrants 2010-2020 and 10 a similar loss.

wikis.title: Al Jazeera: UN says world population to reach 9.7 billion by 2050
wikis.summary: Al Jazeera report (Jun 18, 2019) on UN World Population Prospects 2019 projections.
wikis.body:
- Source: Al Jazeera (News Agencies), 18 Jun 2019.
- UN's World Population Prospects 2019 estimates 7.7 billion today rising to 9.7 billion by 2050; peak of nearly 11 billion near the end of the century.
- More than half the increase is in nine countries: India, Nigeria, Pakistan, DR Congo, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Indonesia, Egypt, US; sub-Saharan Africa nearly doubles.
- China's population is to drop by more than two percent by 2050; India overtakes it by 2027.
- Fertility fell from 3.2 births per woman in 1990 to 2.5 in 2019, expected 2.2 in 2050; 2.1 needed for replacement. 27 countries or territories lost at least one percent since 2010. Deaths outpace births in Belarus, Estonia, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Russia, Serbia, Ukraine and Japan.
- Life expectancy expected at 77.1 years in 2050 versus 72.6 now (64.2 in 1990); poorer countries lag about seven years below average.

wikis.title: Michio Kaku: The Physics of Extraterrestrial Civilizations
wikis.summary: Essay by Michio Kaku on ranking hypothetical alien civilizations as Kardashev Type I, II and III by energy use, and the exoplanet-detection missions expected to search for them.
wikis.body:
- Source: mkaku.org article by Dr. Michio Kaku; undated (references missions planned for "early in the next decade").
- Premise: quoting Carl Sagan on a million-year-old civilization; physics can place upper and lower limits on such civilizations though any conjecture is "sheer speculation".
- Exoplanet context: a dozen Jupiter-sized extra-solar planets known (e.g. around Gliese 876, about 15 light years away); the Space Interferometry Mission (SIM) planned for early next decade, then the Terrestrial Planet Finder late in that decade to scan the brightest 1,000 stars within 50 light years and focus on 50 to 100 planetary systems.
- Ranking principles: thermodynamics, stable matter clumping into planets/stars/galaxies, and growth faster than catastrophe frequency. Nicolai Kardashev's 1964 Journal of Soviet Astronomy paper: Type I (planetary), Type II (stellar), Type III (galactic) energy use, separated by factors of many billions.
- Humanity is Type 0 (burning dead plants). Freeman Dyson: Type I within about 200 years. At 1% growth per year Kardashev estimated 3,200 years to Type II and 5,800 years to Type III.
- Type I could modify weather, earthquakes and volcanoes; Type II uses its star's output (about a billion trillion trillion ergs per second), possibly a Dyson sphere, detectable as infrared waste heat; only a nearby supernova threatens it. Type III, using a galaxy, is "truly immortal" with no known natural catastrophe able to destroy it.

wikis.title: CNN Underscored: the 15 most anticipated games of 2023
wikis.summary: CNN Underscored's list (Jan 24, 2023) of 15 anticipated 2023 games with release dates or windows.
wikis.body:
- Source: CNN Underscored, Matt Cabral, Jan 24, 2023. Listed in release order:

- Hogwarts Legacy (Feb. 10, 2023, WB Games), open-world action-RPG set 100 years before the books.
- Star Wars Jedi: Survivor (March 17, 2023, EA), set five years after Fallen Order.
- Resident Evil 4 (March 24, 2023, Capcom), remake.
- The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (May 12, 2023, Nintendo), with islands floating above Hyrule.
- Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League (May 26, 2023, WB Games/Rocksteady), four-player co-op.

- Baldur's Gate III (August 2023, Larian Studios), after two years of early access.

- Redfall (TBD 2023, Xbox Game Studios/Arkane), vampire co-op shooter.

- Alan Wake 2 (TBD 2023, Epic Games/Remedy), more survival horror.

wikis.title: TIME: the 12 most anticipated video games of 2023
wikis.summary: TIME's list (Dec 18, 2022) of 12 anticipated 2023 games with dates, platforms and details.
wikis.body:
- Source: TIME, Richard Newby, DEC 18, 2022. Notes E3 returns in-person mid-June and games adaptations in 2023 (The Last of Us HBO series in January, Tetris in March, The Super Mario Bros. Movie in April, Gran Turismo film).

- Resident Evil 4 Remake (March 24): Leon S. Kennedy rescuing the President's daughter.
- The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (May 12): Switch; floating islands above Hyrule.
- Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League (May 26): includes Kevin Conroy's final vocal performance as Batman.

- Final Fantasy XVI (June 22): PS5 only; world of Valisthea; action combat instead of turn-based.
- Alan Wake II (TBA), Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon (TBA, FromSoftware, director Masaru Yamamura), Spider-Man 2 (TBA; Kraven and Venom voiced by Tony Todd), Judas (TBA, Ken Levine's Ghost Story Games).

wikis.title: Tom's Guide: 11 most anticipated games of 2023
wikis.summary: Tom's Guide list (by Marshall Honorof, published late 2022) of anticipated 2023 games, with dates and platforms.
wikis.body:
- Source: Tom's Guide, Marshall Honorof; publication date not stated on the page (written before 2023; mentions "this past year" 2022 and Diablo Immortal).
- Forspoken (January 24; PC, PS5): Square Enix, delayed a few times; Frey Holland whisked from New York to Athia.

- Marvel's Spider-Man 2 (listed 2022; PS5): Venom appears.

wikis.title: IGN review of the Dead Space remake (9/10)
wikis.summary: IGN's Editors' Choice review (updated Feb 4, 2023) of Motive Studio's Dead Space remake, scored 9.
wikis.body:
- Source: IGN, Tristan Ogilvie, updated Feb 4, 2023. Score 9, Editors' Choice; initial release Jan 27, 2023; developer Motive Studio, publisher EA.
- After just over 12 hours, the reviewer says the remake "enhances the original in almost every way", keeping dismemberment-based shooting (Plasma Cutter, Kinesis, Stasis).
- Changes: much more detailed visuals and lighting on the USG Ishimura; a more interconnected ship with tram travel, new corridors, backtracking as security level rises (Metroid-like), new zero-gravity sections with free flight; storage rooms no longer cost power nodes but use environmental puzzles.
- Isaac Clarke now speaks, voiced by Gunner Wright (voice of Isaac in the sequels); story is smartly and subtly enhanced.
- Verdict: "definitive way to experience... one of the best survival horror shooters that Capcom never made."

wikis.title: Polygon review of the Dead Space remake
wikis.summary: Polygon's review (Jan 26, 2023) of the Dead Space remake, calling it the best the franchise has been.
wikis.body:
- Source: Polygon, Michael McWhertor, Jan 26, 2023. Reviewed on a pre-release code from EA.
- Dead Space (Motive Studio, EA) releases Jan. 27 on PlayStation 5, Windows PC and Xbox Series X.
- The USG Ishimura is rebuilt in detail; weapons, characters and progression are rethought. Story mostly unchanged (Concordance Extraction Corporation crew, Necromorphs, Isaac Clarke seeking Dr. Nicole Brennan) but it introduces religious fanaticism and alien artifacts earlier.
- Isaac now speaks; Gunnar Wright returns; new cast includes Brigitte Kali Canales (Kendra Daniels) and Faran Tahir (Dr. Challus Mercer).
- Limb-removal combat retained; flamethrower alt-fire is now a two-meter-wide wall of fire; pulse rifle alt-fire is a proximity mine; tiered security clearance gives a Metroid-like feel; free-floating zero-G.
- No multiplayer or microtransactions; accessibility features include colorblind modes and an option to hide disturbing scenes.

wikis.title: IGN review of Hogwarts Legacy (9, Editors' Choice)
wikis.summary: IGN's review (updated Jun 25, 2024) of Avalanche Software's Hogwarts Legacy, praising its world and combat while noting technical issues and a weak main story.
wikis.body:
- Source: IGN, Travis Northup, updated Jun 25, 2024. Score 9, Editors' Choice; initial release Feb 10, 2023; developer Avalanche; reviewed on PS5.
- Verdict: "In nearly every way, Hogwarts Legacy is the Harry Potter RPG I've always wanted to play." Weighed down by "technical issues, a lackluster main story, and some poor enemy variety".
- Praised: Hogwarts open-world map, spellcasting combat, memorable classmates (Sebastian, Natsai) and professors (Fig, Ronen), character creator, many diversions.
- Story: begins with transfer as a fifth-year and a conflict with an evil goblin; plot described as having holes.
- Performance issues on PS5: framerate inconsistency, lighting swings, pop-in.
- IGN addresses J.K. Rowling's comments separately, evaluating the game "as it stands".

wikis.title: Engadget review of Hogwarts Legacy
wikis.summary: Engadget's launch-day review (Feb 10, 2023) of Hogwarts Legacy, praising its open world and combat and discussing the Rowling and goblin controversies.
wikis.body:
- Source: Engadget, Jessica Conditt, Feb. 10, 2023. Played about 22 hours on PlayStation 5; not yet finished.
- Verdict tone: "a massive and gorgeous open-world RPG"; combat with 16 spells, potions and plants, extra-powerful moves; flight on broomstick or thestral; handcrafted quests and secrets; Room of Requirement decorating unlocks about 10 hours in.
- Criticism: the goblin storyline's "goblins are bad, wizardkind is good" framing lacks nuance; goblins are not meaningfully different from the novels, with the question of antisemitism noted.
- J.K. Rowling was not involved in writing or creating the game; the character builder allows a range of gender, voice and appearance options. The reviewer notes calls for a boycott and refers to an editorial on her decision to review.

wikis.title: Hogwarts Legacy: overview, setting and plot (Wikipedia, part 1)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's opening for Hogwarts Legacy: release details, reception and sales, and the setting and plot.
wikis.body:
- 2023 action RPG by Avalanche Software, published by Warner Bros. Games under Portkey Games; Wizarding World series; director Alan Tew; Unreal Engine 4; single-player.
- Releases: PS5, Windows, Xbox Series X/S on 10 February 2023; PS4 and Xbox One 5 May 2023; Switch 14 November 2023; Switch 2 on 5 June 2025.
- Set a century before the Harry Potter novels (1890s). Announced 2020; estimated production cost $150 million. Warner Bros. acquired Avalanche in 2017.
- Controversy over J. K. Rowling's views on transgender people and accusations of antisemitic tropes, leading to calls for a boycott. Early access made it the most-watched single-player game on Twitch.
- Sales: over 12 million copies and $850 million in its first two weeks; 40 million copies and $1 billion in total revenue. Positive reviews praising combat, world and characters, criticising technical problems and lack of open-world innovation. Nominations include BAFTA Games Awards, D.I.C.E. Awards and Grammy Awards.
- Characters: fifth-year protagonist (Sebastian Croft or Amelia Gething), Professor Eleazar Fig, headmaster Phineas Nigellus Black (Simon Pegg), Professor Matilda Weasley (Lesley Nicol); antagonists Ranrok (goblin rebellion) and Victor Rookwood (Dark Wizards).
- Plot: the protagonist learns of ancient magic, the Keepers' four trials, and Isidora Morganach, and races Ranrok and Rookwood for a hidden repository of ancient magic.

wikis.title: IGN review of Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
wikis.summary: IGN's review (updated Jun 25, 2024) of Respawn's Star Wars Jedi: Survivor, praising combat and mobility and noting a rocky PC launch.
wikis.body:
- Source: IGN, Dan Stapleton, updated Jun 25, 2024. Initial release Apr 28, 2023; developer Respawn; rating labelled "amazing" (score digit not visible in the text).
- Verdict: takes Fallen Order "and wall-runs with it"; "a sequel that does virtually everything better than the original". If Respawn makes one more it would "complete the best Star Wars trilogy in 30 years".
- Cal Kestis starts with most earlier powers; five lightsaber stances; grapple, air dash, bigger open maps and many collectibles; likened to Batman: Arkham City versus Fallen Order's Arkham Asylum. Set five years after the first game.
- Launch was rocky, especially on PC; Respawn publicly apologised and began patching.
- Story called predictable but fun and at times emotional.

wikis.title: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor: overview, gameplay and plot
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the 2023 Respawn/EA action-adventure sequel to Jedi: Fallen Order, covering its release, gameplay, characters and plot.
wikis.body:
- 2023 action-adventure game developed by Respawn Entertainment, published by Electronic Arts; director Stig Asmussen; Unreal Engine 4; composers Stephen Barton and Gordy Haab.
- Sequel to Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order (2019), set five years later; follows Jedi Knight Cal Kestis (Cameron Monaghan) fighting the Empire while racing a corrupted High Republic Jedi to a hidden planet, Tanalorr.
- Announced May 2022. Released April 28, 2023 on PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S; PS4 and Xbox One versions released September 17, 2024.
- Development began late 2019 and lasted three and a half years. It was the last game EA released under its 10-year exclusivity contract with Lucasfilm.
- Reception: positive reviews praising characters, combat, level design and music; the PC version was criticized for technical issues. Commercial success for EA. Nominated for Best Action/Adventure Game at The Game Awards 2023 and Adventure Game of the Year at the 27th D.I.C.E. Awards. A sequel concluding the Jedi trilogy is in development.

## Gameplay
- Third-person; Metroidvania-inspired structure. Health and block meters; parrying depletes enemy block meters; red-glowing attacks are unblockable.
- Five lightsaber stances (double-bladed, dual-wield, single, blaster, crossguard), two equippable at once; five difficulty modes.
- Force powers (pull, push, slow time, lift and slam), skill tree in three categories, perks, meditation circles (fast travel, respawn enemies), ridable mounts, Ascension cable grapple, BD-1 droid, companions, side quests ("rumors"), Pyloon's Saloon and Holotactics, seven Jedi Chambers on Koboh.

## Plot (summary)
Cal works for Saw Gerrera, steals data on Coruscant, and is hunted by the Ninth Sister. On Koboh he finds droid ZN-A4 and the Forest Array, freeing Dagan Gera, who has turned to the dark side. Cal, Bode Akuna, Greez and Merrin seek compasses to reach Tanalorr; Bode is revealed as an Imperial spy and a fallen Jedi who kills Eno Cordova; Cere dies when Darth Vader destroys the Jedi Archives on Jedha. The group reaches Tanalorr where Bode attacks.

## Cast
Cameron Monaghan (Cal), Debra Wilson (Cere), Daniel Roebuck (Greez), Ben Burtt (BD-1), Tina Ivlev (Merrin), Noshir Dalal (Bode), Temuera Morrison (Boba Fett).

wikis.title: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor delayed to April 28, 2023
wikis.summary: mxdwn news item on Respawn delaying Jedi: Survivor by six weeks to April 28, 2023.
wikis.body:
- Published January 31st, 2023 (mxdwn.com, Paul David Nuñez).
- Survivor was set to release in March; Respawn announced it needs more time and it is now set to launch April 28, 2023, six weeks after the initial date.
- Director Stig and the Jedi team wrote that the game is "content complete" after three years and they are focused on "bug fixes to enhance performance, stability, polish", adding "six crucial weeks" to the schedule for a global launch on April 28th.
- Game follows Cal five years after the first game; new planets and familiar frontiers, new Force abilities and lightsaber fighting styles. First gameplay footage was shown at The Game Awards 2022.

wikis.title: EA announcement: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor now arrives April 28th
wikis.summary: EA Play news post carrying Respawn's statement moving Jedi: Survivor's global release to April 28.
wikis.body:
- Respawn's Stig and the Star Wars Jedi team say the game is "content complete" after three years, now in a final stage of bug fixes for performance, stability and polish.
- "we have added six crucial weeks to our release schedule - Star Wars Jedi: Survivor will now launch globally on April 28th."
- Describes it as a follow-up to Fallen Order continuing Cal and BD's story, with expansive destinations and evolved combat and traversal.
- Related news listed: optimized for PlayStation 5 Pro (Nov 7, 2024); available on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One (Sep 17, 2024); PS4/Xbox One pre-orders news (Aug 6, 2024).

wikis.title: IGN review of Resident Evil 4 (2023 remake)
wikis.summary: IGN's review of Capcom's Resident Evil 4 remake, scoring it 10 and Editors' Choice.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer: Tristan Ogilvie. Score 10, Editors' Choice. Game initial release listed as Mar 24, 2023 (Capcom).
- About 16 hours of campaign; described as a remake of the 2005 original that "dramatically one-ups the original in almost every conceivable way", with more sinister Spanish countryside setting and tighter pacing.
- Modernised controls: simultaneous movement and aiming, instant weapon switching by D-pad, crouch and stealth, knife parry that takes durability damage and needs repair, quick-smash crates, new checkpoint saves. Difficulties: Assisted, Standard, Hardcore (recommended for returning players), unlockable Professional (no safety net).
- Enemy variety keeps changing (helmets, tendrils, regenerating mutations); many guns from SMGs to rocket launchers and magnums.
- Merchant: crafting recipes, optional side-quest bounties paid in spinel, generous weapon trade-in refunds, new bolt thrower; the review finds his personality diminished.
- Some modes from older versions (e.g. The Mercenaries) are missing, "scrapped or potentially saved for DLC".
- Verdict: "the most relentlessly exciting Resident Evil adventure of all time". Also quotes IGN's 2005 original review score of 9.8.

wikis.title: Capcom press release: Resident Evil 4 remake set for March 24, 2023
wikis.summary: Capcom's June 3, 2022 press release announcing the Resident Evil 4 remake for PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC on March 24, 2023.
wikis.body:
- Dated June 3, 2022, Capcom Co., Ltd. (Haruhiro Tsujimoto, President and COO).
- Resident Evil 4 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC is scheduled for March 24, 2023. Genre: survival horror.
- It is a remake of the original 2005 title; in addition to reworking the story it offers a fresh gameplay experience with visuals powered by Capcom's proprietary RE ENGINE.
- Series cumulative shipments exceed 125 million units since the first title in 1996 (as of March 31, 2022).
- Capcom will also bring Resident Evil Village (over 6.1 million units shipped globally) to PlayStation VR2 on PS5, including its story mode with advanced audio and visual technology.

wikis.title: Engadget: Resident Evil 4 remake lands March 24th, 2023
wikis.summary: Engadget report that Capcom's RE4 remake arrives March 24, 2023, with a PSVR2 version of Resident Evil Village also coming.
wikis.body:
- By Jessica Conditt, June 2, 2022. Remake of the 2005 game starring Leon S. Kennedy and Ashley Graham, for PS5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC via Steam on March 24th, 2023; trailer debuted during a PlayStation State of Play.
- Capcom producer on the PlayStation Blog: "We aim to make the game feel familiar to fans of the series, while also providing a fresh feeling to it", by reimagining the storyline, modernizing graphics and updating controls.
- Capcom teased RE4 content built for PlayStation VR 2, and is building a PSVR2 version of Resident Evil: Village (the entire PS5 version of the game). No release date yet for PSVR2 or the promised Village DLC.
- Capcom and Sony partnered to bring Resident Evil 7 to VR in 2017.

wikis.title: Final Fantasy XVI: overview, gameplay, setting and plot
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Square Enix's 2023 action RPG Final Fantasy XVI (part 1: overview, gameplay, setting, characters, plot).
wikis.body:
- Developed and published by Square Enix (Creative Business Unit III); producer Naoki Yoshida, directors Hiroshi Takai and Kazutoyo Maehiro (also writer), composer Masayoshi Soken, battle designer Ryota Suzuki.
- Released on PlayStation 5 June 22, 2023; Windows September 17, 2024 (page says September 2024); Xbox Series X/S June 8, 2025.
- Concept development began 2015; production and promotion affected by COVID-19 and the Russo-Ukrainian war. Praised for story, graphics, music, gameplay; criticized for lack of role-playing elements, technical issues and side quest design. Sold over three million units in its first week but "failed to meet Square Enix's expectations". DLC followed.

## Gameplay
- Action RPG with segmented open areas across Valisthea; Chocobo (Ambrosia) travel; hideout hub; Active Time Lore database.
- Clive is the only controllable character; AI companions incl. dog Torgal. Eikon abilities switched and chained; "Stagger" meter; Eikon battles. Story mode and normal mode at start; New Game+, "Final Fantasy" mode, arcade mode and Ultimaniac Mode after completion.

## Setting and plot
- Twin continents Ash and Storm, powered by Mothercrystals; Dominants host Eikons; Bearers face prejudice; the Blight depletes aether and drives war between nations (Rosaria, Sanbreque, Dhalmekia, Waloed, Crystalline Dominion, Iron Kingdom).
- Clive Rosfield, passed over when brother Joshua becomes Phoenix Dominant; allies Jill Warrick, Cidolfus Telamon (Ramuh); others Barnabas Tharmr (Odin), Benedikta Harman (Garuda), Hugo Kupka (Titan), Dion Lesage (Bahamut). Ifrit drives the main plot.

wikis.title: PlayStation Blog: Final Fantasy XVI releases June 22, 2023
wikis.summary: December 9, 2022 PlayStation Blog post announcing FFXVI's June 22, 2023 release, pre-orders, gameplay details and English cast.
wikis.body:
- By Sunil Godhania (Square Enix), December 9, 2022: FFXVI releases June 22, 2023; digital Standard and Deluxe edition pre-orders live on PlayStation Store.
- Set in Valisthea under the Mothercrystals with the Blight spreading; Clive Rosfield, "First Shield of Rosaria", sworn to protect brother Joshua, Dominant of Phoenix; Clive swears revenge on Dark Eikon Ifrit.
- Billed as "the first full-fledged Action RPG in the Final Fantasy series, designed for the PS5"; switch between Eikon skills, and control Eikons in battle.
- Accessibility: a Story-focused mode (auto-evade some attacks, combos by simple presses) and an Action-focused mode.
- Torgal can attack and heal; party members like Cidolfus Telamon (Ramuh Dominant) fight independently.
- English cast: Ben Starr (Clive), Logan Hannan (Joshua), Charlotte McBurney / Susannah Fielding (Jill), Ralph Ineson (Cid), Nina Yndis (Benedikta), Alex Lanipekun (Hugo), Stewart Clarke (Dion), David Menkin (Barnabas).

wikis.title: IGN review of Baldur's Gate 3
wikis.summary: IGN's review by Len Hafer of Larian's Baldur's Gate 3, calling it a new high-water mark for CRPGs.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer Len Hafer; updated Jan 31, 2024. Subtitle: "A new high-water mark for CRPGs with satisfying combat and excellent writing."
- Larian Studios sets it in the Forgotten Realms (Dungeons & Dragons); reviewer played 130-plus hours.
- Praises freedom (climbing, fire, axes on doors, winning a drinking contest with a Constitution check), up to four-player co-op online and couch, an excellent character creator, strong writing and voice work, turn-based combat, and choices that call back 80 hours later.
- Criticism: mild to moderate bugs and Act 3 performance issues even on an RTX 3080; four hotfixes since launch had addressed many.
- Verdict: a landmark for the genre; "the last time they all came together was Dragon Age: Origins in 2009".

wikis.title: PlayStation Blog: Baldur's Gate 3 launches on PS5 August 31
wikis.summary: Larian's February 23, 2023 PlayStation Blog post giving the PS5 launch date, co-op, cast and pre-order editions for Baldur's Gate 3.
wikis.body:
- By Swen Vincke (Larian Studios), February 23, 2023: Baldur's Gate 3 comes to PS5 on August 31, 2023.
- Cinematic RPG in the Forgotten Realms; mind flayers and a tadpole in your head; play a custom character or a handcrafted Origin character.
- Co-op: split-screen for up to two players on one PS5, or up to four online.
- JK Simmons voices General Ketheric Thorm, one of three main antagonists; two more to be introduced in coming months.
- Pre-order Collector's Edition or Deluxe Edition for 72-hours early access to Act I from August 28th. Collector's: Deluxe digital copy, sticker sheet, 25cm Mind Flayer vs. Drow diorama, 160-page art book, cloth map, origin character sheets, tadpole keyring, Magic: The Gathering booster, engraved metal d20. Deluxe: Bard Song Pack, dice skin, Adventurer's Pouch, digital soundtrack/artbook/character sheets, plus Divinity: Original Sin II-inspired items.

wikis.title: RPG Site: Baldur's Gate 3 launches August 31 for PS5 and PC
wikis.summary: RPG Site news (Feb 24, 2023) on Larian dating Baldur's Gate 3 for August 31, 2023 on PS5 and PC, with Ketheric Thorm, co-op and editions.
wikis.body:
- By Adam Vitale, 24 February, 2023. Larian announced at Sony's State of Play that Baldur's Gate 3 ships on PlayStation 5, PC (Steam) and Mac on Aug. 31, 2023.
- New trailer shows General Ketheric Thorm, "a seemingly invincible necromancer leading an army of the dead towards the eponymous city of Baldur's Gate", voiced by J.K. Simmons. Swen Vincke: two more antagonists will be introduced over the coming months.
- Split-screen co-op for up to two players on one PS5, or up to four online. Controller support shown; during Steam early access only mouse and keyboard were supported.
- Digital Deluxe and Collector's Editions can be pre-ordered on PS5; all PC early access players (including anyone buying before release) are automatically upgraded to the Deluxe Edition.

wikis.title: TechRadar: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 release date, gameplay and news
wikis.summary: TechRadar's post-launch (updated 16 October 2023) roundup of what was known about Marvel's Spider-Man 2 on PS5.
wikis.body:
- Last updated 16 October 2023 (by Jake Green and contributors). Game is by Insomniac Games; launched October 20, 2023 on PS5, sequel to Marvel's Spider-Man; the same day as Super Mario Bros. Wonder.
- PS5 exclusive, not coming to PS4 (confirmed by a PlayStation tweet). The page says it may reach PC later, "likely" not until at least a year after release, since Marvel's Spider-Man and Miles Morales are already on PC.
- Pre-orders went live June 16 for standard and digital deluxe editions.
- Latest trailer shown at Sony State of Play on September 14, 2023.
- Gameplay: Peter has the symbiote suit ("acrobatic improviser") with new combat abilities incl. a big slam; both Peter and Miles have wing suits chained with web-swinging; switching between the two.
- Setting: Manhattan, plus Queens and Brooklyn; Kraven, Venom and Harry Osborn hinted; Miles notices the symbiote suit changing Peter.

wikis.title: PlayStation Blog: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 arrives October 20, editions detailed
wikis.summary: Insomniac's June 8, 2023 PlayStation Blog post with the October 20, 2023 launch date, pre-order bonuses and edition prices.
wikis.body:
- By James Stevenson (Insomniac Games), June 8, 2023: launches Friday, October 20th, 2023, only on PlayStation 5. Pre-orders start June 16, 2023 at 10:00 AM local time.
- Play as Peter Parker and Miles Morales across Manhattan, Queens and Brooklyn; faster web swinging, web wings, 3D Audio, near-instant character switching; villains include Venom, Lizard and Kraven.
- Pre-order bonuses: Arachknight Suit (Peter), Shadow Spider Suit (Miles) with 3 color variants each, Web Grabber gadget, 3 skill points.
- Standard $69.99 / £69.99 / €79.99 / ¥8,980. Digital Deluxe $79.99 / £79.99 / €89.99 / ¥9,980 (10 guest-artist suits, photo mode items, 2 skill points). Collector's Edition $229.99 / £219.99 / €249.99 / ¥31,980 (Digital Deluxe voucher, Steelbook, 19-inch Spider-Men vs. Venom statue).

wikis.title: Sony press release: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 launches worldwide only on PS5
wikis.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment's October 20, 2023 launch press release for Marvel's Spider-Man 2.
wikis.body:
- October 20, 2023: SIE launches Marvel's Spider-Man 2, developed by Insomniac Games, "built from the ground up" for PS5, with two playable Spider-Men (Peter Parker and Miles Morales), Venom as threat.
- Quotes: Hermen Hulst (Head of PlayStation Studios) calls it Insomniac's fourth PS5 title within the first three years of the console; Jay Ong (Marvel Games); Ted Price (CEO, Insomniac).
- PS5 features: DualSense haptics and adaptive triggers, ultra high-speed SSD for near-instant character switching and Web Wing traversal, Tempest 3D AudioTech.
- Limited edition PS5 bundle sold via PlayStation direct: console with limited edition covers, DualSense controller, and digital game voucher.

wikis.title: CNN Underscored: the 25 best video games of 2022
wikis.summary: CNN Underscored roundup (updated December 13, 2022) of its 25 picks for best games of 2022 across platforms.
wikis.body:
By Ural Garrett, updated Dec 13, 2022. Picks span Sony first-party (God of War Ragnarok, Horizon Forbidden West, Gran Turismo 7), Microsoft (As Dusk Falls), Nintendo (Bayonetta 3, Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope, Splatoon 3, Pokemon Scarlet and Violet) and third-party titles. Prices quoted are retail links (e.g. $70 or $60).

Other picks: Elden Ring; Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (best single-player in the series in some time); Need for Speed Unbound (Criterion, a return to form); The Callisto Protocol (Krafton, directed by Glen Schofield, polarizing reception); TMNT: Shredder's Revenge (Dotemu); Marvel Snap (free, Second Dinner); Marvel's Midnight Suns (2K, Firaxis); The Quarry (2K, Supermassive); Multiversus (WB Games, free); Stray (BlueTwelve Studio/Annapurna); A Plague Tale: Requiem; Somerville (Jumpship); Sifu (Sloclap, easier mode added by patch); and further titles.

wikis.title: God of War Ragnarok
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: Sony's sequel, $70 at GameStop.
wikis.body: Considerably longer than its predecessor with upgraded combat and traversal; the story wraps up the Norse mythology arc "exceptionally well". PlayStation.

wikis.title: Horizon Forbidden West
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: the Horizon Zero Dawn sequel.
wikis.body: Western setting, keeps what players loved about the original and adds underwater traversal and combat. Listed $70, discounted $40 at GameStop.

wikis.title: Elden Ring
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: From Software and George R. R. Martin collaboration.
wikis.body: Sold nearly 18 million copies and became the fastest-selling game for publisher Bandai Namco; brings the Dark Souls formula to a more mainstream audience with an open world. $60 ($53 at Amazon).

wikis.title: As Dusk Falls
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: Xbox interactive drama by Interior Night.
wikis.body: Team of Quantic Dream veterans; story of two interwoven families in which decisions shape the narrative; couch co-op or Twitch-viewer multiplayer. $30 at Best Buy, included in Xbox Game Pass.

wikis.title: Gran Turismo 7
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: Polyphony Digital racing simulator on PS4 and PS5.
wikis.body: PS5 version has real-time ray tracing, 4K native and 60 fps; dynamic time and weather return; even single-player needs an internet connection. $70 ($40 at Amazon).

wikis.title: Bayonetta 3
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: Platinum Games hack-'n'-slash on Nintendo Switch.
wikis.body: Summon infernal demons; multiple playable characters including Viola and Jeanne. $60 ($54 at Amazon).

wikis.title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: first fully 3D Kirby.
wikis.body: Upgradable copy abilities, local co-op and the "Mouthful Mode". $60 at Amazon.

wikis.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2
wikis.summary: CNN's pick: Activision's 2022 shooter.
wikis.body: Best single-player in the series in some time, tight multiplayer, strong audio/visual presentation. $70 at Amazon.

wikis.title: IGN review of God of War Ragnarok
wikis.summary: IGN's review by Simon Cardy of Sony Santa Monica's God of War Ragnarok (updated Nov 19, 2022), rated 10 Editors' Choice.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer Simon Cardy; Score 10, Editors' Choice. Initial release Nov 9, 2022 (Santa Monica Studio).
- Compares the sequel to The Godfather Part II; says it "manages to reach the heights of its predecessor and, in some ways, even tower above it". Writing, performances and music exceptional; combat "fantastically ferocious".
- Story picks up a few years after 2018's God of War, during Fimbulwinter, centered on Atreus (learning his Giant name "Loki") and Kratos; leaves Midgard to find a missing Norse god. Reviewer's playthrough took just over 28 hours with a few side quests.
- Side content: Favours, Vanaheim jungles, legendary enemies and tough side bosses, collectibles (Odin's Ravens, puzzle chests, artifacts); "joyously snackable".
- Verdict: "an enthralling spectacle" and "an almighty achievement".

wikis.title: PlayStation Blog: God of War Ragnarok launches November 9 with new CG trailer
wikis.summary: July 6, 2022 PlayStation Blog post giving God of War Ragnarok's November 9, 2022 release date.
wikis.body:
- By Grace Orlady (Santa Monica Studio), July 6, 2022: God of War Ragnarök is coming to PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 on November 9, 2022.
- New "Father and Son" CG trailer showing Kratos and Atreus facing mounting dangers.
- Pre-orders go live that day; an unboxing of the Collector's Editions with Thor actor Ryan Hurst and art director Rafael Grassetti is offered; editions detailed in a separate blog post.

wikis.title: MobileSyrup: God of War Ragnarok release date November 9, 2022
wikis.summary: MobileSyrup report (July 6, 2022) that God of War Ragnarok launches on PS4 and PS5 on November 9, 2022.
wikis.body:
- By Bradly Shankar, Jul 6, 2022: release date confirmed in a PlayStation Blog post with a brief CG trailer; PS4 and PS5.
- Sequel to 2018's God of War, unveiled September 2020 for a 2021 launch, later delayed to 2022; reports had indicated a November drop. The article notes some fans had been harassing Sony Santa Monica developers for the date.
- PlayStation also unveiled special editions.

wikis.title: IGN review of Horizon Forbidden West
wikis.summary: IGN's review by Simon Cardy (updated Jul 12, 2024) of Guerrilla's Horizon Forbidden West.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer Simon Cardy; subtitle "Rage against the machines." Playthrough of about 32 hours including a healthy amount of side missions.
- Builds on Horizon Zero Dawn (2017): explosive combat against robotic foes, Witcher-like settlements, strong side quests, lore to uncover. Aloy is a combination of human and synthetic life.
- Activities: rebel camps, collectibles, arenas, Tallnecks, Cauldrons (override machines), new Relic Ruins puzzles, and Machine Strike, a strategy board game compared to Gwent and Orlog; random world events.
- Verdict: "A triumphant combination of enthralling combat, top-tier creature and character design, and a captivating open world"; falls "frustratingly short of something revolutionary" given returning series trappings and a lack of freeform climbing.
- PC Complete Edition listed at $59.99 at Humble.

wikis.title: Horizon Forbidden West: overview and gameplay (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Guerrilla Games' 2022 action RPG Horizon Forbidden West, its development, release and gameplay.
wikis.body:
- Developed by Guerrilla Games, published by Sony Interactive Entertainment; director Mathijs de Jonge; Decima engine. Sequel to Horizon Zero Dawn (2017), set in a post-apocalyptic Western United States; Aloy investigates a plague.
- Development began 2018, peaking at over 300 full-time employees and costing around US$212 million. Ashly Burch and Lance Reddick returned as Aloy and Sylens; Angela Bassett and Carrie-Anne Moss joined.
- Announced June 2020; released 18 February 2022 on PS4 and PS5; Windows 21 March 2024 (ported by Nixxes). Burning Shores expansion April 2023; Complete Edition on PS5 October 2023. A sequel is in development.
- Reception: generally positive, praising visuals, combat, quest design and cast; criticized story and Aloy's characterization; "evolutionary" rather than "revolutionary". Sold over 8.4 million units by April 2023. Nominated for Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2022 and the 26th D.I.C.E. Awards.
- Gameplay: bows, new Shredder Gauntlet, traps and tripwires, tethering, ammo types, Focus scanning, detaching machine parts, spear melee, stealth, underwater exploration and new traversal tools.

wikis.title: PlayStation Blog: Horizon Forbidden West arrives February 18, 2022
wikis.summary: Guerrilla's August 25, 2021 post dating Horizon Forbidden West for February 18, 2022, with pre-orders and a Zero Dawn PS5 60fps patch.
wikis.body:
- By Mathijs de Jonge (Game Director, Guerrilla), August 25, 2021: the game comes to PS4 and PS5 on February 18, 2022; pre-orders start September 2, 2021.
- Moving the launch to 2022 "wasn't easy"; teams were "hugely impacted by the global pandemic". Earlier State of Play showed swimming, free climbing and expanded melee combat.
- An Enhanced Performance Patch for Horizon Zero Dawn on PS5, targeting 60 FPS, is live as a free update.

wikis.title: IGN review of Elden Ring
wikis.summary: IGN's review by Mitchell Saltzman (updated May 27, 2025) of FromSoftware's Elden Ring.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer Mitchell Saltzman; 87 hours to beat the game. Updates: Shadow of the Erdtree review (June 18, 2024); Elden Ring won IGN's Game of the Year Award for 2022 (December 7, 2022). Initial release Feb 25, 2022.
- Player is a "Tarnished" heading to The Lands Between to become an Elden Lord; story credits George R.R. Martin as scenario writer, but side stories were most engaging; no in-game journal, no map markers.
- Open world inspired by Breath of the Wild with a Dark Souls game woven in; difficulty about learning enemy patterns; some late bosses near the line of fairness (second phases, multi-enemy fights).
- Verdict: FromSoftware's "largest and most ambitious game yet"; "among the best open-world games", one that "moved a genre forward". PS5 listed $59.99 at Amazon.

wikis.title: Polygon review of Elden Ring
wikis.summary: Polygon's review (Feb 23, 2022) by Michael McWhertor calling Elden Ring FromSoftware's best, most approachable and most difficult game.
wikis.body:
- By Michael McWhertor, Published Feb 23, 2022. Headline: "Elden Ring is FromSoftware's best, most approachable, and difficult game yet"; awarded Polygon Recommends. Reviewed on PS5 with a Bandai Namco download code; game released Feb. 25 on PS4, PS5, Windows PC, Xbox One and Xbox Series X.
- Sees Breath of the Wild's influence; quotes director Hidetaka Miyazaki: "I feel deeply unworthy of the comparison" with Zelda.
- Open world of the Lands Between: on-screen map, Torrent the steed, Sites of Grace fast travel, castles/dungeons/catacombs, no strict quest directives; tools include summons (ghostly wolves, spirit ashes), Roundtable Hold hub, crafting, many weapons and spells.
- Difficulty remains high (Margit the Fell Omen, Tree Sentinel); reviewer was 45 hours in with three major bosses beaten. Story opaque; George R.R. Martin contributed to the lore but did little to change how From tells stories.

wikis.title: Eurogamer review of Elden Ring
wikis.summary: Eurogamer's review by Aoife Wilson (Feb 25, 2022) of Elden Ring's open world and added accessibility tools.
wikis.body:
- Review by Aoife Wilson, updated Feb. 25, 2022; played on PS5; out 25th February on PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S and PC. Publisher/developer FromSoftware, Bandai Namco.
- "Grandiose, mysterious, but now a touch more welcoming": the studio's biggest open world, with optional aids for newcomers: Spirit Summons, flask refills after clearing a group, Stakes of Marika for reviving, Great Runes, freely swappable Ashes of War, early fast travel between Sites of Grace.
- Legacy dungeons and smaller dungeons; striking environmental storytelling.
- Criticisms: crafting largely unnecessary for the reviewer's spellsword Prisoner class; George R.R. Martin's marketing role is "rather baffling" as his contribution is unclear.
- Verdict: "a glorious game" that "may just welcome new fans into the FromSoft fold".

wikis.title: IGN review of As Dusk Falls
wikis.summary: IGN's review by Gabriel Moss (updated Jul 18, 2022) of Interior Night's interactive graphic novel As Dusk Falls, scored 9 Editors' Choice.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer Gabriel Moss; score 9, Editors' Choice; initial release Jul 19, 2022 (Interior Night).
- Choose-your-own-adventure graphic novel set in Two Rock, Arizona; a heist by three brothers collides with a family at the Desert Dream Motel; protagonists include Jay and Vince. Voice cast includes Elias Toufexis and Jane Perry.
- Orange-hued painterly art style compared to Breaking Bad and Disco Elysium; six-hour campaign meant to be replayed; choices cascade; skeleton of the plot stays consistent.
- Up to eight-player mode where everyone votes on decisions (phones can be used), making it "much more of a party game than any other visual novel to date".
- Verdict: "a masterwork of branching storytelling where decisions matter".

wikis.title: Xbox Wire: As Dusk Falls is available now
wikis.summary: Xbox Wire post (July 19, 2022) on As Dusk Falls' launch platforms, multiplayer modes and Companion App.
wikis.body:
- July 19, 2022: As Dusk Falls launches for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Windows, Steam) with Xbox Game Pass and PC Game Pass, and on Xbox One and supported phones, tablets and lower-spec PCs via Xbox Cloud Gaming.
- Interactive crime drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT, inspired by prestige TV; the Walker and Holt families; choices in hostage negotiation, robbery, family conflict.
- Modes: Solo; Multiplayer (lobbies up to eight players, online, couch or mixed, cross-platform, majority vote wins); Broadcast (streamer's Twitch chat votes, tallied in real time).
- Free As Dusk Falls Companion App for iOS and Android works as an input device (swipe); needs the same Wi-Fi and the host must own the game.

wikis.title: IGN: As Dusk Falls release date revealed
wikis.summary: IGN news (Jun 12, 2022) that As Dusk Falls will release July 19, 2022.
wikis.body:
- By Tom Marks, updated Jun 12, 2022. Interior/Night's first game, As Dusk Falls, is set for July 19, shown at Xbox's showcase.
- A branching story-driven game playable solo or co-op with up to eight players; the developer describes it as written in the style of a prestige television show with a painterly art style.
- Originally revealed by Microsoft in 2020 alongside the formation of Interior/Night as an Xbox Game Studio led by Caroline Marchal, previously a lead game designer at Quantic Dream.

wikis.title: IGN review of Gran Turismo 7
wikis.summary: IGN's review by Luke Reilly (updated Mar 7, 2022) of Polyphony Digital's Gran Turismo 7, scored 9 Editors' Choice.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer Luke Reilly; score 9, Editors' Choice; initial release Mar 4, 2022 (Polyphony Digital); PS5 with DualSense haptics.
- "the most welcoming GT ever": the Gran Turismo Cafe hub assigns tasks via 39 "menu books" that introduce licences, buying cars and customisation, awarding reward cars.
- Criticisms: expensive upgrades; microtransaction credit packs (100,000 credits US$2.50; 250,000 US$5; 750,000 US$10; 2,000,000 US$20), a 3,640,000-credit Lamborghini Veneno would need US$40 versus US$5 in GT Sport; flawed rolling starts; car list smaller than rivals; always-online single-player (only Music Rally and a small arcade mode work offline); Music Rally songs disappointing.
- Verdict: "the best the series has been since its dominant PlayStation 2 era" with gorgeous graphics and fantastic driving feel.

wikis.title: IGN: Gran Turismo 7 delayed into 2022
wikis.summary: IGN news (Feb 23, 2021) that Sony delayed Gran Turismo 7 from 2021 to 2022 due to Covid-related production challenges.
wikis.body:
- By Jonathon Dornbush, Feb 23, 2021. Sony statement to GQ, confirmed to IGN: "GT7 has been impacted by Covid-related production challenges and therefore will shift from 2021 to 2022." Some critical aspects of production had slowed over recent months; more specifics on the release date to come.
- GT7 was announced at the June (2020) PS5 reveal showcase; word of a potential early 2021 window had appeared late the prior year. The last entry, Gran Turismo Sport, debuted in 2017 and has been supported by Polyphony Digital since.
- Page also lists an initial release of Mar 4, 2022.

wikis.title: GTPlanet: Gran Turismo 7 release date is March 4 2022
wikis.summary: GTPlanet news (Sep 9, 2021) that Gran Turismo 7 launches March 4, 2022 on both PS4 and PS5.
wikis.body:
- By Andrew Evans, Sep 9, 2021. Release date revealed in a new trailer at the PlayStation Showcase on September 9; first look at the game in just over a year after the reveal in June 2020.
- Launch on both PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 on March 4, 2022, less than six months out. The game was initially announced as a PS5 exclusive; after confused messaging, SIE president and CEO Jim Ryan confirmed a PS4 version the prior weekend.
- Theme: "a combination of the past, present and future" of Gran Turismo. It is not known how the two versions will differ.
- Rest of the page is reader comments (not recorded).

wikis.title: IGN review of Bayonetta 3
wikis.summary: IGN's review by Mitchell Saltzman (updated Oct 29, 2022) of PlatinumGames' Bayonetta 3 on Switch, scored 9 Editors' Choice.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer Mitchell Saltzman; score 9, Editors' Choice; reviewed on Nintendo Switch; initial release Oct 28, 2022 (PlatinumGames).
- Campaign of 10 to 12 hours; combat system ranked among the top five or so of all time; new Demon Slave summoning system and changed weapon mechanics reinvigorate its 13-year-old combat.
- Story is largely standalone but "the weakest of the trilogy": a mysterious villain's motives never pay off. Viola is a highlight as the second playable character.
- Performance on Switch "decidedly not great" with environments a generation behind, though 60fps mostly holds in combat. Jennifer Hale voices Bayonetta in place of Hellena Taylor.
- Verdict: "a far more ambitious sequel than its more iterative predecessor, and that ambition more than pays off."

wikis.title: Siliconera: Bayonetta 3 release date set for October 2022
wikis.summary: Siliconera news (July 13, 2022) that Bayonetta 3 launches October 28, 2022 on Nintendo Switch, with Naive Angel Mode.
wikis.body:
- By Josh Tolentino, July 13, 2022. Nintendo and PlatinumGames confirmed October 28, 2022, exclusively on Nintendo Switch; previously only a 2022 window.
- Release date trailer shows Bayonetta, Jeanne, Luka and Rodin, plus new apprentice witch Viola (katana, slashes that seem able to summon a monstrous cat). Bayonetta can use Demon Masquerade to summon giant monsters.
- An optional "Naive Angel Mode" subtly alters outfits and designs to cut down visible nudity.

wikis.title: Game Rant: Bayonetta 3 release date revealed in new trailer
wikis.summary: Game Rant (Jul 13, 2022) on the October 28, 2022 Switch launch date, trailer and Trinity Masquerade Edition.
wikis.body:
- By Daire Behan, Published Jul 13, 2022. Bayonetta 3 launches October 28, 2022, exclusively on Switch.
- Announced almost five years earlier at The Game Awards 2017; earlier games came to Switch in February 2018; in September 2021 it was said to release in 2022 with kaiju-like Infernal Demon battles and a redesigned Bayonetta. It had no-showed at the June 2022 Nintendo Direct Mini: Partner Showcase.
- Trailer shows Jeanne, Rodan (as spelled) and Luca, and new playable Viola, a witch in training under Bayonetta; areas seemingly based on Tokyo and China.
- "Trinity Masquerade Edition" adds special sleeve art for Bayonetta 3 and the Switch releases of Bayonetta and Bayonetta 2 (the first getting a limited physical release) and a 200-page art book.

wikis.title: IGN review: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
wikis.summary: Tom Marks' IGN review of Kirby and the Forgotten Land, HAL Laboratory's 3D platformer, rated "great".
wikis.body:
- Reviewer: Tom Marks, IGN; updated Mar 24, 2022. Game: Kirby and the Forgotten Land, developer HAL Laboratory, initial release Mar 25, 2022.
- Verdict: "successfully warps the series' already fun mix of ability-based combat, platforming, and secret hunting into the third dimension." Review scoring label: "great".
- Setup: a wormhole opens above Dream Land and Kirby lands in the ruins of a seemingly human society; Waddle Dees are kidnapped by monsters and Kirby rescues them to rebuild their town. Compared by others to Mario's perspective shift in Super Mario 3D World.
- Gameplay: linear levels, copy abilities (about a dozen), secrets, optional Waddle Dees; town buildings unlock item buffs, ability upgrades and minigames like fishing.
- "Mouthful" abilities (car, vending machine, etc.) are praised as entertaining. Treasure Road challenges between levels give stars and coins; blueprints unlock upgraded abilities bought with stars and coins.
- Difficulty: not very challenging even on "Wild Mode"; reviewer died once or twice in a roughly 10-hour playthrough.
- Criticisms: post-apocalyptic setting not as thrilling as Planet Popstar; occasional unclear secret paths or invisible walls; co-op is a letdown (player two is only Bandana Waddle Dee with a spear and no abilities; camera focuses on Kirby only).

wikis.title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on HAL Laboratory's 2022 3D Kirby platformer: gameplay, plot, development, reception, sales and awards.
wikis.body:
## Overview
- 2022 platform game by HAL Laboratory, published by Nintendo for Nintendo Switch; released March 25, 2022. Thirteenth mainline Kirby game, second on Switch, first non-spinoff Kirby game in full 3D. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World released August 28, 2025. Next 3D Kirby game, Kirby and the World Beyond, "is scheduled for release on the Switch 2 in Spring 2027."
- Directors Shinya Kumazaki and Tatsuya Kamiyama; Vanpool assisted development.

## Gameplay
- Kirby rescues Waddle Dees kidnapped by the Beast Pack; new copy abilities Drill and Ranger; "Mouthful Mode" lets Kirby swallow and control large objects such as cars and vending machines. Second player can be Bandana Waddle Dee (spear).
- Abilities are upgraded at Waddle Dee's Weapons Shop in Waddle Dee Town using Rare Stones from Treasure Road levels. The town grows as Waddle Dees are rescued, unlocking minigames (fishing, Waddle Dee Café part-time job, a puzzle game). Amiibo supported.

## Plot
- A dark vortex over Dream Land pulls Kirby into a world of ancient ruins; he meets Elfilin, fights a hypnotised King Dedede, and learns of the extraterrestrial ID-F86, split into Elfilin and Fecto Forgo, who used the Beast Pack (led by Leongar) to resume an invasion. Kirby defeats Fecto Elfilis, then in the post-game faces Morpho Knight and Chaos Elfilis.
- Star-Crossed World: a meteor, the Star of Darkness, holds a sealed evil; Kirby gathers Starries and defeats Genwel Meteonelfilis.

## Development
- HAL began teasing a new Kirby game in 2020. 3D was "very challenging" after several failed attempts back to the 2000s; Kamiyama's detailed pitch let development begin. Hit detection was altered so attacks hit if they look like they connect.
- Revealed at the Nintendo Direct on September 23, 2021 (shown on Nintendo's website six hours early); second trailer January 12, 2022 with the March 25, 2022 date; free demo March 3, 2022. Switch 2 Edition announced April 2025.

## Reception and sales
- Metacritic 85/100 (Switch), 83/100 (Switch 2); OpenCritic 94% recommended (Switch). Scores include IGN 8/10, GameSpot 9/10, Nintendo Life 9/10, Game Informer 9/10, Famitsu 36/40. Minor criticism: limited or "sluggish" movement and repetitive mini-bosses.
- #1 in UK and Japan at launch (380,060 copies in two days in Japan); 2.1 million units in two weeks; 7.52 million copies worldwide as of March 31, 2024, best-selling in the series.
- Awards: Japan Game Awards 2022 Award for Excellence (won); Golden Joystick Nintendo Game of the Year (nominated); The Game Awards 2022 Best Family Game (won); 2023 New York Game Awards Best Kids Game (won); 19th British Academy Games Awards Family Game (won); CEDEC Engineering Award (won).

wikis.title: Nintendo Life review: Kirby and the Forgotten Land (Switch)
wikis.summary: PJ O'Reilly's Nintendo Life review calling Kirby and the Forgotten Land a breezy, inventive first fully 3D mainline Kirby.
wikis.body:
- Review by PJ O'Reilly (European version), Wed 23rd Mar 2022. Headline: "A Breezy Delight With Mario-Level Invention".
- First fully 3D mainline Kirby, marking 30 years of the series. "100% aimed at younger gamers"; not particularly challenging but "endearing and highly replayable". Uses tightly designed play boxes like Super Mario 3D World rather than open worlds like Super Mario Odyssey.
- Copy abilities carry over with new variants and are upgradeable with power stones from side missions; Mouthful Mode is "as funny, daft and delightful" as in trailers.
- Each level has five missions (rescue all Waddle Dees, eat doughnuts, boss with a certain weapon, etc.); a set number of Waddle Dees unlocks each world's final stage. Side missions in space/time tears are the tougher content, with time records.
- Hub Waddle Dee Town gains a cinema, weapons shop, Kirby's house, item store, minigames (Flash Fishing) and a Colosseum.
- Visuals and performance: near-perfect in docked and handheld modes with minor frame rate wobbles; named worlds include Natural Plains and Everbay Coast; orchestral score praised.
- Judged the best the series has been since Kirby: Planet Robobot, after the "somewhat disappointingly safe Kirby Star Allies". Also praises seamless co-op.

wikis.title: PC Gamer review: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2022)
wikis.summary: Morgan Park's PC Gamer review (score 83) praising Modern Warfare 2's gunplay while criticising its Gunsmith progression, UI and bugs.
wikis.body:
- Review by Morgan Park, published 3 November 2022; score 83. Verdict: "Modern Warfare 2 sets a new bar for Call of Duty all over again."
- Facts: developer Infinity Ward, publisher Activision Blizzard, released October 28, 2022; $70/£65; up to 64 players; reviewed on RTX 3060, Ryzen 7 5700G, 16GB RAM; about 88 GB install noted by reviewer.
- Praise: gunplay ("the new bar"); simulated ballistics that behave like lasers on short-sightline maps but require leading shots in 64-player Ground War; hit latency measured by frame counting at 2-3 frames vs 5-7 for Cold War; detailed reload animations and audio (Basilisk revolver has three reloads).
- Movement is the slowest in recent CoD; slide canceling and bunnyhopping removed; minimap no longer shows red dots when shots are fired; reviewer sees it as more tactical. Drill Charge throwable is a favourite. Still wishes killstreaks were removed and complains of the omnipresent UAV.
- Criticism: revamped Gunsmith progression makes guns and 100+ attachments unlock through byzantine chains (e.g. the SZ Mini via Lachmann SMG levels 11, 12, 13); obtuse UI; fits of crashes; weird bugs; "unexplained absence of basic features like stat tracking"; a genre-bending campaign called less elegant.
- Overall: "altogether, it's a good year for Call of Duty." Described as a precursor to Warzone 2.0.

wikis.title: IGN review: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 single-player campaign
wikis.summary: Matt Purslow's IGN campaign review (score 6, okay) calling Modern Warfare 2's six-hour campaign an underwhelming, overly familiar sequel.
wikis.body:
- Review by Matt Purslow, updated Nov 5, 2022; score 6 ("okay"). Campaign only; multiplayer reviewed separately (Seth G. Macy scored it 8, dated November 1, 2022). Game released Oct 28, 2022 by Infinity Ward.
- Verdict: "an unfortunate misfire" that fails to live up to the 2009 namesake and 2019 predecessor; "a lackluster follow-up" that is "already fading in my memory".
- About six hours, mostly set in Mexico with the Las Almas drug cartel; plot involves an Iranian arms deal, stolen US missiles and multiple special forces. Story called paper-thin, predictable within 30 minutes, "less Kathryn Bigelow and more Michael Bay".
- Praise: graphics (Amsterdam level highlighted), top-shelf gunplay and audio feedback, sniper and assault rifles.
