- Criticism: armored bullet-sponge enemies; missions echo past ones (Death From Above, Crew Expendable, All Ghillied Up, Clean House); "Alone" stealth level (40 minutes, injured slow walking) undermined; unwieldy car chase; novelty mechanics (Recon By Fire backpack, armor plates) used briefly.
- Bugs: texture pop-in and low-res water on PS5; a save corruption bug at the last checkpoint caused hard crashes, forcing a mission replay.

wikis.title: PCMag review: Need for Speed Unbound (PC)
wikis.summary: Zackery Cuevas' PCMag review (3.0 average) of Need for Speed Unbound on PC: beautiful and well scored, but frustrating handling and AI.
wikis.body:
- Review by Zackery Cuevas, January 10, 2023; rating 3.0 average; MSRP $69.99. Platforms PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S; racing, ESRB T.
- Bottom line: "a beautiful street racing game that features a cool soundtrack and welcome cross-platform play, but frustrating car physics and CPU drivers sully the experience."
- Pros: great graphics, smooth 60 fps, online crossplay between PC, PlayStation and Xbox, excellent soundtrack. Cons: annoying AI, driving physics and handling don't feel good, cel-shaded art style clashes with realistic cars, expensive customization doesn't transfer to online modes.
- Set in Lakeshore City, a fictionalized Chicago; day-and-night cycle changes each time you enter a hideout; city feels somewhat empty. Story: you and Yaz work at Rydell's mechanic shop; Yaz steals the cars; two years later you enter The Grand, run by Yaz.
- Heat meter: more heat means more aggressive police, gained by racing several times in a night and reset when cash is banked at a hideout. Crossplay allows only cop chases; online and local progression are separate; more than 10,000 customization options bought with in-game cash.
- Soundtrack includes A$AP Rocky, Charli XCX, Diplo, PlayBoi Carti. Car damage from crashes is minimal.
- PC requirements minimum: Ryzen 5 2600 or Core i5-8660, RX570 or GTX 1050 Ti, 8GB RAM, 50GB, Windows 10; recommended Ryzen 5 3600 or i7-8700, RX5700 or GeForce 2070, 16GB. Testbed (i7-10700K, RTX 3060, 16GB) ran 60 fps at 1440p. No official Steam Deck support.
- Suggests waiting for a price cut; Forza Horizon 5 is the top pick for hybrid arcade/sim.

wikis.title: Engadget: Need for Speed Unbound revealed for December 2nd
wikis.summary: Engadget's Oct. 6, 2022 news item on Need for Speed Unbound, its street-art style, A$AP Rocky and December 2nd release.
wikis.body:
- By Jon Fingas, Oct. 6, 2022. Criterion and EA reveal Need for Speed Unbound, first series entry since 2019's Need for Speed Heat.
- Mixes street art (cel-shaded graphics, graffiti flourishes) with realistic-looking cars; promises "true consequence[s]" for decisions.
- Story: a new racer must rise in a street racing league to recover a "priceless" car stolen from a family auto shop.
- A$AP Rocky leads the Takeover Scene, a "precision driving" mode rewarding style; his music and other hip-hop artists feature; trailer hints at his custom Mercedes 190E.
- Police "heat" returns; nitrous boosts for stylish driving; virtual-currency customization including clothing and license plates; free updates with new features, modes and content.
- Available December 2nd for PS5, Xbox Series X/S and PC; no PS4 or Xbox One version.

wikis.title: Polygon: Need for Speed Unbound announced for PS5, PC, Xbox Series X
wikis.summary: Polygon's Oct. 6, 2022 announcement report on Need for Speed Unbound: Lakeshore setting, Dec. 2 launch, prices and development background.
wikis.body:
- By Michael McWhertor & Owen S. Good, Oct 6, 2022. EA announced Need for Speed Unbound for PlayStation 5, Windows PC and Xbox Series X, launching Dec. 2.
- New open-world city Lakeshore; heavily stylized look with graffiti-inspired visual and sound effects; promises 4K, 60 fps; offline single-player campaign and online cross-platform multiplayer.
- Heat/police system: "big rewards or even bigger consequences for getting busted." Hundreds of cosmetic items including licensed gear.
- Music and creative input from A$AP Rocky and his AWGE agency; he leads the Takeover Scene faction with a replayable "precision driving mode" emphasizing style over speed and a territory-claiming mechanic.
- Prices: $69.99 standard; $79.99 "Palace Edition" (Palace Skateboards) with four custom cars, clothing pack, driving effect, decals and license plate, character pose and banner art.
- Developer Criterion Games (includes Codemasters Cheshire, acquired by EA in 2021). Originally envisioned for a 2021 launch until Criterion was assigned to support EA DICE on Battlefield 2042. The franchise returned to Criterion after 2019's Need for Speed: Heat, the last of three Ghost Games titles.

wikis.title: IGN review: The Callisto Protocol
wikis.summary: Tristan Ogilvie's IGN review (7, good) of The Callisto Protocol, a gory Dead Space spiritual successor that lacks innovation.
wikis.body:
- Review by Tristan Ogilvie, updated Jun 25, 2024; score 7 ("good"). Developer Striking Distance Studios; initial release Dec 2, 2022.
- Verdict: "a satisfyingly gory spiritual successor to the Dead Space series, but it's ultimately more of a striking modern mimic than a scary new mutation." Roughly eight hours; linear.
- Premise: convicts at Black Iron Prison on Jupiter's moon Callisto are mutated by a virus; wrongly incarcerated cargo pilot Jacob Lee (Josh Duhamel) with Dani Nakamura (Karen Fukuhara) tries to escape.
- Praise: art direction, audio design, detailed gore, creepy corridors; melee combat with stun baton and dodging feels weighty; "skill shots" after combos.
- Criticism: effectively "a Dead Space game in everything but name" (studio led by Dead Space co-creator Glen Schofield); the GRP telekinesis glove makes the player too powerful and deflates tension even on "maximum security" difficulty; auto-pickup from chests, audio logs playable only in menus, repeated facehugger jump scares; little to do after the story, New Game+ "apparently coming via a free patch".

wikis.title: GamesRadar+ review: The Callisto Protocol
wikis.summary: Leon Hurley's GamesRadar+ review: a gorgeous sci-fi horror game derailed by unforgiving combat.
wikis.body:
- Review by Leon Hurley, published 2 December 2022. Headline verdict: "An impressive game derailed by unforgiving combat"; cons: "Horrible combat"; pros: looks incredible, great sci-fi world building.
- Fast facts: released December 2, 2022; PS5, PS4, PC, Xbox Series X, Xbox One; developer Striking Distance Studios; publisher Krafton. Reviewed on PS5 with publisher code.
- Praise: visuals, lighting shifts (blood-red areas, oxygen processing forest), sound design (monsters trackable in vents), decent story: a cargo pilot crash lands on Callisto with the terrorist who sabotaged the ship.
- Criticism: combat works against single enemies (dodge by holding left or right, stun baton) but fails against several; slow movement and looking around; death animations that cannot be skipped; reviewer felt he "lucked or cheesed" encounters (e.g. shooting legs, memorizing 16 monster spawns on a tram ride). Mini boss with insta-kill attacks singled out.
- Recommends playing on easy; would still like to see a sequel.

wikis.title: PCGamesN review: The Callisto Protocol
wikis.summary: Nat Smith's PCGamesN review calling The Callisto Protocol a fun homage to Dead Space and other horror games, let down by a predictable plot.
wikis.body:
- Review by Nat Smith, published December 2, 2022. Verdict: "A spiritual successor to Dead Space that blends and riffs on ideas from the best horror games of recent years, with plenty of blood and guts to go around, though a lacklustre plot is its one minor flaw."
- First game of Striking Distance Studios, with Glen Schofield at the helm. Third-person sci-fi action horror with diegetic health bars and kinetic powers; nods to Amnesia: The Dark Descent and a blind, sound-tracking foe.
- Playful tone: gory, self-aware death animations; photo mode; headphones recommended for the soundscape; enemies can be pinpointed through vents.
- Combat: close quarters, cinematic camera; no timing window for dodging; stun baton the only melee weapon; hand cannon compared to Dead Space's plasma cutter; biophage tentacles must be shot before mutation into a stronger form; GRP glove works like Dead Space's kinesis and can drag supplies or fling enemies into a meat grinder.
- Balances horror and action, shifting toward action in the third act. Narrative is "paint-by-numbers", predictable and echoes Dead Space. Repeated blood graffiti breaks immersion.

wikis.title: IGN review: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
wikis.summary: Mitchell Saltzman's IGN review (8, great) of Tribute Games' 90s-style TMNT beat-em-up.
wikis.body:
- Review by Mitchell Saltzman, updated Jun 16, 2022; score 8 ("great"). Developer Tribute Games; initial release Jun 16, 2022.
- Verdict: "more than lives up to the legacy of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles arcade games"; fun, simple gameplay, "excellent coop for up to six players online", charming pixel art.
- Reverent to the 1989 arcade game and 1991's Turtles in Time, but adds dodge rolls, chargeable attacks that resist flinching, a rising attack, and a super-attack meter (fills by hitting, resets on damage, stored when full).
- 16 levels, remixing streets, sewers and prehistoric settings plus original ones (e.g. a zoo). Only two level types: normal stages and hoverboard stages; design plays safe and feels "samey" by the end.
- Soundtrack praised (remixes and new songs, including Ghostface Killa and Mega Ran). Each turtle distinct in animations and personality.
- Modes: campaign (collectibles, challenges, persistent progression) and arcade mode, completable in about two hours with no checkpoints or saving.

wikis.title: Gematsu: TMNT Shredder's Revenge launches June 16, six-player mode
wikis.summary: Gematsu's June 9, 2022 report that Shredder's Revenge launches June 16 on PS4, Xbox One, Switch and PC, with a six-player mode.
wikis.body:
- By Sal Romano, Jun 9 2022. Publisher Dotemu and developer Tribute Games announced a June 16 launch for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Switch and PC via Steam.
- A new trailer gives a first look at the six-player multiplayer mode; enemy groups scale in size with the number of players.
- Steam overview: brawler from the Dotemu (Streets of Rage 4) and Tribute Games team; pixel art inspired by the 1987 TV show; Bebop and Rocksteady assault Channel 6 for Krang and Shredder's plan; locations from Manhattan and Coney Island to sewers and Dimension X; enemies include Foot Soldiers, Triceraton Warriors and Rock Troops; the Steam text says up to four players simultaneously; new story mode.

wikis.title: PlayStation Universe: TMNT Shredder's Revenge PS4 release June 16, 2022
wikis.summary: Short PSU news item confirming Shredder's Revenge releases June 16, 2022 with a new co-op trailer.
wikis.body:
- By John-Paul Jones, June 9, 2022. Publisher DotEmu confirmed the PS4 release date of June 16, 2022, "proving that the earlier rumoured date was indeed true".
- A new trailer shows the 1-4 player cooperative play of the side-scrolling brawler.
- Listing: platforms Nintendo Switch, PC, PS4; publisher Dotemu; US and UK release June 16, 2022; genre action, beat 'em up; 1-4 players.

wikis.title: IGN review: Marvel's Midnight Suns
wikis.summary: Dan Stapleton's IGN review (8, great) of Firaxis' card-based tactical RPG Marvel's Midnight Suns.
wikis.body:
- Review by Dan Stapleton, updated Dec 10, 2022; score 8 ("great"). Developer Firaxis; initial release Dec 2, 2022.
- Verdict: "an expansive tactical RPG that makes great use of card game mechanics"; puts Firaxis "in the league of RPG developers like BioWare, Obsidian, Bethesda, and Larian".
- Campaign is roughly 75 hours for the reviewer ("at least 60 hours"), with a cast of more than a dozen Marvel heroes. Story loosely based on Midnight Sons: witch Lilith returns to claim the Darkhold; the player character The Hunter is her child; Caretaker mentors the Midnight Suns.
- Combat: each hero has a customizable eight-card deck; three heroes per mission; shared pool of usually three card plays and one movement per turn; redraws; Heroism points spent on Heroic cards; knockback and environmental attacks; no cover, no missed shots. Losing one hero does not cause an XCOM-style downward spiral.
- Quirks: cannot control where characters land after an attack; no grid makes area attacks awkward.
- Outside combat: Abbey hub, friendships via hangouts unlock passives, costumes and strongest cards; friendships are platonic only, which the reviewer finds anticlimactic; bonding can feel "forced and weird".

wikis.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Firaxis' 2022 Marvel tactical RPG: gameplay, story, development, release, reception and sales.
wikis.body:
## Overview
- 2022 tactical role-playing game by Firaxis Games, published by 2K. Released December 2, 2022 (PS5, Windows, Xbox Series X/S); PS4 and Xbox One on May 11, 2023; a Switch version was "planned but later canceled". Unreal Engine 4.
- Player creates "The Hunter", who leads heroes against Lilith, the "mother of demons", who seeks to revive Chthon. Four DLC packs follow the Midnight Suns against Dracula.

## Gameplay
- Turn-based combat mixed with deck-building; each hero has a customizable eight-card deck; three heroes per mission; three Card Plays, two redraws and one move per turn. Card types: Attack, Skill, Heroic (using Heroism). Environmental attacks use Heroism but no card. "Quick" cards refund a Card Play on a kill.
- 13 base characters (Blade, Captain America, Captain Marvel, Doctor Strange, Ghost Rider, Hulk, the Hunter, Iron Man, Magik, Nico Minoru, Scarlet Witch, Spider-Man, Wolverine) plus DLC Deadpool, Morbius, Venom and Storm.
- Between missions the player manages the Abbey (Forge, yard, Mirror Table, Hero Ops), holds Hangouts and builds friendships.

## Development
- Marvel Games approached Firaxis in 2017 after XCOM 2: War of the Chosen; Jake Solomon was creative director. XCOM mechanics (cover, permadeath, attack randomness) were scrapped as they did not suit superheroes; randomness came from card drawing. Inspirations: Slay the Spire, Fire Emblem and Persona, Saturday morning cartoons.

## Reception and sales
- Generally positive reviews (Metacritic PC 83/100, PS5 and Xbox Series 81/100; IGN 8/10, GameSpot 8/10, Game Informer 8.5/10); writing criticized; nominated for Strategy/Simulation Game of the Year at the 26th D.I.C.E. Awards.
- Commercial failure: 26th best-selling physical game in the UK for the week ending 3 December 2022; Steam peak about 15,500 concurrent players; Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said it did not meet commercial expectations and suggested the release window affected it.

wikis.title: 2K: Midnight Suns release date and Prequel Shorts announced
wikis.summary: 2K announcement that Marvel's Midnight Suns launches December 2 (PC, Xbox Series X|S, PS5) with five Prequel Shorts videos.
wikis.body:
- Marvel's Midnight Suns launches December 2 for PC, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5; pre-orders open. Pre-order any edition for the Doctor Strange Defenders Skin (offer through December 1, 2022). Launch timing for Xbox One, PS4 and Switch "will be confirmed at a later date".
- Announced at the Disney and Marvel GAMES SHOWCASE at D23 Expo 2022: five Prequel Shorts giving backstory on how Lilith became the Mother of Demons and how Blade, Magik, Ghost Rider and Nico Minoru formed the Midnight Suns core.
- First short, "Salem Sisters", premieres October 31 on the Marvel Entertainment YouTube channel; the other four release weekly after.
- Quote from Jake Solomon, creative director at Firaxis Games, on diving into "the dark side of Marvel".

wikis.title: IGN review: The Quarry
wikis.summary: Thomas Wilde's IGN review (7, good) of Supermassive's The Quarry, a bloody but lightly interactive Until Dawn spiritual successor.
wikis.body:
- Review by Thomas Wilde, updated Jun 17, 2022; score 7 ("good"); reviewed on PC. Developer Supermassive Games; initial release Jun 10, 2022.
- Verdict: "a fun, bloody thrill ride on your first playthrough, but its lack of interactivity and a lot of little issues drag down the whole." As a spiritual sequel to Until Dawn, "it's a better movie, but a worse game"; "one step forward and one step back".
- Premise: nine camp counselors stuck at Hackett's Quarry summer camp in upstate New York for one more night; choices decide who survives. Roughly 10-hour campaign; three textbook horror plots layered.
- Play: exploration, conversation choices, quick time events, stealth, simple combat, Mass Effect-style interrupts; accessibility options can make actions auto-succeed; Movie Mode plays the story without interactivity (misses a couple of major events).
- Criticisms: long stretches without meaningful choice; little mystery or clue-hunting; cannot skip seen cutscenes on replays; characters' ironic detachment ("overshot" Scream, ended up with The Cabin in the Woods).
- Praise: solid script, great cast (Ariel Winter, Siobhan Williams, Justice Smith, Brenda Song), atmosphere; reviewer still found surprises on a third run.

wikis.title: Game Informer review: The Quarry, "Screaming Until Dawn"
wikis.summary: Andrew Reiner's Game Informer review (8.5) of The Quarry, praising its choices, characters and 186 possible endings.
wikis.body:
- Review by Andrew Reiner, Jun 08, 2022; score 8.5; reviewed on PC. Publisher 2K Games, developer Supermassive Games, release June 10, 2022; also PS5, Xbox Series X/S, PS4, Xbox One; rated Mature.
- Verdict: decision-making "pays off handsomely" with "a spiderweb of paths leading to 186 potential endings"; "this is the sequel we've been dying to play" (technically a spiritual successor to Until Dawn).
- Setting: final day of summer camp at Hackett's Quarry; a broken-down van gives counselors one more night. Conversations offer two-option interruptions (e.g. "assertive" or "apologetic"); relationships shape paths.
- Criticism: some vague choices are coin flips; a "use a life" system (three lives in the special edition, one in standard) undermines consequences, so reviewer recommends the standard edition; QTEs are telegraphed too long and easy; more cinematic than interactive.
- Praise: likable, flawed counselors; cast includes David Arquette, Ted Raimi, Evan Evagora, Siobhan Williams, Ariel Winter, Justice Smith, Halston Sage; realistic likenesses; Movie Mode; licensed soundtrack. Story logic can be a "headscratcher".

wikis.title: IGN review: Stray
wikis.summary: Tom Marks' IGN review (8, great) of Stray, a cat-based cyberpunk platforming adventure.
wikis.body:
- Review by Tom Marks, updated Jul 20, 2022; score 8 ("great"). Developer BlueTwelve Studio; initial release Jul 19, 2022.
- Verdict: "a delightful adventure in a dark but endearingly hopeful cyberpunk world"; roughly five-hour story balancing simple platforming and puzzles with item-hunting quests.
- You play a normal cat (not magic) in a robot-populated cyberpunk city, helped by drone B-12; the cat can scratch, nap, push objects and meow. Story: a lost cat trying to get home.
- Two modes: linear platforming levels (compared to a 3D Inside) and open town areas like a point-and-click adventure.
- Criticisms: no dedicated jump button (context hops to preset spots), camera wrestling, stiff movement animations; not all new ideas land.
- Excellent futuristic soundtrack; cat actions repurposed into mechanics (e.g. meow alerting a guard).

wikis.title: PlayStation Blog: Stray comes to PS4 and PS5 on July 19
wikis.summary: BlueTwelve Studio producer's June 2, 2022 post confirming Stray's July 19, 2022 release and PlayStation Plus Extra/Premium availability.
wikis.body:
- Post by Swann Martin-Raget, producer at BlueTwelve Studio, June 2, 2022 (after State of Play). Stray will be publicly available July 19, 2022 on PS4 and PS5 and also to PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium members at that time.
- The vision began seven years earlier (initially named "HK Project") by co-founders Koola and Viv.
- Creating an interactive cat was the trickiest challenge; cat animator Miko used video references; about 80% of the team are cat owners; studio cats Oscar and Jun inspired interactions.
- Release trailer shows new environments such as "Antvillage", a village built around a huge reservoir; the backpack and small drone B-12 add ways to interact and talk with characters.

wikis.title: IGN: Stray gets a July 19 release date
wikis.summary: IGN news that Stray, the cyberpunk cat game, launches July 19 on PS4 and PS5 and on PlayStation Plus Extra and above.
wikis.body:
- By Rebekah Valentine, updated Jun 2, 2022. Shown at Sony's State of Play: Stray releases July 19 for PS4 and PS5, a PlayStation console exclusive.
- A cat lost in a falling-apart cyber city must solve an ancient mystery and get home with help from small robot B12.
- Will be on PlayStation Plus at launch for "Extra" tier and above.
- Quotes the PlayStation Blog by producer Swann Martin-Raget on seven-year development and making a believable cat; about 80% of the studio has cats; office cats Oscar and Jun.
- First announced alongside the PS5 itself but pushed from a 2021 release into 2022.

wikis.title: IGN review: Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope
wikis.summary: Dan Stapleton's IGN review (9, amazing, Editors' Choice) of Ubisoft Milan's Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope for Switch.
wikis.body:
- Review by Dan Stapleton, updated Oct 29, 2022; score 9 ("amazing", Editors' Choice). Developer Ubisoft Milan; initial release Oct 20, 2022.
- Verdict: "takes the excellent tactical combat ideas of Kingdom Battle and runs absolutely wild with them"; a sequel that "fixes all of the main issues I had with the original".
- Combat is free of a visible grid; team jump adds real-time steering; nine-character team with distinct personalities (Rabbid Peach, Rabbid Rosalina, Luigi, Bowser). New "Sparks" (dozens, two equipped per hero) grant elemental shots, dashes, resurrection, invisibility, etc.
- Overworld is less linear and packed with puzzles; each world adds a new mechanic; Beep-O now hovers over the lead character.
- Criticisms: the story is "kind of a mess" (a manta ray from space, corrupt ooze, a spaceship between worlds); Switch cannot always handle everything smoothly; puzzles less appealing to replay.
- Content: over 30 hours for the reviewer without completing every puzzle, side mission and Spark.

wikis.title: Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Ubisoft's 2022 Switch tactical RPG crossover: gameplay, plot, development, DLC, reception and sales.
wikis.body:
## Overview
- 2022 action-adventure tactical RPG by Ubisoft Milan and Ubisoft Paris, published by Ubisoft for Nintendo Switch; released October 20, 2022; sequel to Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle (2017). Snowdrop engine. Directors Davide Soliani and Damiano Moro.
- Final Mario franchise title with Charles Martinet as Mario and Luigi (archival clips) before he stepped down in 2023. "According to Ubisoft, the game underperformed commercially."

## Gameplay and plot
- New characters: Edge, Rabbid Rosalina, Bowser; Sparks give distinct powers; less linear levels; turn-based combat without the first game's grid; enemy encounters outside turn-based combat. Xavier Manzanares: real-time element such as dashing a Bob-omb.
- Plot: Rabbid/Luma hybrids called Sparks are pursued by a manta-ray creature with Darkmess; the villain Cursa (a surviving part of the Megabug) is behind it. Team travels five planets (Beacon Beach, Pristine Peaks, Palette Prime, Terra Flora, Barrendale Mesa) aboard the WM-ARC to Cursa's stronghold and frees Rosalina.

## Development
- Announced at E3 2021; released October 20, 2022; co-development by Ubisoft Paris and Milan with Pune, Chengdu and Montpellier. Soundtrack by Grant Kirkhope, Gareth Coker and Yoko Shimomura. Yoshi not playable to evolve the team; Rosalina not playable due to her tall height and being "too powerful".
- Three DLC expansions in 2023: The Tower of Doooom (March 2, 2023), The Last Spark Hunter (June 21, 2023), Rayman in the Phantom Show (August 30, 2023).

## Reception
- Metacritic 85/100; OpenCritic 96% recommend; IGN 9/10, GameSpot 9/10, Game Informer 9/10, Nintendo Life 8/10. Praise for graphics, soundtrack, gameplay and battle improvements; loading times criticized. Sold nearly 3 million copies as of January 2024; underperformed in late 2022 and early January.

wikis.title: Shacknews: Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope gets October 2022 release date
wikis.summary: Shacknews report that a June 28, 2022 Nintendo Mini Direct set Sparks of Hope for October 20, 2022.
wikis.body:
- By TJ Denzer, June 28, 2022. The Nintendo Mini Direct on June 28, 2022 revealed Sparks of Hope launches October 20, 2022 on Nintendo Switch; pre-orders open.
- Gameplay presentation showed a weapon that bounces between foes, a two-shot weapon hitting two opponents, and Bowser with a massive bazooka.
- Ubisoft had been quiet in 2022; it had promised to get Sparks of Hope and Skull and Bones out by Spring 2023. Ubisoft confirmed attending Gamescom 2022.

wikis.title: IGN review: Splatoon 3 single-player
wikis.summary: Brendan Graeber's IGN single-player review (8, great) of Splatoon 3's Return of the Mammalians campaign.
wikis.body:
- Review by Brendan Graeber, updated Sep 12, 2022; score 8 ("great"); covers single-player only. Developer Nintendo EPD; initial release Sep 9, 2022.
- Campaign "The Return of the Mammalians": a hub world, the icy Alterna with six islands, 70 bite-sized missions, chosen in the player's own order; borrows ideas from Splatoon 2's Octo Expansion.
- Fuzzy Ooze blocks paths and can be eaten by a fish sidekick for salmon egg currency; removal opens shortcuts, collectibles, mission kettles or pipes to the next island. Reviewer compares the ooze to Breath of the Wild's blight.
- Story: search for a missing comrade, three bosses, lore fragments about the ruins and how the squid-dominated world came to be.
- Criticisms: many enemies unchanged from prior games; slow intro area; Tableturf Battle card minigame (in Splatville, AI opponents only, Nintendo says multiplayer will be added later for free) is "lackluster" with a dreadfully small card limit.
- Verdict: takes "all the highs of Splatoon 2's creative Octo Expansion missions" into a satisfying hub with freedom of choice.

wikis.title: MobileSyrup: Splatoon 3 release date set for September 9, 2022
wikis.summary: MobileSyrup's Apr 22, 2022 report that Nintendo dated Splatoon 3 for September 9 with a new Turf War look.
wikis.body:
- By Steve Vegvari, Apr 22, 2022. Splatoon 3 comes to Nintendo Switch on September 9th.
- Nintendo showed three minutes of footage of the 4v4 competitive Turf War mode, including the new "Eeltail Alley" map.
- Splatoon 3 first announced in February 2021; campaign titled "Return of the Mammalians" with Agent 3 against the Octarians; synopsis: "Discover the secrets of a mysterious place called Alterna and the Fuzzy Ooze." Salmon Run returns.
- Nintendo is adding the Splatoon 2 Octo Expansion DLC to Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack, whose $63.99 yearly membership gives access to 80 additional missions.

wikis.title: Shacknews: Splatoon 3 release date announced as September 9, 2022
wikis.summary: Shacknews note that Splatoon 3 releases September 9, 2022 on Nintendo Switch, per a Nintendo of America announcement.
wikis.body:
- By Sam Chandler. Splatoon 3 will be released on September 9, 2022 on Nintendo Switch; the date was announced via the Nintendo of America Twitter account.
- First revealed at a Nintendo Direct in February 2021. The piece notes COVID-related delay worries.
- Earlier reveals: multiplayer footage including weapons, and the Salmon Run Next Wave horde-style co-op mode.
- Pre-orders available via the Nintendo Store.

wikis.title: IGN review: Pokémon Scarlet and Violet
wikis.summary: Rebekah Valentine's IGN review (6, okay) praising the open-world design of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet but faulting its unfinished state and technical problems.
wikis.body:
- Review by Rebekah Valentine, updated Nov 24, 2022; score 6 ("okay"). Developer Game Freak; initial release Nov 18, 2022.
- Verdict: the open-world gameplay is "a brilliant direction for the future of the franchise", but the shift is "sabotaged by the numerous ways in which Scarlet and Violet feel deeply unfinished".
- Praise: you can go anywhere after Uva Academy; Paldea is friendly to gradual challenge; no level scaling; roughly 400 Pokémon species; clever new designs (Lechonk, Wiglett); improved monster behavior; unique towns modelled on real-world Spain; online co-op.
- Criticism: world feels empty; buildings mostly facades, repeated storefronts; weak glide ability compared with Legends: Arceus; no dungeons or puzzles; pervasive technical problems (Pokémon stuck in floors, framerate issues, "crippling lag"), made worse by online co-op; no word from Nintendo on patches.
- Verdict quote: "It is completely impossible to play Scarlet and Violet and not notice at least some of its performance issues."

wikis.title: Pokémon Scarlet and Violet (Wikipedia)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the ninth-generation Pokémon games: gameplay, development, DLC, mixed reception and record sales.
wikis.body:
## Overview
- Ninth generation of the Pokémon series, announced February 2022, released 18 November 2022 on Nintendo Switch. Set in Paldea, based on the Iberian Peninsula; first open-world mainline games. Free Switch 2 update released 5 June 2025.
- DLC "The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero": The Teal Mask (13 September 2023), The Indigo Disk (14 December 2023), epilogue Mochi Mayhem (11 January 2024).

## Gameplay
- Starters Sprigatito, Fuecoco, Quaxly; legendaries Koraidon and Miraidon serve as mounts. Terastal phenomenon (Tera Types), Paradox Pokémon, Auto Battle, Tera Raids for up to four players.
- Three story routes: Victory Road (gyms in any order, Elite Four and Champion Geeta), Path of Legends (Titan Pokémon, Herba Mystica), Starfall Street (Team Star); a fourth route resolves the main story after all three.

## Development
- Development began in late 2019 around the release of Sword and Shield. Game Freak wanted a "real and deformed" look; Pokémon models and animations were redone; "PokeSynth" program built for natural overworld sounds.

## Reception and sales
- Mixed reviews: praise for story, criticism of technical problems. Metacritic 72/100 (Scarlet), 71/100 (Violet), the lowest-rated mainline Pokémon games; OpenCritic 48% recommend; GameSpot 8/10.
- Most pre-ordered titles in the series; over 10 million copies in three days (4.05 million in Japan), Nintendo's biggest launch; best-selling game of 2022 in Japan; 27.15 million by June 2025 and over 28 million by December 2025.

wikis.title: Nintendo Life: Pokémon Scarlet and Violet release November 18th
wikis.summary: Nintendo Life news of June 1, 2022 that a new trailer confirmed the 18th November release of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet.
wikis.body:
- By Alana Hagues, Wed 1st Jun 2022. The Pokémon Company released a new trailer for the ninth generation, with a confirmed 18th November release date.
- Trailer shows two new Pokémon professors, a handful of new and returning Pokémon, and environments from craggy landscapes to snowy fields; reveals what the two box art legendaries look like.
- Page is otherwise reader comments (not recorded).

wikis.title: IGN review: A Plague Tale: Requiem
wikis.summary: Travis Northup's IGN review (8, great) of Asobo Studio's A Plague Tale: Requiem, a safe but exciting sequel.
wikis.body:
- Review by Travis Northup, updated Oct 29, 2022; score 8 ("great"). Developer Asobo Studio; initial release Oct 18, 2022.
- Verdict: "an impressive sequel... upping the ante in almost every way", though it "doesn't do a ton to distinguish itself" mechanically and could take more risks.
- Third-person action-adventure in alternate 14th-century France during the Hundred Years' War; player is Amicia protecting her afflicted brother Hugo; rat swarms increased enormously.
- Gameplay: competent but unoriginal stealth; puzzle areas using light against rats; best sections combine both. Skill tree with Prudence, Opportunism and Aggressive playstyles; roughly 20-hour campaign; collectibles, hidden side quests; New Game+ mode.
- Story called depressing but very well told, darker than the first game; graphics praised. Earlier game A Plague Tale: Innocence was scored 7 by IGN (May 13, 2019).

wikis.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem review (PC Gamer)
wikis.summary: PC Gamer's review of A Plague Tale: Requiem, scoring it 85 and calling it a masterful sequel.
wikis.body:
- Reviewer: Jon Bailes; last updated 20 October 2022. Score 85. Verdict: "Requiem is a masterful sequel and an exceptional action adventure."
- Sequel to 2019's A Plague Tale: Innocence; action adventure starring siblings Amicia De Rune and Hugo and a swarm of killer rats.
- Expected price: £44/$50. Release date: October 18, 2022. Developer: Asobo Studio. Publisher: Focus Entertainment. Reviewed on RTX 2070, i7-10750H, 16GB RAM. No multiplayer.
## Story and setting
- Survivors of the first game travel south through France; the mother and apprentice Lucas seek an alchemist to check Hugo, since the rats are linked to a curse in his blood. Provencal and Mediterranean settings; a later Mediterranean island section lets you spend time with the characters.
## Gameplay
- Human encounters become stealth sandboxes with hiding spots, vantage points and shortcuts. Crafting throwable chemical compounds (fire starters, extinguishers, rat bait); sling, ceramic pots, crossbow bolts. Pots, bolts and knives are in limited supply.
- Companions have skills; Hugo can take control of small packs of rats. Rats behave like a living sea of lava, kept at bay with light and fire, erupting in larger tsunamis.
- Set pieces include a falconer and his bird, and a crossbow turret.
## Criticisms
- Systems can clash with odd results; partners (especially Lucas) get stuck on scenery; stealth sections can be pernickety, trial-and-error, and it is often easier to kill everyone.
- Runs "almost 20 hours". Compared to Sony heavyweights The Last of Us Part 2 and God of War, it bows only to those in production values.

wikis.title: Sifu review (IGN)
wikis.summary: IGN's review of Sloclap's martial arts beat-em-up Sifu, praising its combat and its age-on-death system.
wikis.body:
- By Mitchell Saltzman; updated Feb 11, 2022. Developer Sloclap (Absolver). Reviewed on PS5.
- Premise: your father and martial arts master is killed; eight years later you set out to kill each of five people involved. Clues fill a detective board; finding targets can unlock doors in earlier levels.
- Combat: two attack buttons, guard (block, parry, sway), vault, weapon pick-up/throw, and a focus meter for special attacks. Structure meter as in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice. Environmental takedowns (throws down stairs, over railings). DualSense haptics on PS5. Camera sometimes gets squished in a corner.
- Aging: a magical talisman revives you but you age by your current death counter (first deaths one to three years, later five to seven or more). Every 10 years max health shrinks and damage rises; in your 70s the talisman runs out and the next death is game over. Restarting a level keeps the skills, age and death counter of your best playthrough of the previous level.
- Length: five levels; reviewer took about 10 hours to finish first time. Repetition is the pain point; shortcuts unlock; second level can need 10 to 20 minutes before retrying the boss.
- Skills: start with all you need; buy new skills on death or at shrines; skills reset at game over but a skill bought six times becomes permanent.
- Praise: exquisite combat, top-notch animation, outstanding music, watercolor art style; "nearly unparalleled sense of mastery and accomplishment".

wikis.title: Sifu (video game) - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Sloclap's 2022 martial arts beat 'em up Sifu: gameplay, plot, development, release and reception.
wikis.body:
- Sifu is a 2022 beat 'em up developed and published by Sloclap (Kepler Interactive also listed as publisher; Microids published retail editions). Director Jordan Layani, composer Howie Lee, Unreal Engine 4. Set in China.
- Released 8 February 2022 (PS4, PS5, Windows via Epic Games Store), 8 November 2022 (Switch), 28 March 2023 (Xbox One/Series X/S). Deluxe Edition gave 48 hours early access. Retail Sifu: Vengeance Edition by Microids 3 May 2022. Announced February 2021 at Sony's State of Play; delayed from 2021 to polish and avoid overworking the team.
- Sold over 4 million units by May 2025. TV adaptation Sifu: It Takes a Life released on Amazon Prime Video in December 2024. Generally positive reviews for combat, environments, story.
- Gameplay: run-based, third-person, inspired by Bak Mei kung fu, over 150 unique attacks; structure gauge; on death the protagonist is resurrected and ages, gaining power but losing health; when the pendant breaks the next death ends the run. Shrines, the Wuguan school, detective board.
- Plot: Yang, a disgraced student, and four Dawn Group martial artists (Fajar, Sean, Kuroki, Jinfeng) raid the school; the sifu dies; the child, revived by a pendant, spends eight years training then hunts each. Two endings depending on whether the player kills or spares targets (learning Wude).
- Development: no multiplayer (unlike Absolver, 2017); combat inspired by 1970s-80s kung fu movies with Jackie Chan; Bak Mei master Benjamin Colussi choreographed. Updates April 2022 added outfits, training mode, difficulty options (Student, Disciple, Master); 31 August 2022 free update added outfits and a scoring system.

wikis.title: Sifu release date moved up to February 8
wikis.summary: Game Informer news item saying Sifu's launch moved two weeks earlier, from February 22 to February 8, 2022, with combat and progression details.
wikis.body:
- By Wesley LeBlanc, Nov 18, 2021. Sifu, from developer Sloclap, moved its release date by two weeks: after being delayed to 2022 it was set for February 22; now February 8.
- Platforms: PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4 and PC. Price $39.99 standard, $49.99 deluxe.
- Press release: "smooth 60fps across both platforms"; defense (pushbacks, knockdowns, stuns) matters as much as attacks; environments are used to take down enemies; Focus ability builds up while fighting for a "precise and devastating blow".
- Progression: an ancient pendant revives the player at a cost; fighters age with each death, trading max health for offensive power; "getting older has no detrimental drawbacks on abilities". Skills unlocked at the Wuguan training facility between missions or at Shrines; perks boost health, focus charges and more.
- New trailer released alongside the news.

wikis.title: Sifu developer tips (PlayStation Blog)
wikis.summary: Sloclap's launch-eve PlayStation Blog post with tips on progression, bosses and fighting groups in Sifu.
wikis.body:
- Posted February 7, 2022 by Felix Garczynski, Sloclap; Sifu launched the next day. Revealed at State of Play in February 2021.
- Progression: train both Parry and Avoid; explore to unlock keys for shortcuts, hidden rooms and weapons; keep going even if old, and revisit hideouts later to improve your finishing age.
- Bosses: observe first, look for windows of opportunity at the end of attack patterns, do not brute force or button mash.
- Groups: don't get surrounded, dodge and vault; use pushbacks and knockdowns and throwables; prioritize armed enemies; stronger enemies have silver and gold health bars.
- Sloclap says part of the team is already at work on post-launch content, with "free content updates" planned.

wikis.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 review (IGN)
wikis.summary: IGN's review of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 for Switch, calling it a massive JRPG well worth the time despite weak writing and visuals.
wikis.body:
- By Travis Northup, updated Jul 29, 2022. Subtitle: "A massive JRPG that's well worth the time." Reviewed on Switch OLED, docked and handheld.
- World: war-torn Aionios; residents pod-grown with 10-year life spans; "flame clocks"; Off-Seers play flutes to release the dead. The story is self-contained though it references Xenoblade 1 and 2.
- Praise: improved combat, quest design and RPG sandbox; strong characters (Lanz, Taion, Sena) with extensive voice-acted side quests; side quests that add new party members and backstory; class swapping and Ouroboros transformations keep combat fresh for over 100 hours.
- Criticism: hit-or-miss writing, repetitive cutscenes, anime cliches, pacing filler; a game that took 150 hours to complete; weak bosses; low-res textures, pop-in and blur on Switch, though cutscenes are crisp and frame rate holds at 30; environments milder than earlier games.
- Reviewer says it is competing to be his favorite in the series.

wikis.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 launches July 29 (Gematsu)
wikis.summary: Gematsu (Sal Romano) report that Xenoblade Chronicles 3 moved from a September window to July 29, 2022 on Switch, with battle system and character details.
wikis.body:
- Announced Apr 19 2022: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 launches on Switch July 29 (2022), earlier than the previously announced September release window. Publisher Nintendo, developer Monolith Soft; originally announced in a February Nintendo Direct for September.
- A new trailer shows the group's journey in Aionios and the "Ouroboros" forms.
- Special/Collector's Edition via My Nintendo Store: package artwork by Masatsugu Saito, full-color hardcover art book of 250+ pages, steel case; not yet available for preorder, more details later.
- Story: connects the futures of the two previous mainline games, with "life" as theme. Protagonists Noah (Keves soldier, off-seer, mourns the fallen) and Mio (Agnus soldier, off-seer). Keves has mechanical technology and combat vehicles; Agnus is strong in ether. Six soldiers set out for Swordmarch, a land pierced by a giant sword. Others: Lanz (great sword that doubles as shield), Eunie (healer), Taion (tactician), Sena (immense strength).
- Battle: fought against enemies directly in the overworld with up to seven characters; class change (Noah is a Swordfighter, Mio a Zephyr); Interlink system where tag-team pairs (Noah and Mio, Lanz and Sena, Eunie and Taion) combine into a giant Ouroboros with its own moveset.

wikis.title: The Last of Us Part I review (IGN)
wikis.summary: IGN's review of the PS5 remake The Last of Us Part I, calling it the definitive solo way to play but somewhat inessential.
wikis.body:
- By Luke Reilly, updated Jan 15, 2023. Subtitle "Click of approval." Third version of Naughty Dog's 2013 game (after The Last of Us Remastered, "eight years later").
- Fully rebuilt world, characters and animations on PS5; DualSense haptics; "a simply remarkable array of accessibility options". Includes prequel Left Behind as a separate story. Missing the original's multiplayer.
- Two display modes: native 4K at a targeted 30 fps, and dynamic 4K at a targeted 60 fps; reviewer used dynamic 4K/60 and turned film grain off. Denser foliage, more destructible objects, standout reflections and lighting.
- Verdict: the definitive way for solo players, but "something inherently inessential about it" as a remake of an already fabulous remaster. Reviewer still thinks the original's story is superior to Part II's.

wikis.title: The Growing Future of The Last of Us (PlayStation Blog)
wikis.summary: Naughty Dog's June 2022 post announcing a standalone Last of Us multiplayer game, HBO show update, and the Part I remake with editions and pricing.
wikis.body:
- Posted June 9, 2022 by Rochelle Snyder, Naughty Dog. The Last of Us Part II has sold through more than 10 million copies globally "as of this Spring".
- Multiplayer: Naughty Dog is creating a standalone, full-scale multiplayer game, "much larger than a mode"; studio growing significantly; "more news to come next year".
- HBO series: helmed by Craig Mazin with Executive Producer Carolyn Strauss and Neil Druckmann (Executive Producer, Writer, directed a full episode). Ashley Johnson and Troy Baker join the cast in major roles.
- The Last of Us Part I: complete remake releasing September 2, 2022 on PS5, in development for PC. Modernized gameplay, improved controls, expanded accessibility, 3D Audio, haptics, adaptive triggers; includes Left Behind. Game Director Matthew Gallant and Creative Director Shaun Escayg lead it.
- Pre-orders open at 4PM PT; Standard Edition $69.99 USD / $89.99 CAD / EUR 79.99 / JPY 7,900; Digital Deluxe $79.99 USD / $99.99 CAD / EUR 89.99 / JPY 8,900 with early unlock of in-game items.

wikis.title: The Last of Us Part I remake announced (GameTyrant)
wikis.summary: GameTyrant news that the Last of Us Part I remake is official for PS5 on September 2, 2022, with a PC version to follow.
wikis.body:
- By Ross Vernon. Naughty Dog and PlayStation lifted the veil on the rumored remake with a release trailer. Launches on PlayStation 5 on September 2, 2022; PC version in development with an unknown release date.
- Promises modernized gameplay, controls, visuals and accessibility options; the trailer shows improved character models, lighting and textures compared with The Last of Us Remastered for PS4, but no details on core gameplay changes.
- The writer notes it is Naughty Dog's first remake project, released 9 years after the original and 8 after the remaster, and is disappointed multiplayer (Factions) is missing; the standalone multiplayer is separately in development.

wikis.title: Rollerdrome review (IGN)
wikis.summary: IGN's review of Roll7's roller-skating third-person shooter Rollerdrome on PS5.
wikis.body:
- By Jonathon Dornbush, updated Aug 22, 2022. Subtitle "Skate or die." Developer Roll7 (OlliOlli World); played entirely on PS5.
- Setting: the year 2030; player is Kara Hassan, a new skater in a dystopian bloodsport against waves of "house players" (melee combatants to mini-mechs with homing missiles). First-person locker-room sections reveal corporate-control commentary.
- Skating and gunplay simultaneous: auto-lock aim, four guns sharing one ammo pool, every trick refills ammo, kills raise a score multiplier. Optional Tony Hawk's Pro Skater-like challenges; enemy placement is not randomized.
- Art and sound: colorful arenas (arid desert canyon, midwest mall), soundtrack by Electric Dragon mixing '70s disco and '80s synth. Heavy DualSense feedback; the reviewer's hands got tired.

wikis.title: Rollerdrome (video game) - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Roll7's 2022 skating-shooter Rollerdrome: gameplay, development, release and reception.
wikis.body:
- Action game by Roll7, originally published by Private Division (2021-2025), then 2K (2025-). Director Paul Rabbitte, producer Drew Jones, designer Andreas Yiannikaris, composer Electric Dragon, Unity engine.
- Released August 16, 2022 for Windows, PS4, PS5; Xbox Series X/S on November 28, 2023. Announced June 2, 2022 during Sony's State of Play.
- Gameplay: Kara Hassan skates and shoots in a deadly sport; ammo refills through tricks, health from pick-ups, bullet time aiming; optional challenges per stage.
- Development: began as a side project by Rabbitte from a 48-hour Game Maker's Toolkit game jam in 2017 (theme 'Dual Purpose Design'), described as a mix of Tony Hawk's and Doom; two years in production; players do not fall on failed tricks; inspirations Rollerball and The Running Man; cel-shaded style. After Take-Two's sale of Private Division and the dissolution of Roll7 in 2024, publishing rights went to 2K.
- Reception: Metacritic PS5 79/100; IGN 9/10; GameSpot 8/10; Game Informer 8.5/10; GamesRadar 3.5/5; PC Gamer US 94/100.

wikis.title: Rollerdrome pricing and PlayStation Plus Premium trial
wikis.summary: Gematsu report on Rollerdrome's launch pricing ($19.79 introductory, $29.99 standard) and a PS Plus Premium trial for the August 16 launch.
wikis.body:
- By Sal Romano, Jul 12 2022. Publisher Private Division and developer Roll7 announced Rollerdrome launches August 16 (2022).
- Introductory price $19.79 on Steam and for PlayStation Plus members of any tier.
- PS5 and PS4 users who are not PlayStation Plus members pay $29.99 at launch.
- A game trial available for PlayStation Plus Premium members day and date with release.
- A new behind-the-scenes developer video ("Flow and Level Design") shows fusing fluid movement and stylish tricking in a retro-futuristic universe.

wikis.title: Yellen warns U.S. could hit debt ceiling by June 1
wikis.summary: CNBC report that Treasury Secretary Yellen told Speaker McCarthy the debt limit x-date could come as early as June 1, 2023.
wikis.body:
- Published Mon, May 1 2023 (CNBC, Christina Wilkie). Yellen's letter to House Speaker Kevin McCarthy: new tax-receipt data moved the estimate of when Treasury "will be unable to continue to satisfy all of the government's obligations" to potentially as early as June 1 if Congress does not raise or suspend the debt limit.
- Earlier than expected: Goldman Sachs' latest estimate put it in late July, though weaker tax receipts could advance that. The CBO also revised its x-date: "significantly greater risk that the Treasury will run out of funds in early June" (director Phill Swagel).
- President Biden invited the "big four" (Schumer, McConnell, McCarthy, Jeffries) to a May 9 White House meeting.
- Only eight legislative days in May when House and Senate are both in session. White House has refused talks for two months, demanding a clean hike; House GOP wants spending cuts. A Republican bill to raise the limit and cut spending passed the House less than a week earlier.
- Goldman noted few market ripples so far, which could change "once the Treasury announces a specific deadline".

wikis.title: US may default as soon as June 1, Yellen reaffirms (CNN)
wikis.summary: CNN report of Yellen's May 15, 2023 letter reaffirming that default could come as soon as June 1 absent congressional action.
wikis.body:
- By Tami Luhby, published May 15, 2023. Yellen wrote to McCarthy that Treasury will likely no longer be able to satisfy all obligations if Congress has not acted "by early June, and potentially as early as June 1"; the actual date could be days or weeks later depending on revenue and payouts. She will update Congress the next week.
- Two weeks after her first warning; forecasters had thought cash and "extraordinary measures" would last until later in the summer, but weak tax collections pulled the date forward.
- Yellen: waiting until the last minute "can cause serious harm to business and consumer confidence, raise short-term borrowing costs for taxpayers, and negatively impact the credit rating of the United States." Treasury borrowing costs rose for securities maturing early June.
- The CBO said there is a "significant risk" of being unable to pay all obligations in the first two weeks of June.
- Biden expected to meet McCarthy and other leaders again Tuesday. McCarthy: "We have no agreements on anything." Schumer said talks are ongoing.

wikis.title: California bans sale of new diesel trucks by 2036 (CNBC)
wikis.summary: CNBC report that California regulators approved the Advanced Clean Fleets rule ending new diesel big-rig sales by 2036 and requiring zero-emission trucks by 2042.
wikis.body:
- Published Fri, Apr 28 2023 (Emma Newburger). The California Air Resources Board unanimously approved the Advanced Clean Fleets rule: ban on new diesel big-rig sales by 2036, all trucks zero-emission by 2042; described as the state's second zero-emissions trucks rule and the first in the world to require new commercial trucks to be electric.
- Estimated $26.5 billion in public health benefits from avoided health impacts and deaths.
- Heavy-duty trucks are nearly one third of the state's nitrogen oxide and over one quarter of fine particle pollution from diesel; medium and heavy-duty trucks are 10% of US vehicles but 25% of transport greenhouse gas emissions (Union of Concerned Scientists).
- Truck makers and lobbyists oppose it as costly and citing lack of charging infrastructure. Companies with 50 or more trucks must convert fleets; drayage trucks zero-emission by 2035; garbage trucks and school buses by 2027; new sales requirements start 2024.
- New York, New Jersey, Washington, Oregon, Massachusetts, Vermont and Colorado have adopted California's Advanced Clean Trucks rule. California banned new gasoline cars from 2035.

wikis.title: California approves Advanced Clean Fleets heavy-duty ZEV regulation (CARB)
wikis.summary: CARB press release (April 28, 2023) announcing the Advanced Clean Fleets rule, the world's first mandate to end combustion truck sales.
wikis.body:
- CARB release 23-13, April 28, 2023. Approved a phased-in transition to zero-emission medium- and heavy-duty vehicles; supports Gov. Newsom's goal of fully transitioning trucks in the state to zero-emission by 2045.
- Expected $26.6 billion in health savings; fleet owners save an estimated $48 billion in operating costs through 2050. An estimated 1.7 million zero-emission trucks on California roads by 2050.
- Trucks are 6% of California vehicles but over 35% of transportation NOx and a quarter of on-road greenhouse gas emissions. California to invest almost $3 billion 2021-2025 in ZE trucks and infrastructure, part of a $9 billion package.
- Timeline: fleets (last-mile delivery, federal, state and local government) start in 2024; drayage trucks ZE by 2035; last-mile delivery and yard trucks by 2035; work trucks and day cab tractors by 2039; sleeper cabs and specialty vehicles by 2042; end of combustion truck sales in 2036. Existing vehicles may run through useful life; exemptions based on technology availability. About 150 ZE medium/heavy trucks commercially available in the US.
- Quotes from CARB Chair Liane Randolph and Yana Garcia.

wikis.title: CARB Advanced Clean Fleets rule (Government Fleet)
wikis.summary: Government Fleet's May 2023 explainer on CARB's Advanced Clean Fleets rule and what it means for public and private fleets.
wikis.body:
- By Christy Grimes, May 3, 2023. CARB approved the rule April 28, 2023, after over 140 public comments and an hours-long discussion. Complements the Advanced Clean Trucks rule adopted in 2020 (every new truck sold in California zero-emission by 2045); supports Gov. Newsom's 2045 goal.
- State and local agencies must ensure 50% of vehicle purchases are zero-emission beginning 2024 and 100% beginning 2027; small government fleets (10 or fewer vehicles) and those in designated counties begin ZEV purchases in 2027. Alternate ZEV Milestones Option is phased by vehicle type. Government fleets may buy ZEVs or near-ZEVs until 2035; from 2035 only ZEVs qualify.
- Existing vehicles may run through their useful life; drayage trucks must be zero-emission by 2035; exemptions based on technology availability. About 150 ZE medium/heavy trucks commercially available (per CARB).
- Estimated $48 billion operating cost savings through 2050 and $26.6 billion health savings. Trucks are 6% of California vehicles but over 35% of transportation NOx and a quarter of on-road greenhouse gases. Almost $3 billion through 2025 of a $9 billion ZEV package.
- Rule includes an end to combustion truck sales in 2036.

wikis.title: Sites Reservoir still on track to break ground in 2024 (KRCR)
wikis.summary: KRCR local report (Oct 19, 2022) on federal $30 million for Sites Reservoir, its projected 2024 groundbreaking, and salmon opposition.
wikis.body:
- By Dylan Brown, Wed, October 19, 2022. The Biden Administration recently committed $30 million to the Sites Reservoir project; Rep. Doug LaMalfa praised it but wants more funding: "We could've broken ground next year. Is that possible now? I'm not sure."
- Long-proposed, $4 billion project; would hold enough for five million homes a year or half a million acres of farmland (LaMalfa: water for over 24 million Californians and 500,000 acres). Would take about five to seven years to fill in drier years, possibly one winter in a very wet year.
- Jerry Brown (no relation to the former governor): would increase Northern California reservoir capacity by 15%. "Actual construction would begin in 2025 and the reservoir would begin operations in 2031."
- Opposition: environmentalists; a Save California Salmon petition reached 50,000 signatures, citing a UC Davis report that over 45% of California salmon face extinction.

wikis.title: Sites Reservoir project gets green light (CapRadio)
wikis.summary: CapRadio piece (Nov 24, 2023) on Sites Reservoir's approval, with an interview of PPIC's Jeffrey Mount on how it would work and who benefits.
wikis.body:
- By Vicki Gonzalez, Friday, November 24, 2023. Planned site: 14,000 acres of grassland in Glenn and Colusa counties, just over an hour north of Sacramento. First proposed in the 1950s, re-proposed several times, about 70 years.
- Early November: Gov. Newsom said he would push it forward under his streamlined infrastructure plan. The prior week Bureau of Reclamation and Sites Project Authority certified the final environmental impact report. "Construction will begin in 2024, with completion expected in 2030."
- Jeffrey Mount (Public Policy Institute of California): an off-channel reservoir that would pump water from the Sacramento River during higher flows (subject to State Water Resources Control Board approval); purpose is to soften dry-year scarcity; in a wet year like 2023 they projected 700,000 acre feet could be set aside, "70% of a Folsom Reservoir's worth". Broad coalition of buyers including federal and state government, Sacramento Valley irrigation districts, and interest from Metropolitan Water District. "The limitation always in this is money."

wikis.title: Sites Reservoir - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the proposed offstream Sites Reservoir west of Colusa, California: plan, history, funding and specifications.
wikis.body:
- Proposed offstream reservoir west of Colusa in the Sacramento Valley, to be built and operated by the Sites Project Authority; diverts water from the Sacramento River through existing canals to a new reservoir. Managing agency listed: California Department of Water Resources; part of the State Water Project.
- Timing (per page): "Construction is planned to begin in 2027 with operations targeted to begin by 2034"; infobox also shows "2024 start; 2030 completion (proposed)". Cost estimated $3.9 billion; benefits about $260 million per year; operating cost $10-20 million.
- Specs: infobox max volume 1.8 million acre-feet, 14,000 acres, max depth 310 ft; text says up to 1.5 million acre-feet, about 260 feet deep, 13 miles by 4 miles, 8th largest in California, serving 7.5 million people for a year; dams Sites Dam and Golden Gate Dam.
- History: proposed in the 1950s; preliminary studies $50 million (1996-2014); 2018 Proposition 1 award of $816 million ($875 million eligible after 2021 adjustment); California Water Commission found it feasible in December 2021; certified by Newsom November 2023 under SB 149; July 2025 streambed agreement and biological opinion approved; Barnard Construction Company selected as main contractor in January 2026.
- Funding: $449 million from USDA; over $224 million federal via Bureau of Reclamation; selected to apply for a $2.2 billion WIFIA loan. Authority formed August 26, 2010.

wikis.title: Sites Reservoir moves forward; Friends of the River react (KRCR)
wikis.summary: KRCR report (June 5, 2024) that Sites Reservoir cleared a hurdle under Newsom's streamlining law, with an environmental group's concerns.
wikis.body:
- By Anna Montemor, Wed, June 5, 2024 (updated June 6). The project cleared a major hurdle thanks to Gov. Gavin Newsom's streamlined law that will reduce environmental groups' delays.
- Would create an additional 1.5 million acre-feet of off-stream storage in eastern Colusa and Glenn counties, "about one-third of the size of Shasta Lake"; the project says it would support 3 million households' yearly usage.
- Friends of the River Policy Director Keiko Mertz: endangered species issues in aquatic ecosystems, especially the Delta; "20th Century infrastructure projects that continue taking more water, more than what falls from the sky, is not sustainable".
- Construction "is set to happen in 2026" but the project does not yet have the full green light.

wikis.title: Tesla Project Highland (Model 3 refresh) insider details (InsideEVs)
wikis.summary: InsideEVs (Mar 23, 2023) relaying a Not A Tesla App insider's claims about the refreshed Model 3, Project Highland.
wikis.body:
- By Dan Mihalascu, Mar 23, 2023. Source: a "trusted insider" via Not A Tesla App. Refreshed Model 3 expected to enter production in Q3 2023.
- Exterior: different headlight shape and redesigned, more aerodynamic front bumper with a single camera in the lower grille center like the Cybertruck; redesigned rear bumper (aesthetic); subtly updated side mirrors.
- Cameras: three new cameras reportedly (front bumper center, two on the sides), front fenders with two cameras each (one backward, one forward), same as Hardware 4 Model S/X, said to be 5-megapixel with anti-glare coating versus 1.2-megapixel on Hardware 3.
- Outside temperature sensor reportedly removed (temperature from GPS location and weather data). Interior: wood trim replaced by fabric finish, possibly Alcantara; dashboard updated, details unspecified.

wikis.title: Rumors of Tesla Project Highland Model 3 reveal on Sept 1 (Tesla Oracle)
wikis.summary: Tesla Oracle (Aug 31, 2023) on rumors that Tesla would reveal the Highland Model 3 the next day, with leaked photos and European prototype sightings.
wikis.body:
- Published August 31, 2023. Rumors from China: Tesla plans to unveil the refreshed Model 3 "tomorrow (1st Sep 2023)". Prototypes spotted in the Netherlands, France and Germany.
- Alleged leaked images (through a phone photo of a screen or page) first appeared on Spanish forum Cochaspias.net and went viral; most enthusiasts think they are genuine, not renders. May be promotional material.
- According to some Tesla influencers, Tesla called a joint China-Europe employee meeting for the next day.
- Earlier reveal rumors around Elon Musk's May visit to China died; Tesla reportedly modified its Model 3 line at Giga Shanghai for Highland. Musk not in China now; it would be the first major vehicle reveal without him. Tesla will update the Chinese online ordering page on unveiling.
- All statements are rumors ("reportedly", "seems").

wikis.title: Tesla Model 3 - Wikipedia (overview, background, launch)
wikis.summary: First part of the Wikipedia article on the Tesla Model 3: overview, naming, reservations and production ramp.
wikis.body:
- Battery electric mid-size fastback sedan by Tesla, introduced in 2017, marketed as more affordable than Model S and X. World's top-selling plug-in electric car 2018-2020 until the Model Y overtook it; first electric car to pass 1 million global sales in June 2021.
- Facelift introduced late 2023 for Gigafactory Shanghai markets and early 2024 for North America and Fremont-supplied countries.
- Specs from infobox: 57.5, 79 or 82 kWh batteries; EPA est. range 272 mi (RWD), 363 mi (LR RWD), 341 mi (LR AWD), 303 mi (Performance); DC charging 170 kW (RWD) / 250 kW (LR).
- History: 2006 Musk interview aimed for a $30,000 price point; codename "BlueStar" (2007); announced on Musk's Twitter July 16, 2014; drag coefficient Cd=0.225. Unveiled 2016 with 325,000 reservations within a week (over US$14 billion); 455,000 net reservations by August 2017; $1000 refundable deposit from March 31, 2016.
- Production: build plan for 500,000 units advanced to 2018; "production hell"; US$2 billion in new shares issued in May 2016; April 18, 2018 target 6,000/week; July 1, 2018 Musk announced 5,000 cars in a week met.
- Standard Range at $35,000 announced February 28, 2019; passed the Chevrolet Volt as best-selling US plug-in in February 2019 and the Nissan Leaf in early 2020 as world's all-time best-selling.

wikis.title: How PepsiCo is trying to get Doritos, Cheetos bags into compost bins (CNBC)
wikis.summary: CNBC report on PepsiCo/Frito-Lay's push toward recyclable, compostable, biodegradable or reusable packaging by 2025.
wikis.body:
- Published Wed, Apr 19 2023, updated Nov 27 2023 (correction: multipack changes removed approximately 12 million pounds of plastic). Statements from PepsiCo Foods North America CEO Steven Williams at CNBC's Sustainable Returns event.
- PepsiCo goal: design 100% of packaging to be recyclable, compostable, biodegradable or reusable by 2025. Williams: "These things are hard, they're not easy... we're fully committed to it"; biodegradable packaging technology "still nascent". Snack and convenient foods business nearly $23 billion in North America; Frito-Lay and Quaker both had double-digit revenue growth in 2022.
- Multipacks moved from outer plastic to recyclable cardboard.
- Frito-Lay introduced an industrially compostable bag for Off The Eaten Path in April 2021 (mail back or drop off for composting). In April (2023) Frito-Lay and Quaker opened a packaging innovation learning center at Frito-Lay's R&D headquarters in Texas, aiming to make certification-ready testing two to three times faster. Other packaging made from 85% renewable plant materials with roughly 60% lower greenhouse gas emissions. Next: home-compostable and biodegradable.
- Context: PepsiCo goal of 20% of beverages in reusables by 2030 vs Coca-Cola's 25%; McDonald's agreed to produce a report on reusable packaging after shareholder pressure.

wikis.title: Frito-Lay launches industrially compostable bags with Off The Eaten Path (PepsiCo press release)
wikis.summary: PepsiCo/Frito-Lay press release (Sept 23, 2021) on the industrially compostable Off The Eaten Path bag and TerraCycle take-back.
wikis.body:
- PLANO, Texas, Sept. 23, 2021. Frito-Lay introduced an industrially compostable bag for Off The Eaten Path; available at Whole Foods Market and select retailers starting that month, on specially marked Chickpea Veggie Crisps and Veggie Crisps.
- Materials creation produces approximately 60 percent lower GHG emissions than traditional packaging; technology may be licensed to other companies at no cost. Part of PepsiCo's goal to design 100% of packaging to be recyclable, compostable, biodegradable or reusable by 2025 and the pep+ transformation.
- Consumers mail bags back via a TerraCycle prepaid label or use a local composting drop-off. Off The Eaten Path donates $1 to Ocean Conservancy per specially marked bag returned to TerraCycle by May 30, 2022, up to $192,000.
- Quotes from David Allen (VP sustainability, Frito-Lay North America), Tom Szaky (TerraCycle), Marissa Solis, Edith Cecchini (Ocean Conservancy). Frito-Lay North America is the $18 billion convenient foods division.

wikis.title: Ford to invest $1.3 billion to build EV hub in Oakville, Canada (CNBC)
wikis.summary: CNBC report (Apr 11, 2023) that Ford will invest C$1.8 billion in its Oakville Assembly Plant to make next-generation EVs.
wikis.body:
- Published Tue, Apr 11 2023. Ford will invest 1.8 billion Canadian dollars (about $1.3 billion) to transition the Oakville Assembly Plant in Ontario into the Oakville Electric Vehicle Complex, building next-generation EVs expected "around mid-decade".
- Retooling expected to take six months, beginning in the second quarter of next year. Combines three body shops into one and adds battery pack assembly; uses cells from a battery plant under construction in Kentucky.
- Dave Nowicki (director of EV manufacturing): "We're reusing all of its infrastructure". Ford declined to disclose capacity or the number of models; the 2020 deal with Unifor expected five EV models, possibly scaled back to two per Automotive News.
- First complete retool of a North American gas-vehicle plant to EVs. Oakville keeps building the Ford Edge and Lincoln Nautilus until next year's downtime. Part of Ford's plan for 2 million EV capacity globally by end of 2026.

wikis.title: Ford to invest $1.3 billion to overhaul Oakville for EVs (Manufacturing Dive)
wikis.summary: Manufacturing Dive report on Ford's $1.3 billion Oakville Assembly Complex overhaul for EV production, including a 407,000-square-foot battery assembly facility.
wikis.body:
- Ford announced (on a Tuesday) it will invest $1.3 billion to overhaul its Oakville Assembly Complex in Ontario for EV production, repurposing existing buildings and building a 407,000-square-foot on-site battery assembly facility.
- The campus already has three body shops, one paint building and one assembly building. The battery facility will rely on cells and arrays from its joint venture battery park in Kentucky; Oakville workers assemble packs installed in EVs assembled on-site.
- Part of a broader effort to bring more EV production in-house, led by the Tennessee hub (BlueOval City: battery factory, assembly plant, component suppliers).
- Jim Farley: "Canada and the Oakville complex will play a vital role in our Ford+ transformation... a modern, super-efficient, vertically integrated site for battery and vehicle assembly."

wikis.title: Ford details $1.8 billion Oakville EV retooling (Electric Autonomy)
wikis.summary: Electric Autonomy report that Ford is spending C$1.8 billion to make Oakville a high-volume EV hub, with construction in 2024 and production in 2025.
wikis.body:
- Ford Motor Co. is spending $1.8 billion to turn its Oakville, Ont., plant into a "high-volume" EV hub; "Construction will start in 2024 and vehicle production will begin in 2025". Details of the plan first announced in 2020. New name: Oakville Electric Vehicle Complex.
- Site: just over 487 acres, 40 km west of Toronto; currently three body shops, one paint building, one assembly building, roughly 3,000 employees. After remodel, adds a 407,000-square-foot battery pack assembly plant using cells and arrays from BlueOval SK Battery Park in Kentucky.
- No information on new jobs or which EVs; 2020 reporting said at least five EVs, unconfirmed recent reports suggest fewer.
- Quotes from Bev Goodman (Ford of Canada; founded 119 years ago), Lana Payne (Unifor) and Jim Farley. Ford also announced a lithium iron phosphate battery plant in Marshall, Mich., production starting 2026.

wikis.title: The 10 Best Legend of Zelda Games of All Time (IGN)
wikis.summary: IGN staff ranking of the ten best mainline Zelda games for the series' 40th anniversary, from Twilight Princess (10) to Tears of the Kingdom (1).
wikis.body:
- By IGN Staff, updated Feb 16, 2026, celebrating the 40th anniversary of the series. Ranking with initial release dates:
10. Twilight Princess (Nov 19, 2006): unfairly maligned; large world, sidequests, Snowpeak Ruins; standout is Midna; "the bloat in this game is extreme" (Kat Bailey).
9. The Legend of Zelda (Feb 21, 1986): open-ended exploration and secrets; thrown into a monster-infested world with no weapon (Brendan Graeber).
8. A Link Between Worlds (Nov 22, 2013, 3DS): non-linear progression, dungeons in any order, emotional story; hints at Breath of the Wild.
7. Link's Awakening (Sep 19, 2019 listing): unique story without Zelda or Ganon; DX added a dungeon and color, the 2019 remake updated visuals.
6. The Wind Waker (Dec 13, 2002): cel-shaded style now widely accepted; lots of ocean; dark, fascinating story.
5. Majora's Mask (May 27, 2000): three-day time limit; reused characters reworked; somber themes of abandonment, trauma, death.
4. Ocarina of Time (Nov 21, 1998): tops IGN's best N64 games list; defined 3D adventure games.
3. A Link to the Past (Nov 21, 1991): storyline, dense world, Dark World, soundtrack.
2. Breath of the Wild (Mar 3, 2017): reinvented a 30-year-old series; go anywhere, climb anything; criticized for lack of traditional dungeons and items.
1. Tears of the Kingdom (May 12, 2023): "The latest entry into the Zelda series is also its best"; building mechanics, quality-of-life improvements, exciting story.

wikis.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild on Nintendo Switch (Nintendo store page)
wikis.summary: Nintendo's US store page describing Breath of the Wild's premise, gameplay features, Expansion Pass DLC and Switch 2 compatibility.
wikis.body:
- Premise: "After a 100-year slumber, Link wakes up alone in a world he no longer remembers"; he must explore Hyrule and regain his memories "before Hyrule is lost forever".
- Rated for Fantasy Violence, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol. Game Voucher eligible. Nintendo Switch 2 compatibility: "Supported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch." A Nintendo Switch 2 upgrade pack is offered. Digital sale listed as ending 9/27/26 at 03:59 a.m. UTC.
- World: towers to climb and survey the land; more than 100 Shrines of Trials with puzzles and in-game rewards; villages; stables where Link can rest, prepare food or Elixirs.
- Sheikah Slate: map, scope for points of interest, Runes downloaded in certain Shrines, Inventory and Adventure Log.
- Travel: horseback, raft, shield-surfing down slopes, paraglider.
- Combat: over 180 different weapons that wear out over time; bow shots and explosives.
- Cooking and clothing: hunt, gather and raid camps for food; recipes heal and boost stats; outfits protect from weather or enemy fire; "if you wear metal during a storm, you may be in for a shock".
- DLC: Expansion Pass grants three treasure chests (one holds a shirt with the Nintendo Switch logo) and two DLC packs, The Master Trials and The Champion's Ballad. Full game required.
- The 44-page Explorer's Guide, once only in the Explorer's Edition bundle, is a free PDF download.
- Related news dated 09/04/26: Nintendo and Laced Records vinyl soundtrack collection available.

wikis.title: Metacritic critic reviews of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch)
wikis.summary: Metacritic's Switch critic-review page showing a 97 Metascore ('Universal Acclaim') and excerpts of perfect-score reviews from March 2017.
wikis.body:
- Nintendo Switch Metascore 97, "Universal Acclaim"; 117 critic reviews shown: 106 positive (97%), 3 mixed (3%), 0 negative (0%).
- Reviews shown are dated Feb 27 to Mar 2, 2017, mostly scored 100.
- Edge Magazine (100): says it evokes feelings "we haven't known for 20 years" and that Ocarina of Time "may have to settle for second place".
- Attack of the Fanboy (100): "one of the best games ever made".
- Destructoid (100): "not your typical boiler plate open world cash grab"; a "new blueprint".
- GameSpot (100): "a defining moment for The Legend of Zelda series".
- IGN (100): "a masterclass in open-world design"; reviewer spent more than 50 hours and expected 50 to 100 more.
- Metro GameCentral (100): "The best Zelda there's ever been, and very possibly the best video game ever made."
- Stevivor (100) notes the game was delayed repeatedly and made a cross-gen switch.

wikis.title: Hivemapper passes 1 million kilometers mapped
wikis.summary: TechCrunch, March 23, 2023: Hivemapper says its dashcam network collected over 1 million km of unique imagery and outlines its token-based challenge to Google Maps.
wikis.body:
- Published 1:05 PM PDT, March 23, 2023, by Rebecca Bellan.
- Hivemapper puts dashcams on ride-hail and delivery vehicles; said Thursday it collected more than 1 million km (about 620,000 miles) of unique street-level imagery, over the last three months. Only 2% of the world's roads are mapped. Launched November 2022.
- Comparison: Google has 60 million km; it took Google from 2007 to 2019 to collect 16.1 million km. Target: 10 million unique road km by early next year.
- Dashcams cost $549 (high-quality imager, precise GPS). Contributors and editors are rewarded in the HONEY token; CEO Ariel Seidman says only 10 billion HONEY will ever exist.
- More than 11,000 contributors and 418 regions mapped to some degree (e.g. about 30% of Los Angeles roads, 1.4% of Genoa). Ops head Gabe Nelson: coverage of 90% in a region is where it becomes big.
- Strategy: recruit small to mid-sized fleets; fleet dashboard shows routes and tokens; higher rewards in South Korea, the Netherlands, Portugal, London, Paris, Madrid and Tokyo.
- Nelson claims Google raised prices 1800% since 2018 (Hivemapper's internal estimate); Google says it has not altered its price structure since 2018 and did not confirm its customer count. Hivemapper contrasts itself with Mapbox, which uses OpenStreetMap data.
- Seidman says he isn't "religious about crypto", calling it a tool for giving drivers shares.

wikis.title: HiveMapper reaches 1 million kilometers mapped (SolanaFloor)
wikis.summary: SolanaFloor news item saying HiveMapper, launched in 2022, has mapped 1 million km using contributor data rewarded in HONEY tokens.
wikis.body:
- HiveMapper, a mapping startup, reached "a milestone of 1 million kilometers of mapped terrain" in its aim to rival Google Maps.
- Launched in 2022; combines decentralization with user-generated content, unlike Google Maps, which the article says relies mainly on satellite imagery and proprietary data.
- Users contribute driving data and are rewarded in the HONEY token, giving a community-centric service that can offer cheaper alternatives.
- Aims to cover the entire world "within the next few years".
- The page says it raised over $21 million in seed funding to expand and develop its AI mapping technology.

wikis.title: Federal Reserve implementation note, May 3, 2023
wikis.summary: Fed press release on the operational settings implementing the FOMC's May 3, 2023 rate decision.
wikis.body:
- Board voted unanimously to raise the interest rate paid on reserve balances to 5.15 percent, effective May 4, 2023.
- FOMC directive to the Desk: maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 5 to 5-1/4 percent; standing overnight repo operations with minimum bid rate of 5.25 percent and aggregate limit of $500 billion; overnight reverse repo at an offering rate of 5.05 percent with per-counterparty limit of $160 billion per day.
- Balance sheet: Treasury securities roll over above a cap of $60 billion per month; agency debt and agency MBS principal reinvested into MBS above a cap of $35 billion per month.
- Board also voted unanimously to raise the primary credit rate by 1/4 percentage point to 5.25 percent, effective May 4, 2023, approving requests from eleven Reserve Banks (Boston, Philadelphia, Cleveland, Richmond, Atlanta, Chicago, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Kansas City, Dallas, San Francisco).
- Last update: May 03, 2023.

wikis.title: Fed raises rates a quarter point on May 3, 2023 and signals a possible pause
wikis.summary: CNBC report on the FOMC's unanimous 0.25-point hike to 5%-5.25%, the 10th in a little over a year, with softened forward guidance.
wikis.body:
- Published Wed, May 3 2023 2:00 PM EDT (updated May 4), by Jeff Cox.
- Fed approved its 10th rate increase in just over a year, unanimously, taking the fed funds rate to a target range of 5%-5.25%, "the highest since August 2007".
- Statement omitted the March sentence that "the Committee anticipates that some additional policy firming may be appropriate"; Chairman Jerome Powell: "a decision on a pause was not made today" but the change was "meaningful".
- Powell: inflation pressures "continue to run high" and getting to 2% "has a long way to go". Hikes began March 2022; labor market remained strong.
- Backdrop: three mid-size banks shuttered; JPMorgan Chase took over First Republic on Monday (Powell called it an "exception" and a "good outcome"); Q1 growth 1.1% annualized. Statement says tighter credit conditions are likely to weigh on activity, hiring and inflation. Prominent Democratic lawmakers urged a stop to hikes.
