wikis.body:
- Updated September 3, 2026 (Ian White).
- First powered monitor in the Reference Premiere Series; launching at $799.99 per pair.
- New high-density axial Tractrix horn with upgraded BMC material, flush-mounted; 5.25-inch Cerametallic woofer; built-in driver-matched amplification.
- Inputs: HDMI ARC, USB-C, optical, RCA line-level, phono, 3.5mm aux; Bluetooth 5.3; subwoofer output; IR remote; compatible with KS-28 stands.
- Not disclosed: amplifier power, frequency response, Bluetooth codecs, USB resolution, dimensions, weight.
- Compared with passive RP-600M II (6.5-inch Cerametallic woofer, 1-inch titanium LTS tweeter).

wikis.title: Klipsch Reference Signature Series and RP-500PM at CEDIA 2026
wikis.summary: Hifi Pig's 2 September 2026 report on Klipsch's new six-model Reference Signature Series and the RP-500PM powered monitor shown at CEDIA Expo 2026 in Denver.
wikis.body:
- September 2, 2026.
- Reference Signature Series: six models: RS-8301F and RS-6301F floorstanders, RS-8301M and RS-6301M monitors, RS-6301C centre, RS-6101SA Dolby Atmos surround/height module. Three-way horn-loaded, titanium-diaphragm Linear Travel Suspension tweeters, phase-aligned horn with midrange inside the tweeter horn, spun-copper Cerametallic cones, one-piece BMC baffle; Ebony and Walnut finishes; bi-wire/bi-amp binding posts on select models.
- Series price target: $1,600 to $3,000 per pair, select models this winter; final pricing at launch.
- RP-500PM: first powered monitor in Reference Premiere; 5.25-inch Cerametallic woofer, axial Tractrix horn; HDMI ARC, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, optical, RCA, phono, 3.5mm; sub output; IR remote.
- RP-500PM available in December in North America, MSRP $799.99; UK SRP GBP 799 (Henley Audio distributes).

wikis.title: Klipsch Reference Signature speakers get first listen at CEDIA 2026
wikis.summary: ecoustics report on Klipsch's six-model three-way Reference Signature Series shown at CEDIA Expo 2026 in Denver ahead of a winter launch.
wikis.body:
- Updated September 2, 2026 (Ian White). Shown at CEDIA Expo 2026 in Denver; earlier shown as concepts at CES 2026 (January). Select models arrive this winter.
- Lineup: RS-8301F (three-way 8-inch floorstander), RS-6301F (three-way 6.5-inch floorstander), RS-8301M and RS-6301M (three-way monitors), RS-6301C (three-way 6.5-inch centre), RS-6101SA (two-way 6.5-inch Dolby Atmos/height/surround).
- Key change from Reference Premiere: a dedicated midrange driver, with a new phase-aligned horn placing the midrange inside the tweeter horn; titanium-diaphragm Linear Travel Suspension tweeter retained.
- 8-inch models pair 8-inch Cerametallic bass drivers with a 6.5-inch midrange; smaller models 6.5-inch bass with 5.25-inch midrange; floorstanders use dual woofers, monitors one.
- RS-6301C uses a vertical driver array instead of horizontal MTM to reduce horizontal lobing and comb filtering.
- RS-6101SA can sit atop a tower to fire upward or be wall-mounted; rear switch selects Atmos or Surround crossover.
- One-piece BMC front baffle.
- The writer notes Klipsch showed Reference Premiere III at Audio Advice Live 2026 in August.

wikis.title: KEF outdoor speakers collection (coming April 2027)
wikis.summary: KEF US collection page teasing a new range of weatherproof outdoor speakers with Uni-Q technology, coming April 2027.
wikis.body:
- KEF's new outdoor speakers described as "Coming Soon", weatherproof, engineered for heavy rain, coastal salt and sunlight; first time KEF's Uni-Q technology is used outdoors.
- Designs: landscape satellites, 3-way bollard speakers, surface-mount speakers.
- Available to view and purchase via KEF.com and retail partners from April 2027; newsletter sign-up offered.
- Listed under the collection: KEF Ventura Series outdoor speakers, Ventura 6 at $599.99.

wikis.title: KEF LS LUXE wireless bookshelf speaker product page
wikis.summary: KEF US product page for the LS LUXE, a wireless HiFi bookshelf speaker designed with Ross Lovegrove, listing specs, finishes and price.
wikis.body:
- **Product:** KEF LS LUXE, "The Wireless HiFi That Redefines Luxury", a wireless bookshelf speaker sculpted by Ross Lovegrove.
- **Price:** page shows Dusk Titanium at $3,999.99 per pair; Dusk Titanium "is currently on backorder". A separate $799.99 item appears beside the "S-LUXE Floor Stand" pairing option (Slate Grey).
- **Finishes:** Dusk Titanium, Eclipse Black, Mineral White.
- **Drivers/tech:** 12th generation 6.5-inch Uni-Q driver; MAT (absorbs 99% of unwanted rear sound); Velocity Control Technology (VECO), "debuting for the first time in a wireless speaker", uses motion-sensing feedback to reduce distortion and power compression; current-drive amplifier; Music Integrity Engine DSP.
- **Audio:** high-res up to 384kHz/24bit.
- **Connectivity:** HDMI eARC, optical, coaxial, AUX; Apple AirPlay, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, Roon Ready ("Available in 2027"); dual dedicated wired subwoofer outputs, or the KW1 wireless adapter.
- **Control:** KEF Connect app (EQ); C3 remote with aluminium plate, backlit buttons and customisable Favourite button.
- **Cabinet:** sculpted, low-diffraction, meant to reduce vibrations.

wikis.title: KEF introduces LS LUXE
wikis.summary: Short news teaser from The Absolute Sound dated July 30, 2026 announcing KEF's LS LUXE wireless speaker with myKEF early access.
wikis.body:
- Dated July 30, 2026, by TAS Staff.
- KEF introduces LS LUXE: "the union of Ross Lovegrove's sculptural vision and KEF's enduring acoustic innovation", a wireless speaker "reimagined as a work of art".
- Tagline: "This is What Luxury Sounds Like."
- "myKEF early access begins now" for those who want to be among the first to get LS LUXE.
- No specs or pricing in the text.

wikis.title: JBL launches JBL Cove whole-home audio system
wikis.summary: JBL press release (1 September 2026) introducing the Cove M1, P1 and X1 Wi-Fi speakers, with features, prices and an 08 October 2026 availability date.
wikis.body:
- **Announced:** Amsterdam, 1 September 2026.
- **Product:** JBL Cove, a whole-home Wi-Fi audio system of three speakers, usable alone, as stereo pairs or as a multi-room system via the JBL One app.
- **Models:** Cove M1 (compact), Cove P1 (portable, battery, Dolby Atmos), Cove X1 (flagship, four tweeters and dual woofers, Dolby Atmos).
- **Price/availability:** white and black at JBL.com from 08 October 2026; M1 EUR 229.99, P1 EUR 449.99, X1 EUR 499.99.
- **Features:** Constant Sound Field, automatic self-tuning, AI Sound Boost; Music Follows Me (press and hold the Moment button, no phone or app); 3-step setup with no account needed; Spotify Tap; Alexa+ voice control "later this year" (OTA update US only this year).
- **Soundbars:** works with JBL Bar 300/500/800/1000/1300 MK2; Cove P1 and M1 at launch can be added as rear channels for Dolby Atmos.
- **Connectivity:** Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Roon Ready, Spotify Connect, Tidal Connect, Qobuz Connect.
- **Quote:** Carsten Olesen, President, Consumer Audio at HARMAN: "a new benchmark for the future of JBL home audio".

wikis.title: JBL Cove Wi-Fi speakers launch (SoundGuys)
wikis.summary: SoundGuys news piece of Sep 2, 2026 on JBL's Cove M1, P1 and X1 multi-room speakers and the Music Follows Me feature.
wikis.body:
- By Shimul Sood, Sep 2, 2026.
- Three Wi-Fi speakers: Cove M1, portable P1, flagship X1; work alone, as stereo pairs, or multi-room.
- Standout feature: Music Follows Me, press and hold the Moment button to move music or TV audio room to room without the JBL One app.
- Prices: M1 EUR 229.99 (~$265); P1 EUR 449.99 (~$520), adds battery and Dolby Atmos; X1 EUR 499.99 (~$578), four tweeters, two woofers, Dolby Atmos.
- Auto-tuning, Constant Sound Field, AI Sound Boost.
- Supports Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, Tidal Connect, Qobuz Connect, Roon; Spotify Tap; Alexa+ voice control "coming later this year".
- Black and white; "an exact availability date hasn't been announced yet."
- Notes Sonos and others have offered multi-room audio for years.

wikis.title: JBL Pulse 6 speaker availability (Engadget)
wikis.summary: Engadget report of Aug. 26, 2026 that the $330 JBL Pulse 6 light-show speaker is up for preorder and ships September 6.
wikis.body:
- By Anna Washenko, Aug. 26, 2026.
- JBL Pulse 6 portable Bluetooth speaker retails for $330; preorder today, "expected to begin shipping on September 6".
- 360-degree light show; integrated handle; 16 pre-programmed themes (ten ambient, six party).
- Connects with compatible PartyBox speakers and the PartyLight Stick; syncs audio with other JBL products via Auracast.
- Upgraded acoustic design; JBL last updated the Pulse collection in 2022; AI Sound Boost to reduce distortion.
- Up to 12 hours battery; IP68 water and dust rating.

wikis.title: JBL Pulse 6 launch (SoundGuys)
wikis.summary: SoundGuys news piece of Aug 26, 2026 on the $329.95 JBL Pulse 6, its lighting modes, audio upgrades and comparison to the Pulse 5.
wikis.body:
- By Matt Horne, Aug 26, 2026.
- Price $329.95, order now, shipping due September 6; $80 more than the Pulse 5 at launch.
- 16 lighting themes (party and ambient), illuminated carrying handle; Bedside Lamp mode on double-tap; Sunset Mode countdown up to 60 minutes, music stops at end.
- Audio: upgraded acoustic design claimed to give deeper bass and more balance; AI Sound Boost; Bluetooth 6.0; lossless playback over USB-C; Auracast, pair two units for stereo.
- Weight 1.49kg; IP67 upgraded to IP68; battery up to 12 hours.
- SoundGuys on the Pulse 5: liked the light show and bass for small gatherings, but felt buyers paid a premium for lighting rather than audio value, and found it heavy.

wikis.title: Bluesound PULSE SUB wireless subwoofer product page
wikis.summary: Bluesound product page for the PULSE SUB, a $1,099 wireless powered subwoofer listed as coming soon with delivery expected late 2026.
wikis.body:
- Status: "Coming Soon"; "Expected Delivery Late 2026". Price $1,099.00.
- 350W total system power; dual-opposed 6.5-inch woofers to reduce cabinet vibration.
- Wireless connection to compatible Bluesound players (POWERNODE, PULSE M, PULSE FLEX; designed as the fit for PULSE CINEMA and PULSE CINEMA MINI), plus wired option and low/line-level analog input.
- BluOS Controller app: volume, crossover, phase.
- Removable magnetic grilles; Black or Tan.
- Specs: WiFi 5, Ethernet RJ45, ARM Cortex-A55 quad-core 1.8GHz, network standby 8W, SKU SW200, 292 x 330 x 315 mm (11.5 x 13.0 x 12.4 in), 10 kg / 22 lbs.

wikis.title: Bluesound introduces the PULSE SUB
wikis.summary: Bluesound press release (Toronto, August 27, 2026) announcing the redesigned 350W PULSE SUB wireless subwoofer with price and availability later in 2026.
wikis.body:
- Posted August 27, 2026, Toronto.
- PULSE SUB: redesigned wireless powered subwoofer; 350-watt amplifier with Smart DSP, two custom 6.5-inch woofers in opposing configuration; "2.5x more power than the previous generation".
- Opposing woofers counteract mechanical forces so the cabinet "stays nearly still".
- Pairs via BluOS Controller app with PULSE CINEMA, PULSE CINEMA MINI, POWERNODE, PULSE M, PULSE FLEX; app controls volume, crossover, phase. Connects over Wi-Fi or Ethernet; low line-level analog input lets it act as a wired active sub.
- Design: just over one square foot of floor space, tonal-weave fabric grilles, matte satin finishes (Matte Black, Matte White Tan), cable management channels.
- Quote: Matt Simmonds, VP of Bluesound Product Development: "Great bass shouldn't be loud and boomy."
- Price/availability: "later this year" at $1099 USD, $1299 CAD, EUR 999, GBP 849 via authorized retailers, bluesound.com and Amazon; pre-orders at a later date.

wikis.title: Bluesound Pulse Sub announcement (Trusted Reviews)
wikis.summary: Trusted Reviews news item of August 28, 2026 on Bluesound's redesigned Pulse Sub with 350W and dual-opposing woofers.
wikis.body:
- By Gian Estrada, August 28, 2026.
- 350-watt amplifier with Smart DSP drives two custom 6.5-inch woofers in an opposing layout, "roughly 2.5 times more power than the previous generation".
- Opposing drivers cancel vibration.
- Pairs with existing Bluesound products via BluOS Controller app; options include Pulse Cinema and Pulse Cinema Mini soundbars and the Powernode.
- Low line-level analogue input allows use as a wired active sub with non-BluOS systems.
- Quote from Matt Simmonds on not being "loud and boomy".
- Available "later in 2026" at GBP 849 / EUR 999; pre-order details to follow.

wikis.title: Buchardt Audio E50-S passive speaker product page
wikis.summary: Buchardt Audio page for the EUR 4,300/pair E50-S passive speaker, a bass-lighter, midrange-focused, higher-sensitivity variant of the E50.
wikis.body:
- Price EUR 4.300,00 per pair; "Delivery: October"; shipping, tax and import costs covered; made in Denmark from solid European oak; 10 years warranty.
- Parts from SB Acoustics, Scan-Speak, Jantzen Audio and Duelund Coherent Audio; custom Satori 7.5" woofer with TeXtreme cone (Oxeon AB, Sweden); Argento Audio binding posts.
- "S" stands for "Sensitivity"; 1 cm / 0.4" wider than the E50. "Not an upgrade over the E50, but rather a different approach."
- Sound vs E50: less overall bass, more midrange focus, more forward, energetic and "snappy"; treble still airy and smooth.
- Suits smaller rooms, speakers near walls, or less powerful amplifiers (from small 15-watt tube amps up); the E50 is "a hungry speaker".
- More pronounced BBC dip and lighter bass than E50; tuned by ear. Buchardt chose not to publish measurements; says the E50 is more frequency-linear but "if you want a frequency-linear speaker, this is NOT what you are looking for".
- Costs more than the E50 because of a more advanced, costly crossover (resistor-free); the E50's PURIFI woofer allowed a single crossover component.

wikis.title: Monitor Audio Silver Series 8G speaker range
wikis.summary: Monitor Audio US overview page for the seven-model Silver Series 8G hi-fi speaker range with US prices.
wikis.body:
- Silver Series 8G "comprises seven all-new models" for two-channel and multi-channel systems; described as "The Most Capable Silver Series Ever", focused on "uncompromising high-fidelity sound".
- Models: Silver 500 8G, Silver 300 8G (3-way floorstander), Silver 100 8G (true 3-way standmount), Silver 50 8G (compact 2-way bookshelf), Silver On-Wall 8G, Silver Centre 8G, Silver AMS 8G (sits atop Silver 50 and 300 for immersive cinema).
- US prices (marked NEW): Silver 500 $4000; 300 $3000; 100 $2300; AMS $1400; 50 $1250; Centre $1200; On-Wall $650. AV systems: Silver 300 7.1.4 $10749; Silver 300 5.1 $6699; Silver 50 5.1 $3649.
- European Walnut veneer is real, fully engineered wood from sustainable timber.
- Quotes: Hi-Fi News on Silver 500 8G "an exciting, large-scale delivery"; AVForums "tremendous attention-grabbing quality".

wikis.title: Monitor Audio Silver Series 8G announced (StereoNET)
wikis.summary: StereoNET news of 17 August 2026 on Monitor Audio's seven-model Silver Series 8G, its driver and cabinet changes, and pair prices from August 2026.
wikis.body:
- By Jay Garrett, 17th August, 2026.
- Seven all-new models: Silver 500, 300, 100, 50, On-Wall, Centre, AMS; covers 5.1 and Dolby Atmos 7.1.4 layouts. Built around Monitor Audio's "Transparent Design Philosophy".
- Drivers: latest C-CAM Ceramic-Coated Aluminium/Magnesium technology with RST III cone geometry; reworked C-CAM Gold Dome tweeter (vented rear chamber, new shorting ring, UD Waveguide II); new Silent Flow port "inspired by the interlocking wing feathers of an owl"; upgraded crossover components.
- Cabinets: Through-Bolt Driver Bracing; outrigger feet inspired by the Platinum Series 3G on floorstanders; spikes swappable for rubber feet.
- Finishes: High Gloss Black, Satin White, European Walnut (real engineered wood from sustainable timber).
- Available from August 2026, MSRP (GBP | EUR | US$ | A$): 500 2650|3100|3300|4999 pair; 300 2000|2400|2600|3,999 pair; 100 1500|1800|2000|2,999 pair; 50 800|1000|1050|1,599 pair; On-Wall 450|550|575|849 piece; Centre 800|1000|1050|1,599 piece; AMS 900|1100|1200|1,799 pair.

wikis.title: Rotel Amora 5 loudspeaker product page
wikis.summary: Rotel product page with specifications for the Amora 5, a 2-way bass-reflex bookshelf loudspeaker.
wikis.body:
- Amora 5: loudspeaker "shaped by decades of Rotel engineering experience", pairs with Rotel systems.
- Design: 2-way bass-reflex; 1 x 25 mm (1 in) silk dome tweeter, 1 x 165 mm (6.5 in) woven fibre composite midrange/bass driver; crossover 2.5 kHz.
- Frequency response 48 Hz - 28 kHz; sensitivity 87 dB (2.83 Vrms / 1 m); nominal impedance 8 ohm; recommended amplifier power 30 - 120 Watts.
- MDF cabinet; Matte Black or Matte White; black grille; dual gold-plated terminals.
- Dimensions 350 x 190 x 300 mm (13.8 x 7.5 x 11.8 in); weight 7.7 kg (17 lb).
- No price on the page.

wikis.title: Rotel returns to loudspeakers with the Amora 5 (StereoNET)
wikis.summary: StereoNET news of 19 August 2026 on Rotel's Amora 5 standmount speaker, its return to passive speakers, with US$999 per pair price.
wikis.body:
- By Jay Garrett, 19th August, 2026.
- Amora 5: new two-way bass-reflex standmount loudspeaker, "the brand's return to passive speaker design".
- 25mm silk-dome tweeter (aluminium surround ring, shaped ABS faceplate), 165mm woven-fibre composite mid/bass with aluminium frame, 2.5kHz crossover; 48Hz to 28kHz, 87dB sensitivity.
- MDF cabinet 350 x 190 x 300mm (HxWxD), rear-firing port, dual gold-plated terminals for single or bi-wire, magnetic fabric grille.
- Quote: Peter Kao, Managing Director of Rotel: "we extend the Rotel experience through the final stage of the system".
- Matte Black and Matte White, available from August 2026, SRP US$999 | EUR 999 | GBP 999 | A$1,499 | NZ$1,849 per pair.

wikis.title: Q Acoustics 3040c floorstanding speaker product page
wikis.summary: Q Acoustics UK product page for the 3040c compact floorstanding speaker (GBP 599 per pair) with specs and the 3000c range.
wikis.body:
- 3040c compact floorstander, pair, GBP 599.00.
- Tech: C3 (Continuous Curved Cone) mid/bass; hermetically sealed, mechanically isolated HF unit; P2P bracing; HPE tubes.
- Specs: 2 x 120 mm bass, 1 x 22 mm treble; 43 Hz - 30 kHz (-6 dB); 6 ohm nominal; 88.0 dB; 25-120 W; crossover 2.4 kHz; 26.8 L; 942 x 285 x 281 mm; 14.6 kg each.
- Finishes: Pin Oak, Claro Walnut, Satin White, Satin Black.
- Range prices: 3010c GBP 249, 3020c 299, 3030c 399, 3050c 749 pair, 3090c centre 229, 3010c 5.1 GBP 1,126, 3050c 5.1 GBP 1,626.

wikis.title: Q Acoustics 3040c compact floorstander (What Hi-Fi?)
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi? news of 30 July 2026 on Q Acoustics' 3040c, which completes the 3000c range, priced 599 pounds in the UK.
wikis.body:
- By Joe Svetlik, published 30 July 2026.
- 3040c completes the 3000c range "two years after the first model launched"; a step down from the 3050c.
- C3 (Continuous Curved Cone) driver platform: "controlled bass performance, expressive midrange and smoother integration with the high-frequency driver".
- Floating tweeter, hermetically sealed and mechanically isolated (from Concept series), vented inner chamber; Point to Point bracing; Helmholtz Pressure Equaliser tubes.
- Solid aluminium stabilisers, top-adjustable spikes, low-profile terminal panel from the 5000 series to allow closer wall placement.
- Finishes: Satin Black, Satin White, Pink Oak, Claro Walnut.
- Out now in the UK; US in October. GBP 599 / $1099 (AU$ TBC), just below the 3050c (GBP 749 / $1199).

wikis.title: Triangle AIO Twin wireless speaker product page
wikis.summary: Triangle Hi-Fi USA page for the $899 AIO Twin Bluetooth and Wi-Fi active speaker pair with phono input.
wikis.body:
- Price $899.00 for the pair (page variant colour Macassar); many finishes listed (English Green, Abyss Blue, Linen Grey, White, Brown Maple, Black, Eggplant, Macassar). Return and refund within 30 days.
- Stereo active speakers for rooms up to 25 m2; 25mm silk dome tweeter, 13cm midwoofer; 2 x 50 Watts.
- Bluetooth 5.0 aptX; Wi-Fi streaming up to 24 bit / 192 kHz; Wi-Fi multiroom; phono input for turntables (33 & 45 rpm); optical/SPDIF for TV; IR remote.
- Triangle AIO app (Linkplay technology); services: Deezer, Spotify, Qobuz, Tidal, TuneIn.
- "TRIANGLE ... French Manufacture"; workshop in Soissons.

wikis.title: Triangle AIO Twin in Macassar finish (Trusted Reviews)
wikis.summary: Trusted Reviews news of August 7, 2026 that Triangle's AIO Twin connected speaker system is now offered in a Macassar ebony veneer finish.
wikis.body:
- By Gian Estrada, August 7, 2026.
- New Macassar ebony wood veneer finish: genuine wood veneer, vertical grain with fine golden lines over rich dark brown, contrasts shift with viewing angle; oblong grille in deep brown Gabriel fabric (Scandinavian textile).
- Triangle cites its Soissons workshops and four decades of loudspeaker work.
- Hardware: switchable MM phono and RCA input, Bluetooth 5.0 and Wi-Fi to 24-bit/192kHz, multi-room with other AIO speakers, optical S/PDIF for TVs, subwoofer output.
- No price in the text.

wikis.title: Creative XF1 Bluetooth 6.0 desktop speakers product page
wikis.summary: Creative US page for the $179.99 XF1 2.0 desktop speakers with 72W RMS, Bluetooth 6.0 with LDAC and 10-band parametric EQ.
wikis.body:
- Price $179.99. Reviews dated 2026-08-25/26: T3 (dreamy affordable desktop arrangement), CNET 8.4/10 ("exceeded my expectations for the price"), Tom's Guide (Nick Pino).
- 72W RMS; bi-amplified (each driver its own channel); FEA-optimized woofer; MDF satellite enclosures; cork stands angle at 15 degrees.
- Bluetooth 6.0 (SBC, AAC, LDAC), USB audio Type-C, AUX; hi-res over USB and line-in; subwoofer output option.
- Creative Nexus app: 10-band Parametric EQ, 100+ presets (Tom's Guide quote says 120+).
- Specs: 2.0 system; each speaker 155 x 99.7 x 191 mm; 1.29 kg left, 1.36 kg right; range up to 10m/33 ft; works with Windows, Mac, Switch, Switch 2, PS5.

wikis.title: Creative XF1 desktop speakers launch (SoundGuys)
wikis.summary: SoundGuys news of Aug 6, 2026 on the $179.99 Creative XF1 bi-amplified 2.0 desktop speakers with 72W RMS, Bluetooth 6.0 and LDAC.
wikis.body:
- By Aamir Siddiqui, Aug 6, 2026.
- Launched globally; compact bi-amplified 2.0 system; up to 72W RMS (26W x2 woofers, 10W x2 tweeters); 3-inch woofers, 0.74-inch silk-dome tweeters; dual Hi-Res Audio certification, 55Hz to 40kHz.
- Connectivity: USB-C digital audio (up to 24-bit/96kHz), 3.5mm AUX, Bluetooth 6.0 with LDAC, subwoofer output with automatic mode switching for 2.1.
- Detachable cork stands tilt drivers 15 degrees.
- Creative Nexus app: 10-band parametric EQ, "more than 120 genre- and game-specific presets".
- $179.99 in Black and White, available today in the US from Creative's store; wider retail "expected to follow". Compared to Edifier MR4 and PreSonus Eris 3.5 BT Gen 2.

wikis.title: Sony ULT TOWER 5 wireless party speaker product page
wikis.summary: Sony Electronics US page for the $449.99 ULT TOWER 5 party speaker with Party Chain via Auracast and 20 hour battery.
wikis.body:
- ULT TOWER 5, marked "New", $449.99; estimated delivery Sep 22-23.
- 20 hour battery life; 360-degree Party Sound; XLR, RCA and USB Type-C inputs for DJs; Party Chain via Auracast; handles; 10-band EQ; Sound Connect app; built-in Party Lights.
- Sound modes: ULT1, ULT2, FLAT, LIVE; front-facing ULT button.
- Co-created with hip-hop sound creators: Dot Da Genius, Daru Jones, Dready, Dennis "ROC.am" Jones.
- Purchase perks: 3-month Audible Premium Plus trial offer, My Sony points.

wikis.title: Sony ULT Tower party speakers with Auracast (Engadget)
wikis.summary: Engadget news of Sept. 1, 2026 on Sony's ULT Tower Max ($1,500), Tower 7 ($650) and Tower 5 ($450) party speakers with Party Chain.
wikis.body:
- By Lawrence Bonk, Sept. 1, 2026. Three new ULT Tower speakers, each replacing an older model.
- Ports: XLR, RCA, USB-C; works with ULT MIC1 microphone for karaoke.
- New Party Chain links speakers wirelessly via Bluetooth Auracast, only among these new speakers, "so they won't be able to wirelessly connect to older models".
- Four EQ buttons: ULT1, ULT2 (bass), FLAT ("true-to-source"), LIVE.
- ULT Tower Max: "most powerful bass yet", rear woofer, four tweeters, mid-range speaker, 360-degree Party Sound, wider-tread wheels; $1,500; replaces Tower 10.
- ULT Tower 7: wheels, Party Sound, IPX4, 30 hours battery; $650; replaces XV800.
- ULT Tower 5: IPX4, about 20 hours battery; $450; replaces XV500.

wikis.title: Sony ULT TOWER MAX, 7 and 5 party speakers (audioXpress)
wikis.summary: audioXpress news of September 1 2026 on Sony's three new ULT POWER SOUND party speakers with Auracast Party Chain, co-developed with hip-hop producers.
wikis.body:
- By Joao Martins, September 1 2026.
- Sony expanded ULT POWER SOUND with ULT TOWER MAX, ULT TOWER 7, ULT TOWER 5; co-developed with hip-hop producers Dot Da Genius, Daru Jones, Dready and Dennis "ROC.am" Jones.
- Technologies: new large circular woofers, large cabinets, ULT DUCT (tuned port), 360-degree Party Sound, Sound Field Optimization, Auracast-based Party Chain that synchronizes music and lighting; stereo configuration also possible.
- Connectivity: XLR, RCA, USB-C; optional ULTMIC1 karaoke microphone.
- Lighting modes BEAT, WAVE, MELLOW.
- ULT button: ULT1 and ULT2 (bass), FLAT, LIVE; Custom EQ in Sony Sound Connect app.
- Author notes Party Chain is for "compatible Sony speakers" and wonders whether a JBL Auracast speaker could join; "it's a question of testing".

wikis.title: LG launches xboom Blast party speaker (LG newsroom)
wikis.summary: LG global newsroom release dated 10 Aug 2026 announcing the xboom Blast outdoor Bluetooth party speaker with 220W, 36 hour battery and IP68.
wikis.body:
- SEOUL, Aug. 10, 2026.
- Up to 220 watts (AC) and up to 210 watts on battery; two 5.25-inch neodymium woofers and two 20 mm Peerless tweeters; xboom Signature Sound tuned by will.i.am.
- Replaceable 99 watt-hour battery; Play Time Enhance; up to 36 hours playback (caveat: actual usage varies).
- IP68 (dust tight, immersion up to 1 m for 1 hour) and seven military-grade durability tests.
- AI Sound, Space Calibration Pro, Sound Field Enhance, AI Lighting (Dual Ring Lighting), Auracast multi-speaker, Bluetooth and USB-C.
- Duffel-bag-inspired design with fabric handle and vertical rope handle; 2026 Red Dot Design Award.
- "Pricing and availability ... in the US will be announced at a later date."

wikis.title: LG xboom Blast launch (PR Newswire via Morningstar)
wikis.summary: US PR Newswire release of Aug. 11, 2026 announcing the LG xboom Blast portable outdoor party speaker.
wikis.body:
- ENGLEWOOD CLIFFS, N.J., Aug. 11, 2026.
- Global launch of LG xboom Blast, premium portable Bluetooth party speaker for beach, camping, poolside and backyard use.
- Up to 36 hours battery (Play Time Enhance), IP68, seven military-grade durability tests; dual 5.25" woofers, three passive radiators, Peerless tweeters; xboom Signature Sound tuned by will.i.am.
- AI Sound, Space Calibration Pro, Sound Field Enhance, AI Lighting, Auracast for multiple speakers, USB-C audio.
- Duffel bag-inspired design; 2026 Red Dot Design Award; fabric exterior and side bumpers.
- "Pricing and availability of the new LG xboom Blast in the US will be announced at a later date."

wikis.title: LG xboom Blast specs and price (The Gadgeteer)
wikis.summary: The Gadgeteer article of August 16, 2026 on LG's xboom Blast, listing a $499.99 price and questioning headline specs.
wikis.body:
- By Rei Padla, August 16, 2026. Price listed: $499.99, buy at Amazon.
- Up to 220W on AC, 210W on battery; two 5.25-inch neodymium woofers, two 20mm Peerless tweeters; sound tuned by will.i.am.
- 99Wh replaceable battery, up to 36 hours; the author notes LG gives no volume level or conditions for that figure.
- IP68 plus "seven military-grade durability tests" (not detailed by LG); protective side bumpers and durable fabric.
- Duffel-bag shape, top handle and rope handle for vertical carry; 2026 Red Dot Design Award; no weight figure in LG's announcement.

wikis.title: FiiO EA13 vacuum tube power amplifier product page (Apos)
wikis.summary: Apos Audio page for the FiiO EA13 28W Class-A tube power amp, $769.99 but sold out pending restock.
wikis.body:
- Sale price $769.99 USD (Black or Silver); "sold out of our EA13 inventory", restock timing unknown.
- Pure Class-A push-pull tube amp: two SYLVANIA NOS PCF80 preamp tubes and four JJ ELECTRONIC EL34 power tubes (Czech-made).
- Output 28W + 28W at 4 or 8 ohm at THD+N below 5%; at least 18W + 18W at THD+N below 1%.
- Four RCA inputs, 6.35mm headphone output, mechanical VU meters, 40-level stepped analog volume.
- Custom EI silicon-steel output transformers; CNC aluminum front panel, unibody chassis.

wikis.title: FiiO EA13 vacuum tube amplifier announcement
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi? news report on FiiO's EA13 six-tube Class A push-pull amplifier, its specs and price.
wikis.body:
- FiiO unveiled the EA13, a full-size vacuum tube amplifier that aims to bring classic valve amplification in a modern, feature-heavy design; the headline says it takes inspiration from the "golden era of 1950s tube amplifiers".
- Six tubes, Class A push-pull circuitry, 28 watts per channel at 8 ohms.
- Two Sylvania NOS PCF80 preamplifier tubes ("refined, transparent presentation", "open, natural soundstage") and four JJ Electronic EL34 power tubes.
- Low-noise output transformer built to suppress vibration and improve electromagnetic shielding and stability; FiiO says this gives tauter, fuller bass, refined treble and improved dynamics.
- Connections: four RCA line-level inputs, 4 ohm and 8 ohm speaker outputs, 6.35mm single-ended headphone output on the front.
- Build: CNC-machined, sandblasted aluminium front panel, solid metal body for EM shielding, two mechanical VU meters flanked by backlit volume and input selector knobs.
- Price: out now at 769 GBP / 769 USD / 665 EUR.
- Published 25 August 2026, by Harry McKerrell.

wikis.title: Goldmund Telos 9800 mono power amplifier (manufacturer page)
wikis.summary: Goldmund's product page for the Telos 9800, a two-chassis mono power amplifier delivering 1,560 Wrms into 8 ohms.
wikis.body:
- Goldmund calls the Telos 9800 "our ultimate creation", building on the Telos 8800 with a completely redesigned platform.
- For the first time the power supply and amplification stages are in separate, interconnected enclosures.
- Redesigned power stage: next-generation MOSFET output devices, more powerful transformers, increased energy reserves, a newly developed SoftStart circuit; claimed benefits are stability, faster transient response and better loudspeaker control.
- Output: 1,560 Wrms into 8 ohms.
- Designed with designer Cecile Barani; a single gold plate sits at the junction of the two enclosures; redesigned digital display.
- Construction: seamless micro-blasted aluminium chassis, gold-plated copper terminals and screws, 15mm-thick aluminium panels and 40mm-thick radiator chassis as passive heat sink, EMI shielding.
- Finishes: grey and black (contact dealers for availability and lead time).
- No price or date stated on the page.

wikis.title: Goldmund Telos 9800 introduced (The Absolute Sound)
wikis.summary: The Absolute Sound news item introducing Goldmund's Telos 9800 mono power amplifier with specs, size and a suggested price of $990,000 per pair.
wikis.body:
- Announced August 2026 ("Rhythm is pleased to announce the arrival of..."); article dated Aug 27, 2026.
- Builds on the Telos 8800; power supply and amplification are separate, interconnected enclosures for the first time in a Goldmund amplifier.
- Power supply: 10 kVA of transformer capacity and the largest capacitor bank Goldmund has developed (648 mF); in-house transformers, next-gen MOSFET output devices, SoftStart circuit.
- Fully symmetrical signal path; 1,560 Wrms into 8 ohms ("laboratory measurements show significantly higher output into lower impedances").
- Natural convection cooling, 15 mm side panels, 40 mm radiator sections; gold-plated copper terminals and screws.
- Designed with Cecile Barani; grey or black finishes; gold plate at the junction.
- Dimensions 53.8 x 19.7 x 19.7 in; weight 794 lb per monoblock.
- Availability: two pairs are "now in transit to North America"; suggested retail is $990,000 per pair.

wikis.title: Goldmund Telos 9800 announcement (StereoNET)
wikis.summary: StereoNET news report on Goldmund's Telos 9800 two-piece 1,560-watt amplifier, with size, weight, features and a 400,000 CHF per unit price.
wikis.body:
- Swiss firm Goldmund unveiled the Telos 9800, a two-piece, 1560-watt amplifier; the article calls it the most powerful, advanced and sculptural amp the brand has built.
- Weight 360kg per unit; size 1,367 x 500 x 500 mm (HxWxD). Power supply and amplification stages are in separate but interconnected units.
- 9.7 kVA of transformer capacity and a 648 mF capacitor bank (the largest Goldmund has produced); stable down to 1 ohm (4,180 Wrms output); damping factor listed as 900 at 1 kHz / 8 ohm.
- Includes Goldmund's 'Leonardo' technology, a signal-processing algorithm that digitally realigns frequencies to reduce phase distortion.
- Fully symmetrical input to output with galvanic isolation between the two stages; protection systems.
- Inputs/outputs: RCA and XLR analogue inputs, Goldmund speaker binding posts, S/PDIF digital in and outs.
- Designer Cecile Barani (who also designed Goldmund's Gaia speakers).
- Price: 400,000 CHF per unit, approx. 370,000 GBP / 430,000 EUR / US$500,000.
- Article by Jay Garrett, 10th August, 2026.

wikis.title: Pro-Ject Harley-Davidson turntable (manufacturer page)
wikis.summary: Pro-Ject's product page for its limited special edition Harley-Davidson belt-drive turntable, with design, components and specifications.
wikis.body:
- Limited Special Edition collaboration between Pro-Ject and Harley-Davidson, bringing the "mechanical soul" of the open road to the living space; manufactured by Pro-Ject under license from Harley-Davidson Motor Company.
- Plinth shaped after the Harley-Davidson Bar & Shield logo, machined from solid MDF with no hollow spaces; Alu-MDF sandwich chassis; polished aluminium and stainless steel; genuine leather mat "reminiscent of a classic bike saddle".
- Drive: belt drive, 33/45 rpm with electronic speed change; AC synchronous motor made in Europe powered by a DC/AC generator; total moving mass 2.75 kg; diamond-cut aluminium sub-platter and motor pulley (tolerances within one thousandth of a millimetre).
- Platter: 300 mm heavy glass with leather mat; 915 g record puck with special Harley-Davidson design; three height-adjustable damped aluminium feet.
- Tonearm: 8.6" (218.5 mm) hand-polished aluminium S-shape, SME headshell, high-purity copper wiring, TPE damped counterweight, adaptive gravity-based anti-skating; effective mass 23.8 g; overhang 18.5 mm.
- Cartridge: pre-adjusted Pick it PRO MM, made in Denmark. 5P-DIN phono connector; Connect it Phono E 5P/RCA cable included.
- Power 15V/800 mA DC; 4W, 0W standby; dimensions 543 x 124 x 437 mm (WxHxD).
- No price or date on the page.

wikis.title: Pro-Ject and Harley-Davidson team up on a turntable (Louder)
wikis.summary: Louder news report, published 9 September 2026, on Pro-Ject's Harley-Davidson Bar & Shield turntable priced at 2590 EUR.
wikis.body:
- Austrian audio firm Pro-Ject teamed with Harley-Davidson for a turntable said to bring the "mechanical soul of the open road to your living space".
- Two-speed, belt-driven; plinth inspired by the Bar & Shield logo; polished aluminium and stainless steel; leather mat to represent a bike saddle.
- Components: diamond-cut aluminium sub-platter, heavy glass main platter, 8.6" aluminium S-shaped tonearm, DC/AC generator, Pick It Pro Moving Magnet cartridge, height-adjustable feet, heavy-duty record puck.
- Pro-Ject quote: "Every edge, every curve is a deliberate nod to over a century of American motorcycle heritage"; "Find your groove. Hold your speed."
- Price: 2590 EUR.
- Specs listed: 33/45 rpm, 300 mm glass platter, effective arm length 8.6" (218.5 mm), mass 23.8g, overhang 18.5 mm, 15V DC / 800 mA supply, 4W max / 0W standby, 543 x 124 x 437mm.
- By Scott Munro, published 9 September 2026.

wikis.title: Pro-Ject E1.2 turntable (manufacturer page)
wikis.summary: Pro-Ject's product page for the E1.2 plug-and-play entry-level turntable in Standard, Phono and BT versions, with specs and press review quotes.
wikis.body:
- E1.2: "Plug & Play Entry Level Audiophile Turntable", "handmade in the EU" (the page also says handmade in the Czech Republic).
- Versions: E1.2 Standard; E1.2 Phono (switchable built-in phono preamp for any Line/CD input); E1.2 BT (built-in Bluetooth 5.4 transmitter with aptX HD support). Standard/Phono foil finishes black, white, wood; BT foil finishes black and wood; E1.2 BT Colour has heavier MDF chassis with handpainted satin finish.
- Pick it MM E Premium cartridge (conical diamond tip, low-mass neodymium magnet, damped ABS body); 730 g damped die-cast aluminium platter; CNC-machined aluminium tonearm, high-mass gimbal, precision pinpoint bearing; factory pre-adjusted.
- Specs: 33/45 rpm electronic speed change, belt drive with electronic speed control; wow & flutter 33: +/-0.23%, 45: +/-0.21%; speed drift 33: +/-0.7%, 45: +/-0.6%; signal to noise 65dB; effective arm length/mass 218.5 mm / 7.0 g; overhang 22mm; 15V DC/0.8A supply; 4.5W; 415 x 112 x 320mm; 3.6 kg net; acrylic dustcover included.
- Listed reviews (2025) include: "Sounds genuinely excellent for the money" (UK, 11.2025), "Listening pleasure at a low price" (Germany, 08.2025), "This is not a toy" (Germany, 11.2025).
- No price on the page.

wikis.title: Pro-Ject E1.2 BT and E1.2 Phono announced (hi-fi+)
wikis.summary: hi-fi+ news of Pro-Ject's E1.2 BT wireless turntable with new Colour finishes and the UK arrival of the E1.2 Phono, with prices.
wikis.body:
- Dated Didcot, Oxfordshire, UK, 18 August 2026: Pro-Ject expands its E-Line with the E1.2 BT.
- Qualcomm Bluetooth transmitter module with Bluetooth 5.4, aptX HD and aptX Adaptive; dedicated pairing button; can pair with Pro-Ject's Uni Box S3 or Wireless Box E.
- Keeps features of the EISA Award-winning E1.2 (Best Value Turntable 2025-2026, introduced summer 2025): factory-adjusted tracking force and anti-skating, 730g die-cast aluminium platter, pre-adjusted Pick it MM E cartridge.
- Finishes: High Gloss Black, Satin White, Walnut standard; Colour palette adds Satin Black, Satin White, Satin Fir Green, Satin Golden Yellow, Satin Steel Blue on a CNC-machined MDF chassis.
- E1.2 Phono is added in the UK: switchable phono preamplifier.
- Handmade in Europe, with a 25-year spare-parts availability guarantee.
- Pricing (available now): E1.2 BT 399 GBP standard finishes, 449 GBP Colour finishes; E1.2 Phono 319 GBP.

wikis.title: Technics SL-1200M7G 55th Anniversary Edition (Technics US product page)
wikis.summary: Technics US product page for the gold SL-1200M7G 55th Anniversary Edition direct-drive turntable, limited to 12,000 units, priced $1,599.99.
wikis.body:
- Gold Edition of the SL-1200MK7 commemorating the 55th anniversary of the SL-1200 series (since 1972); seven colours; worldwide limited release of 12,000 units. Sale price $1,599.99 (SKU SL-1200M7GL).
- Design: serial number plate on gold badge, gold-finished magnesium tonearm, slipmat with gold Technics logo.
- Coreless direct drive brushless DC motor, said to eliminate cogging; digital pitch fader +/-8% / +/-16%; 33 1/3, 45 and 78 rpm (with switch); starting torque 0.18 N.m; 0.7 s from standstill to 33 1/3 rpm; wow and flutter 0.025% W.R.M.S.
- Tonearm: static-balance S-shape, effective length 230mm, overhang 15mm, offset angle 22 degrees, stylus pressure 0-4g.
- Platter: aluminium die-cast, 332mm, about 1.8kg with slipmat; aluminium die-cast/ABS/glass fibre cabinet with spring-and-rubber insulators.
- Detachable power and phono terminals, gold-plated phono terminals; 8 W (about 0.2 W standby); 453 x 169 x 353 mm; about 9.6kg.

wikis.title: Technics SL-1200 55th Anniversary Edition (What Hi-Fi?)
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi? news of the limited-edition gold SL-1200 55th Anniversary turntable, published 18 August 2026, price not yet confirmed.
wikis.body:
- Technics celebrates 55 years since the SL-1200 launch with the SL-1200 55th Anniversary Edition, "a tribute to a turntable lineage that has helped define DJ culture".
- Limited to 12,000 units globally; gold anodised S-shaped aluminium tonearm, gold tonearm base, platter with gold rim and strobe marks, gold knobs and buttons, gold-themed slipmat, individually engraved anniversary badge with serial number.
- Based on the SL-1200 MK7: digitally controlled single-rotor direct drive, vertical pitch fader up to 16 per cent, adjustable-height tonearm, Reverse Play mode.
- Originally released in 1972 as a "high-performance direct-drive turntable for demanding music lovers"; DJs adopted it for die-cast aluminium cabinet, high-torque motor, stable rotation, quick start-up.
- Planned global release September 2026; seven colours: gold, blue, red, black, green, white or grey.
- Price not yet confirmed; Technics says it will be shared closer to launch.
- By Ioan Hazell, 18 August 2026.

wikis.title: Technics SL-1200 55th Anniversary Edition announcement (Tracking Angle)
wikis.summary: Tracking Angle's 18 August 2026 report of Technics' press release for the limited SL-1200 55th Anniversary Edition, with SL-1200 history.
wikis.body:
- 18 August 2026: Technics announces the SL-1200 55th Anniversary Edition; global release scheduled for September 2026, first public showing at DMC DJs Day Poland at Fabryka Norblina in Warsaw on 20 August. Unveiled via a DJ set by Yousuke Yukimatsu on Resident Advisor's YouTube channel.
- Globally limited to 12,000 units, each with an engraved serial-numbered anniversary badge; seven colourways: Gold, Blue, Red, Black, Green, White, Grey.
- Gold details: anodised S-shaped aluminium tonearm, platter with gold rim and strobe marks, knobs and buttons, tonearm base, anniversary badge, gold-themed slipmat.
- Based on the MK7 platform: iron-coreless direct drive, single-stator/single-rotor, digital control; pitch up to +/-16% with vertical fader; adjustable-height aluminium S-shaped tonearm; Reverse Play mode.
- History given: SP-10 in 1970 (widely recognised as the first direct-drive turntable), SL-1100 in 1971, SL-1200 in 1972, SL-1200MK2 in 1979 with quartz-controlled direct drive.
- No price stated.

wikis.title: Esoteric T-01 MagneDrive turntable (manufacturer page)
wikis.summary: Esoteric's product overview for the T-01 turntable using its patented contact-free MagneDrive system, dated 08-21-2026.
wikis.body:
- Notice dated 08-21-2026: "Esoteric Launches the T-01 'Esoteric MagneDrive' Turntable". Models: T-01 (tonearm included, no cartridge) and T-01 AL (no tonearm, no cartridge).
- MagneDrive (patent JP6501130), first introduced in the Grandioso T1: a magnetic driver with alternating N/S poles on the motor induces synchronous rotation of a soft iron induction wheel on the non-magnetic aluminium platter, with no physical contact, isolating the platter from motor vibration and rumble. Esoteric says it spent more than five years from project start on patent acquisition and commercialization.
- "Four years after the debut of the Grandioso T1"; inherits 10MHz external clock sync (G-01XD / G-05 master clock), triple-layer aluminium-and-MDF cabinet with high-gloss piano lacquer mid-chassis, and a new silent MagneDrive motor in a more installation-friendly chassis (no specialized jigs needed as with the T1).
- Platter: 13kg solid aluminium; Magne-Float reduces effective mass to approx. 4kg (and effective bearing load to approx. 5.5kg in another passage of the page); inverted bearing; hand-polished finish.
- Separate main unit and compact power supply unit; "Master Sound Discrete Clock" motor driver; specialised isolation feet (spike, pad, damper).
- Two speeds 33 1/3 / 45 rpm adjustable in 0.1% increments; TA-9S static-balance tonearm with gimbal bearings; up to two tonearms with optional arm boards.
- No price on this page.

wikis.title: Esoteric T-01 MagneDrive turntable (audioXpress)
wikis.summary: audioXpress news of the Esoteric T-01 contactless-drive turntable, dated August 21 2026, shipping late September 2026 from $50,000 / 48,000 EUR.
wikis.body:
- Esoteric announced the T-01, derived from the Grandioso T1 (the turntable that also signalled the brand's 35th Anniversary); second implementation of its patented (JP6501130) MagneDrive system.
- Magnetic driver above the motor with alternating N/S poles induces rotation in a soft-iron induction wheel around the aluminium platter; no belt, rim or direct coupling.
- Magne-Float platter reduces effective mass to approx. 4kg; inverted bearing; 33 1/3 and 45 rpm with +/-12 percent adjustment in 0.1 percent increments.
- External 10MHz clock via BNC input, compatible with the G-01XD and G-05 Master Clock generators; motor integrated into the chassis in a Vibration Absorber Case; separate power supply unit.
- Triple-layer aluminium/MDF chassis, piano-lacquer middle section; integrated spike/pad/damper feet.
- Standard T-01 ships with Esoteric's TA-9D tonearm (article wording); T-01AL has no tonearm; up to two tonearms supported.
- Specs: wow-and-flutter 0.06-percent-or-less WRMS; 35kg total system weight with tonearm.
- Availability: ships internationally in late September 2026, starting at $50,000 in the US and 48,000 EUR in Europe.
- Background: Esoteric established 1987, Tokyo-based, formerly part of TEAC, formally merged back into TEAC in April 2024 under President Yuji Hanabusa.

wikis.title: Kanto Obi3 G2 turntable (manufacturer page)
wikis.summary: Kanto Audio's product page for the OBI3 G2 belt-drive turntable with Bluetooth 5.3 and a selectable phono preamp, listed at 269.99 CAD.
wikis.body:
- Belt drive with speed sensor; 33-1/3 and 45 RPM; pitch control +/-10%; wow and flutter under 0.15% WRMS (DIN weighted).
- Weighted aluminium platter, engineered-wood plinth, J-style aluminium tonearm with manual cue lever (cue-activated start and auto-stop), adjustable counterweight and antiskate; Audio-Technica AT3600L cartridge.
- Outputs: RCA with selectable phono preamp; Bluetooth 5.3.
- Dimensions 17 x 14.3 x 4.9 in (43.2 x 36.3 x 12.4 cm); weight 12.1 lb (5.5 kg). In the box: turntable, power supply, RCA cable, ground cable; also clear dustcover, felt slip mat and 45 adapter.
- Price shown: $269.99 CAD.
- The page also carries reviewer quotes about Kanto's ORA speakers (not about this turntable).

wikis.title: Kanto launches second-generation Obi3 turntable (Wifi Hifi)
wikis.summary: Wifi Hifi Magazine report on Canadian brand Kanto's Obi3G2 turntable, its features, accessories and prices from $249.99 USD.
wikis.body:
- Kanto Audio introduced the second-generation Obi3 (Obi3G2), a belt-drive turntable with a platter-mounted speed sensor that monitors rotation and corrects motor speed continuously.
- Weighted aluminium platter, engineered-wood plinth, aluminium J-shaped tonearm with adjustable counterweight and anti-skate, manual cue lever, +/-10% pitch control, electronic 33-1/3 / 45 RPM selection, auto-stop; pre-installed Audio-Technica AT3600L cartridge.
- RCA output with selectable built-in phono preamp; Bluetooth 5.3; 43.2 x 36.3 cm (17 x 14.3 in) footprint.
- Colours: Black, White, Green, Ice Blue, Walnut. Ships with dust cover, slip mat, 45 adapter, counterweight, RCA and ground cables.
- Released with accessories: TT-AKIT setup and alignment kit, TT-SB brush, TT-GKIT gel cleaning kit, TT-AM anti-static acrylic mat, TT-CRM cork and rubber mat, TT-CS20 outer sleeves, TT-IS20 inner sleeves.
- Quote from Brett Smalley, Director of Marketing: "We wanted the second generation of Obi3 to be approachable for people starting a record collection, while still offering room to adjust and learn."
- Price: $249.99 USD / CA$269.99 / 179.99 GBP / 199.99 EUR; available in North America now, worldwide availability beginning in early September. (Posted "1 month Ago" relative to crawl; no explicit date.)

wikis.title: Ruka TD-1 vertical turntable pre-order (Ruka Studio)
wikis.summary: Ruka Studio's pre-order page for the TD-1 wall-mounted vertical turntable at $1,399, made to order and shipping in about 12 months.
wikis.body:
- Ruka TD-1 pre-order: sale price $1,399.00 (regular price $1,799.00); free record stand, free shipping (within the United States), fully refundable until it ships.
- Two modes: wireless Bluetooth out for everyday listening, or wired pure analog signal; powered via USB-C; vertical magnetic mounting.
- Specs: wow & flutter <0.15% RMS; speed accuracy +/-0.1%; signal-to-noise >=75 dB; swappable MM cartridge; 12 in tall, 3 in wide, 1.6 in deep.
- In the box: TD-1, cartridge, wall mount, USB-C power cable, RCA audio cables, founder's record stand.
- Made to order, ships in about 12 months.

wikis.title: Ruka Studio TD-1 vertical turntable (Yanko Design)
wikis.summary: Yanko Design's 17 August 2026 piece on Ruka Studio's TD-1 wall-mounted vertical belt-drive turntable, preorder at $1,399 with shipping in 2027.
wikis.body:
- Ruka Studio is a Los Angeles-based company founded in 2024, reportedly by former Apple engineers and designers; the TD-1 is its first product.
- Mounts vertically on a wall or stands on a floor stand; aluminium body; mechanical switches and knobs for playback, speed and Bluetooth pairing; wired output for hi-fi systems, Bluetooth to speakers or earbuds.
- Rubber-coated magnetic plate holds the record against the wall, with built-in spirit level; swappable moving-magnet cartridge (extra cost per the article); belt drive with motor de-coupled from the acrylic platter.
- Preorder from a $100 reserve price on the company's website; price $1,399; preordered models expected to ship in 2027; the $100 credit is fully refundable or applied to the final price.
- Author Gaurav Sood, 08/17/2026.

wikis.title: Ruka Studio TD-1 vertical turntable (What Hi-Fi?)
wikis.summary: What Hi-Fi? news, 13 August 2026, on the TD-1 vertical turntable from Los Angeles startup Ruka Studio founded by former Apple engineers.
wikis.body:
- Ruka Studio (Los Angeles, founded by a group of former Apple engineers and designers) is set to launch its first product, the TD-1 vertically spinning turntable.
- Currently priced at $1399, which the company claims is "the lowest price it will ever be".
- Aluminium body, "switches that click" for playback, speed and Bluetooth pairing; magnetic clamp holds records; belt-driven with decoupled motor for a "quieter and smoother listening experience".
- Swappable moving-magnet cartridge (buyers can choose "which cartridge [they] want" for no extra fee before shipping); RCA wired outputs plus Bluetooth.
- Wall-mountable via rubber-coated magnetic plate with built-in spirit level; record stand and floor stand available (stand prices not confirmed); a table stand is on the way.
- Waitlist spots for the first production run (500 units) can be reserved for $100, credited toward the $1399 price and fully refundable. Pre-ordered units expected to ship in 2027.
- By Ioan Hazell, 13 August 2026.

wikis.title: Roku Pro Series OLED and Pro Series LX OLED TVs (Mashable via Yahoo)
wikis.summary: Mashable/Yahoo report of 1 September 2026 on Roku's two new OLED TVs, starting at $999.99.
wikis.body:
- Roku announced two new OLED TVs. Prices start at $999.99.
- Roku Pro Series OLED: already available at Amazon; $999.99 for 55-inch, $1,199.99 for 65-inch; native 120Hz refresh rate and 4K resolution; ultra-thin metal bezel; tool-free stand; Bluetooth pairing to headphones; backlit remote.
- Roku Pro Series LX OLED: launching at the beginning of October 2026; brightest and most advanced, brighter display and wider colour range than the Pro Series OLED, more advanced polarizer to reduce reflections, 144Hz refresh rate; sizes not announced; list price $1,299.
- Quote from Chris Larson, VP for Retail Strategy at Roku: "OLED technology has been locked behind premium price tags, forcing many customers to choose between the display they want or a price that works for them."
- By Lauren Allain (Mashable), Sept 1, 2026.

wikis.title: Roku launches Pro Series OLED and Pro Series LX OLED TVs (Business Wire press release)
wikis.summary: Roku's 1 September 2026 press release launching its first-ever OLED TVs, the Pro Series OLED (from $999) and Pro Series LX OLED ($1,299, October 2026).
wikis.body:
- Roku launched its first-ever OLED TVs, sold exclusively on Amazon: Pro Series OLED and Pro Series LX OLED.
- Pro Series OLED: 120Hz OLED panel, 4K, Dolby Vision, Roku Smart Picture Max, ultra-wide viewing angles, ultra-thin metal bezel, adjustable tool-free stand with cable straps, Automatic Game Mode, FreeSync Premium and VRR, voice remote with backlit buttons and customizable shortcuts, Bluetooth Headphone Mode, push-to-talk voice control, on-TV remote finder button.
- Pro Series LX OLED: "Roku's most advanced TV yet": brighter picture, wider colour range, 144Hz VRR, advanced polarizer that cuts room reflections, Roku Voice Remote Pro (hands-free voice, rechargeable battery with USB-C).
- Availability: Pro Series OLED now in 55" and 65" sizes nationwide on Amazon, MSRP starting at $999; Pro Series LX OLED available beginning October 2026, MSRP $1,299.
- Quote from Chris Larson, VP Retail Strategy: "OLED technology has been locked behind premium price tags... we're removing that cost barrier."
- Published Sep 1, 2026 via Business Wire.

wikis.title: Sony BRAVIA 6 65-inch OLED K-65A60 (Sony Electronics product page)
wikis.summary: Sony US product page for the 65-inch BRAVIA 6 (2026) OLED Google TV with Gemini, on sale at $1,699.99.
wikis.body:
- BRAVIA 6 65" Class OLED 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini (2026), model K-65A60; sale price $1,699.99, save $300.00 from $1,999.99; estimated shipping Sep 21. Other sizes offered: 48", 55", 77", 83".
- Over 8 million self-lit pixels for pure black and contrast; Triluminos Pro reproduces over a billion colours; Google TV for streaming apps; Gemini for TV.
- Footnotes mention Sony Pictures Core, Dolby Vision/Atmos and DTS:X, IMAX Enhanced, VRR with 4K/120fps games.
- Detailed specifications are not included in the extracted text.

wikis.title: Sony BRAVIA 6 OLED TV announcement (eCoustics)
wikis.summary: eCoustics' 28 August 2026 report on Sony's BRAVIA 6 OLED TV for North America, with sizes, prices and how it differs from the BRAVIA 8 models.
wikis.body:
- Sony unveiled the BRAVIA 6 OLED for the North American market, in sizes 48 to 83 inches; Google TV platform with Sony Pictures Core and Gemini; far-field mic can be disabled; four HDMI 2.1 ports (4K/120 Hz, VRR, ALLM) (the article notes the BRAVIA 9 II has only two).
- MSRP (US / CAD): 83" $3,999.99 / $5,599.99; 77" $2,999.99 / $4,199.99; 65" $1,999.99 / $2,799.99; 55" $1,499.99 / $2,199.99; 48" $1,299.99 / $1,799.99. "Actual street pricing may (probably will) be lower."
- Versus BRAVIA 8 / 8 II: 4K Processor rather than XR Processor; Triluminos Pro; no Contrast Booster; 2 full-range drivers + 2 tweeters rather than Acoustic Surface Audio; no CI integration; peak brightness expected a bit lower (final measurements not yet available); Sony Pictures Core 12 months, 5 credits.
- Dolby Vision, HLG, HDR10; Dolby Atmos and DTS:X; height-adjustable stand.
- Where to buy list: Amazon and Best Buy at the same US prices.
- By Chris Boylan, updated August 28, 2026.

wikis.title: Sony announces Bravia 6 OLED TV (HDTVTest)
wikis.summary: HDTVTest news of 28 August 2026 on Sony's Bravia 6, its first OLED TV of 2026, with US prices and panel speculation.
wikis.body:
- Sony confirmed the Bravia 6 OLED after leaks first appeared in July; sizes 48, 55, 65, 77 and 83 inches (first 83-inch OLED from Sony since the A80L in 2023). Slogan: "OLED essentials, now within reach".
- US prices: 48" $1,300; 55" $1,500; 65" $1,999; 77" $2,999; 83" $3,999.
- Fitted with a WOLED panel from LG Display; Sony has not confirmed it, but "most believe" it is the new, cheaper OLED SE panel (120Hz, around 1,000 nits), which does not match Primary Tandem OLED or RGB LED in colour accuracy and peak brightness.
- Sits below the Bravia 8 II (QD-OLED, carried over from last year). MediaTek Pentonic 800 chipset; four full-bandwidth HDMI 2.1 ports at 4K/120Hz; Dolby Vision (not Dolby Vision 2), Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, VRR, ALLM, eARC; Google TV with Sony Pictures Core.
- Context: Sony is merging its TV business with TCL as of next year, prompting rumours it may abandon OLED; Sony said it "remains committed to delivering a full lineup of televisions", which the article says is not an outright denial.
- By Mike Wheatley, 28 August 2026.

wikis.title: Marantz CINEMA 50 Series 2 AV receiver (Marantz US product page)
wikis.summary: Marantz US product page for the CINEMA 50 Series 2, a 9.4-channel Dolby Atmos AV receiver priced at $3,000.
wikis.body:
- CINEMA 50 SERIES 2: 9.4-channel AV receiver with Dolby Atmos, Dirac Live upgradability and HEOS; $3,000; available in Black.
- 110W per channel amplification; up to 11.4 pre-amp mode/pre-outs; upgraded high-performance DAC.
- Connectivity: six 8K HDMI inputs and three 8K outputs (comparison table lists 2 HDMI outputs, 1x eARC); eARC.
- Room correction Audyssey MultEQ XT32, Dirac Live upgradable; tuned by the Marantz "Sound Master".
- Formats: Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, IMAX Enhanced, AURO-3D, 360 Reality Audio, MPEG-H; HEOS multi-room streaming, AirPlay 2, Roon Ready, Spotify/Tidal/Qobuz Connect.
- Comparison on page: CINEMA 50 Premium (previous) $2,800; CINEMA 60 SERIES 2 $2,000 (7.2ch, 100W); CINEMA 70s SERIES 2 $1,500 (7.2ch, 50W).

wikis.title: Marantz CINEMA Series 2 introduced (Harman press release)
wikis.summary: Harman press release dated August 6, 2026 introducing Marantz's CINEMA 50, 60, 60 DAB and 70s Series 2 AV receivers, with prices and availability.
wikis.body:
- August 6th, 2026: Marantz introduces CINEMA Series 2: CINEMA 50 Series 2, CINEMA 60 Series 2, CINEMA 60 DAB Series 2 (Europe only) and CINEMA 70s Series 2.
- New 32-bit, eight-channel DAC in every model, converting all channels simultaneously.
- Dirac Live Room Correction available as an additional-cost option; CINEMA 60, 60 DAB and 70s Series 2 now join CINEMA 50 in offering Dirac Live upgradeability; CINEMA 50 Series 2 supports the full Dirac ecosystem including Bass Control and Active Room Treatment (ART).
- A future firmware update will add Low-Latency Bluetooth LE Audio; upgraded HEOS; Web Control 2.0; HDMI Diagnostics 2.0 in CI Mode; Channel Level Monitoring on all models.
- Exclusive to CINEMA 50 Series 2: Dolby Atmos Channel Expander and Center Bi-Amp Mode; nine channels of amplification, 11.4 channels of processing.
- Gaming: 1440p video pass-through and AMD FreeSync compatibility on all models.
- Finishes: Black and Silver Gold (Black only in North America). Full-channel preamp outputs on all models.
- Availability: from Marantz.com and authorized retailers from August 12th 2026 (September 15th 2026 for CINEMA 70s Series 2).
- Prices: CINEMA 50 Series 2 $3,000 / 2,100 EUR / 1,850 GBP; CINEMA 60 Series 2 $2,000 (Americas and APAC); CINEMA 60 DAB Series 2 1,450 EUR / 1,250 GBP (Europe only); CINEMA 70s $1,500 / 1,100 EUR / 950 GBP.

wikis.title: Marantz CINEMA 60 Series 2 AV receiver (Marantz US product page)
wikis.summary: Marantz US product page for the CINEMA 60 Series 2, a 7.2-channel Dolby Atmos AV receiver at $2,000.
wikis.body:
- CINEMA 60 SERIES 2: 7.2-channel AV receiver with Dolby Atmos and HEOS; $2,000; Black finish.
- 100W per channel; upgraded 32-bit 8-channel DAC; 7 HDMI ports with eARC and support for two screens (the comparison table lists 6 HDMI inputs, 3 of them 8K, and 2 outputs with 1x eARC).
- Room correction Audyssey MultEQ XT; Dirac Live upgradability; max 7.1 processing channels; IMAX Enhanced not listed as supported.
- Comparison: CINEMA 60 Premium (previous) $1,800; CINEMA 50 SERIES 2 $3,000; CINEMA 70s SERIES 2 $1,500.
- Streaming: HEOS multi-room, AirPlay 2, Roon Ready, Spotify/Tidal/Qobuz Connect, Bluetooth re-transmit.

wikis.title: Marantz CINEMA Series 2 receivers (The Luxe Review)
wikis.summary: The Luxe Review, 7 August 2026, on Marantz's refreshed CINEMA Series 2 AV receivers with new DAC and gaming support.
wikis.body:
- Series 2 family: flagship CINEMA 50 Series 2, CINEMA 60 Series 2, CINEMA 60 DAB Series 2 and slimline CINEMA 70s Series 2.
- Externally little changed (porthole display, sculpted fascia); each adopts a new 32-bit, eight-channel DAC that Marantz says improves timing accuracy, imaging and dynamics.
- All support 1440p video pass-through, AMD FreeSync and 4K 120Hz; HEOS updated for faster operation. Final tuning by the Marantz Sound Master in Japan.
- CINEMA 50 Series 2: 1,850 GBP; nine channels of 110W, 11.4-channel processing; Dolby Atmos Channel Expander and Centre Bi-Amp mode.
- CINEMA 60 Series 2 and Europe-only 60 DAB Series 2: seven channels of 100W, optional Dirac Live; 60 DAB sells for 1,250 GBP.
- CINEMA 70s Series 2: 950 GBP, seven channels at 50W per channel.
- Full-channel preamp outputs retained.
- Availability: from August 15 2026; the 70s follows in September.
- By Steve May, August 7, 2026.

wikis.title: Marantz CINEMA 70s Series 2 slimline AV receiver (Marantz US product page)
wikis.summary: Marantz US product page for the CINEMA 70s Series 2, a 7.2-channel slimline Dolby Atmos AV receiver at $1,500.
wikis.body:
- CINEMA 70s SERIES 2: 7.2-channel slimline AV receiver with Dolby Atmos support and HEOS; $1,500; Black.
- 50W per channel; upgraded 32-bit 8-channel DAC; 6 HDMI ports including eARC (comparison table: 6 inputs, 3 of them 8K; 1x HDMI eARC output); optional Dirac Live room correction; Audyssey MultEQ.
- Compact slimline design for smaller spaces; HEOS multi-room and hi-res streaming.
- Comparison: CINEMA 50 SERIES 2 $3,000; CINEMA 60 SERIES 2 $2,000.

wikis.title: Introducing Marantz CINEMA Series 2 (The Absolute Sound)
wikis.summary: The Absolute Sound's 7 August 2026 repost of Marantz's CINEMA Series 2 press release, covering the DAC, Dirac Live, gaming and installer features.
wikis.body:
- Dated August 6, 2026 (posted Aug 07, 2026): Marantz introduces CINEMA Series 2 - CINEMA 50, 60, 60 DAB (Europe only) and 70s Series 2.
- New 32-bit, eight-channel DAC; Dirac Live upgradeability now on 60, 60 DAB and 70s as well as 50; CINEMA 50 supports the full Dirac ecosystem including Bass Control and ART.
- Future firmware update to add Low-Latency Bluetooth LE Audio; upgraded HEOS; Web Control 2.0; HDMI Diagnostics 2.0 in CI Mode; Channel Level Monitoring.
- CINEMA 50 Series 2 only: Dolby Atmos Channel Expander, Center Bi-Amp Mode.
- Gaming: 1440p video pass-through with AMD FreeSync.
- Finishes Black and Silver Gold (Black only in North America); redesigned packaging with reduced plastic.
- Wording and figures follow the manufacturer's press release (see the Harman release): available from August 12th 2026 (September 15th for the 70s); $3,000 / 2,100 EUR / 1,850 GBP for the 50, $2,000 for the 60, 1,450 EUR / 1,250 GBP for the 60 DAB, $1,500 / 1,100 EUR / 950 GBP for the 70s.

wikis.title: Marantz Cinema 60 DAB Series 2 and Cinema 50 Series 2 (Son-Video)
wikis.summary: Son-Video blog, 18 August 2026, comparing Marantz's Cinema 60 DAB Series 2 and Cinema 50 Series 2 AV receivers.
wikis.body:
- Front panel unchanged (small circular OLED display, two knobs, honeycomb-patterned front); upgrades are internal: improved 32-bit DAC, architecture refined by the engineers who work on Marantz hi-fi, optional Dirac Live in addition to built-in Audyssey.
- Cinema 60 DAB Series 2: 7 amplified channels, up to 100 W per channel into 8 ohms (20 Hz-20 kHz, two channels driven), 140 W into 6 ohms at 1 kHz; supports up to 7.2 or 5.2.2 channels; current-feedback topology, discrete power stages, HDAM-SA2 modules; Dolby Atmos, DTS:X; Audyssey MultEQ XT with optional Dirac Live; six HDMI inputs (three HDMI 2.1, 8K/60Hz and 4K/120Hz), two outputs (main eARC); DAB+ radio.
- Cinema 50 Series 2: nine power stages, 110 W per channel into 8 ohms, 150 W into 6 ohms; up to 11.4 channels; four subwoofer outputs; Audyssey MultEQ XT32 and Dirac Live; Auro-3D and IMAX Enhanced; six HDMI inputs at up to 40 Gbit/s, three outputs (one for zone 2).
- Both: Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HLG, VRR, ALLM, QFT, AMD FreeSync; HEOS, Qobuz Connect, Tidal Connect, Roon Ready.
- Conclusion: the 60 DAB suits 5.2.2 or 7.2 systems; the 50 suits dedicated home theaters and can add external amplifiers via 11.4 pre-outs.
- No prices in the extracted text. By Valentin Lefort, published 18 August 2026.

wikis.title: Roland FP-40 digital piano product page
wikis.summary: Roland US product page for the FP-40 digital piano and its Piano Sphere app integration.
wikis.body:
- Roland calls the FP-40 "Roland's newest digital piano"; it works with the Piano Sphere app.
- **Sound:** Piano Reality Sound Engine, "inspired by the technology in Roland's flagship GP Series grand pianos", combining premium sampled sounds with selected modeling technologies. Enhanced built-in speakers with a newly designed layout for more depth in the low register.
- **Action:** PHA-4 Standard keyboard with fully weighted hammer action, escapement and Ivory Feel keys; triple-sensor key action for faster note repetition than the "dual sensors found in other instruments".
- **Piano Sphere app:** developed with Skoove, using teaching techniques "trusted by more than three million players worldwide". Personalised plan by level, interest and pace; three free courses (beginner to advanced); real-time feedback via a Piano Sphere button on the piano that lights up; streaks and reward badges. 100 licensed and copyright-free songs from day one with no ongoing subscription; an upgrade gives access to over 1000 songs and lessons.
- **App availability:** Google Play and Apple App Store worldwide except China, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia, Belarus, and Crimea and Sevastopol. Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
- **Other features:** slim, lightweight, newly designed shallow chassis; Bluetooth Audio/MIDI and USB-C; headphone quiet practice; compatible with headset microphones for lessons and streaming; Roland Piano App for advanced sound settings and practice tools.
- Sold in FP-40 Black and FP-40 White.

wikis.title: Roland FP-40, its first Wi-Fi piano (Sonicstate)
wikis.summary: Sonicstate news item of 01/09/26 on Roland announcing the FP-40 digital piano with built-in Wi-Fi and the Piano Sphere app.
wikis.body:
- Roland announced the FP-40, a portable digital piano and "the company's first to include built-in Wi-Fi". Available now for $749.
- Wi-Fi joins the home network after initial setup; piano and app receive wireless updates; playing history is recorded automatically even when the app is closed.
- PHA-4 Standard keyboard (fully weighted hammer action, escapement, Ivory Feel keys) with triple-sensor system.
- Piano Reality Sound Engine derived from Roland's flagship GP-series grand pianos; enhanced speaker system and redesigned internal layout for deeper low end.
- Bluetooth streaming from phone or tablet; free Roland Piano App for sound personalisation.
- Piano Sphere: free companion app (iOS and Android) developed with Skoove, "a learning method already used by over three million players"; 100 licensed and copyright-free songs including Coldplay and Harry Styles; a paid upgrade unlocks over 1,000 songs and lessons. The Piano Sphere button on the piano flashes if the app detects trouble with a section. Streaks, badges and personalised plans. Eight languages supported (English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, traditional and simplified Chinese).
- Roland positions the instrument within its "Direct Connect" strategy of linking instruments directly to network services and customer journeys.

wikis.title: Orange Baby Terror 20W solid-state micro amp head (product page)
wikis.summary: Orange Amps product page for the Baby Terror, a 20W solid-state micro-lunchbox amp head priced at $249 USD.
wikis.body:
- The Baby Terror is "the micro-lunchbox member of the solid-state Baby series"; price $249.00 USD. The page shows it unavailable/notify-me at capture.
- **Controls:** Gain, Volume, three-band EQ (Bass, Middle, Treble), Presence, Tubby switch (extra low-end richness at cleaner gain settings), and a footswitchable second volume (FS Volume) for boosts.
- **Rear:** effects loop; balanced line out with ground lift for recording (preamp signal, use with own IRs in a DAW); 8/16 ohm speaker output.
- **Specs:** 20 watts, all solid-state; unboxed 165 x 140 x 100 mm (6.5 x 5.51 x 3.94 in); 1.5 kg (3.31 lb); padded gig bag included; UPC 5060299179134.
- Described as keeping the lunchbox size of the Micro Terror but adding a full tone-shaping toolkit.

wikis.title: Orange Amps introduces the Baby Terror amp (Premier Guitar)
wikis.summary: Premier Guitar news item of Jul 29, 2026 on Orange Amps releasing the 20W Baby Terror micro-lunchbox head.
wikis.body:
- Orange Amps released the "Baby Terror", described as an analog micro-lunchbox addition to its Baby series, 20 watts, built for backpacks, desktops, rehearsal rooms and small stages.
- Gain, Volume, full three-band EQ and Presence; "Tubby" switch lets more low end through early in the signal path for fuller clean and dirty-clean sounds; switch off for a leaner response at high gain.
- Footswitchable second volume for solos or lifts without changing gain or EQ.
- Rear: effects loop, balanced line out with ground lift (preamp signal into a DAW with own impulse responses), 8- and 16-ohm speaker outputs.
- Single-ended, class A, JFET front end; comes with a padded custom-designed protective bag.
- Quote from Sarah Yule, Managing Director of Orange Amps: "The Baby Terror is proof that small does not have to mean less features. It is small enough to carry with one hand, but serious enough to become your main amp – however big your rig is."
- Street price $249.

wikis.title: Insta360 Luna Pro gimbal camera announced in China (PetaPixel)
wikis.summary: PetaPixel news of Aug 20, 2026 on Insta360 announcing the China-only Luna Pro gimbal camera, positioned against the DJI Osmo Pocket 3 and 4.
wikis.body:
- Insta360 announced the Luna Pro, "a slimmed-down, single-camera version of the Luna Ultra it launched earlier this summer", keeping the detachable screen; co-engineered with Leica and called its "flagship gimbal camera".
- China-only launch; pricing and availability elsewhere not announced. Article expects global availability "sometime in the next one to two months" based on the last Luna launch.
- Single Type 1 sensor (likely the Ultra's main-camera sensor); 8K footage that retains 4K resolution when shooting vertically. The article says the Osmo Pocket 3 tops out at 3K (1,728 x 3,072) at up to 60p vertically, and the Pocket 4 and 4P do not improve on that.
- Detachable two-inch OLED touchscreen, HD transmission up to 20 meters, built-in microphone; pairs with Insta360's dedicated microphone.
- Dolby Vision HDR, built-in Leica color profiles, 10-bit I-Log with up to 14 stops dynamic range.
- "80mm portraits" at up to 4Kp60 from 4x digital zoom; 4K live frames can be exported as photos.
- Dual AI chip for low-light performance and auto tracking (single subjects and groups); three-axis stabilized gimbal.

wikis.title: Insta360 Luna Pro goes official with a 1-inch sensor (GSMArena)
wikis.summary: GSMArena news of 10 September 2026 on the Insta360 Luna Pro gimbal camera with 1-inch sensor, priced $600 in the US.
wikis.body:
- Insta360 expands the Luna series with the Luna Pro: 1-inch sensor with a Leica Summicron lens, 8K Dolby Vision video and 10-bit I-Log.
- 4nm chipset plus dedicated image processor; up to 8K and up to 1080p 240fps slow motion.
- 3-axis stabilization; 2x lossless zoom and up to 4x HighRes zoom.
- Detachable 2-inch OLED touchscreen; 47GB built-in storage; claimed up to four hours of battery life.
- Supports 10-bit I-Log and ACES.
- Available through Insta360's official store, Amazon and select retailers; $600 in the US; colours Cosmic Black and Stellar White. Joins the Luna Ultra, which has a dual-sensor setup.

wikis.title: Insta360 X6 8K 360 camera store page
wikis.summary: Insta360 US store page for the X6 8K 360 camera listing bundles and prices.
wikis.body:
- Insta360 X6, 8K 360 camera; colours Midnight Black and Arctic White; page shows 4.5 rating (8 reviews). Highlights: dual Sony custom sensors and triple AI chip system, 8K 1-inch imaging, InstaFrame 2.0, 5K60fps and 170 degree ultra-wide video.
- Store terms: normally ships within 2 days, free shipping over $129, 15-day returns, 7-day price match, 12-month warranty. Banner says Insta360 Luna Pro is "Available now".
- Bundles: Standard $699.99 (X6, Xtreme Battery, USB-C cable, pouch); Essentials $799.99; Travel $749.99; Motorcycle Multiview $794.99; Invisible Dive $929.99 (dive case to 197ft / 60m); Get-Set $729.99; Road Cycling (Integrated or Independent) $844.99; Snowboard $754.99.

wikis.title: Insta360 X6 flagship 360 camera announced (PetaPixel)
wikis.summary: PetaPixel news of Aug 12, 2026 on the Insta360 X6 360-degree camera, on sale that day from $699.
wikis.body:
- Insta360 announced its new flagship 360-degree camera, the X6; smaller than the X5 with a bigger sensor, better battery life.
- Sensors: dual custom Sony Type 1/1.1 square sensors for a "full one-inch equivalent"; PetaPixel says that is 33% more sensor area than the X5, and Insta360 claims four times the light intake per frame.
- Chip: one 8-core 3.3GHz 4nm processor plus two dedicated imaging chips; Insta360 claims 500% more computing power than the X5, 106% faster clock, 35% lower power draw. New low-light mode with two ambient light sensors; AdaptiveTone 2.0 captures two exposures per frame; native Dolby Vision HDR with 10-bit color.
- 1,200-nit (peak) 2.32-inch OLED; battery records 140 minutes of 8K30fps 360 video (51% longer than X5); fast charge empty to 80% in 24 minutes. Replaceable lenses, said to be five times more scratch-resistant and 60% cheaper to replace.
- IP68, waterproof to 20 meters without a case, 60 meters with the Invisible Dive Case Pro.
- Positioned as "three cameras in one": 360 camera, subject-tracking gimbal camera (InstaFrame produces flat 4K video), and single-lens action cam (up to 5Kp60, 5Kp30 at 170-degree, 4Kp120).
- "PanoMind" in-house AI model (trained on more than 10,000 hours of footage across 30-plus scenarios); AI Director builds a highlight edit on the camera when plugged in to charge, analysis runs on-camera and can be switched off.
- On sale August 12 in black or white, starting at $699. Update 8/12: Insta360 changed the pricing from its initial communications.

wikis.title: DJI Mic Mini 2S adds internal recording (PetaPixel)
wikis.summary: PetaPixel news of Aug 04, 2026 on DJI announcing the Mic Mini 2S wireless lav system with 32-bit float internal recording, not sold in the US.
wikis.body:
- DJI announced the Mic Mini 2S, expanding the Mic Mini 2 with 32-bit float internal recording on each transmitter.
- 14.5GB of storage per transmitter, "up to 28 hours" of audio in the default 24-bit mode (DJI clarified this on 8/4); no estimate for 32-bit float.
- One receiver connects to up to four transmitters; also compatible with Mic Mini and Mic Mini 2 transmitters and the DJI Mic Series Mobile Receiver.
- AI noise canceling at two levels (basic for indoor noise like fans, air conditioning, reverb; strong for "aggressive" outdoor noise); Clipping Control; Loudness Balance; three voice tone presets (regular, bright, rich).
- Transmitters weigh 12 grams; incompatible with an optional wired lavalier capsule; magnetic front cover detachable, eight standard colors plus special designs sold separately.
- Transmitters connect natively, without a receiver, to Osmo Pocket 4P, Osmo Pocket 4, Osmo 360, Osmo Nano and Osmo Action 6.
- Available starting the same day in most global regions but "will not be available in the United States". Two transmitters, receiver and charging case: $265 CAD (excl. tax) or 189 euros (incl. tax); single-transmitter version $149 CAD or 99 euros.

wikis.title: Google Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL announcement (Google blog)
wikis.summary: Google blog post of Aug 12, 2026 introducing the Pixel 11 series with the Tensor G6 chip, priced from $899, on shelves August 20.
wikis.body:
- Google unveiled Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL, powered by Google Tensor G6 running the latest Gemini Nano model, designed for "Gemini Intelligence".
- **Design:** edge-to-edge glass across the camera bar; camera bar thickness reduced by 40% (compared to earlier base-model Pixels), "virtually bumpless" with a Made by Google case. Pixel 11 colors: Pistachio, Hibiscus, Frost, Obsidian. Pro/Pro XL: Canyon, Fog, Olive, all-matte Obsidian. Pro phones have a Super Actua display up to 3,600 nits and an anti-scratch coating with more than double the previous generation's scratch resistance.
- **HiLight (Pro, Pro XL):** colored LEDs around the flash that glow when Gemini listens/thinks/responds and for custom-colored callers; message notifications expected later.
- **Cameras:** Pixel 11 new 48-megapixel main sensor with 56% more light sensitivity, 5x telephoto supports 30x Super Zoom. Pro models: new main sensor, upgraded 48-megapixel telephoto with 30% more light sensitivity, Portrait Mode at 5x, Pro Zoom at 120x; Night Sight up to 4.5x faster.
- **Tensor G6:** 25% faster web browsing, 15% quicker app launches, 50% more TPU compute, on-device AI tasks up to 3.5 times faster and up to 3.5 times less energy; Titan M3 security chip with post-quantum cryptography for secure boot.
- **Charging/storage:** all start at 256GB; Pixelsnap built in; Qi 2.2 25W on Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro; Pixel 11 Pro XL wired charging gives 15 hours of battery life in 15 minutes (with Google 45W charger).
- Seven years of OS, security and Pixel Drop updates; Pro phones include six months of Google AI Pro.
- Pre-order today from $899 (Pixel 11), $1099 (Pro), $1299 (Pro XL); on shelves August 20.

wikis.title: Everything announced at Made by Google 2026 (9to5Google)
wikis.summary: 9to5Google roundup dated Aug 12 2026 of the Pixel 11 phones, Tensor G6, Gemini features, Pixel Tag, Pixel Buds and Pixel Watch 5.
wikis.body:
Ties together: hardware Google detailed ahead of the Made by Google 2026 event ("about eight hours" before it started, per the article).

- **Overview:** Pixel 11 series (Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, 11 Pro Fold), Tensor G6, camera/video features, Gemini Intelligence, Pixelsnap accessories, Pixel Tag, Pixel Buds Pro 2 update, Pixel Watch 5.
- **Pixel 11:** $899; colors Frost, Obsidian, Hibiscus, Pistachio; camera bar 40% thinner; 48MP wide sensor with 56% more light sensitivity; 30x SuperRes Zoom; 12 GB RAM and 256 GB storage baseline; 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging; battery life still 30+ hours.
- **Pixel 11 Pro / Pro XL:** from $1,099 (6.3-inch) and $1,299 (6.8-inch); HiLight LED ring; 50MP wide, 48MP telephoto with 30% more light sensitivity; 120x Pro Zoom; Instant Night Sight up to 4.5x faster; 3,600 nits; 12 GB RAM on the 256 GB model (16 GB on 512 GB or 1 TB); wired charging up to 75% in about 30 minutes on the XL; six months of AI Pro.
