- **Pixel 11 Pro Fold:** $1,899 (a $100 increase); nearly 10% lighter (258 vs 239 g) and 0.7 mm thinner; glass fiber composite back "nearly impossible to crack"; 16 GB RAM and 256 GB; 4,750 mAh battery (down from 5,015); Live Transcribe in Gboard supports American Sign Language.
- **Tensor G6:** Gemini Nano 4, TPU with 50% more compute and 2x memory bandwidth, on-device AI up to 3.5x faster; Titan M3 security chip.
- **Camera/video:** Magic Capture (analyzes about 500 frames), Camera Looks (Natural, Shadows, Vanilla plus stylistic looks), Pro Stable Video, Creator Suite (Teleprompter, Project Folders, Audio Visualizer, Storyboard).
- **Gemini Intelligence:** task automation across more apps, Gemini can dial businesses, Gboard Rambler, Proactive Assistance (previously Magic Cue), location-aware At a Glance, Live Translate extended to podcasts and videos.
- **Pixel Tag:** Find Hub tracker, $29 or $99 4-pack, UWB, not available until November 11.
- **Pixel Buds Pro 2:** new Olive color; software update next month with dynamic ANC; Gemini audio control for Pro 2 and Buds 2a.
- **Pixel Watch 5:** design unchanged; Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated, 3 GB RAM, 64 GB storage; 2x more accurate route tracking; health upgrades (Breathing Emergency Detection, blood pressure and insulin resistance trends); Stephen Curry Edition; $399 (41mm), $429 (45mm), cellular +$100.

wikis.title: Everything announced at Made by Google 2026 (TechCrunch)
wikis.summary: TechCrunch roundup of Aug 12, 2026 covering the Pixel 11 lineup, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag and Gemini features.
wikis.body:
- Google held its Made by Google 2026 event on Wednesday, unveiling the Pixel 11 series, Pixel Watch 5 and a competitor to Apple's AirTag.
- **Gemini/accessibility:** Live Transcribe expands to American Sign Language via the Pixel Camera; "Rambler" voice input handles run-on sentences and filler words; Circle to Search accessible from the Pixel Camera.
- **Pixel 11:** camera bar more than 40% thinner, all-glass; base storage 256GB (doubled); starts at $899, a $100 increase over the Pixel 10, tied to dropping the 128GB option and "the ongoing RAM supply shortage". Colors Frost, Hibiscus, Pistachio, Obsidian.
- **Pixel 11 Pro / Pro XL:** improved drop resistance, anti-scratch coating with more than twice the scratch resistance of Pixel 10 Pro; Pro starts at $1,099 (vs $999 for Pixel 10 Pro); colors Canyon, Fog, Olive, all-matte Obsidian.
- **Pixel 11 Pro Fold:** nearly 10% lighter and almost 1mm thinner; 48-megapixel main camera; 30x Super Zoom; IP68; glass-fiber composite back and redesigned hinge, "three times more durable"; Olive and Obsidian.
- **Pixel Tag:** connects to Android's Find Hub network; $29 or $99 for four; locatable from a Pixel Watch; Pixel Buds users can ask Gemini to find or ring it.
- **Pixel Watch 5:** monthly blood pressure and insulin resistance trend summaries in Google Health app; 41mm from $399, 45mm from $429; Stephen Curry edition $579. Pixel Buds Pro arrives in Olive.

wikis.title: Google Pixel Watch 5 store configurator
wikis.summary: Google Store configuration page for the Pixel Watch 5 listing sizes, colors, connectivity options and prices.
wikis.body:
- Sizes: 41mm (fits wrists 130-210mm) from $399.99; 45mm (150-215mm) from $429.99; 45mm Special Edition Stephen Curry (140-215mm) $579.99.
- Colors: Polished Silver Aluminum/Fog Active Band; Champagne Gold Aluminum/Canyon Active Band; Satin Pyrite Aluminum/Olive Active Band; Matte Black Aluminum/Obsidian Active Band; Satin Pyrite Aluminum/Rye Performance Loop Band.
- Connectivity: 4G LTE + Bluetooth/Wi-Fi $499.99 (page offers 2 years of data for any Pixel Watch 5 (LTE)); Bluetooth/Wi-Fi $399.99.
- Trade-in up to $300 back with eligible trade-in. Pixel Care+ monthly $6/month or 2-year $119; with Loss & Theft $7/month or $139 (not available to New York residents).
- Page banner: "Celebrate 28 years of Google with sweet savings ... Shop birthday deals".

wikis.title: Made by Google 2026 launch live blog (Android Central)
wikis.summary: Android Central live blog of 12 August 2026 covering the Pixel 11 series, Pixel 11 Pro Fold, Pixel Watch 5 and Pixel Tag announcements.
wikis.body:
- Event: Made by Google keynote began Wednesday, August 12 at 3 p.m. PT / 6 p.m. EDT, streamed on the Made by Google YouTube channel and the Google Store site. Lineup: Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, 11 Pro Fold, Pixel Watch 5 and "the surprise Pixel Tag". Article says the big story is "software upgrades, less on hardware upgrades".
- **HiLight:** circular LED array replacing the temperature sensor; swirls in different patterns as Gemini listens, processes and speaks; glows for notifications and calls; on all Pro models (11 Pro, Pro XL, Pro Fold) but not the base Pixel 11, which only has an LED flash.
- **Tensor G6** in all models with a 50% faster TPU. Magic Capture records the viewfinder and picks best moments at HDR+ quality; Live Video Translate translates video audio in real time; Gemini can build interactive workouts; Circle to Search in Camera; Night Sight instant (4.5x faster); Rambler speech-to-text; Creator Suite (project folders, storyboard, teleprompter); Pro Stable video mode.
- **Pro sensors:** main 50MP 1/1.3" f/1.68; ultrawide 48MP 1/2.51" f/1.7; telephoto 48MP 1/1.95" f/2.8; selfie 42MP f/2.2. Pro models use Gorilla Glass Victus 2; displays 2x more scratch resistant than any prior Pixel.
- **Pixel 11:** new 48MP main sensor with 56% more light than Pixel 10; 30x telephoto zoom. **Pixel 11 Pro Fold:** 1mm thinner than Pixel 10 Pro Fold; composite back Google says is impossible to crack; 10.5MP ultrawide and 10.8MP 5x telephoto; Pixelsnap in all four models.
- **Pixel Watch 5:** design unchanged; CPU 20% faster and 50% more RAM; GPS 2x more accurate (Google claims better than Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Garmin Fenix 8 Pro); breathing emergency alerts, blood pressure and insulin resistance trends (30-day summaries); Gemini-made watch faces; strength-training rep and set counting.
- **Pixel Tag:** 11.8g, IP67, UWB and Bluetooth, works up to 50 meters from the paired phone; separate keyring attachment needed; CR2032 battery lasting over a year; $29 or $99 for four; coming November 11.
- **Prices:** Pixel 11 $899 (no 128GB model this year); 11 Pro $1,099; Pro XL $1,299; Pro Fold $1,899. Pixel Watch 5 41mm $399, 45mm $429, LTE $499 and $529, Stephen Curry Edition $579; watches launch September 3.
- Titan M3 security chip adopts NIST post-quantum cryptography standards.

wikis.title: Google Pixel Tag Google Store page
wikis.summary: Google Store product page for the Pixel Tag finder tag, "Coming November 2026", with specs.
wikis.body:
- "Coming November 2026"; sold as a 1-Pack or 4-Pack (prices not rendered on the captured page). Color: Fog.
- Works with Find Hub: "a global network of over 1 billion Android devices"; meter-by-meter directional guidance; play a sound on the tag or ask Gemini to ring it; press the tag's button to ring your phone even if silent (Fast Pair).
- Design: thin stainless steel look; page's spec list says materials are "Polycarbonate and metal"; 100% plastic-free packaging.
- Dimensions: 1.1 in wide, 1.8 in high, 0.2 in deep; 0.4 oz with battery (0.3 oz without).
- IP67 (max depth 1 meter up to 30 minutes). Bluetooth Channel Sounding and Ultra Wideband for precision finding; accelerometer; built-in speaker.
- User-replaceable CR2032 coin cell, lasts over one year. Compatible with Android 9 and later. 1 year warranty.
- Privacy: location data is encrypted and not stored on the Find Hub network.

wikis.title: Keep tabs on your valuables with Google Pixel Tag (Google blog)
wikis.summary: Google blog post of Aug 12, 2026 introducing the Pixel Tag, its first finder tag, at $29 from November 11.
wikis.body:
- "Google's first-ever finder tag", using the Find Hub network for keys, wallet, luggage.
- Build: durable stainless steel, IP67; speaker plays a sound and a button rings your phone; battery up to one year, user-replaceable.
- Setup: pull the battery tab and bring near an Android device running Android 9 or newer; pairs via Fast Pair; name items in the Find Hub app; share with up to 10 people.
- Finding: map in Find Hub; ring within Bluetooth range; Ultra-Wideband with Bluetooth Channel Sounding for precision finding with distance and direction cues; Left Behind alerts; out of range it uses Find Hub's network of "over one billion Android devices" with end-to-end encrypted location information; alerts when an unknown tag travels with you.
- Can be located and rung from a Pixel Watch, Find Hub app or browser; Pixel Buds users can ask Gemini to ring it.
- Price: $29, or $99 for a 4-pack; on shelves November 11.

wikis.title: Google takes on AirTag with the $29 Pixel Tag (TechCrunch)
wikis.summary: TechCrunch article of Aug 12, 2026 comparing the $29 Pixel Tag finder with Apple AirTag.
wikis.body:
- At Made by Google 2026 Google unveiled the $29 Google Pixel Tag, using Google's Find Hub network of Android devices; add it to Android's Find Hub. Can be located and rung from a Pixel Watch.
- Differs from AirTag in shape: slimmer and elongated. Pixel Tag 1.1 in wide, 1.8 in high, 0.2 in deep vs AirTag 1.26 in wide and 0.31 in high; 0.4 oz with battery vs 0.39 oz.
- Both IP67 (submersion to 1 meter for up to 30 minutes).
- Bluetooth and Ultra Wideband for precision finding; no NFC; built-in speaker; user-replaceable CR2032 battery, roughly a year.
- $29 for one, $99 for a four-pack; available for purchase November 11, 2026.

wikis.title: BenQ iScreenBar monitor light bar for iMac (buy page)
wikis.summary: BenQ US buy page for the iScreenBar monitor light bar designed for iMac; most price and stock text is unrendered template code.
wikis.body:
- Product: iScreenBar Monitor Light Bar, described as "Purpose-built for your iMac with a magnetic mount and precision fit", leaving the camera, microphone and speakers unobstructed.
- macOS integration: automatically wakes with the iMac; brightness and color temperature adjustable from the BenQ app, with app-based lighting presets.
- ASYM-Light asymmetric optics with a cutoff angle directs light onto the desk and away from the screen and eyes ("glare-free").
- Includes a magnetic cable organizer x1.
- Prices and stock status were not captured (unrendered template placeholders).

wikis.title: BenQ iScreenBar monitor light bar for iMac (MacRumors)
wikis.summary: MacRumors news of Aug 25, 2026 on BenQ launching the iScreenBar, billed as the first monitor light bar built for the iMac, at $189.
wikis.body:
- BenQ announced the iScreenBar, which it says is "the first monitor light bar built for the iMac".
- Made from aluminum; lights an area of 33.5 by 19.7 inches at 500 lux. Glass touch panel plus a macOS app for brightness, color temperature and light mode.
- Turns on/off via presence detection and can activate when the iMac wakes; auto-adjusts to room light; video call mode evens lighting and reduces glare on the face.
- Mounts to the back of the iMac with a magnetic clamp; includes a magnetic cable clip; asymmetric optics avoid shining on the screen or into the eyes; powered by the iMac's USB-C port, which also allows automatic camera mode activation.
- Price $189 from BenQ or Amazon; compatible with the 24-inch iMac (2021 and later).

wikis.title: Twelve South Valet 4.25 in. Qi2.2 wireless charging tray (product page)
wikis.summary: Twelve South product page for the Valet 4.25 in., a leather valet tray with 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, $129.99.
wikis.body:
- Price $129.99; colors Black Base/Black Frame, Taupe Base/Ecru Frame, Brown Base/Brown Frame (page marks variants as sold out or unavailable at capture). Also offered in a 7.5 in. size.
- Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W; USB-C port up to 10W wired (charge two devices at once); premium Nappa leather tray; four-way orientation; interchangeable removable leather frame; weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management.
- Specs: 9.75 x 4.25 x 1.5 in; 1.5 lbs; surface clearance 6 mm; genuine Nappa leather and zinc alloy base; 45W color-matched power supply; 1.5 m USB-C cable; EU and UK adapters. USB-C wired outputs: iPhone up to 25W, Samsung 15W, Pixel 15W, AirPods 5W.
- Free US shipping over $85, 30-day returns (custom monogram items final sale), two-year manufacturer's warranty.

wikis.title: Twelve South launches new leather Valet tray with Qi2 25W (9to5Toys)
wikis.summary: 9to5Toys news of Jul 28, 2026 on Twelve South launching the compact 4.25-inch Valet tray and 25W wireless charger at $129.99.
wikis.body:
- Twelve South debuted its leather Valet tray with onboard wireless charging at CES 2026; now launches a compact model at a lower price. The article says the original high-end customizable Valet appears no longer available on the official site.
- Valet 4.25-inch: leather tray on weighted zinc alloy base with a 25W wireless MagSafe pad, plus an "additional 10W USB-C port" to charge a second device (e.g. Apple Watch or Kindle).
- Colors: Black with Black base, Taupe with Ecru Frame, Brown with Brown frame; $129.99 shipped.
- Features: Qi2.2 up to 25W, Nappa leather tray, four orientations, interchangeable leather frames, hidden cable management, includes 45W power supply, 1.5m USB-C cable and UK/EU adaptors.

wikis.title: Twelve South debuts smaller Valet tray with 25W MagSafe charging (9to5Mac)
wikis.summary: 9to5Mac news of Jul 28, 2026 on the 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet, priced $129.99.
wikis.body:
- Earlier this year Twelve South debuted the Valet, a "wireless charging station and personal essentials tray"; the first version measured 7.5 inches. The new version is 4.25 inches with MagSafe and Qi2.2 charging up to 25W.
- Twelve South describes it as "a beautiful home object first and a sophisticated wireless charger second"; soft square charging pad, weighted zinc alloy base.
- Features: Nappa leather tray, four configurable orientations, interchangeable leather frames, hidden cable management, extra USB-C port for up to 10W wired charging, 45W power supply and 1.5m cable.
- Available to order now for $129.99 in three color combinations; the author calls it "pricey".

wikis.title: Supreme x Analogue Pocket edition page
wikis.summary: Analogue product page for the Supreme/Analogue Pocket special edition handheld.
wikis.body:
- Described as a "Metallic portable handheld multi-video-game-system" with unibody aluminum, 24K Gold-plated and custom red glossy finishes.
- Compatible with the 2,780+ Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance cartridge library; works with cartridge adapters for other handhelds.
- Built-in synthesizer and sequencer; MicroSD card reader at side; custom logo LCD display; debossed logos front and back; 3.5" x 5.75". Cartridges sold separately.

wikis.title: Supreme's 24K gold Analogue Pocket for FW26 (The Gadgeteer)
wikis.summary: The Gadgeteer article of August 17, 2026 on Supreme's Fall/Winter 2026 Analogue Pocket editions, a gold-plated model and a glossy red model.
wikis.body:
- Supreme's Fall/Winter 2026 collaboration introduces two special Analogue Pocket models: a glossy red version and a "Gold Supreme Analogue Pocket" over aluminum construction. Supreme describes the gold version as 24K gold-plated.
- Article notes plating thickness, gold quantity and durability are not stated.
- Underlying Pocket: plays original Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance cartridges (Analogue says more than 2,780 cartridges); two FPGAs, not software emulation; 3.5-inch 1600 x 1440 display at 615ppi; USB-C charging; rechargeable 4,300mAh battery. The standard Pocket supports Game Gear, Neo Geo Pocket Color, Atari Lynx, TurboGrafx-16 and other formats via separately sold adapters.
- Nothing announced suggests a performance upgrade over the standard Pocket.
- Supreme's Fall/Winter 2026 collection launches on August 20, 2026, but Supreme "has not announced a retail price or confirmed the individual drop timing for either Analogue Pocket edition".

wikis.title: Analogue Pocket gets a gold limited edition in Supreme collab (Trusted Reviews)
wikis.summary: Trusted Reviews news of August 18, 2026 on the limited-edition Supreme Analogue Pocket in gold and red.
wikis.body:
- Supreme is making the Analogue Pocket a limited-edition collector's item with a 24-karat gold finish, launching as part of Supreme's Fall/Winter 2026 collection.
- "No word yet" on when it goes on sale or how many units will be made; expected to cost more than the standard Analogue Pocket's $239.99 list price.
- Two versions: an aluminium unibody model with a glossy red finish, and a gold-plated version. Hardware is unchanged from the regular Pocket.
- Pocket is FPGA-based and plays Game Boy cartridges natively; 1,600 x 1,440 display, "exactly ten times the resolution of the original Game Boy Color on each axis". The standard Pocket comes in black or white.

wikis.title: Razer x XBOX 25th Anniversary gaming gear collection (Razer page)
wikis.summary: Razer US campaign page for the limited XBOX 25th Anniversary Edition Hammerhead V3 X, Basilisk V3 Pro 35K and BlackWidow V4 75%, open for pre-order.
wikis.body:
- Razer joins XBOX's 25th anniversary with "a limited collection"; described as "ultra-exclusive". Includes 1 month of XBOX Game Pass Ultimate (terms apply).
- **Razer Hammerhead V3 X HyperSpeed, XBOX 25th Anniversary Edition:** wireless gaming earbuds with Razer HyperSpeed Wireless, SmartSwitch Dual Wireless and THX Spatial Audio.
- **Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K, XBOX 25th Anniversary Edition:** RGB wireless gaming mouse.
- **Razer BlackWidow V4 75%, XBOX 25th Anniversary Edition:** compact hot-swappable mechanical keyboard with Razer Chroma RGB and Razer Orange Tactile Switches Gen-3.
- All three marked "Pre-order Now". No prices or dates on the captured page.

wikis.title: Razer XBOX 25 Anniversary Collection announcement (Razer Newsroom)
wikis.summary: Razer press release of August 25, 2026 announcing a limited-edition XBOX 25th Anniversary lineup of three peripherals.
wikis.body:
- Razer announced the XBOX 25 Anniversary Collection, developed with XBOX: Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K, BlackWidow V4 75% and Hammerhead V3 X HyperSpeed for XBOX, in an XBOX-inspired translucent green design with anniversary detailing.
- Quote from Travis Furst, Head of AI Hardware and Console Division at Razer: "This collection brings both legacies together into gear fans can see, feel, and play on, pairing XBOX heritage with Razer performance."
- **Basilisk V3 Pro 35K:** wireless ergonomic mouse, Razer Focus Pro 35K Optical Sensor Gen-2, HyperScroll Tilt Wheel, 13 customizable controls, HyperSpeed Wireless, Chroma RGB.
- **BlackWidow V4 75%:** hot-swappable, Orange Tactile Switches Gen-3, dedicated XBOX key opening XBOX Game Bar, 2-side underglow with per-key Chroma RGB, magnetic plush leatherette wrist rest.
- **Hammerhead V3 X HyperSpeed:** HyperSpeed 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.3, SmartSwitch, up to 35 hours battery, IPX4, surround sound on XBOX and PC.
- To be showcased at gamescom 2026.

wikis.title: Designed for XBOX 25th Anniversary Collection (XBOX Wire)
wikis.summary: XBOX Wire post of August 25, 2026 listing the Designed for XBOX 25th Anniversary accessories now open for preorder.
wikis.body:
- Anna Vo, Director, XBOX Brand Marketing: the collection "is now available for preorder", "Inspired by the original console", pairing nostalgic translucent green with 25-year design details.
- **Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K:** wireless ergonomic RGB mouse, up to 140 hours wireless, 4-way scroll wheel, Focus Pro 35K Optical Sensor Gen-2. Preorder at Razer.com.
- **Razer BlackWidow V4 75%:** compact hot-swappable keyboard; an "XBOX" key that launches Game Bar, exclusive to this edition. Preorder at Razer.com.
- **Razer Hammerhead V3 X HyperSpeed:** multi-platform earbuds, HyperSpeed 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth 5.3; up to 35 hours total (10 hours plus 25 from case); USB-C passthrough.
- **8BitDo Ultimate Charging Dock for XBOX Controllers, X25 Special Edition:** transparent green; fits XBOX Series X|S and XBOX One wireless controllers (8bitdo.com).
- **Backbone Pro XBOX 25th Anniversary Edition:** blind-box format with Iconic Blue, Bold Orange, Crystal Clear colorways (backbone.com).
- **PowerA XBOX Sling Bag:** fits ROG XBOX Ally and ROG XBOX Ally X; four compartments (powera.com).
- **GameSir X5 Lite for XBOX:** translucent green mobile controller, official XBOX licensing, Apple MFi certification (gamesir.com).

wikis.title: TerraMaster F4-425 Pro NAS (Gadget Flow)
wikis.summary: Gadget Flow product page for the TerraMaster F4-425 Pro 4-bay NAS, discounted from $699.99 to $594.99.
wikis.body:
- Overview: 4-bay NAS "built for speed and room to grow". Page shows $699.99 reduced to $594.99 ("105USD OFF"); Gadget Flow rating 9.1; discovered Sep 12, 2026.
- Processor: Intel N305 (page says "8-core") and 8GB memory; three M.2 NVMe slots for cache.
- TOS 7 with a built-in OpenClaw agent that manages files with plain-language commands; most AI tasks run locally.
- Dual 5GbE ports combining for up to 1020 MB/s.
- Media server: hardware 4K decoding, Plex, Emby, Jellyfin.
- Ransomware defense: TFSS snapshots and HyperLock-WORM.

wikis.title: TerraMaster F4-425 Pro launches June 23 (TerraMaster blog)
wikis.summary: TerraMaster blog post of June 25, 2026 on the F4-425 Pro 4-bay NAS launching June 23 with the AI-native TOS 7.
wikis.body:
- TerraMaster says it officially launched the F4-425 Pro on June 23, a next-generation 4-bay NAS for home backup, small business file sharing and private cloud, running TOS 7.
- Hardware per this page: Intel 8-core processor, 16GB DDR5 memory, dual 5GbE ports; supports Docker apps; 4-bay RAID with expansion and data protection. (Gadget Flow's page lists an Intel N305 with 8GB.)
- TOS 7 is called "the world's first AI-native NAS operating system": natural-language commands, more than 500 standardized system APIs, 23 native CLI execution interfaces, a skill-based task planning engine; independent Storage Manager app with RAID guidance and health explanation.
- Offer: 20% launch discount for the first two weeks before release; sold via official store, Amazon (multiple regions), AliExpress, Newegg, Walmart and B&H.

wikis.title: TerraMaster F4-425 Pro 4+3 hybrid NAS with Intel Core 3 N350 or Core i3-N305
wikis.summary: CNX Software article on TerraMaster's F4-425 Pro NAS, its specifications, TOS 7 software and pricing.
wikis.body:
- The F4-425 Pro 4+3 Hybrid NAS is an update of the F4-425 Plus (Intel N150) with either an Intel Core 3 N350 "Twin Lake" octa-core CPU or a Core i3-N305 "Alder Lake-N" octa-core CPU.
- Storage: 4 SATA bays (3.5-inch HDD and/or 2.5-inch SSD/HDD, up to 132TB total, 32TB per drive, hot swap) plus 3 M.2 2280 NVMe slots (PCIe 3.0 x1, up to 24TB total, 8TB per drive). RAID 0/1/5/6/10, JBOD, Single, TRAID / TRAID+.
- Memory: DDR5 non-ECC SO-DIMM, expandable to 32GB; the Core i3-N305 model has 8GB, the Core 3 N350 model 16GB.
- CPUs: i3-N305 up to 3.8 GHz Turbo, 15W TDP; Core 3 N350 up to 3.9 GHz Turbo, 7W TDP; both 6MB cache, 32U Intel HD graphics. Transcoding H.264, H.265, MPEG-4, VC-1 up to 4K @ 60 FPS.
- Networking: 2x 5GbE RJ45 with link aggregation. Ports: 3x USB 3.2 (10 Gbps) Type-A, 1x USB 3.2 Type-C, HDMI 2.1 (terminal output only).
- 120mm smart fan, 20.9 dB(A) at 1m (HDD standby), aluminum-alloy chassis, 90W external adapter, 150 x 181 x 219 mm, 2.9 kg.
- The author says the N350 should be only marginally faster than the N305 (a refresh with slightly higher CPU and GPU frequencies); the main difference is 8GB vs 16GB RAM.
- Ships with TOS 7 (Linux 6.12), with natural-language control through OpenClaw AI, Smart ISO mounting, unified recycle bin, per-port bandwidth limits, revamped notification center; the company claims search accuracy improved by 120% and query speed by 10 times. NAS will not auto-update from TOS 6.0 to 7.0; it must be done manually.
- Pricing: TerraMaster store $559.99 (i3-N305 + 8GB) and $669.99 (Core 3 N350 + 16GB); Amazon $699.99 and $799.99. The store prices look like a time-limited 20% promotion. The F4-425 Plus (N150, 16GB) goes for $519.99. A giveaway of two F4-425 Pro and two 4TB drives (four winners) was launched.
- Reader comment: TOS 7 still has many bugs, some requiring an OS reinstall.

wikis.title: Christopher Nolan's next film set at Universal for Imax release on July 17, 2026, Matt Damon in talks
wikis.summary: Deadline exclusive (Oct 8, 2024) that Nolan's next movie is at Universal for an Imax release on July 17, 2026 with Matt Damon in talks to star.
wikis.body:
- Sources tell Deadline Nolan is returning to Universal for his next film, planned for an Imax release on July 17, 2026; Matt Damon is in talks to star. Universal had no comment.
- Plot details are secret; sources say the film is expected to shoot in early 2025.
- Some believed Nolan might take the package to market, but Universal seemed the logical landing spot after Oppenheimer, which grossed $328.9 million domestic and $975.6 million worldwide and won seven Oscars including Best Picture, Best Director, and acting prizes for Cillian Murphy and Robert Downey Jr.
- It would be Damon's third film with Nolan (Interstellar in 2014, Oppenheimer). Damon joins Christian Bale and Murphy as actors who have worked with Nolan at least three times.
- "With the project now a full go, expect it to attract plenty of A-list talent."

wikis.title: Christopher Nolan's next movie lands at Universal with Matt Damon in talks
wikis.summary: Hollywood Reporter (Oct 8, 2024) on Nolan setting his next film at Universal for a July 17, 2026 release with Matt Damon in talks to star.
wikis.body:
- Nolan is staying at Universal, his Oppenheimer studio; Matt Damon is in talks to star. The feature has a release date of July 17, 2026, THR confirmed. Deadline first reported it.
- The news comes amid speculation about where and when Nolan would make his next feature. He publicly split with Warner Bros. in late 2020 amid its "Project Popcorn" initiative, but has expressed openness over the past year to work with the studio again.
- Unlike Oppenheimer, which was acquired by Universal in a controlled auction, this project went straight to the studio, according to sources. Sources say it is not a big-screen take on the 1960s British series The Prisoner, which Nolan contemplated in the 2000s.
- Nolan will write the script and produce with wife Emma Thomas for Syncopy. It will be Damon's third film with Nolan (small, key surprise role in 2014's Interstellar).
- Oppenheimer grossed $975 million globally, Nolan's third-biggest, behind The Dark Knight Rises ($1.084 billion) and The Dark Knight ($1.003 billion); it earned Nolan his first Oscars (for directing, and as producer for best picture) and it took home five other Oscar wins.

wikis.title: Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday begins production
wikis.summary: Marvel announcement (Mar 26, 2025) that Avengers: Doomsday began production, with cast list and May 1, 2026 release date.
wikis.body:
- Marvel Studios announced production has begun on Avengers: Doomsday, "in theaters May 1, 2026", in a multi-hour global livestream that revealed part of the cast.
- Cast listed: Chris Hemsworth, Vanessa Kirby, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Letitia Wright, Paul Rudd, Wyatt Russell, Tenoch Huerta Mejia, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Simu Liu, Florence Pugh, Kelsey Grammer, Lewis Pullman, Danny Ramirez, Joseph Quinn, David Harbour, Winston Duke, Hannah John-Kamen, Tom Hiddleston, Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Alan Cumming, Rebecca Romijn, James Marsden, Channing Tatum, Pedro Pascal, and Robert Downey Jr.
- Anthony and Joe Russo return to direct Doomsday and Avengers: Secret Wars (in theaters May 7, 2027). Announced at San Diego Comic-Con 2024, with Downey, who starred in 10 films as Tony Stark, returning as the villain Victor von Doom.

wikis.title: Disney pushes next two Avengers films; dates The Dog Stars and The Devil Wears Prada 2
wikis.summary: Deadline (May 22, 2025) on Disney moving Avengers: Doomsday and Secret Wars to December dates and setting other 2025-2026 release dates.
wikis.body:
- Avengers: Doomsday (directed by the Russo Brothers) moves from May 1 to December 18, 2026; Avengers: Secret Wars moves from May 7 to December 17, 2027. Insiders say they are among the biggest films ever made and the delays allow more time to execute the vision; December was chosen given success in the holiday corridor (e.g. Spider-Man: No Way Home). Doomsday is "in production now".
- 20th Century Studios: Ridley Scott's The Dog Stars (Jacob Elordi; also Margaret Qualley, Josh Brolin, Guy Pearce, Benedict Wong) is set for March 27, 2026. Based on Peter Heller's novel, set nine years after a flu pandemic wipes out most of humanity; a grieving pilot and his dog in a remote Colorado airfield.
- The Devil Wears Prada 2 is dated May 1, 2026. Sequel to the 2006 film that grossed over $326 million; expected to follow Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) amid the declining print industry. Aline Brosh McKenna is writing; David Frankel expected to return with producer Wendy Finerman; cast not yet formally announced.
- IMAX/3D re-release of Avatar: The Way of Water on October 3, 2025, ahead of Avatar: Fire and Ash on December 19.
- Confirmed Doomsday cast includes Chris Hemsworth, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Paul Rudd, Letitia Wright, Florence Pugh, Simu Liu, Tom Hiddleston, Wyatt Russell, David Harbour, Winston Duke, Danny Ramirez, Hannah John-Kamen, Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Alan Cumming, Rebecca Romijn, James Marsden, Kelsey Grammer, Channing Tatum, Tenoch Huerta Mejia, Lewis Pullman and Robert Downey Jr.

wikis.title: Mortal Kombat II release date moved to May 8, 2026
wikis.summary: Deadline report on Mortal Kombat II's date changes: from Oct 24, 2025 to May 15, 2026, then to May 8, 2026.
wikis.body:
- Updated (Oct 21, 2025): New Line's Mortal Kombat II, originally set to open that weekend (Oct 24, 2025), moves a week earlier than the previously announced May 15 to May 8, 2026, the same Mother's Day weekend frame as Amazon MGM Studios' Sheep Detectives, in the wake of The Devil Wears Prada 2. Remaining on May 15: Row K's comedy Poetic License and Amazon MGM's Is God Is.
- Earlier exclusive (Aug 29): the film moved to May 15, 2026 from October 24, 2025. Reasoning given: the crowded late-October frame (Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere, Regretting You), Halloween the next weekend. The red-band trailer had a record 107M global views.
- Mid-May was a bonanza for Warner Bros/New Line: Final Destination: Bloodlines opened to a franchise record $51.6M ($138.1M US / $301M worldwide). The three Mortal Kombat movies have made $257.8M globally. Research screenings reportedly strong.
- Cast: Karl Urban (Johnny Cage), Adeline Rudolph, Jessica McNamee, Josh Lawson, Ludi Lin, Mehcad Brooks, Tati Gabrielle, Lewis Tan, Damon Herriman, Chin Han, Tadanobu Asano (Lord Raiden), Joe Taslim (Bi-Han), Hiroyuki Sanada (Hanzo Hasashi/Scorpion). Director Simon McQuoid; screenplay Jeremy Slater, based on the videogame by Ed Boon and John Tobias. Producers Todd Garner, James Wan, Toby Emmerich, E. Bennett Walsh, McQuoid.
- Blurb: champions, now joined by Johnny Cage, battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn threatening Earthrealm.

wikis.title: Mortal Kombat II undergoes another release date shift
wikis.summary: Collider (Oct 26, 2025) on Mortal Kombat II moving from May 15 to May 8, 2026, plus cast and premise.
wikis.body:
- Mortal Kombat II moves one week sooner, from May 15 to May 8, 2026 (Mother's Day weekend). Its original date was October 24, 2025. The sequel has been "more than four years in the making".
- New slot avoids a direct clash with The Devil Wears Prada 2 (May 15) but faces Amazon MGM Studios' The Sheep Detectives (Hugh Jackman).
- Cast: Karl Urban as Johnny Cage, Adeline Rudolph (Kitana), Josh Lawson (Kano), Ludi Lin (Liu Kang), Jessica McNamee (Sonya Blade), Hiroyuki Sanada (Scorpion), Joe Taslim (Noob Saibot), Lewis Tan (Cole Young), Tati Gabrielle (Jade), Mehcad Brooks (Jax); Martyn Ford as Shao Kahn.
- Producer Todd Garner on the premise: the Scorpion/Bi-Han (original Sub-Zero) relationship "a story of violence, betrayal, and vengeance"; Scorpion's spirit becomes a wraith consumed by thirst for revenge.
- Listing: rated R, 116 minutes, director Simon McQuoid, writer Jeremy Slater.

wikis.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day (TMDB page)
wikis.summary: TMDB entry for Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026) with overview, credits, release, budget and revenue.
wikis.body:
- Release: 07/31/2026 (US), PG-13, 2h 25m; genres science fiction, action, adventure. Tagline "A brand new day starts now." Status: Released.
- Overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him, and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on, sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control; it might also be the only thing that can stop "a powerful villain no one can even see".
- Director Destin Daniel Cretton; writers Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers; characters by Steve Ditko and Stan Lee.
- Top cast: Tom Holland (Peter Parker), Zendaya (MJ), Mark Ruffalo (Bruce Banner/Hulk), Jon Bernthal (Frank Castle/Punisher), Jacob Batalon (Ned Leeds), Sadie Sink (Jean Grey), Florence Pugh (Yelena Belova), Liza Colon-Zayas (Detective Jean DeWolff), Tramell Tillman (William 'Bill' Metzger).
- Budget $225,000,000; revenue $2,453,024,087. 1 award nomination. Keywords include mcu, secret identity, mind control, aftercreditsstinger.
- A user review (Aug 2, 2026) rates it 80%.

wikis.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day (Rotten Tomatoes page)
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page for Spider-Man: Brand New Day with scores, consensus, synopsis and sample reviews.
wikis.body:
- Status "Now Playing", PG-13, 2h 25m; genres action, adventure, fantasy. Director Destin Daniel Cretton; cast Tom Holland (Peter Parker), Zendaya (MJ), Sadie Sink (Jean Grey), Jacob Batalon (Ned Leeds), Jon Bernthal (Frank Castle).
- Scores at time of capture: Tomatometer 90% from 432 reviews; Popcornmeter 97% from 25,000+ verified ratings.
- Synopsis: Peter Parker fights crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him; pressure of seeing old friends move on sparks a change he may not control, which might also be the only thing that can stop "a powerful villain no one can even see".
- Critics consensus: "Spinning a web of spectacular set pieces together with mature emotional stakes and Tom Holland's soulful performance, Brand New Day is a promising reset..."
- Audience says: amazing web-slinging action, genuine emotional stakes, return of old and new friends, promise of more "big potato" adventures.
- Sample reviews: NPR (Bob Mondello, Sep 4, 2026) "a lot of fun" though overstuffed; Washington Post (Gene Park, Aug 13, 2026) 3/4, "messy but largely successful"; Salon (Aug 12, 2026) mocks the amount of MCU content; Pinkvilla 3.5/5; Cup of Soul 8/10; Phantom Tollbooth (Sep 8, 2026) 4/5.

wikis.title: Michael (2026 film)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the 2026 Michael Jackson biopic directed by Antoine Fuqua: plot, cast, production, release and box office.
wikis.body:
- Biographical film directed by Antoine Fuqua, written by John Logan, produced by Graham King, John Branca, John McClain. Follows Michael Jackson's early life from the Jackson 5 in the 1960s to the Bad World Tour in the late 1980s. Jackson is played by his nephew Jaafar Jackson (child: Juliano Valdi), both in film debuts. 127 minutes; US/UK.
- Cast: Colman Domingo (Joseph Jackson), Nia Long (Katherine), Miles Teller (John Branca), KeiLyn Durrel Jones (Bill Bray), Laura Harrier (Suzanne de Passe), Jessica Sula (La Toya), Mike Myers (Walter Yetnikoff), Kendrick Sampson (Quincy Jones), Larenz Tate (Berry Gordy), Deon Cole (Don King).
- Companies: Lionsgate Films, GK Films, Optimum Productions; distribution Lionsgate (US), Universal Pictures (international; Kino Films in Japan, Volga in Russia).
- Development: began November 2019 (Graham King secured rights, Logan attached); Lionsgate announced it in February 2022; Fuqua named director and Jaafar cast in January 2023; principal photography January to May 2024 after delays from the 2023 SAG-AFTRA strike.
- A clause in a legal settlement was discovered, so references to the 1993 child sexual abuse allegations were removed, the third act was revised, and reshoots took place in June 2025, bringing the budget to $155-200 million. Kat Graham's Diana Ross portrayal was cut for "legal considerations". Final script ends as the Bad World Tour begins. Paris Jackson criticized the casting of Teller in a legal filing.
- Plot covers Jackson 5 formation in 1966, Motown signing, Off the Wall (1978, Quincy Jones), Thriller, the Pepsi commercial fire during the 1984 Victory Tour, and the 1988 Wembley Bad World Tour.
- Release: premiered April 10, 2026 at Uber Eats Music Hall, Berlin; UK April 22 (Universal), US April 24, 2026 (Lionsgate). Generally negative reviews from critics, who praised Jaafar's performance but criticized the story as "sanitized".
- Box office $1.021 billion worldwide: highest-grossing biographical film, first biopic to reach $1 billion, highest-grossing Lionsgate film, fourth-highest-grossing film of 2026. A sequel is in development.

wikis.title: Lionsgate and Universal set Michael for April 24, 2026
wikis.summary: TheWrap (July 23, 2025) on the Michael Jackson biopic Michael getting an April 24, 2026 release date.
wikis.body:
- Lionsgate and Universal set Antoine Fuqua's Michael Jackson biopic for April 24, 2026. Lionsgate distributes domestically, Universal overseas except Japan (Kino Films). Global Imax support.
- It becomes the de facto summer-kickoff tentpole, replacing Marvel's usual first-weekend-of-May slot, since Disney moved Avengers: Doomsday and Secret Wars into the holiday season.
- The film was pulled from an October 2025 date after CEO Jon Feltheimer said in May that Fuqua and producer Graham King had turned in a 3.5-hour cut.
- Jaafar Jackson stars; Colman Domingo and Nia Long play Joe and Katherine Jackson; Miles Teller plays John Branca.
- No competing wide releases on April 24; The Devil Wears Prada 2 and Animal Friends are set for May 1. Other Lionsgate 2026 titles: Hunger Games prequel Sunrise on the Reaping (Thanksgiving), an I Can Only Imagine sequel (February), Mel Gibson's The Resurrection of the Christ (date TBD).

wikis.title: Lionsgate and Universal announce Michael for theaters April 24, 2026
wikis.summary: Press release (July 23, 2025) announcing the Michael biopic's worldwide theatrical and IMAX release on April 24, 2026.
wikis.body:
- "Michael" will be released in theaters and IMAX around the world beginning April 24, 2026. Lionsgate distributes domestically, Kino Films in Japan, Universal in the rest of the world.
- Produced by Oscar-winning Graham King, directed by Antoine Fuqua, script by three-time Oscar nominee John Logan. Newcomer Jaafar Jackson plays his late uncle.
- Described as an intimate look at Michael Jackson's journey to become the King of Pop.
- Site sidebar items (not part of the release) mention it later crossing $1 billion worldwide and a record musical-biopic opening estimated at $200 million+ worldwide, and premium early access screenings on Wednesday, April 22.

wikis.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping set for Nov. 20, 2026
wikis.summary: Deadline (June 6, 2024) on Lionsgate dating the next Hunger Games prequel film for Nov. 20, 2026 with Francis Lawrence in talks to direct.
wikis.body:
- Lionsgate sets The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping for Nov. 20, 2026, following Suzanne Collins' new novel due March 18, 2025 (Scholastic, simultaneous print/digital/audio in the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand). Francis Lawrence, director of the last four films, is "in talks" to return.
- Nina Jacobson and Brad Simpson return to produce under Color Force (its sixth outing since bringing the series to Lionsgate in 2012).
- Setting: 24 years before the original trilogy, on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games (Second Quarter Quell), won by Haymitch Abernathy, the only District 12 winner before Katniss and Peeta. The previous prequel, The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes, was set 64 years before the trilogy.
- Collins cites David Hume's idea of implicit submission and the use of propaganda; "Real or not real?" Lionsgate's Adam Fogelson calls her "our creative north star".
- The only other wide release Nov. 20, 2026 is an untitled Warner Bros/New Line movie.
- Franchise figures: books sold more than 100M copies, rights in 54 languages; four movies took more than $3.3 billion worldwide. Extensions include The World of the Hunger Games at Motiongate Dubai and a London stage production (Conor McPherson, directed by Matthew Dunster).

wikis.title: Sunrise on the Reaping trailer: first look at Joseph Zada's young Haymitch
wikis.summary: Variety (Nov 20, 2025) on the first trailer for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, with plot premise and cast.
wikis.body:
- Lionsgate released the first trailer; the film opens in theaters Nov. 20, 2026. Based on the 2025 book of the same name.
- Set 24 years before the first film; young Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) is selected for the 50th Hunger Games, the second Quarter Quell, so each district sends twice the tributes: 48 children fight to the death.
- Cast: Elle Fanning (younger Effie Trinket), Ralph Fiennes (President Coriolanus Snow), Kieran Culkin (Caesar Flickerman), Jesse Plemons (younger Plutarch Heavensbee), Kelvin Harrison Jr., Glenn Close, Maya Hawke, Mckenna Grace, Billy Porter, Whitney Peak, Ben Wang, Molly McCann, Iona Bell, Percy Daggs IV.
- Directed by Francis Lawrence, screenplay Billy Ray; Brad Simpson and Nina Jacobson return as producers.

wikis.title: Wuthering Heights with Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi set for Feb. 13, 2026
wikis.summary: Deadline (Dec 13, 2024) on Warner Bros dating Emerald Fennell's Wuthering Heights for Valentine's Day weekend 2026 and how it won the project.
wikis.body:
- Warner Bros Motion Pictures Group and MRC's adaptation from Oscar winner Emerald Fennell will hit theaters on Feb. 13, 2026 (Valentine's Day weekend). Also on that date: Universal's Reminders of Him and Sony's animated Goat.
- LuckyChap production; Robbie plays Catherine Earnshaw, Elordi plays Heathcliff; Hong Chau, Alison Oliver and Shazad Latif also star. Based on Emily Bronte's 1847 novel; UK shoot planned for early next year. Plot details of Fennell's version unknown.

wikis.title: Project Hail Mary (2026 film)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the 2026 film of Andy Weir's novel Project Hail Mary, directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller: plot, cast, production, release and reception.
wikis.body:
- 2026 science fiction film produced and directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller, written by Drew Goddard, based on Andy Weir's 2021 novel. Stars Ryan Gosling (also producer) as Ryland Grace, with Sandra Huller (Eva Stratt), James Ortiz (Rocky) and Lionel Boyce. Cinematography Greig Fraser; music Daniel Pemberton; 156 minutes; US/UK.
- Premise: middle school teacher and former molecular biologist Grace wakes with amnesia aboard the Hail Mary, sole survivor of a crew headed to Tau Ceti (11.9 light-years away), to stop the alien microbe "astrophage" dimming the Sun. He befriends the rock-like alien "Rocky" from Erid (40 Eridani A); Rocky is a puppet operated by five puppeteers ("Rockyteers") led by Ortiz. The film ends with Grace living on Erid, teaching Eridian children; the Sun's infection is cured with "taumoeba".
- Development: MGM neared a deal in March 2020 (rights acquired for $3 million); Lord and Miller hired May 2020; Goddard hired to write. Pre-production began in 2020, before the novel was published; filming through 2024 in the UK; spacecraft scenes on a practical set. Budget $248 million gross / $200 million net.
- Release: premiered March 9, 2026 at Empire Leicester Square, London; US March 20, 2026 (4,007 theaters) by Amazon MGM Studios; Sony Pictures Releasing International elsewhere. Digital May 12, 2026; MGM+ June 18 and Prime Video July 3; discs August 11, 2026.
- Box office as of September 11, 2026: $344.1 million US/Canada and $341.2 million elsewhere, $685.3 million worldwide, seventh-highest-grossing film of 2026. Opening weekend $80.6 million domestic ($141 million worldwide), Amazon MGM Studios' biggest debut.
- Reception: Rotten Tomatoes 95% of 430 reviews (8.2/10); Metacritic 77 (60 critics); CinemaScore "A".

wikis.title: Project Hail Mary (Rotten Tomatoes page)
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page for Project Hail Mary with scores, synopsis, consensus and sample reviews.
wikis.body:
- PG-13, Mar 2026, 2h 36m, sci-fi/adventure. Directors Phil Lord and Christopher Miller; cast Ryan Gosling (Ryland Grace), Sandra Huller, James Ortiz, Lionel Boyce. Streaming on Prime Video.
- Scores at capture: Tomatometer 95% (430 reviews); Popcornmeter 95% (25,000+ verified ratings).
- Synopsis: science teacher Ryland Grace wakes on a spaceship light years from home with no memory; must solve the riddle of the substance causing the sun to die out; "an unexpected friendship" means he may not have to do it alone.
- Critics consensus: "A visually dazzling space odyssey that's carried along effortlessly by the gravitational pull of Ryan Gosling at his most winning, Project Hail Mary is a near-miraculous fusion of smarts and heart."
- Audience says: "One stellar Gosling + one arachnid-ish alien + one Hail Mary mission = lightning in a spaceship."
- Sample reviews: Filmspotting 3.5/5, Sydney Morning Herald 3.5/5 (has "longueurs"), Film Frenzy 3/4, Ithaca Times ("You probably will bawl your eyes out at that little rock astronaut").

wikis.title: Masters of the Universe (2026 film)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the 2026 Masters of the Universe film directed by Travis Knight: plot, cast, development, release and box office.
wikis.body:
- 2026 American sword-and-sorcery film based on Mattel's franchise; the second live-action adaptation after the 1987 film. Directed by Travis Knight; writers Chris Butler, Aaron Nee, Adam Nee, David Callaham. 140 minutes; budget $170 million; box office $114 million.
- Cast: Nicholas Galitzine (Prince Adam/He-Man), Camila Mendes (Teela), Idris Elba, Jared Leto (Skeletor), Alison Brie (Evil-Lyn), James Purefoy (King Randor), Morena Baccarin (Sorceress), Johannes Haukur Johannesson (Fisto), Charlotte Riley (Queen Marlena), Kristen Wiig (Roboto voice).
- Plot: Adam is sent to Earth as a boy after Skeletor attacks Eternos; fifteen years later he lives in Oklahoma City, recovers the Sword of Power, is drawn back to Eternia by Teela, fights Skeletor at Snake Mountain and Castle Grayskull; Skeletor shatters the Sword and torments Adam inside his memories.
- Development: announced in 2009 by Sony Pictures Entertainment with Escape Artists; after multiple writer, director and casting changes, rights went to Netflix in 2022 and were bought by Amazon MGM Studios in 2024. Principal photography in London, January to June 2025.
- Release: premiered May 18, 2026 at the TCL Chinese Theatre, Los Angeles; US June 5, 2026 (Amazon MGM Studios); international by Sony Pictures Releasing International.
- Reception: positive reviews praising performances, action, visual effects, score and nostalgic tone, but it underperformed, grossing $114 million worldwide against a $170 million budget; it later had streaming success after its Prime Video premiere.

wikis.title: Masters of the Universe review (Deadline)
wikis.summary: Deadline review (June 2, 2026) by Pete Hammond praising Nicholas Galitzine and the light tone of the new Masters of the Universe film.
wikis.body:
- Pete Hammond calls it "a blast back to the '80s" as Hollywood and Mattel take another go at Masters of the Universe, coming in the wake of Barbie's 2023 success. Verdict: it works "on its own terms" through a younger attitude, genuine humor and Nicholas Galitzine's self-deprecating charm.
- Director Travis Knight (Laika, Kubo and the Two Strings) stages "several kick-ass battles"; writers Chris Butler, Adam and Aaron Nee, Dave Callaham keep it "amusing enough, if not earth-shattering".
- Cast notes: Idris Elba as Duncan/Man-At-Arms adds gravitas; Jared Leto's Skeletor has scene-stealing humor; Camila Mendes as Teela; Alison Brie as Evil-Lyn; Kristen Wiig voices Roboto; Tom Wilton voices Cringer; brief cameo by original He-Man Dolph Lundgren.
- Background given: Mattel launched the toy line in 1982; cartoons 1983-1985; a poorly reviewed 1987 Dolph Lundgren film; a Netflix incarnation.

wikis.title: Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow dated June 26, 2026
wikis.summary: Deadline (May 14, 2024) on Warner Bros/DC Studios setting Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow for June 26, 2026.
wikis.body:
- The Warner Bros / DC Studios film Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow will hit theaters June 26, 2026; no wide entries dated on that weekend.
- Directed by Craig Gillespie, starring Milly Alcock; adapts Tom King's 2022 comic series (illustrated by Bilquis Evely); Ana Nogueira wrote the screenplay. Second feature from DC Studios under James Gunn and Peter Safran, after Superman (July 11, 2025).
- Gunn: unlike Superman, Supergirl "was raised on a rock, a chip off Krypton, and watched everyone around her die... for the first 14 years of her life... She's much more hardcore".
- Alcock (House of the Dragon) would appear in another DC project first. Last Warner Bros Supergirl film was 1984 (Helen Slater, Faye Dunaway, directed by Jeannot Szwarc), which grossed $14M stateside.

wikis.title: Scream 7 box office opening weekend
wikis.summary: Hollywood Reporter report on Scream 7's franchise-best opening of $64.1 million domestic and $97.2 million global.
wikis.body:
- Scream 7 opened to a franchise-best $64.1M domestically and $33.1M overseas, a $97.2M global start (Spyglass Media film, released via Paramount).
- Biggest launch ever for a horror title going out in February; biggest debut of 2025 so far (as the article words it), not adjusted for inflation.
- Friday's domestic haul was $28.8M including $7.8M Thursday previews. Prior record-holder Scream VI opened to $44.4M in March 2023. Paramount had forecast a $40M-plus launch; NRG tracking projected $45M.
- Audience: 18-24 and 25-34 were the majority of ticket buyers; Rotten Tomatoes critics 33% (series-worst), audience 78%; CinemaScore B-.
- Premium formats (first Scream in Imax) made up 40% of gross, Imax alone 9%.
- Budget: net $45M; Spyglass fully produced, Paramount co-financed half.
- Kevin Williamson (writer of Scream, 2 and 4) directs. Neve Campbell returns as Sidney with daughter Tatum (Isabel May); Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Matthew Lillard, Scott Foley, Mason Gooding and Jasmin Savoy Brown also appear. Melissa Barrera was fired over social posts; Jenna Ortega left earlier; Christopher Landon exited as director.
- Context: Paramount-Skydance (David Ellison) cleared to buy Warner Bros. Discovery after Netflix stepped away.
- Holdovers: GOAT about $12M; Wuthering Heights about $6.9M; Elvis concert doc (Neon, Baz Luhrmann) A+ CinemaScore.

wikis.title: Scream 7 release date, cast and plot
wikis.summary: Newsweek explainer on Scream 7's February 27, 2026 release, trailer, plot and cast.
wikis.body:
- Scheduled for theaters on February 27th, 2026; first trailer (the "Big Game Spot") released Monday, February 2nd.
- A first for the franchise: released in both IMAX and 4DX.
- Neve Campbell returns as Sidney Prescott, her sixth Scream film, with a daughter to protect (Isabel May).
- Paramount synopsis: a new Ghostface emerges in the quiet town where Sidney has built a new life; her daughter becomes the next target.
- Scream 6 recap: three Ghostfaces in New York City targeted Sam and Tara Carpenter; Sam, Tara, Chad, Mindy and Kirby survive.
- Cast list: Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Isabel May, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Mason Gooding, Anna Camp, Joel McHale, Mckenna Grace, Michelle Randolph, Jimmy Tatro, Asa Germann, Celeste O'Connor, Sam Rechner, Ethan Embry, Tim Simons, Mark Consuelos.

wikis.title: Return to Silent Hill gets US theatrical release from Cineverse
wikis.summary: Variety exclusive: Cineverse acquired US rights to Return to Silent Hill for a wide release at a date to be announced.
wikis.body:
- Cineverse acquired US rights to "Return to Silent Hill", the newest film based on Konami's horror game series; wide US theatrical release, date to be announced.
- Directed by Christophe Gans (also directed 2006's Silent Hill); stars Jeremy Irvine and Hannah Emily Anderson; promised to be "a faithful adaptation of the video game 'Silent Hill 2'".
- Synopsis: James, broken after his relationship with Mary ends, is called back to Silent Hill by a mysterious letter from her and finds the town transformed by an unknown evil.
- Franchise has a global box office of $156 million to date across the first two films (Cineverse's Yolanda Macias).
- Produced by Victor Hadida (Davis Films), Molly Hassell (Hassell Free Production) and David Wulf; financed by Davis Films and Ashland Hill Media Finance. Deal negotiated by Macias and Brandon Hill for Cineverse and CAA Media Finance. International rights are with The Veterans, representing it at the Cannes Film Market.

wikis.title: Return to Silent Hill release date January 23, 2026
wikis.summary: GamingBolt report, citing Deadline, that Return to Silent Hill hits theatres on January 23, 2026.
wikis.body:
- Per Deadline, Return to Silent Hill opens in theatres on January 23, 2026; it is the third film in the Silent Hill adaptations after Silent Hill (2006) and Silent Hill: Revelation (2012).
- Stars Jeremy Irvine and Hannah Emily Anderson; directed and co-written by Christophe Gans; music by original game composer Akira Yamaoka. Announced in 2022.
- Adapts Silent Hill 2; the protagonist is named James. How faithfully it adapts the story is "currently unknown".
- Gans: "we decided to go back to the best of these stories."

wikis.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple on Rotten Tomatoes
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page with scores, synopsis and consensus for 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple.
wikis.body:
- Rated R, Jan 2026, 1h 50m; Horror, Mystery & Thriller. Streaming on Netflix; rent or buy on Fandango.
- Tomatometer 91% (351 reviews); Popcornmeter 88% (2,500+ verified ratings).
- Nia DaCosta directs, expanding on the world of Danny Boyle and Alex Garland's 28 Years Later. Dr. Kelson (Ralph Fiennes) makes a discovery that could change the world; Spike (Alfie Williams) encounters Jimmy Crystal (Jack O'Connell). "The infected are no longer the only threat to survival."
- Critics consensus: "A direct continuation of 28 Years Later that ups the gore while deepening the dread, The Bone Temple is finely adorned by Nia DaCosta's unnerving direction as well as Ralph Fiennes and Jack O'Connell's inspired performances."
- Audience says: "as hard to look at as it's hard to look away from -- a mad, visceral mood piece with a surprisingly substantial amount of humanity."

wikis.title: The Bride! (2026 film) - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Maggie Gyllenhaal's 2026 gothic romance The Bride!, covering plot, cast, production, release and box office failure.
wikis.body:
- 2026 American gothic romance written and directed by Maggie Gyllenhaal, inspired by the 1935 Bride of Frankenstein and Mary Shelley's Frankenstein. Stars Jessie Buckley (dual role, also Mary Shelley), Christian Bale as Frank, Peter Sarsgaard, Annette Bening, Jake Gyllenhaal, Penelope Cruz. Distributor Warner Bros. Pictures; runtime 126 minutes.
- Plot: in 1936 Chicago, Mary Shelley's ghost possesses Ida; Ida dies, and Dr. Cornelia Euphronius revives her for Frank. Memory-less, she becomes "Penelope"; the pair go on a crime spree to New York and Niagara Falls, pursued by Detective Jake Wiles and Myrna Malloy, and by crime boss Lupino's men. Both die and are ultimately revived.
- Production: Production Weekly (Aug 2023) reported a Netflix remake; Warner Bros. took over by Jan 2024 after Netflix left (disagreement over filming in New York vs New Jersey, per WSJ); costs incl. marketing likely to exceed $100 million. Shot on IMAX-certified digital cameras by Lawrence Sher; score by Hildur Gudnadottir (replacing Jonny Greenwood). Some violent scenes cut after negative test screenings. Budget $80-90 million.
- Release: premiere Feb 26, 2026 (Leicester Square); France and South Korea March 4; US March 6, 2026 in IMAX. Earlier dates Sept 26 / Oct 3, 2025. Digital April 7, 2026; disc May 19, 2026.
- Box office: $24 million worldwide ($13M US/Canada, $11M elsewhere); opening weekend $7.3M domestic, third behind Hoppers and Scream 7; second weekend down 70% to $2.1M. Variety, Deadline and THR called it a box office bomb; expected loss upward of $90 million.
- Reception: Rotten Tomatoes 57% of 335 reviews, average 5.8/10; CinemaScore C+.

wikis.title: The Bride! official movie site
wikis.summary: Official site blurb for The Bride!, Maggie Gyllenhaal's Frankenstein-companion film from Warner Bros. Pictures.
wikis.body:
- Written and directed by Maggie Gyllenhaal; stars Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale, Peter Sarsgaard, with Annette Bening, Jake Gyllenhaal, Penelope Cruz.
- Premise: a lonely Frankenstein (Bale) travels to 1930s Chicago to ask Dr. Euphronious (Bening) to create a companion; they revive a murdered young woman and The Bride (Buckley) is born: "Murder! Possession! A wild and radical cultural movement! And outlaw lovers".
- Producers: Gyllenhaal, Emma Tillinger Koskoff, Talia Kleinhendler, Osnat Handelsman Keren. Crew: DP Lawrence Sher, production designer Karen Murphy, editor Dylan Tichenor, composer Hildur Gudnadottir, costumes Sandy Powell.
- Warner Bros. Pictures release: theaters and IMAX in North America March 6, 2026; internationally from 4 March 2026. Page notes it is available on digital.

wikis.title: Moana (2026) on Rotten Tomatoes
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page for Disney's live-action Moana with scores and consensus.
wikis.body:
- Live-action reimagining of Disney's animated Moana; PG, Jul 2026, 1h 55m. Moana (Catherine Laga'aia) voyages beyond the reef of Motunui with demigod Maui (Dwayne Johnson).
- Tomatometer 33% (197 reviews); Popcornmeter 88% (1,000+ verified ratings). Rent or buy on Fandango.
- Critics consensus: "The sea calls to no one in this underwhelming new version of Moana, an endeavor that solidifies its animated predecessor as the superior adventure."
- Audience says: "A beautifully rendered live-action adaptation of the 2016 classic ... faithfully delivers the beloved story, enhanced by a handful of surprises and culturally resonant touches."
- Sample reviews: Observer (UK) Jul 16, 2026 calls it "an unimaginatively faithful remake"; Dwight Brown Aug 5, 2026 gives 2.5/4.

wikis.title: Disney sets Toy Story 5 and Mandalorian & Grogu for 2026, delays live-action Moana
wikis.summary: THR report on Disney's April 2024 release-calendar changes.
wikis.body:
- Pixar's Toy Story 5 set for June 19, 2026 (announced by Bob Iger in February 2023 as a return to form after Lightyear).
- Live-action Moana (Dwayne Johnson) pushed a year to July 10, 2026 (previously June 27, 2025), giving room from Moana 2 opening that November.
- Star Wars' The Mandalorian & Grogu confirmed for May 22, 2026; Jon Favreau directs, Pedro Pascal stars; first Star Wars big-screen film since 2019's The Rise of Skywalker.
- Tron: Ares (Jared Leto) opens Oct. 10, 2025. 20th Century's The Amateur moved from Nov. 8, 2024 to April 11, 2025.

wikis.title: Disney casts Catherine Laga'aia in live-action Moana
wikis.summary: Deadline report on the casting of Catherine Laga'aia as Moana in Disney's live-action remake, dated June 12, 2024.
wikis.body:
- Disney cast Catherine Laga'aia (17, from Sydney, Australia; Samoan heritage) in the title role; live-action Moana set for theaters July 10, 2026. Moana 2 (animated) opens the Wednesday before Thanksgiving that year.
- Also cast: John Tui as Chief Tui, Frankie Adams as Sina, Rena Owen as Gramma Tala; Dwayne Johnson reprises Maui. The 2016 original grossed $687.2 million globally and was Oscar-nominated.
- Directed by Thomas Kail (Hamilton, Grease Live, We Were the Lucky Ones). Shooting "this summer".
- Producers: Johnson, Dany Garcia, Hiram Garcia (Seven Bucks Productions), Beau Flynn (FlynnPictureCo); Lin-Manuel Miranda also producing. EPs include Auli'i Cravalho, who won't reprise the role. Writers Jared Bush and Dana Ledoux Miller tapped.

wikis.title: Toy Story 5 on Rotten Tomatoes
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page with synopsis, scores and consensus for Disney and Pixar's Toy Story 5.
wikis.body:
- PG, Jun 2026, 1h 42m; Kids & Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animation. Buy on Fandango.
- Tomatometer 93% (326 reviews); Popcornmeter 94% (10,000+ verified ratings).
- Premise: "Toy meets Tech": Woody (Tom Hanks), Buzz (Tim Allen), Jessie (Joan Cusack) and the gang meet Lilypad (Greta Lee), a new tablet with disruptive ideas about what is best for Bonnie.
- Consensus: "Proving that old toys can learn new tricks while reckoning with an era of endless screen time, Toy Story 5 largely sidesteps franchise fatigue..."

wikis.title: Toy Story 5 (2026) box office (The Numbers)

wikis.title: Resident Evil (2026) on Rotten Tomatoes
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page for Zach Cregger's Resident Evil with scores, synopsis and consensus.
wikis.body:
- R, 1h 30m; Horror, Action; in theaters. Tomatometer 95% (187 reviews); Popcornmeter 91% (2,500+ verified ratings).
- Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) reinvents the franchise in an all-new story: Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier, in a non-stop race for survival as one horrifying night collapses into chaos.
- Consensus: "Packing unforgettable scares into a sleek runtime while Austin Abrams' crack comedic timing provides crucial levity, Zach Cregger's Resident Evil is a propulsive tribute to the pleasure and terror of playing a truly spooky video game."
- WSJ's Kyle Smith: Cregger "has made perhaps the greatest tentacle-based horror show of all time."

wikis.title: Sony boards Zach Cregger's Resident Evil, sets Fall 2026 release
wikis.summary: Deadline exclusive (March 7, 2025): Cregger's Resident Evil reboot stays at Sony with a September 18, 2026 date.
wikis.body:
- Constantin's Resident Evil reboot, directed by Zach Cregger, stays at Sony after Warner Bros. was "kicking the tires". Theatrical release date September 18, 2026.
- Cregger co-wrote the screenplay with Shay Hatten; it "apparently harkens back to the original Capcom game's horror roots".
- Producers: Constantin Film (producing and co-financing; Robert Kulzer), Vertigo Entertainment (Roy Lee, Miri Yoon), PlayStation Productions. Sony Pictures Motion Picture Group president Sanford Panitch; Nicole Brown oversees for Columbia Pictures.
- Franchise has grossed $1.2 billion worldwide across earlier Sony films (Paul W.S. Anderson/Milla Jovovich series and 2021's Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City).
- Cregger's Weapons (Josh Brolin, Julia Garner) was slated for MLK weekend 2026 per the article's wording.

wikis.title: Resident Evil (2026 film) - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on Zach Cregger's 2026 Resident Evil: plot, development, cast, release and critical response.
wikis.body:
- 2026 comedy horror film directed by Zach Cregger, written by Cregger and Shay Hatten, based on Capcom's franchise. Stars Austin Abrams (Bryan, medical courier), Zach Cherry, Kali Reis, Paul Walter Hauser. Distributor Sony Pictures Releasing; 95 minutes; budget $75 million; box office $26 million.
- Plot: Bryan delivers a package to Raccoon General Hospital in Raccoon City, Colorado during an outbreak; he is bitten, delivers the stabilizer needed for a cure, and mutates as the National Guard arrives.
- Development: Constantin planned a reboot from early 2022; Cregger hired January 2025; four studios (incl. Warner Bros. and Netflix) bid; Sony won March 2025. Cregger said it is an original story with no game characters, set in parallel to Resident Evil 2's outbreak in an alternate timeline; he cut most jokes after test audiences found it "too funny".
- Filming: Prague, October 10, 2025 to January 22, 2026; cinematographer Dariusz Wolski; music by Ryan and Hays Holladay.
- Release: LA premiere September 15, 2026; Fantastic Fest September 17; US September 18, 2026 (filmed for IMAX). Thursday previews $8.8 million; opening projected $40-50 million from 3,000 theaters.
- Reception: Rotten Tomatoes 95% of 186 reviews (7.8/10); Metacritic 81 from 44 critics; CinemaScore B+; described as the highest-rated video-game film on Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic.

wikis.title: PAW PATROL: The Dino Movie on Rotten Tomatoes
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page with synopsis, scores and consensus for PAW PATROL: The Dino Movie.
wikis.body:
- PG, 1h 28m; Kids & Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animation; in theaters. Tomatometer 83% (35 reviews); Popcornmeter 95% (500+ verified ratings).
- Synopsis: after a storm, the pups crash land on an uncharted island of dinosaurs and meet Rex, stranded for years and a dino expert. Mayor Humdinger's reckless mining makes a dormant volcano erupt, leading to "dino-sized rescues".
- Consensus: "A colorful prehistoric adventure packed with lively action and engaging problem solving... delivers exactly what its youngest fans want."
- Sydney Morning Herald (Sep 9, 2026), 3/5: extra oomph from a new Backstreet Boys song, but "something depressing about watching yet another well-worn franchise".

wikis.title: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the 2026 Canadian animated film Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie.
wikis.body:
- 2026 Canadian animated adventure comedy directed by Cal Brunker (co-written with Bob Barlen), sequel to Paw Patrol: The Mighty Movie (2023); Spin Master Entertainment; Paramount Pictures worldwide, Elevation Pictures in Canada; 88 minutes; budget $40 million; box office $147 million.
- Premiered August 3, 2026 (Los Angeles); released August 14, 2026. Reception: mixed reviews; commercial success.
- Development: a third film announced September 26, 2023; animation by Mikros Image (Montreal, with Paris). Based on the "Dino Rescue" sub-theme.
- Plot: after a boat rescue the pups wash up on "Dino Island", meet wheelchair-using Rex and baby T-Rex Rhubarb (Marshall names). Mayor Humdinger with Harper Cutlass and Alistair Stonewall dynamites a diamond reserve, causing an eruption; pups and dinosaurs save everyone. Rex joins the team.
- Voice cast: Carter Young (Marshall), Mckenna Grace (Skye), Terry Crews, Jennifer Hudson, Fortune Feimster, Jameela Jamil, Bill Nye, Paris Hilton, Snoop Dogg, Henry Bolan (Ryder), Ron Pardo (Humdinger).

wikis.title: Scary Movie (2026) on Rotten Tomatoes
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page with scores and consensus for the 2026 Scary Movie.
wikis.body:
- R, Jun 2026, 1h 36m; Comedy, Horror; streaming on Paramount+. Tomatometer 24% (136 reviews); Popcornmeter 64% (5,000+ verified ratings).
- Premise: "Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, Shorty, Ray, Cindy and Brenda find themselves targeted by another mad slasher."
- Consensus: "Taking a stab at modern horror movies and missing more than it cuts, Scary Movie's self-referential callbacks and tired gags make for a stunted return..."
- Audience says: "Laden with nostalgia and OG ribaldry, Scary Movie delivers stupid, good fun that's appropriately inappropriate."

wikis.title: Scary Movie (2026 film) - Wikipedia
wikis.summary: Wikipedia article on the 2026 Scary Movie (Scary Movie 6), directed by Michael Tiddes with the Wayans family.
wikis.body:
- 2026 American parody film directed by Michael Tiddes; written by Marlon, Shawn, Keenen Ivory and Craig Wayans and Rick Alvarez; sixth in the series, called a spiritual sequel to the first two. Stars Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans, Anna Faris, Regina Hall. Distributor Paramount Pictures; 96 minutes; budget $30 million; box office $231.9 million.
- Announced 2024; first Wayans involvement since they left after Scary Movie 2 (2001) over creative conflicts.
- Premiered June 3, 2026 (Los Angeles); US release June 5, 2026. "Generally negative reviews" but a commercial success, second-highest grossing in the series after the first.
- Plot (spoof of Ghostface slashers): a new Ghostface targets Tuesday Campbell; legacy characters Cindy, Brenda, Shorty and Ray are drawn in; the twist reveals Elle and Jack as killers and Anthony Anderson and Shaquille O'Neal as more Ghostfaces; the legacy four end by killing the newcomers.
- Cast also includes Kenan Thompson, Dave Sheridan, Lochlyn Munro, Kim Wayans, Cheri Oteri.

wikis.title: Scary Movie tops box office, slaying Masters of the Universe
wikis.summary: AP/NBC News weekend box office report for June 5-7, 2026: Scary Movie opens with a franchise-best $55 million.
wikis.body:
- Scary Movie topped the weekend with $55 million domestic (studio estimates) and a franchise-best $105.5 million global launch, beating Scream 7's $97 million worldwide debut. Budget $30 million; Rotten Tomatoes 26%; CinemaScore "B". Paramount distributes; Miramax produced.
- Wayans return after leaving over creative differences following 2001's Scary Movie 2. FranchiseRe's David A. Gross: "an outstanding opening for a comedy sequel this far into the series"; weekend figure is triple the genre average.
- Masters of the Universe (Amazon MGM, Nicholas Galitzine) opened to $29.3 million domestic plus $25 million overseas against a cost of nearly $200 million; Mattel Studios' first release since Barbie.
- Backrooms (A24, $10 million) $25.9 million, down 68%, $212 million worldwide. Obsession (Focus) $25.6 million in fourth weekend, $152.1M domestic / $224.8M worldwide. Mandalorian and Grogu $10 million in third weekend.
- Michael became Lionsgate's highest-grossing film with $898 million; The Super Mario Galaxy Movie crossed $1 billion worldwide, 2026's first. Weekend up 63% from last year (Comscore).

wikis.title: Coyote vs. Acme on Rotten Tomatoes
wikis.summary: Rotten Tomatoes page with synopsis, scores and consensus for Coyote vs. Acme.
wikis.body:
- PG, 1h 41m; Kids & Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animation; in theaters. Tomatometer 96% (283 reviews); Popcornmeter 95% (2,500+ verified ratings).
- Premise: Wile E. Coyote finally fights back, teaming with billboard accident lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte) against corporate counsel Buddy Crane (John Cena) and ACME, Inc.
- Consensus: "A daffy satire that's equal parts heart and wily humor, Coyote vs. Acme makes a triumphant case for the Looney Tunes' modern relevance..."
- Sydney Morning Herald 3/5: "The animation has all the verve of the old cartoons but overall the production lacks the deadpan wit"; Filmspotting (Sep 11, 2026) 3.5/5.

wikis.title: Coyote vs. Acme director and star on Comic-Con screening
wikis.summary: Variety interview (July 25, 2026) with director Dave Green and star Lana Condor on Coyote vs. Acme's Comic-Con debut after Warner Bros. shelved it.
wikis.body:
- Dave Green learned in November 2023 that Warner Bros. Discovery had shelved the film as a tax write off; he called the news "devastating".
- Ketchup Entertainment rescued it and set a theatrical release for Aug. 28. First public screening was Saturday night at San Diego Comic-Con.
- Animated/live-action hybrid about Wile E. Coyote taking on the Acme Corporation for releasing defective products; stars Lana Condor, Will Forte, John Cena plus Looney Tunes (Roadrunner, Tweety, Bugs Bunny).
- Fan campaign image: a lone protester dressed as Wile E. Coyote with a "Release Me" sign outside Warner Bros. Studios in the rain; never identified.
- Script by Samy Burch from a story by James Gunn and Jeremy Slater, based on a 1990 New Yorker article by Ian Frazier.
- Context: Warner Bros. faces its impending merger with Paramount Skydance (delayed).

wikis.title: Coyote vs. Acme gets late summer 2026 global release (Comic-Con 2025)
wikis.summary: Deadline report (July 26, 2025) from the Comic-Con panel: Coyote vs. Acme will release globally Aug. 28, 2026.
wikis.body:
- Will Forte said at San Diego Comic-Con the global release date is Aug. 28, 2026.
- Warner Bros. took the $70M movie off its schedule as a tax writeoff; Ketchup Entertainment took worldwide rights in a $50M deal (per Deadline). Ketchup also released The Day the Earth Blew Up, which made $8.8M domestic, $15.1M worldwide.
- Panel: director Dave Green, Will Forte, Martha Kelly, Eric Bauza (voice of Bugs Bunny), moderator Paul Scheer. Green got the job at the end of 2019 and developed the script in 2020 with Samy Burch from a 1990 New Yorker humor piece; a six-year process.
- Clips: Coyote's failed ACME plans set to Johnny Cash's "Hurt"; a courtroom scene with Forte's attorney, John Cena's Buddy Crane and P.J. Byrne's Bill Pellicano; Luis Guzman as the judge.

wikis.title: Mont Cenis (Lyon-Turin) base tunnel project progress
wikis.summary: Railway Gazette report (Dec 6, 2025) on the Franco-Italian Mont Cenis base tunnel: boring on the Italian side, schedule and access routes.
wikis.body:
- Boring of the main running tunnels on the Italian section started September 17; expected to be the last major Alpine rail tunnel; centrepiece of the TEN-T Mediterranean Corridor. TELT SAS chief executive Maurizio Bufalini says it will serve 18% of the European population.
- 57.5 km tunnel from Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne (France) to Susa (Italy), at 569 m altitude; will supersede the 13.7 km Frejus tunnel (1871, 1,295 m altitude). TELT manages a 65 km cross-border section.
- Idea floated in 1980s; treaty ratified 2002; work began 2016; scheduled to open in 2033.
- Expected 20 to 30 high-speed and 120 to 170 freight trains per day versus at most six passenger trains on the Frejus line. Paris-Milano (850 km) in about 5 h, cutting 2 h. At least half of land freight expected to shift from road to rail.
- Full capacity depends on access lines: about 160 route-km in France needing work, not ready until several years after opening; Italy's Susa-Torino access (50 km) partly upgraded, 24 km new.
- Maddalena 1 exploration tunnel bored more than 7 km; 13.4 m TBM "Viviana".
- Alternative coastal route incl. Terzo Valico dei Giovi (53 km, 37 km in tunnels) expected by 2030.

wikis.title: Lyon-Turin Base Tunnel (CINEA featured project)
wikis.summary: EU agency page describing the Lyon-Turin Base Tunnel's scope, progress by end 2024 and CEF funding.
wikis.body:
- 57.5 km rail tunnel beneath the Alps between Italy and France, flagship TEN-T project in the Mediterranean Corridor; expected completion by 2033.
- By end of 2024: of 164 km of tunnels planned (two single-track tubes, four entry tunnels, 204 safety by-passes), 39.5 km excavated, more than 15 km of base tunnel. All civil-works contracts (EUR 4 billion total) awarded; ten construction sites operating. Five of seven TBMs delivered or under construction.
- Over 50% of excavation materials to be reused.
- Funding: Connecting Europe Facility; project duration 1 Jan 2014 - 20 Jun 2026; EU contribution EUR 1,514,000,000. Last updated February 2025.

wikis.title: Danjiang Bridge by Zaha Hadid Architects nears completion
wikis.summary: Dezeen report (Oct 27, 2025) on Taiwan's Danjiang Bridge, set to open 12 May 2026.
wikis.body:
- Zaha Hadid Architects unveiled photos of Danjiang Bridge, set to be the world's longest single-tower, cable-stayed bridge; set to open on 12 May 2026. Main structure complete with the final steel decking segment across the Tamsui River estuary.
- Asymmetric cable-stayed design: longest section 450 m; cables fan from a single 200 m concrete mast; Y-shaped concrete columns near land; built to withstand extreme weather and seismic events.
- Purpose: connect highways either side of the river, reduce traffic on local roads and on Guandu Bridge 5 km upstream. Mast positioned to keep sunset views; single mast lessens riverbed impact.
- Remaining work: asphalt, lighting, structural load tests. Will have pedestrian and cycle lanes. Photography by Paddy Chao.

wikis.title: ZHA completes Danjiang Bridge in Taiwan (designboom)
wikis.summary: designboom article on the opened Danjiang Bridge, the world's longest single-mast asymmetric cable-stayed bridge.
wikis.body:
- Bridge spans the mouth of Taiwan's Tamsui River between New Taipei City's Tamsui and Bali districts; opened May 2026; expected to cut roughly 25 minutes from commuter journeys and ease Guandu Bridge.
- 920 m long; single 200 m concrete mast; 450 m main span; 71 m wide deck for vehicles, pedestrians, cycles and future Danhai Light Rail extension.
- Designed for earthquakes of magnitude 7 or above (pier supports, cable stays, hydraulic dampers, friction pendulum bearings, synthetic rubber pads).
- Zaha Hadid Architects won the international competition in 2015 with Sinotech Engineering Consultants and Leonhardt, Andra und Partner; construction began 2019; final decking installed 2025.

wikis.title: Dubai unveils $35B plan for world's largest airport
wikis.summary: ENR report (May 2, 2024) on the Al Maktoum International Airport expansion.
wikis.body:
- Dubai announced a $35 billion plan (statement April 28) to expand Al Maktoum International Airport (Dubai World Central), 400 gates, up to 260 million passengers and 13+ million tons of cargo yearly; more than 27 sq miles, five parallel runways, four terminals.
- Dubai International (87 million passengers, 1.81 million tons cargo last year) will be replaced; Emirates to relocate by 2034. Phase 1 completion in 2034 to handle up to 150 million passengers per year.
- Phase 1: Concourse 1 (1.7 miles long, almost 19 million sq ft, 100 contact gates), West Terminal, people mover with four stations, two new runways. Phase 2: identical second Concourse; final phase Concourses 3 and 4 and East Terminal.
- Airfield opened 2010 (cargo; passengers a year later); 877,400 passengers in 2022. An "airport city" for a million residents is planned.
- Developer: Dubai Aviation Engineering Projects.

wikis.title: Manhattan high-rise at risk of partial collapse (CNN live updates)
wikis.summary: CNN live coverage (July 7-8, 2026) of a former Pfizer building under conversion in Midtown Manhattan whose columns buckled.
wikis.body:
- Structural columns buckled on the 21st floor of an under-construction building on East 42nd Street (former Pfizer headquarters, being converted to apartments); first reports just before 8 a.m. Tuesday.
- Officials said they are "confident" temporary shoring is stabilizing it; emergency jacks then new steel supports installed (Buildings Commissioner Ahmed Tigani). A fire chief earlier raised concern about a possible "localized collapse" but said total collapse is impossible.
- Four nearby buildings remained under evacuation orders, a fifth partly; some lifted. Evacuated workers face potential weeks without office access.
- Project: adds 19 floors to the 10-story building at 219 East 42nd Street and renovates the 33-story tower at 235 East 42nd (Gensler), expected complete next year.
- Developer Nathan Berman (MetroLoft) called it "a typical construction mishap", blamed added weight; "I don't know that a four-inch sag is a collapse." The site had prior complaints and a 2025 worker-injury lawsuit (denied).

wikis.title: Engineers blame missing steel reinforcement for Pfizer HQ structural failure at 235 East 42nd Street
wikis.summary: The Real Deal reports that engineers say reinforcing steel plates called for in the plans were not installed on two columns that buckled on July 7 in the former Pfizer Building office-to-home conversion.
wikis.body:
- Published Jul 17, 2026 by TRD Staff (Dana Bartholomew), a week after the incident made national news.
