wikis.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime 4th season to debut April 3
wikis.summary: Anime News Network report that the fourth season of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime premieres April 3 on NTV's "Friday Anime Night", with a five-cour run, plus the franchise's history and upcoming projects.
wikis.body:
## The announcement

- "The official website for the That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken) franchise revealed on Thursday that the fourth anime season will debut on April 3 on NTV's now one-hour 'Friday Anime Night' programming block, at 11:00 p.m. JST."
- "The new season will start airing on BS11 on April 4 at 10:00 p.m. JST."
- "The anime's fourth season will air for a total run of five cours (quarters of a year), with the first two cours airing continuously."

## Staff and cast

- "8-Bit is returning once again to animate the fourth season, and Miho Okasaki returns to voice protagonist Rimuru Tempest."

## Source novels

- Fuse serialized the story on the "Shosetsuka ni Naro" (Let's Become Novelists) website from 2013 to 2016; "the series has since garnered over 400 million page views".
- Micro Magazine began publishing the series in print with illustration by Mitz Vah in 2014.
- "The novel series ended with its 23rd and final volume on November 29."
- A spinoff side story volume, Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Toaru Kyuka no Sugoshi-kata (How to Spend a Certain Vacation), shipped alongside the final volume.
- "The novels will get a side-story series, with the first part slated for release in 2026."
- Yen Press releases the novel series in English.

## Previous anime

- The first television anime, of Taiki Kawakami's manga, premiered in October 2018; Crunchyroll streamed it and FUNimation Entertainment streamed an English dub.
- Season 2's first cours premiered in January 2021; the spinoff The Slime Diaries premiered on Tokyo MX in April 2021; season 2's second cours began in July 2021 - "nine straight months of television anime from the franchise in 2021".
- The film That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Scarlet Bond opened in Japan in November 2022.
- The three-episode Coleus' Dream anime debuted in Japan in November 2023 with all three episodes; Crunchyroll streams it with subtitles and an English dub.
- Season 3 premiered in April 2024 and aired two continuous cours for a half-year run.

## Upcoming film

- "The second anime film Gekijo-ban Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Sokai no Namida-hen (That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea) will open in Japan on February 27, 2026."
- Crunchyroll has acquired the worldwide theatrical rights; Sony Pictures Entertainment and Crunchyroll will screen the film in theaters "with dates to be announced".

## Page data

- Posted on 2026-01-15 04:10 EST by Joanna Cayanan. Sources: the franchise's website, Comic Natalie.

- Volume: $12,842,386 ($12.8 million). Resolver: 0x2F5e3684c... Page shows "Earn 3.25%" and 292 comments.

## Outcomes as listed

- Democrats Sweep: 61% - $3,338,432 Vol. (Buy Yes 61c / Buy No 40c)
- R Senate, D House: 31% - $2,272,844 Vol. (Buy Yes 31c / Buy No 70c)

- D Senate, R House: 1% (summary strip: 1.1%) - $1,913,512 Vol. (Buy Yes 1.3c / Buy No 99.0c)
- Other: <1% - $1,884,374 Vol. (Buy Yes 0.3c / Buy No 99.9c)

## Rules

- "This market will resolve according to the party that wins control of the United States Senate and the party that wins control of the United States House of Representatives in the 2026 United States midterm election."
- Senate control goes to the party winning a majority of voting seats; if no majority, to the party with half the voting seats that holds the Vice Presidency; if still ambiguous, to the party of "the first selected President Pro Tempore of the Congress that convenes after the specified election."
- House control goes to the party winning a majority of voting seats; if no majority, to the party of "the first elected Speaker of the House of the Congress that convenes after the 2026 midterm election."
- Senate counting includes all regular and special Senate elections determining representation in the upcoming 120th Congress scheduled for November 2026 as of October 31, 2026; vacant seats with no scheduled election are treated as held by the party of the most recent member.
- House counting includes all 2026 midterm House elections electing voting members of the 120th Congress. Runoff results determine a seat "even if it takes place after November 2026."
- Contested seats are attributed to the party under which the member was elected, even if the member-elect switches party or vacates before Congress organizes; uncontested seats to the party holding them as of election day.
- Independents who caucus with (or announce intent to caucus with) a party count toward that party. If caucus decisions cannot be determined on election day, the market "may remain open until the earlier of (i) an announcement from the relevant members of their intents to caucus, or (ii) January 4th, 11:59 PM ET of the following calendar year"; with no announcement by then, the member counts for no party.
- "The resolution sources for this market will be official information from relevant state electoral authorities, the United States Congress, and a consensus of credible reporting."

wikis.title: AMD A10-7850K "Kaveri" APU launch and its Linux support
wikis.summary: Launch-day introduction to AMD's first Kaveri APU, the A10-7850K, its architecture and figures, and what Linux users need to know ahead of full benchmarks.
wikis.body:
## The launch
- "This morning AMD is releasing the first APUs in their Kaveri family, their most advanced APU ever with up to 12 compute cores and is a big push forward with their overall HSA architecture."
- Written by Michael Larabel in Processors on 14 January 2014 at 08:00 AM EST. Page 1 of 4.

## Architecture and figures
- "Kaveri features up to 12 compute cores in the form of two dual-core x86 modules and then eight GPU cores that are GCN derived."
- "AMD expects Kaveri to deliver up to 20% better IPC performance for these four processor cores that are of the 'Steamroller' microarchitecture."
- "Steamroller is 28nm based and features improved instruction schedulers, larger caches, an improved memory controller, and various other improvements."
- "Kaveri has a transistor count around 2.41 billion and a die size of 245 mm2."
- Heterogeneous System Architecture (HSA): "the GPU and CPU cores having uniform visibility to the entire memory space, improved flexibility in dispatching work."
- "AMD's Windows-based slides claim 24% better system performance over the Core i5 4670K and 8% better performance over the previous-generation A10-6800K 'Richland' APU."

## How the review sample arrived
- "at the last minute we were offered an AMD Kaveri test system for providing the Linux community with the necessary information they need for making an informed purchase."
- A second A10-7850K was sent for other benchmarks and for the OpenBenchmarking.org / Phoromatic test farm.
- The sample's "delivery date of this past Friday was unfortunately postponed by FedEx over the nasty weather situation in Chicago"; it was picked up on Saturday afternoon, "this didn't allow enough time to have our complete launch-day coverage."
- Full benchmarks promised "in the days ahead," including comparisons with older AMD APUs and Intel Core i3/i5/i7 CPUs, plus compiler optimization testing, driver comparisons, kernel tuning and distribution comparisons.

## Article structure
- Page 1 Introduction; Page 2 AMD Kaveri A10-7850K; Page 3 AMD Kaveri A10-7850K On Linux; Page 4 AMD Kaveri Linux.

wikis.title: Watch Dogs release date set for May 27, Wii U version later
wikis.summary: GameSpot news that Ubisoft confirmed a May 27 release for Watch Dogs on Xbox 360, Xbox One, PS3, PS4 and PC, with the Wii U version coming later.
wikis.body:
## The announcement

- Ubisoft announced that its open-world action game Watch Dogs will launch on May 27.
- That date covers the Xbox 360, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4 and PC versions.
- "The Wii U iteration will come sometime later, though a specific date was not mentioned."
- "The news comes from a trailer leaked on Xbox.com."
- UPDATE: "The May 27 release date for Watch Dogs is now officially confirmed by Ubisoft. That date pertains to the console and PC versions of the game, not Wii U."

## Earlier delay

- Watch Dogs "was originally expected to launch back in November 2013 as a launch title for the Xbox One and PS4".
- "Sony even prepared a special-edition Watch Dogs PS4 launch bundle, which it would later need to rescind."
- Ubisoft delayed the game in October to spring 2014. The delay was an "intense decision" but ultimately the right one so the game could have expanded appeal, according to CEO Yves Guillemot.

## Sales expectation

- "When Watch Dogs does launch, it is expected to sell around 6 million copies, about the same figure as the original Assassin's Creed in 2007."

## Page data

- By Eddie Makuch on March 6, 2014 at 10:16AM PST.
- GameSpot's game hub lists Watch Dogs as "First Released May 26, 2014", platforms PC, PS3, PS4, PS5, STA, WIIU, X360, XONE, XBSX.

wikis.title: Kaiju No. 8 (Wikipedia article)
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's article on Kaiju No. 8, Naoya Matsumoto's Shōnen Jump+ manga: its serialisation and premise, how it was conceived and drawn, the Production I.G anime and its spin-offs, and its sales and awards.
wikis.body:
## What the source is

The English Wikipedia article on Kaiju No. 8 (怪獣8号, Kaijū Hachigō), also known in English as Monster #8, a Japanese web manga written and illustrated by Naoya Matsumoto. The capture holds the article body followed by its reference list.

## The manga

Serialized on Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ app and website from July 2020 to July 2025, collected in 16 tankōbon volumes. Published digitally on Manga Plus in English and other languages; Viz Media began publishing digitally in August 2020 and in print in North America since December 2021.

The story follows Kafka Hibino, who after ingesting a parasitic creature gains the ability to turn into a kaiju, and must use that power while trying to join the organization that eliminates kaiju, to fulfill a promise made with a childhood friend. The setting gives kaiju a "fortitude level" and classifies them as honju, yoju and daikaiju; Defense Force officers wear powered suits made from kaiju remains, rated by "unleashed combat power" up to 100%.

## Origins

Matsumoto presented the outline to Shōnen Jump+ deputy editor-in-chief Seijiro Nakaji near the end of 2018, influenced by Ultraman — particularly Ultraseven (1967) — as well as Shin Godzilla (2016) and Pacific Rim (2013). Kafka's predicament was partly inspired by Matsumoto's own struggles in the manga industry. Kaiju codenames were based on typhoon categorization; Kaiju No. 8's design was modeled after oni with a colour scheme inspired by Tron (1982).

## The anime and spin-offs

An anime television series by Production I.G aired April to June 2024, with a second season July to September 2025, and a "conclusion arc" announced. The infobox records the TV series on TXN (TV Tokyo) from April 13, 2024 to September 27, 2025, 23 episodes, music by Yuta Bandoh. Tetsuya Nishio was character designer and chief animation director; Mahiro Maeda was chief kaiju designer.

Spin-offs include the light novel Kaiju No. 8: Exclusive on the Third Division (November 4, 2022), the manga Kaiju No. 8: B-Side (January 5, 2024 to July 12, 2024, 2 volumes), Kaiju No. 8 Relax (from June 4, 2024, 4 volumes), the ONA Kaiju No. 8 Narumi's Weekday (from September 5, 2026, 4 episodes), and a video game.

## Reception

By September 2025 the manga had over 19 million copies in circulation. It won the Next Manga Award in the web manga category in 2021 and was nominated for the Eisner Award in 2022.

wikis.title: Kaiju No. 8: the manga, its creation and its adaptations
wikis.summary: Wikipedia's article body on Naoya Matsumoto's manga Kaiju No. 8 — serialisation, premise, setting, how it was conceived and drawn, the Production I.G anime, and its sales and awards.
wikis.body:
## The series

Kaiju No. 8 (Japanese: 怪獣8号, Hepburn: Kaijū Hachigō), also known in English as Monster #8, is a Japanese web manga series written and illustrated by Naoya Matsumoto. It was serialized on Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ app and website from July 2020 to July 2025, with its chapters collected in 16 tankōbon volumes. Shueisha has also published the series digitally on its Manga Plus platform in English and several other languages. Viz Media began publishing the series digitally in August 2020 and has published it in print in North America since December 2021.

The story follows Kafka Hibino who, after ingesting a parasitic creature, gains the ability to turn into a kaiju, and must navigate using his power while trying to join an organization that eliminates kaiju, to fulfill a promise made with a childhood friend.

## Setting

The series is set in a world where monsters named kaiju regularly cause disasters. Japan has the highest rate of kaiju attacks in the world and establishes the Japanese Anti-Kaiju Defense Force (JAKDF). Kaiju are assigned a "fortitude level", a scale indicating overall strength, and are classified as honju (more dangerous, stronger) and yoju (smaller, able to accompany or sprout off from honju). Kaiju with high fortitude levels or abnormal characteristics are given a number as an identifier based on when they first appear, and are classified as daikaiju.

Defense Force officers wear powered suits made from kaiju remains granting increased strength, speed and durability. A suit's total power output is measured as a percentage, "unleashed combat power", varying per person up to a maximum of 100%.

## How it was conceived

Matsumoto began his career in 2006 with Neko Romancer in Jump Giga (then Akamaru Jump). He authored Nekowappa!, which debuted in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 2009, published a one-shot Shikai Enbu in the 2012 spring edition of Jump Giga (then Jump Next), and began a second serialization, Pochi Kuro, on Shōnen Jump+ in 2014.

Near the end of 2018 Matsumoto presented the initial story idea and outline for Kaiju No. 8 to Shōnen Jump+ deputy editor-in-chief Seijiro Nakaji. He was influenced by tokusatsu media such as the Ultraman series — particularly Ultraseven (1967) — as well as Shin Godzilla (2016) and Pacific Rim (2013), and aimed to create a story about a protagonist pursuing a goal while concealing their identity from a hostile organization they have joined. The premise of Kafka joining the Defense Force was established early, though initial plans involved him maintaining a secret identity while living a normal life. Kafka's predicament was partly inspired by Matsumoto's own career struggles in the manga industry. Nakaji noted the concept was unexpected, as Matsumoto had previously authored fantasy series.

## How it was drawn

Page layouts were designed for clarity, particularly on smartphones, because of the manga's digital release. Nakaji cited a fully coloured panel in the second chapter as an example of using the digital format in a way not feasible in a physical magazine. A coworker suggested the kaiju codenames be based on typhoon categorization to enhance their portrayal as disasters. Kaiju designs drew from mythological creatures, animals and plants; Kaiju No. 8's design was modeled after oni, with a colour scheme inspired by the film Tron (1982).

Matsumoto worked with three assistants: Osamu Koiwai on background art, Jiro Sakura on finishing work, and Mantohihi Binta on weapon design. For backgrounds Matsumoto provided a storyboard with panel compositions to Koiwai, who created a draft for approval before finalizing the art, a process taking three to four days.

## The anime

An anime television series adaptation produced by Production I.G aired from April to June 2024, with a second season airing from July to September 2025. A "conclusion arc" to the anime series has been announced.

Production I.G producer Masashi Ohira brought Tetsuya Nishio onto the project as character designer and chief animation director, believing Nishio's designs facilitated animation and possessed a three-dimensional quality. Nishio designed the human characters and humanoid kaiju. Mahiro Maeda served as chief kaiju designer and provided detailed imagery of kaiju anatomy.

The infobox records the TV series as directed for studio Production I.G with music by Yuta Bandoh, broadcast on TXN (TV Tokyo), running from April 13, 2024 to September 27, 2025 across 23 episodes.

## Other works

The series has spawned a light novel, two spin-off manga series, and a video game. The infobox lists:

- Kaiju No. 8: Exclusive on the Third Division — light novel by Keiji Andō, illustrated by Naoya Matsumoto, Shueisha (Jump J-Books), published November 4, 2022.
- Kaiju No. 8: B-Side — manga by Keiji Andō, illustrated by Kentaro Hidano, Shōnen Jump+, January 5, 2024 to July 12, 2024, 2 volumes.
- Kaiju No. 8 Relax — manga in Saikyō Jump from June 4, 2024, 4 volumes.
- Kaiju No. 8 Narumi's Weekday — ONA directed by Shigeyuki Miya, music by Yuta Bandoh, studio Production I.G, from September 5, 2026, 4 episodes.

## Sales and awards

By September 2025 the manga had over 19 million copies in circulation. The series has been praised for its premise, characters and art. It won the Next Manga Award in the web manga category in 2021 and was nominated for the Eisner Award in 2022.

wikis.title: Continental's first aluminium-housing turbocharger enters series production
wikis.summary: Continental began series production of the first car turbocharger with a water-cooled aluminium turbine housing, fitted to BMW's 1.5L three-cylinder engine for the MINI Hatch.
wikis.body:
## What was announced

Continental's powertrain developers have launched series production of the first car turbocharger with an aluminium turbine housing. Integration into the three-cylinder, 1.5L 100 kW gasoline engine for the MINI Hatch has been ongoing since spring 2014.

Water-cooling is what enables the lightweight material to be used, giving a weight reduction of nearly 30% alongside cost and system benefits.

## How the cooling works

Full-load operation can make common turbocharger constructions with a steel housing glow red with heat. In Continental's unit a double-walled aluminium housing surrounds the hottest area with a cooling water jacket. The coolant keeps the external housing surface no hotter than 120 °C (248 °F) and the internal temperature below 350 °C (662 °F).

Udo Schwerdel, Head of the Turbocharger Product Line, Engine Systems, Powertrain Division, gives two benefits:

- Much less effort is required to protect neighbouring components from the heat.
- Cooling of the exhaust flow reduces the thermal load on the catalytic converter, "meaning it hardly ages at all".

The dynamic response of the electric actuator at the wastegate ensures the catalytic converter still heats up quickly.

## Integration with the engine

The turbocharger was developed from being a typical add-on component into an integral part of the engine. Continental worked closely with the BMW Group from the simulation phase onward; Schwerdel called this "an indication of trust that we greatly appreciate".

In keeping with the modular principle specified by BMW, the turbocharger is tightly integrated in the engine as a fixed component of the exhaust manifold. Continental turbochargers with a steel housing can also be attached to the same base engine using the interface on the cylinder head, an option the car manufacturer uses for high-performance engines and vehicles for export to hot countries. The bearing housing is cooled from inside the turbocharger for steel variants, while cooling from outside is sufficient for aluminium ones.

## Weight and cost

- 1.2 kg (2.6 lbs) of weight is saved per aluminium turbocharger in the MINI.
- Reduced weight also means reduced fuel consumption, supporting the industry's fuel consumption and emission targets.
- Despite the additional expenditure for water cooling, aluminium turbochargers are more affordable for manufacturers. Schwerdel: "High-temperature-resistant materials such as nickel-base alloys drive up prices for turbochargers with steel housings, whereas our aluminum alloy is a cost-effective material."

## Background

The first Continental turbocharger went into series production in a 1.0L engine in 2011.

wikis.title: Continental's first production aluminum turbocharger housing, in BMW's 1.5-L three-cylinder
wikis.summary: SAE news item on Continental announcing the first turbocharger with an aluminum turbine housing to enter automotive series production, first used in BMW's 1.5-L three-cylinder engine in the Mini 3-door.
wikis.body:
## What was announced
- "Continental on July 15 announced the first turbocharger with an aluminum turbine housing to enter automotive series production."
- The aluminum housing is integrated into the BMW three-cylinder exhaust manifold.

## First application
- BMW's 1.5-L, 134 hp (100 kW) turbocharged three-cylinder gasoline engine used in the Mini 3-door is the first powertrain application for the new AL turbo housing.

## Design and figures
- The housing is double-walled and water cooled.
- Compared to a typical heat-resistant cast-steel turbocharger housing, it offers a nearly 30% weight saving - 2.65 lb/1.2 kg - and lower cost.
- Its design is claimed to reduce thermal load on the catalytic converter, increasing its durability.
- Fast catalyst light-off is ensured by an electric actuator at the turbo wastegate.

wikis.title: Microsoft merges Windows and Windows Phone developer accounts
wikis.summary: CRN Australia report that Microsoft has given developers access to both the Windows 8 and Windows Phone stores from one account, and cut the annual fees.
wikis.body:
## What changed

- "Microsoft has given developers access to both its Windows 8 and Windows Phone app stores for the same price as it moves to align - and possibly merge - the two stores."
- "The changes mean developers registered with one store will we able to submit apps for the other from the same account, and annual costs will be reduced."
- Microsoft "has been **reportedly** considering a merged store for Windows 8 and Windows Phone apps".

## Pricing

- Previously: individual Windows Store developers paid **$49 per year**; Windows Phone accounts cost **$19 per year**.
- Now: app builders get access to both for **$19**.
- Development companies will pay **$99** for access to both stores, "whereas under the old system they needed to pay the same amount for each store".

## Quote

- Microsoft's **Todd Brix**, on the Windows App Builder Blog: "Over the last month, we've brought the Windows Store and the Windows Phone Store together into a single marketing and operations team to deliver a better experience for developers, end users and partners."
- Brix: "Windows Store developers are now also Windows Phone developers, and Windows Phone developers are also Windows Store developers."

## Byline

- By Stewart Mitchell, Nov 8, 2013 12:28PM. "This article originally appeared at pcpro.co.uk".

wikis.title: Xbox One launches in China on September 23 at 3699 RMB
wikis.summary: GameSpot report on Microsoft's announcement of the Xbox One's China launch date, bundle pricing, launch line-up and local partnerships.
wikis.body:
## The announcement

- By Eddie Makuch, **July 30, 2014** at 9:40AM PDT. "Just days after preorders opened for the console, Microsoft today announced that the Xbox One will launch in China on **September 23**."
- "The Xbox One is the first gaming console approved for sale in China through the new **Shanghai Free Trade Zone**." "For the past decade and a half, consoles were blocked from sale in China over fears that such systems posed a threat to the mental health of children."

## Bundles and prices

- **3699 RMB ($600)** bundle: a system ("it is unclear if Kinect is included"), copies of *Powerstar Golf* and *Neverwinter Online*, and free Xbox Live Gold through **March 2015**. Also a localized Chinese interface with local payment options, a **two-year warranty**, and access to the **BesTV** entertainment experience.
- **4299 RMB ($700)** Xbox One **Day One edition**: system, Kinect camera, commemorative controller, a day one achievement, plus *Kinect Sports Rivals*, *Forza Motorsport 5: Racing Game of the Year*, *Neverwinter Online Commemorative Edition* and *Powerstar Golf* with in-game credit.
- Games will range in price from **99 RMB ($16) to 249 RMB ($40)**, Microsoft said.

## Launch line-up

- *Forza Motorsport 5: Racing Game of the Year*, *Kinect Sports Rivals*, *Powerstar Golf*, *Zoo Tycoon*, *Max: The Curse of Brotherhood*.
- Further in the future Microsoft "plans to bring Xbox-exclusive titles like *Sunset Overdrive* and *Halo: The Master Chief Collection* to China".

## Update on third-party games

- "[UPDATE] Representatives for 2K Games and Electronic Arts declined to comment on what games they are bringing to Xbox One in China. Ubisoft, on the other hand, confirmed that *Trials Fusion*, *Rayman Legends*, *Just Dance 2014*, and *Shape Up* will be available for Xbox One at launch in China."
- Stephanie Perotti, Ubisoft executive publishing director for China: "Ubisoft has been present in China for 17 years... We are delighted to partner with Microsoft to bring some of our major franchises to the Xbox One for our Chinese fans."
- Microsoft said **12** of the "world's largest developers" plan to release games in China for Xbox One, including EA, Ubisoft and 2K Games.
- **Thirteen** of China's "best developers" are working on Xbox One titles, beginning with *Neverwinter Online* from Perfect World, plus titles from Gamebar and Yingpei Games; Snail Games, NetEase and Tencent are also building games.
- Perfect World CEO **Robert Xiao**: "We have three studios working on Xbox games including *Neverwinter Online*, *Celestial Sword*, and *Project X*... For the six months following Xbox One's launch, *Neverwinter Online* will be available only on Xbox One."

## Media and apps

- Xbox One owners in China get BesTV programming, including **two free movies per month**; sports programming (such as the English Premier League) "free for the first year".
- The full **Xbox Fitness** library comes to China, with a new experience, **Tai Chi**, first available in China.
- Local apps: **QQ Music, Douban FM, GameFY, Karaoke Master**.

## Other announcements

- **ID@Xbox** launches in China today; its arrival "also means developers around the world can now publish their games in China".
- Microsoft announced plans to open **two "innovation centers"** in China, the first in **Shanghai**, "dedicated spaces driving local innovation initiatives in game and app development", built on continuing investments from the government and Microsoft.

## Caveats noted

- "Earlier this year, the Chinese government published a list of censorship rules for console games" - any game that "threaten China's national unity, sovereignty or territorial integrity" would be banned. "It is unclear if the games mentioned in this post... will need to be censored."
- Sony "said earlier this year that it also has plans to bring its PlayStation brand to China, though details are not yet finalized".

wikis.title: BioLite BaseCamp Stove Kickstarter campaign
wikis.summary: Kickstarter project page for the BioLite BaseCamp Stove, a wood-powered off-grid cooking and charging stove, with its funding totals, reward tiers and delivery estimates.

wikis.title: Civilization: Beyond Earth release date set for October 24 with Exoplanets Map Pack preorder bonus
wikis.summary: GameSpot news that 2K and Firaxis announced an October 24 PC launch for Sid Meier's Civilization: Beyond Earth, revealed the Exoplanets Map Pack preorder bonus and released gameplay videos.
wikis.body:
## Announcement

- "2K and Firaxis Games today announced that Sid Meier's Civilization: Beyond Earth will launch for PC on October 24."
- "Announced just four months ago at PAX East 2014, Beyond Earth is the latest entry in the beloved strategy series, and is described as a spiritual successor to Alpha Centauri."
- 2K Games and Firaxis also released a developer walkthrough gameplay video and a behind-the-scenes video detailing how the game came to be.
- "Today's news comes just a day after Firaxis released Civilization Revolution 2 for iOS devices."
- Sidebar game hub entry lists "First Released Oct 23, 2014", platforms LNX, MAC, PC.

## Preorder bonus: Exoplanets Map Pack

- Gamers who reserve the title at participating retailers receive the Exoplanets Map Pack, six maps inspired by real-world exoplanets, available at launch.
- Kepler 186f: "This lush forest planet is one of the oldest known Earth-like planets".
- Rigil Khantoris Bb: "Orbiting the closest star to our solar system, the historical records of this arid continental planet's settlement are well-preserved".
- Tau Ceti d: "This planet of seas and archipelagos features a booming biodiversity and a wealth of resources".
- Mu Arae f: "Tidally locked in orbit around a weak star, the southern hemisphere of this planet is a blistering desert where the sun never sets, while the northern hemisphere is perpetually in frozen darkness".
- 82 Eridani e: "An alien world of scarce water and wracked by tectonic forces".
- Eta Vulpeculae b: "A mysterious new discovery with unknown terrain".

## Byline

- By Eddie Makuch on July 3, 2014 at 8:13PM PDT.

wikis.title: Microsoft's two 3D Touch Windows Phones, including McLaren
wikis.summary: Neowin report that Microsoft has more than one Windows Phone with 3D Touch in the works - the 5.2-inch McLaren and a larger 6-inch handset.
wikis.body:
## Report

- By Brad Sams, Senior News Editor, Neowin - **Jul 7, 2014**.
- "Earlier this month, details emerged on Microsoft's plans for 3D gesture and touch support for Windows Phone." Neowin says it was sent info on the upcoming Microsoft **McLaren** handset, "and we now know that there is more than one phone with 3D Touch support in the works".

## McLaren

- A **5.2-inch** device with a **1080p** display, **20MP** camera, in a **64GB** storage flavour ("other storage options may be available").
- "Look for this device to arrive this fall; we are hearing that **October** is the targeted release month."
- "Other rumors have noted that the device may have a quad-HD display, 2560x1440" but "our sources indicate that 1080P is the spec for release".

## The larger handset

- "In addition to McLaren, there is a larger device - we understand it will be a **6-inch** handset that will support 3D Touch as well, replacing the **Lumia 1520**, possibly launching later this year too".
- "this may be the same device that leaked earlier today that will have an upgraded SoC".

## Positioning

- "Microsoft is looking to position 3D Touch as a premium differentiator among high-end Windows Phone devices."
- The piece notes the differences between entry-level and top-end Lumias "are not well defined", and that 3D Touch is expected to be "a defining feature for the Lumias at the top end of the market".
- Hedge: "as always with this type of information, it can change before launch in the same way that Microsoft pulled the Surface mini days before it was announced".

wikis.title: Rumour that Microsoft will reveal two new Windows Phones
wikis.summary: Report on a rumour, sourced to The Verge, that Microsoft showed two unannounced Windows Phone devices - a "selfie phone" and a cheaper PureView handset - at an internal meeting.
wikis.body:
## The report

- "A new report claims Microsoft will soon reveal two more new Windows Phone devices, just a few days after the company announced the budget priced Lumia 530 smartphone."
- The report comes from The Verge, citing unnamed sources.
- It claims Microsoft's devices leader Stephen Elop showed off the two phones, via a video presentation, at an internal Microsoft meeting "earlier this week".

## The two devices

- One device was previously rumoured earlier in the year under the code name "Superman"; it has a five megapixel front facing camera and a 4.7 inch display. Elop reportedly described it as a "selfie phone" during his presentation.
- The other product will reportedly have a PureView rear camera but will be priced lower than previous Lumia smartphones with those high end lenses. Images of this phone may have already been leaked several weeks ago.
- The Verge's report did not have information on when exactly the two phones will be announced nor their specific price points.

## Context given

- A couple of weeks earlier, Elop stated in an email to the Device Group that Microsoft will concentrate near term efforts "by targeting the more affordable smartphone segments, which are the fastest growing segments of the market, with Lumia."
- Windows Central says it exclusively reported a few weeks earlier that Microsoft had quietly cancelled plans to launch a new high end Lumia device that fall, code named McLaren, which would have used its 3D Touch gesture technology.

By John Callaham, 29 Jul 2014. Source: The Verge.

wikis.title: BioLite SolarPanel 5+ review
wikis.summary: A hands-on review of the BioLite SolarPanel 5+ solar charger, covering its 2200 mAh battery, design, field use and price.
wikis.body:
## The product
- "the Biolite SolarPanel 5 series charger" comes in two forms: "the Biolite SolarPanel 5 a default solar charger and and the 5+ that features a 2200mAh onboard battery."
- "Both the 5 and 5+ solar panels integrate a sundial and 360-degree adjustable kickstand to help positioning to maximize exposure to the sun."
- "both USB ports are enclosed by two little rubber doors to protect them from the elements."

## Battery
- 2200 mAh battery "can be pre-charged at home via the supplied USB cable or topped up via the solar panel."
- "A little row of LEDs offers a battery level indicator and the little batter icon beside the LEDs is a little on-off switch."
- "We were able to get a full iPhone charge with a single charge of the onboard battery."

## Use in the field
- Strapped to the back of a rucksack through the metal stand while climbing, with the charge cable fed into a side pocket.
- Used to run the GPS tracking application ViewRanger on a phone for "a full day of charge for GPS tracking."
- "the same USB that allows you to manually charge the SolarPanel 5+ can be used to charge your camera" — a Fujifilm X100T. The panel "also offers some shade so the camera isn't subjected to the hot sun for a prolonged period of time."
- "designed for travel weighing less than 400g and is ultra slim."

## Price and output
- "retailing at under £70 for the SolarPanel 5+ model (featuring the internal battery)."
- "the solar panel offers an impressive 5 watts per hour in full sun."

## Review scores
- Value for Money: 100%; Portability: 99%; Performance: 100%; Design: 100%. Total Score 99%.
- Categories: Outdoor Gear, Reviews. Dated May 1, 2016.

wikis.title: Global renewable energy investment fell 18% in 2016 (BNEF study)
wikis.summary: Report on a Bloomberg New Energy Finance study finding global renewable energy investment dropped 18 percent in 2016 to $287.5 billion, with country-by-country figures.
wikis.body:
## Headline finding

- "Global investment in renewable energy dropped by 18 percent in 2016 due to sharp falls in equipment prices and a slowdown in China and Japan, a study found Thursday."
- "After reaching record levels in 2015, investment fell last year to $287.5 billion, according to researchers at Bloomberg New New Energy Finance (BNEF)."
- The fall was due in part to "further sharp falls in equipment prices, particularly in photovoltaics".

## China and Japan

- "Following a record year in 2015, Chinese investment fell 26 percent to $87.8 billion, down from $119.1 billion, while in Japan it dropped 43 percent to $22.8 billion."
- BNEF's Asia head, Justin Wu, said both nations are "cutting back on building new large-scale projects and digesting the capacity they have already put in place".
- "The government is now focused on investing in grids and reforming the power market so that the renewables in place can generate to their full potential."

## Offshore wind

- "2016 a record year for offshore wind power where investment pledges rose 40 percent to $29.9 billion".
- Growth "was driven by developers taking advantage of 'improved economics' resulting from the availability of bigger turbines and better construction knowhow".

## By country and region

- United States: investment fell 7 percent to $58.6 billion. Canada: slipped 46 percent to $2.4 billion.
- Asia-Pacific, "which accounts for 47 percent of the global figure": overall fall of 26 percent to $135 billion; Indian investment "remained at almost the same level as 2015, at $9.6 billion".
- Europe: a slight increase of 3 percent to $70.9 billion; the UK led "for the third year in a row with investment of $25.9 billion, a rise of 2 percent".
- Germany: $15.2 billion, a 16 percent fall on 2015. France: $3.6 billion, down 5 percent.
- Developing countries: "many projects did not secure funding before the year's end". South Africa fell 74 percent to $914 million; Chile down 80 percent to $821 million.

wikis.title: Kaneka silicon solar cell reaches 26.3 percent efficiency
wikis.summary: Tech Xplore report on a Kaneka Corporation team setting a silicon solar cell efficiency record of 26.3 percent, describing how the cell was made and what remains unproven.
wikis.body:
## The record

- "A team of researchers working at Kaneka Corporation has broken the record for silicon-based solar cell efficiency by producing a cell that was tested to be 26.3-percent efficient - an increase of 0.7 percent over the previous record holder."
- The work is described in a paper published in the journal Nature Energy.
- The team plans to continue reaching for the theoretical limit of 29.1 percent.
- By Bob Yirka, March 21, 2017.

## How the cell was made

- Started with a crystalline silicon disk thinner than standard cells - just 165 micrometers.
- The surface was etched to minimize light reflection.
- Both sides were coated with amorphous silicon to reduce loss of charge carriers.
- Efficiency was further improved by the company's proprietary heterojunction technology and interdigitated electrodes.
- The electrode grid was moved from the front of the cell to the back, allowing more sunlight to enter the cell while minimizing losses in the optics.
- The cell is described as an HJ-IBC cell developed in the Photovoltaic & Thin Film Research Laboratories of Kaneka Corporation.

## Verification and limits

- The new record was measured by the Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems in Freiburg for accuracy, "proving the team's claims".
- The researchers "have not yet determined how well their technique can be ported to industrial processing", so "it is still not clear if or when it might result in more efficient products sold to consumers".
- The team announced its intentions to continue efforts to further improve efficiency.

## Context given

- Silicon-based solar cells, the industry standard, are "still not able to compete with coal due to the relatively high cost involved in making them"; raising efficiency would mean end-users could buy fewer cells to meet their needs.

wikis.title: Dell Wyse 5070 vs the Always Connected PC: redefining the desktop in parts
wikis.summary: Computerworld opinion column by Rob Enderle comparing Dell's Wyse thin client desktop with the Asus Always Connected PC laptop as steps toward cloud-centric "PC as a Service" computing.
wikis.body:
## Note on the page

- The URL is for a Dell UltraSharp 32 8K display story, but the page served is Rob Enderle's Computerworld opinion column "Dell Wyse 5070 vs the Always Connected PC: redefining the desktop in parts", May 2, 2018, 6 mins.

## What the column covers

- "This past week has been fascinating for me. I got my hands on my first Always Connected PC laptop made by Asus. And then Dell [a client of the author] announced their updated thin client desktop solution, the Dell Wyse 5270."
- Both products "are designed to replace their more traditional PC counterparts with solutions that are more cloud-centric, and both are big steps toward what will eventually be PC as a Service end-game".
- Dell "is arguably the leader in desktop thin client technology - having acquired Wyse some time ago - but they're the only major Microsoft [also a client of the author] partner not producing an Always Connected PC product".
- Reviews of the Microsoft initiative "have been mixed, largely because the platform is brand new"; the fixes "are mostly done and were tied to mistakes with software load and settings issues".
- Author: Rob Enderle, contributor, president and principal analyst of the Enderle Group. "The opinions expressed in this blog are those of Rob Enderle and do not necessarily represent those of IDG Communications, Inc."
- Credit line: Mark Hachman / IDG.

## Framing: appliance computing

- The thin client and the Always Connected PC bring "an experience much closer to an appliance then your typical PC experience".
- "Thin clients are basically the current iteration of the old-fashioned terminal, something that defined computing before the PC and was largely eliminated by it."
- The author recalls his first OS/2 terminal: "it crashed a lot, took nearly 5 minutes to boot up and it didn't have a light pen".

## Outlook

- "With Microsoft's move to become far more cloud-centric, the eventual move to some kind of thin client platform is a given. The strongest iteration of that for now is something like the Dell Wyse 5070."
- The Always Connected PC "is at least a generation out from being able to address this potential. 5G will make an enormous difference, and while that begins rolling out next year, it probably won't hit critical mass until 2020."

wikis.title: Dell Wyse 5070 thin client
wikis.summary: Dell's updated thin client desktop, its ports, monitor support and the sectors where it has been well received.
wikis.body:
- The Wyse 5070 "has a full selection of ports, can be configured with decent graphics capability and is both relatively small and relatively attractive on a desktop".
- "Pushing the envelope on performance, it will support up to four 4K monitors."
- "In talking to the team at Dell World, it has been well-received on the trading floor, in healthcare (for viewing charts), defense (map and battlefield management), architecture and design (in a variety of industries)."
- Stated benefits: "strong centralized management and security, a small desktop footprint, low noise and heat, extremely high reliability, near-instant on and low distributed energy use/heat".
- On energy: "if you put a lot of high performance workstations on a floor they can easily overwhelm the HVAC system...not to mention overload power distribution, forcing very expensive office upgrades".
- Centralizing performance "in the glass house" is said to make heat and noise easier to deal with and to provide "a far less expensive upgrade path" for greater technology density or desktop performance.
- The column notes the article elsewhere calls the announced product the "Dell Wyse 5270".

wikis.title: Asus Always Connected PC
wikis.summary: The Always Connected PC platform as a blend of PC and smartphone, its 4G limitation and the case for a 5G version 2.
wikis.body:
- "Unlike thin clients - which, truth be told, have been in the market for decades - the Always Connected PC platform didn't exist before this year."
- "This platform is a blend of a PC and smartphone (without phone capability)."
- "The product is ideally always on, syncs in the background and can host a remote client if connects with high-enough bandwidth. This platform currently and predominantly uses a 4G WAN connection."
- Problems cited: "64-bit non-native apps don't run well or at all, and background sync isn't working" - which "either have been resolved or will be resolved with patches".
- "As a thin client implementation, however, 4G just isn't adequate and 5G doesn't roll out until next year. Which suggests this platform's best opportunity to fill this gap will be Version 2 of the offering, with 5G support."
- "The old saying 'explorers get the arrows, settlers get the land' applies here. We are still in the explorer phase of this offering."

wikis.title: Comcast to offer Xfinity gigabit internet in 15 U.S. cities by early 2017
wikis.summary: Neowin report on Comcast expanding Xfinity gigabit internet to 15 cities/metro areas by early 2017, with the city list, speeds and prices.
wikis.body:
## The expansion

- "By early 2017, Comcast will have its gigabit internet service available in 15 cities/metropolitan areas."
- Through the Xfinity brand, residents get either a fiber-based gigabit service with symmetrical download/upload speeds, or a gigabit version over Comcast's existing cable network.
- On the cable network: up to gigabit download speeds "but with upload speeds of 35 Mbps".
- Areas without fiber "will be required to have a newer DOCSIS 3.1 modem in order to receive advertised speeds".

## Already live (five cities)

- Detroit, MI ("just got the hook up for Xfinity gigabit yesterday"), plus Atlanta, Chicago and Nashville.

## Coming over the next several months (ten cities)

- Denver, CO
- Indianapolis, IN
- Jacksonville, FL
- Kansas City, MO
- Knoxville, TN
- Portland, OR
- San Francisco "Bay Area", CA
- San Jose, CA
- Salt Lake City, UT
- Seattle, WA

## Pricing

- Gigabit internet through Xfinity: "around $140/mo".
- Gigabit Pro (some fiber areas): 2 Gbps download/upload, $159/mo during promo pricing ("said to be a couple years") and $300/mo after that.
- Activation and installation fees "will set you back $1,000 upon signing up for the service".

## Longer-term plan

- "Comcast intends to offer gigabit internet through its cable-based network throughout the 39 states and Washington, D.C., where the company currently offers services, before the end of 2018."

## Page data

- By Chris Schroeder, Nov 2, 2016. Source credited: Ars Technica.

wikis.title: Asus ZenScreen MB16AC portable monitor takes orders at $249

wikis.title: Apple's cash pile passes a quarter of a trillion dollars
wikis.summary: Report that Apple held $256.8 billion in cash and investments at the end of its most recent quarter, the first time its stockpile topped a quarter of $1 trillion.
wikis.body:
## The figure
- "Apple had more than a quarter of $1 trillion in cash and investments on its balance sheet for the first time ever."
- "Apple had $256.8 billion in its cash stockpile at the end of its the most recent quarter, up from $233 billion at the same time last year."
- "Five years ago, Apple had 'just' $110.2 billion in cash."

## Cash held overseas
- Apple "has increasingly stashed away most of its cash overseas for tax purposes."
- "Apple CFO Luca Maestri said on Tuesday that $239 billion of its cash was held abroad."
- "There are growing hopes that Apple might soon be able to bring back, or repatriate, this cash to the United States at a one-time lower tax rate if President Trump is able to get his tax plan through Congress."
- Possible uses listed: hire more workers, build more plants, make acquisitions, repurchase stock and boost its dividend.

## Comparisons given
- "Apple's cash, if it were its own company, would be the 11th largest firm in the S&P 500."
- Companies with market valuations higher than $250 billion: Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Facebook, Berkshire Hathaway, ExxonMobil, Johnson & Johnson, JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo and General Electric. "Apple's cash is worth only slightly less than all of GE."
- Worth more than AT&T, Walmart, Home Depot, Coca-Cola and Disney, and "more than three times Time Warner's market value" (AT&T was then acquiring CNNMoney owner Time Warner).
- Also worth more than Bank of America, Pfizer, Procter & Gamble, Visa, Verizon and Comcast.
- "$250 billion in cash is about 10 times the market value of Snapchat parent Snap. It is 3.5 times the valuation of Uber, and 20 times that of Twitter." Nearly 50 times BlackBerry's market cap.

## Byline
- By Paul R. La Monica and Seth Fiegerman, May 2, 2017 5:26 PM ET; first published May 2, 2017 4:55 PM ET.

wikis.title: SK Hynix adds GDDR6 and updated HBM2 to its memory catalog
wikis.summary: Report that SK Hynix updated its product catalog with 8 Gb GDDR6 chips at 14 Gbps and 12 Gbps and a 32 Gb 1.60 Gbps HBM2 stack, with the resulting memory bandwidths.
wikis.body:
## GDDR6

- "South Korean DRAM and NAND flash giant SK Hynix updated its product catalog to feature its latest GDDR6 memory, besides HBM2."
- "The company had April announced its first GDDR6 memory products."
- First GDDR6 chips come in 8 Gb (1 gigabyte) densities, data-rates of 14 Gbps and 12 Gbps, DRAM voltages of 1.35V.
- "The company is giving away small quantities of these chips for product development, mass production will commence soon, and bulk availability is slated for Q4-2017."
- "This would mean actual products implementing these chips could be available only by very-late Q4 2017, or Q1-2018."

## Bandwidth figures

- 14 Gbps GDDR6 across a 256-bit bus (8 chips): 448 GB/s. Across 384-bit (12 chips): 672 GB/s.
- 12 Gbps chips: 384 GB/s in 256-bit (8-chip) setups, 576 GB/s in 384-bit (12-chip) setups.

## HBM2

- SK Hynix "also updated its HBM2 catalog to feature a 32 Gb (4 gigabyte) HBM2 stack, with a clock speed of 1.60 Gbps".
- "The 2.00 Gbps stack which featured in the Q4-2016 version of this catalog is no longer available."
- At 1.60 Gbps, a GPU with four stacks has 819.2 GB/s of memory bandwidth; a chip with two stacks, "such as the purported 'Vega 10' prototype that has made several media appearances, hence has 409.6 GB/s".

Source given as SK Hynix.

wikis.title: SK Hynix lists GDDR6 and HBM2 memory in its Q2 2017 databook
wikis.summary: eTeknix report that SK Hynix's Q2 2017 catalogue adds 12Gbps and 14Gbps GDDR6 and 1.6Gbps HBM2 memory, with the quarters in which each is said to ship and the graphics cards they are tied to.
wikis.body:
## The listing

- "DRAM and NAND flash manufacturer SK Hynix is launching GDDR6 and HBM2 memory before the end of the year, according to a new catalogue listing."
- "The South Korean memory giant has added 12Gbps and 14Gbps GDDR6 memory plus 1.6Gbps HBM2 memory to its Q2 2017 databook [PDF]."
- "SK Hynix's GDDR6 and HBM2 products have been sent in small quantities to hardware developers. Mass production is expected to begin soon."

## GDDR6

- "SK Hynix will ship two types of 8GB GDDR6 memory - 12Gbps and 14Gbps - during the last quarter of 2017."
- "GDDR6 memory will feature in NVIDIA's next-gen, Volta-based GeForce graphics cards, which is expected for release early-2018."
- "14Gbps GDDR6 memory, coupled with a 256-bit interface, delivers 448GB/s memory bandwidth."

## HBM2

- SK Hynix's second-generation High Bandwidth Memory "will launch during the current quarter", before the GDDR6 release.
- "This means the 4GB, 1.6Gbps memory - which will power AMD's Vega graphics cards - will ship by the end of June."
- "An earlier version of HBM2 was originally listed as 2Gbps in an earlier databook and was slated for release last year. This change may have contributed to delay the launch of AMD's Vega-based Radeon cards."
- "NVIDIA's Tesla P100 and Volta V100 cards will also feature HBM2 to be provided by Samsung, not SK Hynix."

## Byline

- By Ashley Allen, May 16, 2017; "Last Updated: May 17, 2017". Tags: gddr6, HBM2.

wikis.title: Lian Li DK-05 motorised desk PC chassis goes on sale at $2,100
wikis.summary: Report that the Lian Li DK-05 desk PC chassis with motorised height control is now on sale for $2,100, listing its motherboard, cooling and I/O specifications.
wikis.body:
## Availability and price

- The Lian Li DK-05 desk PC chassis, "unveiled earlier this year", "is now available to purchase priced at $2100 and is available from online retailers such as Newegg".
- It is equipped with motorised height controls.

## Specifications given

- Contains two Extended ATX (305×276) motherboard trays and "removes the need for any PC case to be positioned under or on top of your desk".
- Supports motherboards equipped with up to 8 PCI and PCI express cards, two 2.5″ drives and a power supply.
- Prepared for extensive liquid cooling: mounting points for reservoirs, pumps or drivers between the motherboard trays; fan trays prepared for 360 & 480mm radiators.
- Two separate front I/O panels with USB 3.1 Type-C, USB 3.0, HDMI and HD-Audio, allowing control of the PCs inside or use of only one motherboard tray.
- Each I/O panel has RGB adjustment dials to fine-tune optional RGB lighting kits.
- The right side of the desk has the height adjustment panel: a height indicator (in cm or inch), manual up/down adjustment and programmable buttons for stored height positions.

## Byline

- Geeky Gadgets, 2:06 pm August 1, 2017, by Julian Horsey. Source given as Lian Li. The page embeds a video.

wikis.title: 2017 US Go Congress preview (33rd Congress, San Diego)
wikis.summary: American Go E-Journal preview of the 33rd US Go Congress at the Town and Country Resort in San Diego, giving attendance figures, the workshops and lecture programme, and the weather forecast.
wikis.body:
## The event

- The 33rd US Go Congress "kicks off next Saturday at the Town and Country Resort in San Diego, California", with "just a week left" as of the article.
- The schedule for the week-long event "is finally complete", reports Congress Co-Director Ted Terpstra.
- "Currently there are 531 registered attendees including 26 professional go players."

## Workshops

- A ten-session Go Teachers' Workshop "for those wanting to learn the optimal ways of teaching go in the classroom"; many sessions given by Myungwan Kim, 9P. Coordinator: Jonathan Hop.
- For young very-strong players, a 10-session workshop sponsored and run by the Nihon-Kiin professionals Yashashiro, 9P and Tsuruta 4P. Coordinator: Ihan Lui.

## Lectures

- Each afternoon and evening after the US Open rounds (Sunday-Friday, except Wednesday) there will be lectures and game analysis "by the more than 20 professional players from around the world", with sessions for the best players and for new players.
- A special set of go classes by European go teacher In-seong Hwang. Lecture topics: "Let's get the Go-Avengers (includes Thor vs Hulk, Iron Man vs Black Widow and Captain America vs Nick Fury)", "Let's make Go Easier" and "AlphaGo Games, the Future of Go".

## Weather

- Terpstra: "The summer in San Diego has been pleasant with almost no rain."
- Five-day forecast of high temperatures: 77, 76, 77, 77, and 77 degrees, "Perfect for swimming in one of the three swimming pools at the Town and Country Resort. It should be a fine US Go Congress."

## Article details

- Published Saturday July 29, 2017 in the American Go E-Journal. Categories: U.S. Go Congress, U.S./North America.

wikis.title: Intel reportedly accelerating the Basin Falls unveil and Coffee Lake launch
wikis.summary: TechPowerUp report, citing DigiTimes and Taiwan-based PC vendor sources, that Intel will unveil its Basin Falls/X299 platform at Computex 2017 and pull the Coffee Lake launch forward to August 2017.
wikis.body:
## The report
- "According to DigiTimes, sources among Taiwan-based PC vendors have indicated that Intel's upcoming Basin Falls platform, which includes Skylake-X and Kaby Lake-X processors on a new X299 chipset, will be unveiled at Computex 2017 (May 30th, June 3rd), in Taipei - two months earlier than expected."
- "This move comes accompanied by an accelerated launch of the Coffee Lake microarchitecture, which still uses the 14 nm process, to August 2017 from an initial January 2018 launch."
- The article keeps the hedge "if these reports are correct" / "If true".

## Basin Falls line-up as expected
- Basin Falls products "are expected to be revealed near the E3 gaming show in June, with the official release at the end of the month".
- "It is currently expected that the Skylake-X series features three 140W processors with 6, 8 and 10-core designs, while the Kaby Lake-X series carries a 112 W, quad-core processor. In August, Intel will release a top-end 12-core Skylake-X processor."
- These are set against "AMD's expected X399 platform... with 12 and 16-core processors (with double the threads) being available".

## Coffee Lake
- "Intel is expected to initially release several K-series Core i7/i5/i3 processors and accompanying Z370 chipsets in August, with more CPUs and the H370, B360 and H310 chipsets at the end of 2017 or early 2018."
- "Coffee Lake is supposed to carry an increased number of cores in its mainstream designs."

## Other claims
- "Digitimes also reports that Intel has ordered five extra EUV machine sets from ASML in an effort to increase its manufacturing capabilities."
- The article frames the move as a response to AMD Ryzen, citing "Ryzen's 52% performance increase (and incredible energy efficiency) over the now defunct... Bulldozer".

## Byline
- By Raevenlord, Wednesday, April 19th 2017 05:49. Source: DigiTimes.

wikis.title: Nest Thermostat E: cheaper, redesigned smart thermostat at $169
wikis.summary: CNNMoney report on Nest Labs launching the Nest Thermostat E, an $169 restyled version of its smart thermostat, $80 below the Nest Learning Thermostat.
wikis.body:
## The product

- Nest Labs is releasing "a new version of its flagship smart thermostat with a new look and a big $80 price drop".
- "The Nest Thermostat E, launching Thursday, will cost $169 and feature a new vanilla design to help it blend into a home instead of stand out."
- The existing Nest Learning Thermostat costs $249 and "will still be available".

## Design changes

- "The metal ring has been replaced with white polycarbonate plastic."
- "The crisp LCD screen is covered with a frosted display that fades to light gray when not in use", with a minimalist look that removes tick marks and other details.
- "When the motion sensor is triggered, the Nest will light up with large orange numbers showing the current temperature."

## Features

- Works with the same Nest app as the older version; can be controlled by phone or via an Echo or Google Home.
- It learns heating and cooling habits over time, but "Nest isn't highlighting that feature".
- "The Thermostat E will have an automatic schedule programmed in right of out the box, based on data Nest has collected over the years from all its users."
- "It does not include a c-wire connector, which won't be an issue for most homes according to the company."

## Savings pitch

- "According to Nest's own studies, a smart thermostat can save users $131 to $145 a year."
- Different states and cities offer rebates; "in locations like Chicago, it can offset the entire cost of the Thermostat E".

## Company background given in the piece

- The Nest Learning Thermostat launched six years ago and "has won design awards and dominated the smart home market that it helped launch".
- Nest's only other new product is the Nest Protect smoke and CO2 alarm.
- Nest acquired wi-fi camera company Dropcam for $555 million and rebranded its products as Nest Cam; its most recent release added features such as facial recognition to the indoor Nest Cam.
- Nest Labs was founded by former Apple executive Tony Fadell in 2011 and acquired by Google for $3.2 billion in 2014. The Dropcam CEO said he regretted the deal, "partially due to issues with Fadell's management style". Fadell resigned from Nest Labs in 2016.
- Nest is owned by Alphabet (GOOGL).

## Byline

- By Heather Kelly, CNNMoney (San Francisco). "First published August 31, 2017: 12:01 AM ET".

wikis.title: Phase 3 trial of an mRNA seasonal influenza vaccine in adults 65 and older (NCT07805707)
wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for GlaxoSmithKline's Phase 3 efficacy study of an investigational mRNA seasonal influenza vaccine against a licensed flu vaccine in adults aged 65 and over.
wikis.body:
## Registration

- NCT number: NCT07805707
- Title: "A Study on the Efficacy of a Vaccine Against Influenza in Adults ≥65 Years of Age"
- Official title: "A Phase 3 Randomized, Observer-Blind, Controlled Study to Evaluate the Clinical Efficacy of an mRNA Based Seasonal Influenza Vaccine in Older Adults ≥65 Years of Age"
- Sponsor: GlaxoSmithKline (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 54000 (estimated)
- Conditions: Influenza, Human

## Dates

- Start: 2026-09-02 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2028-06-09 (estimated)
- Completion: 2028-06-09 (estimated)
- First posted: 2026-09-04 (actual)
- Last update posted: 2026-09-18 (actual)

## What the study does

- Compares an investigational mRNA flu vaccine with a licensed flu vaccine in adults 65 years of age and older.
- Participants receive one injection and are followed during the flu season.
- Measures prevention of laboratory-confirmed flu illness, side effects and immune responses.

## Interventions

- COMBINATION_PRODUCT: mRNA Seasonal Flu vaccine — single-dose intramuscular administration of the season-adapted investigational mRNA Seasonal Flu vaccine.
- COMBINATION_PRODUCT: Licensed Influenza Vaccine — single-dose intramuscular administration of an age-appropriate and season-adapted licensed influenza vaccine used as the active comparator.

## Primary outcome measures

- Laboratory-confirmed protocol-defined influenza-like illness (ILI) assessed by incidence rate ratio (Day 15 through the end of the influenza season).
- Solicited administration site adverse events (Day 1 to Day 7).
- Solicited systemic AEs (Day 1 to Day 7).
- Unsolicited AEs (Day 1 to Day 28).
- Serious adverse events (Day 1 up to the end of the influenza season, with at least 180 days of follow-up).
- Adverse events of special interest (same time frame).
- Any laboratory abnormalities (Day 1 pre-dose and Day 29 post-dose).

## Sites

- 163 site(s) in United States.

wikis.title: Phase 3 trial of a Clostridioides difficile vaccine in adults 65 and older (NCT07282665)
wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for Pfizer's Phase 3 placebo-controlled study of a Clostridioides difficile vaccine in adults aged 65 years and older.
wikis.body:
## Registration

- NCT number: NCT07282665
- Title: "A Study to Learn About a Clostridioides Difficile Vaccine in People 65 Years of Age and Older"
- Official title: "A PHASE 3, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, DOUBLE-BLINDED, RANDOMIZED STUDY TO EVALUATE THE EFFICACY, SAFETY, AND TOLERABILITY OF A CLOSTRIDIOIDES DIFFICILE VACCINE IN ADULTS 65 YEARS OF AGE AND OLDER"
- Sponsor: Pfizer (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 32500 (estimated)
- Conditions: Clostridoides Difficile Associated Disease

## Dates

- Start: 2025-12-10 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2028-12-11 (estimated)
- Completion: 2029-06-07 (estimated)
- First posted: 2025-12-15 (actual)
- Last update posted: 2026-09-09 (actual)

## What the study does

- Purpose is to learn how effective, safe and tolerable the C. difficile vaccine is in decreasing the number of C. difficile infections (pCDI) in adults 65 years of age or older.
- Participants receive either the C. difficile vaccine or placebo (saline), given as a shot into the upper arm muscle.
- The study looks at the number of diarrhea (loose stools) events related to a C. difficile infection, "so the length of the study can change" — it may finish sooner if events happen quickly, or take longer if they happen slowly, and "sometimes, the study might stop early if the vaccine clearly does not work".
- Participants stay in until enough events have occurred; on average each person is expected to take part for up to about three and a half years.
- 3 planned clinic visits and 3 planned phone visits, then scheduled clinic visits every year until the end of study.
- If a participant has 3 or more loose stools in 24 hours they are asked to save the next one and contact the study site, which checks whether it could be a C. difficile infection (at the clinic or by phone or video call).

## Interventions

- BIOLOGICAL: C.difficile vaccine — given as an intramuscular injection.
- OTHER: Saline Placebo — 0.9% sodium chloride solution given as an intramuscular injection.

## Primary outcome measures

- Percentage of participants reporting local reactions (7 days after each vaccination).
- Percentage reporting systemic events (7 days after each vaccination).
- Percentage reporting adverse events (from each vaccination through 1 month after).
- Percentage reporting serious adverse events (Vaccination 1, Day 1, through 12 months after Vaccination 2, 18 months).
- Incidence of the first episode of medically attended and clinically meaningful primary CDI (from 14 days after Vaccination 2 to the end of surveillance, up to approximately 3.5 years).
- Incidence of the first episode of medically attended primary CDI (same time frame).
- Incidence of the first episode of clinically meaningful primary CDI (same time frame).

## Sites

- 185 site(s) in United States, Argentina, Japan, United Kingdom.

wikis.title: Phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes trial of maridebart cafraglutide (NCT07037433)
wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for Amgen's Phase 3 placebo-controlled study of maridebart cafraglutide on cardiovascular outcomes in participants with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and overweight or obesity.
wikis.body:
## Registration

- NCT number: NCT07037433
- Title: "Evaluating the Impact of Maridebart Cafraglutide on Cardiovascular Outcomes in Participants With Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and Overweight or Obesity"
- Official title: "A Phase 3 Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study to Evaluate the Impact of Maridebart Cafraglutide on Cardiovascular Outcomes in Participants With Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and Overweight or Obesity"
- Sponsor: Amgen (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 12800 (estimated)
- Conditions: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease, Overweight, Obesity

## Dates

- Start: 2025-07-25 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2028-06-30 (estimated)
- Completion: 2030-09-29 (estimated)
- First posted: 2025-06-25 (actual)
- Last update posted: 2026-09-03 (actual)

## What the study does

- Primary objective: "to demonstrate that maridebart cafraglutide is superior to placebo when given as an adjunct to standard of care with respect to reducing cardiovascular (CV) morbidity and mortality."

## Interventions

- DRUG: Maridebart Cafraglutide — administered SC.
- DRUG: Placebo — administered SC.

## Primary outcome measures

- Time to first occurrence of a composite of CV death, myocardial infarction or ischemic stroke (3-point MACE), up to approximately 35 months.
- Time to first occurrence of a composite of all-cause death, MI, ischemic stroke, coronary revascularization or heart failure event (5-point MACE), up to approximately 35 months.

## Sites

- 783 site(s) in United States, Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Hungary, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Puerto Rico, Romania, Singapore, Slovakia, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Turkey (Türkiye), United Kingdom.

wikis.title: EASi-KIDNEY: Phase 3 trial of BI 690517 with empagliflozin in chronic kidney disease (NCT06531824)
wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for Boehringer Ingelheim's Phase 3 EASi-KIDNEY trial of the aldosterone synthase inhibitor BI 690517 combined with empagliflozin in patients with chronic kidney disease.
wikis.body:
## Registration

- NCT number: NCT06531824
- Title: "EASi-KIDNEY™ (The Studies of Heart & Kidney Protection With BI 690517 in Combination With Empagliflozin)"
- Official title: "A Multicenter, International, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Clinical Trial of the Aldosterone Synthase Inhibitor BI 690517 in Combination With Empagliflozin in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease"
- Sponsor: Boehringer Ingelheim (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 11000 (estimated)
- Conditions: Kidney Disease, Chronic

## Dates

- Start: 2024-08-30 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2028-08-30 (estimated)
- Completion: 2028-08-30 (estimated)
- First posted: 2024-08-01 (actual)
- Last update posted: 2026-09-17 (actual)

## What the study does

- Open to adults with chronic kidney disease at risk of progression, with and without type 2 diabetes; open to people taking ACE inhibitors or ARBs, people already on empagliflozin or another SGLT2 inhibitor, and people on none of these treatments.
- Purpose: to find out whether BI 690517 helps people with chronic kidney disease when taken in combination with empagliflozin.
- After a run-in period confirming appropriate renin-angiotensin system blockade and establishing participants on empagliflozin, participants are randomly assigned to BI 690517 tablets or placebo tablets, 1 tablet once a day in addition to empagliflozin for the duration of the study.
- Doctors document worsening kidney disease, hospitalisation for heart failure, or cardiovascular death; time to these events is compared between the 2 groups.
- The study continues until the required number of events have occurred, "which is about 3 to 4 years". Participants visit the site about 5 times in the first 6 months, then every 6 months, with blood and urine samples, blood pressure, weight and kidney function checks.

## Interventions

- DRUG: BI 690517 (called Type M randomized treatment).
- DRUG: Placebo matching BI 690517.
- DRUG: Empagliflozin (called Type E).

## Primary outcome measure

- Time to first occurrence of the primary composite outcome of (i) kidney disease progression, (ii) hospitalization for heart failure, or (iii) cardiovascular death — time frame up to 4 years.

## Sites

- 557 site(s) in United States, Argentina, Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, China, Denmark, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, Portugal, South Korea, Sweden, Taiwan, United Kingdom.

wikis.title: EASi-HF Preserved: Phase 3 trial of vicadrostat with empagliflozin in heart failure (NCT06424288)
wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for Boehringer Ingelheim's Phase III EASi-HF Preserved trial of oral vicadrostat (BI 690517) plus empagliflozin in symptomatic heart failure with LVEF of 40% or more.
wikis.body:
## Registration

- NCT number: NCT06424288
- Title: "A Study to Test Whether Vicadrostat in Combination With Empagliflozin Helps People With Heart Failure"
- Official title: "EASi-HF Preserved - A Phase III Double-blind, Randomised, Parallel-group Superiority Trial to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of the Combined Use of Oral Vicadrostat (BI 690517) and Empagliflozin Compared With Placebo and Empagliflozin in Participants With Symptomatic Heart Failure (HF: NYHA II-IV) and Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) ≥40%"
- Sponsor: Boehringer Ingelheim (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 6000 (estimated)
- Conditions: Heart Failure

## Dates

- Start: 2024-06-17 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2028-05-22 (estimated)
- Completion: 2028-05-22 (estimated)
- First posted: 2024-05-22 (actual)
- Last update posted: 2026-08-21 (actual)

## What the study does

- Open to adults aged 18 or above legal age with heart failure symptoms and a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of 40% or more.
- Purpose: to find out whether vicadrostat (BI 690517) in combination with empagliflozin helps people with heart failure.
- Two groups, assigned by chance with an equal chance of each: vicadrostat/empagliflozin tablets once a day, or placebo/empagliflozin tablets once a day.
- Participants can stay in the study as long as they benefit from treatment and can tolerate it, visiting doctors regularly; study staff may also contact participants by phone and participants regularly answer questions about their well-being.
- "The study does not have a fixed duration. It continues until there is enough data to see if the treatment is working."

## Interventions

- DRUG: vicadrostat.
- DRUG: empagliflozin.
- DRUG: placebo matching vicadrostat.

## Primary outcome measure

- Time to first event of cardiovascular death, hospitalisation for heart failure (HHF) or urgent heart failure visit — time frame up to 42 months.

## Sites

- 652 site(s) in United States, Argentina, Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Czechia, Germany, Hungary, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Serbia, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Taiwan, Turkey (Türkiye), United Kingdom, Vietnam.

- The trial is event-driven; "Part 1 will conclude when approximately 850 primary endpoint events have occurred."

## Interventions

- DRUG: Maridebart cafraglutide — administered SC.

wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for Sanofi's Phase 3 immunogenicity and safety study of MenQuadfi against locally licensed meningococcal vaccines in healthy infants and toddlers aged 2 to 23 months in China.
wikis.body:
## Registration

- NCT number: NCT07710872
- Title: "Immunogenicity and Safety Study of an Investigational Quadrivalent Meningococcal Conjugate Vaccine Administered in Healthy Infants and Toddlers in China"
- Official title: "A Phase 3, Modified-double Blind, Multi-center Study of the Immunogenicity and Safety of an Investigational Quadrivalent Meningococcal Conjugate Vaccine Administered in Healthy Infants and Toddlers (2 to 23 Months of Age) in China"
- Sponsor: Sanofi (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 4568 (estimated)
- Conditions: Meningococcal Infection, Healthy Volunteers

## Dates

- Start: 2026-08-22 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2028-03-13 (estimated)
- Completion: 2029-07-26 (estimated)
- First posted: 2026-07-17 (actual)
- Last update posted: 2026-09-09 (actual)

## What the study does

- Purpose: "to describe the safety and immunogenicity of MenACYW conjugate vaccine compared with locally-licensed meningococcal vaccines in healthy infants and toddlers in China."

## Cohorts and durations (including 6-month safety follow-up after the last dose)

- Cohort I (Groups 1 and 2): approximately 211 or 271 days (approximately 7 or 9 months); 2-dose vaccination at V01 (D01) and V02 (D31) or V03 (D91); two blood samples pre-vaccination (D01) and 30 days post the 2nd dose (D61 or D121).
- Cohort II (Groups 3 and 4): up to 18 months; 2-dose vaccination at V01 (D01) and V02 (D31) or V03 (D91), with a 1-dose booster for Group 3 only at 18 MoA; up to 4 blood samples.
- Cohort III (Groups 5 and 6): up to 21 months; 3-dose primary vaccination at V01 (D01), V02 (D31) and V03 (D61), plus a 1-dose booster at 12 MoA (V05) or 18 MoA (V06); 4 blood samples in total.
- Cohort III (Group 7): approximately 16 months; 3-dose primary vaccination at V01 (D01), V02 (D61) and V03 (D121), plus a 1-dose booster at V05 at 12 MoA; 4 blood samples in total. A safety visit is planned on the 9th day after the first vaccination for the ESDR participants (the first 30 participants in this group).
- Telephone calls are planned on the 4th, 9th and 21st day after each vaccination (including boosters), and 5 monthly calls over the 5 months after the last on-site visit for safety follow-up.

## Interventions

- BIOLOGICAL: MenQuadfi® (Meningococcal Polysaccharide [Serogroups A, C, W, and Y] Tetanus Toxoid Conjugate Vaccine) (Sanofi Pasteur Inc., Swiftwater, PA, USA) — liquid solution, IM injection.
- BIOLOGICAL: Menhycia® (ACYW135 Meningococcal Conjugate Vaccine [CRM197]) (CanSino Biologics Inc., China) — lyophilized powder (MenAC conjugate vaccine) and liquid solution (MenYW135 conjugate vaccine), IM injection.

## Primary outcome measures

- Cohort I (12 through 23 MoA): vaccine seroresponse to serogroups A, C, Y and W, and antibody titers (GMTs) measured by rSBA — 30 days post 2nd vaccination (up to Day 121).
- Cohort II (6 through 11 MoA): seroresponse and GMTs by rSBA — 30 days post 2nd vaccination (up to Day 121).
- Cohort III Groups 5 and 6 (3 through 5 MoA): seroresponse and GMTs by rSBA — Day 91.
- Cohort III Groups 7 and 6 (2 through 5 MoA): seroresponse and GMTs by rSBA — Day 151.

## Sites

- 3 site(s) in China.

wikis.title: Embold: Phase III master protocol of elecoglipron for obesity or overweight (NCT07667803)
wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for AstraZeneca's Phase III Embold master protocol covering two pivotal placebo-controlled studies of oral elecoglipron for weight management, with and without type 2 diabetes.
wikis.body:
## Registration

- NCT number: NCT07667803
- Title: "A Master Protocol to Investigate Efficacy and Safety of Elecoglipron in Participants With Obesity or Overweight With or Without T2DM"
- Official title: "A Phase III Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Multicenter Master Protocol to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Elecoglipron in Participants With Obesity or Overweight With or Without Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (Embold)"
- Sponsor: AstraZeneca (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 4500 (estimated)
- Conditions: Weight Management

## Dates

- Start: 2026-06-29 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2028-07-31 (estimated)
- Completion: 2029-07-30 (estimated)
- First posted: 2026-06-25 (actual)
- Last update posted: 2026-09-09 (actual)

## What the study does

- Master study protocol, Study D7260C00015, covers 2 independent, pivotal studies: Study 1 and Study 2.
- Each is a global, randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, multicenter Phase III study of elecoglipron compared with placebo adjunct to diet and exercise for weight management.
- Population: adults aged 18 and above living with obesity (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2), or overweight (BMI ≥ 25 kg/m2) with at least 1 weight-related comorbidity (hypertension, prediabetes, dyslipidemia, CV disease and/or obstructive sleep apnea) — without T2DM (Study 1) and with T2DM (Study 2).
- Two doses of elecoglipron compared with placebo, given once daily as oral tablets.
- "Approximately 3000 participants will be randomized in the study 1 and 1500 participants in the study 2."
- "The primary endpoint is percent change in body weight from baseline at 72 weeks."

## Interventions

- DRUG: Elecoglipron — film-coated tablet once daily.
- DRUG: Placebo — placebo matching elecoglipron film-coated tablet once daily.

## Primary outcome measure

- Percent body weight loss — time frame 72 weeks.

## Sites

- 325 site(s) in United States, Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Poland, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Taiwan, Turkey (Türkiye), United Kingdom.
