## Registration

- NCT number: NCT05774951
- Title: "A Study of Camizestrant in ER+/HER2- Early Breast Cancer After at Least 2 Years of Standard Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy"
- Official title: "CAMBRIA-1: A Phase III, Open-Label, Randomised Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of Extended Therapy With Camizestrant (AZD9833, a Next Generation, Oral Selective Estrogen Receptor Degrader) Versus Standard Endocrine Therapy (Aromatase Inhibitor or Tamoxifen) in Patients With ER+/HER2- Early Breast Cancer and an Intermediate or High Risk of Recurrence Who Have Completed Definitive Locoregional Therapy and at Least 2 Years of Standard Adjuvant Endocrine-Based Therapy Without Disease Recurrence"
- Sponsor: AstraZeneca (INDUSTRY)
- Study type: INTERVENTIONAL; Phase: PHASE3
- Status: RECRUITING
- Enrollment: 4300 (estimated)
- Conditions: Breast Cancer, Early Breast Cancer

## Dates

- Start: 2023-03-31 (actual)
- Primary completion: 2027-04-20 (estimated)
- Completion: 2036-05-29 (estimated)
- First posted: 2023-03-20 (actual)

## What the study does

- Assesses if camizestrant improves outcomes compared to standard endocrine therapy in patients with ER+/HER2- early breast cancer with intermediate or high risk of recurrence who completed definitive locoregional therapy (with or without chemotherapy) and standard adjuvant endocrine therapy for at least 2 years and up to 5 years.
- "The planned duration of treatment in either arm of the study is 60 months."
- Eligible patients must have intermediate or high risk of recurrence as defined by specified clinical and biologic criteria; prior use of CDK4/6 inhibitors is permitted.
- Primary endpoint is invasive breast cancer-free survival (IBCFS); main secondary endpoints include invasive disease-free survival (IDFS), distant relapse-free survival (DRFS), overall survival (OS), safety and clinical outcome assessments (COAs).
- "Patients will be followed for 10 years from randomization of the last patient."

## Interventions

- DRUG: Camizestrant — experimental, administered orally.
- DRUG: Tamoxifen — comparator, administered per local approved label.
- DRUG: Anastrozole — comparator, per local approved label.
- DRUG: Letrozole — comparator, per local approved label.
- DRUG: Exemestane — comparator, per local approved label.

## Primary outcome measure

- Invasive breast cancer-free survival (IBCFS) — time frame up to 10 years.

wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for Pfizer's Phase 3 trial NCT07573462, evaluating the safety and tolerability of the multivalent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine PG4 against 20vPnC (Prevnar 20) in healthy infants.
wikis.body:
## Study

- **Title:** A Study to Learn About the Safety of an Expanded Pneumococcal Vaccine in Healthy Infants
- **Official title:** A PHASE 3, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLINDED TRIAL TO EVALUATE THE SAFETY AND TOLERABILITY OF A MULTIVALENT PNEUMOCOCCAL CONJUGATE VACCINE IN HEALTHY INFANTS
- **NCT number:** NCT07573462
- **Sponsor:** Pfizer (INDUSTRY)
- **Status:** RECRUITING
- **Study type:** INTERVENTIONAL
- **Phase:** PHASE3
- **Enrollment:** 2400 (estimated)
- **Conditions:** Pneumococcal Disease

## Dates

- Start 2026-05-04 (actual)
- Primary completion 2028-12-30 (estimated)
- Completion 2028-12-30 (estimated)
- First posted 2026-05-07 (actual)
- Last update posted 2026-09-15 (actual)

## Purpose

The study is "to learn about the safety of a new pneumococcal vaccine and how the new pneumococcal vaccine helps to fight against germs that can cause pneumonia (lung infections), meningitis (brain infections), and otitis media (ear infections) in infants when compared to the pneumococcal vaccine that is currently in use, 20vPnC (Prevnar 20 (R))." It will test if the new vaccine is as safe as the one currently in use, and the new vaccine "can possibly provide additional protection against germs that cause pneumococcal disease that are not included in the vaccines that are currently given to infants." Pneumococcal disease is caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae.

## Design

- Two groups; all participants assigned to one of them.
- Seeking infants who are about 2 months of age.
- About 2400 infants assigned by chance to receive either PG4 (new vaccine) or 20vPnC (currently in use), into the left thigh muscle at 2, 4, 6, and 12 to 15 months of age.
- Infants take part for about 16 to 19 months (about 1 and a half years), with 6 study clinic visits and 1 phone call; parent(s)/legal guardian(s) are asked about side effects.

## Interventions

- BIOLOGICAL: PG4 - Multivalent Pneumococcal Vaccine
- BIOLOGICAL: 20-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (20vPnC)

## Primary outcome measures

- Percentage of participants reporting local reactions within 7 days after each dose - time frame: Day 7
- Percentage of participants reporting systemic events within 7 days after each dose - time frame: Day 7
- Percentage of participants reporting adverse events (AEs) from Dose 1 to 1 month after Dose 3
- Percentage of participants reporting AEs from Dose 4 to 1 month after Dose 4
- Percentage of participants reporting serious adverse events (SAEs) - time frame: Dose 1 to 6 months after Dose 4

## Locations

41 site(s) in United States, Australia, Canada, Finland, Germany, Poland.

wikis.summary: ClinicalTrials.gov record for Sanofi's Phase 3 lot-to-lot consistency trial NCT07348692 of the 21-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine PCV21 in healthy infants and toddlers.
wikis.body:
## Study

- **Title:** Lot-to-lot Consistency Study of a 21-valent Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccine in Healthy Infants From 2 Months of Age
- **Official title:** A Phase 3, Randomized, Modified Double-blind, Active-controlled, Parallel-group, Lot-to-lot Consistency, 4-arm Study to Investigate the Safety and Immunogenicity of a 4-dose Regimen of a 21-valent Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccine in Healthy Infants and Toddlers
- **NCT number:** NCT07348692
- **Sponsor:** Sanofi (INDUSTRY)
- **Status:** RECRUITING
- **Study type:** INTERVENTIONAL
- **Phase:** PHASE3
- **Enrollment:** 2195 (estimated)
- **Conditions:** Pneumococcal Immunization, Healthy Volunteers

## Dates

- Start 2026-01-20 (actual)
- Primary completion 2027-06-07 (estimated)
- Completion 2028-05-29 (estimated)
- First posted 2026-01-16 (actual)
- Last update posted 2026-05-22 (actual)

## Purpose

A phase 3 randomized, modified double-blind study "to measure whether 3 lots of the investigational pneumococcal vaccine PCV21 can help the body to develop germ-fighting agents called 'antibodies' (immunogenicity) in a similar way (ie, same immune response) when they are given to infants aged from approximately 2 months (42 to 89 days) and are safe compared to a licensed 20-valent pneumococcal vaccine (20vPCV) (Prevnar 20 (TM))."

## Design

- Study duration per participant: up to approximately 17 months.
- Study vaccines (either PCV21 or 20vPCV) administered at approximately 2, 4, 6 and 12 months of age.
- Cohort A: randomization to three PCV21 formulation groups or one 20vPCV comparator group (Groups 1-4, approximately 896 total participants).
- Cohort B: randomization to three PCV21 formulation groups only (Groups 1-3, approximately 1299 total participants).
- Routine pediatric vaccines given as per local recommendations.
- 6 study visits: V01; V02 60 days after V01; V03 60 days after V02; V04 30 days after V03; V05 at 12 months of age; V06 30 days after V05.

## Interventions

- BIOLOGICAL: PCV21 vaccine - suspension for injection, intramuscular
- BIOLOGICAL: 20vPCV licensed vaccine - suspension for injection, intramuscular

## Primary outcome measures

- For all participants: Serotype specific Immunoglobulin G (IgG) Geometric Mean Concentration (GMC) - time frame: 30 days after the third dose of PCV21 vaccine

## Locations

19 site(s) in United States, Honduras, Puerto Rico.

## Study

- **Official title:** A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Study to Evaluate REGN7508, A Factor XI Monoclonal Antibody, Versus Apixaban and Enoxaparin for Prophylaxis of Venous Thromboembolism After Elective Total Knee Arthroplasty (ROXI-APEX)
- **NCT number:** NCT07015905
- **Sponsor:** Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (INDUSTRY)
- **Status:** RECRUITING
- **Study type:** INTERVENTIONAL
- **Phase:** PHASE3
- **Enrollment:** 2000 (estimated)
- **Conditions:** Venous Thromboembolism (VTE)

- Start 2025-06-25 (actual)
- Primary completion 2027-02-20 (estimated)
- Completion 2027-05-12 (estimated)
- First posted 2025-06-11 (actual)
- Last update posted 2026-09-15 (actual)

## Purpose

The study researches "an experimental drug called REGN7508 (called 'study drug')" in adults undergoing elective, unilateral (one side) total knee replacement surgery. "The aim of the study is to see how effective the study drug is at preventing Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) and other related diseases after total knee replacement surgery."

Other research questions: what side effects may happen from taking the study drug; how much study drug is in the blood at different times; whether the body makes antibodies against the study drug (which could make it less effective or lead to side effects).

- Incidence of the composite endpoint of asymptomatic or symptomatic Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) [including VTE-related death] - time frame: Through day 12 visit, approximately 14 days

wikis.title: Rumoured AMD 12nm Polaris 30 GPU for Radeon RX-600 cards before end of 2018
wikis.summary: A report on leaks out of China claiming AMD will launch a 12nm Polaris 30 GPU in Radeon RX-600 series cards before the end of 2018, with mid-range Navi cards following in Q1 2019.
wikis.body:
## The claim

- "AMD could be prepping a 12nm Polaris 30 GPU to be launched before the end of 2018, according to leaks out of China."
- The part "would appear in a series of Radeon RX-600-branded graphics cards". (The article's headline on the page reads "Radeon RX-680 graphics cards"; the page title and body use RX-600.)
- Standfirst: "Chinese whispers suggest AMD is planning new Polaris GPU before the end of 2018, with mid-range Navi launches coming in Q1 2019".
- The leak was "Posted on Chinese site ChipHell"; the source is referred to as the "rumour monger" and, later, as "WJM47196".

## Claimed specifications

- 15 per cent performance boost compared to current RX-500 series cards, "which were a minor refresh on 2016's RX-400s".
- Manufactured using the 12-nanometre FinFET process.
- Image caption on the article: "Not a graphics card based on the rumoured 12nm Polaris GPU".

## Navi

- Navi-based cards following "in the first quarter of 2019".
- "AMD is planning to release mid-range Navi-based cards first, followed by top-of-the-range GPUs using High-Bandwidth Memory 2 (HBM2)."
- Navi "is slated to succeed the Vega architecture, and, as WCCFTech pointed out, will use a 7nm process and be primarily aimed at next-generation games consoles, such as the PlayStation 5, which is expected to be launched before the end of 2020."

## AMD's line-up as described

- Unlike Nvidia, which "tends to have one graphics architecture that spreads across its entire range", AMD's line-up is "a bit more complicated".
- Vega was expected to follow up and replace Polaris, but apart from HBM2 support in its GBP 450+ cards and integration into AMD's Ryzen accelerated processing units (APUs), "there's been no sign of mainstream or mobile discreet Vega graphics cards".
- Vega typically found in cards from GBP 450 and upwards "now that cryptocurrency values have crashed", while 8GB Polaris-based cards "can be had for under GBP 300" - leaving little in the middle.
- The Polaris refresh plus mid-range-first Navi "will therefore leave AMD with three graphics card architectures for low-, mid-range and high-end", while Nvidia's Turing-based GPUs "could make their debut next month".
- "The real performance boost for AMD's desktop graphics cars will likely come with HBM2 sporting Navi GPUs or a 7nm Vega 20 GPU with HBM2 aimed at gamers, if WJM47196 is correct."
- "Intriguingly, perhaps, Vega at 7nm may help deal with much of its heat dissipation issues and could conceivably accommodate two cores in a single die connected via infinity fabric."

## Byline

- V3 Newsdesk, 04 July 2018. Topics listed: Hardware, Components, AMD, Vega, polaris, Navi, 12nm, 7nm.

wikis.title: Volkswagen's MEB modular electric-drive toolkit
wikis.summary: A Volkswagen newsroom article describing the MEB (Modulare E-Antriebs-Baukasten) platform that the brand plans to build 10 million electric vehicles on, including the I.D. CROZZ and I.D. BUZZ.
wikis.body:
## What MEB is

- In German, "Modulare E-Antriebs-Baukasten", acronym MEB; translated, "modular electric-drive toolkit".
- Described as "the basic building block of the Volkswagen brand's electric transportation future".
- Not just the basic metal chassis, but "the layout of key components and, most importantly, how they all fit together". Compared to the Volkswagen MQB, "the toolkit that underpins Volkswagen models from the Golf to the Atlas"; MEB "can easily adapt to many different sizes of vehicles and battery capacities while using common components to help lower costs".

## Scale and plans

- "Around the world, Volkswagen is making plans to produce 10 million copies of the MEB in a variety of styles - the most ambitious electric-vehicle rollout of any major automaker."
- MEB "will form the basis of the future anticipated Volkswagen electric vehicles in America, namely the production versions of the I.D. CROZZ SUV, the I.D. BUZZ van and beyond".
- Thomas Ulbrich, Member of the Volkswagen Brand Board of Management, E-Mobility division: "By 2022 alone, we anticipate that four Volkswagen Group brands will be ramping up 27 MEB models worldwide, ranging from compact cars to the I.D. BUZZ van."

## Technical points

- Electric drive components take up less space than gas engines and transmissions, so I.D. models "can offer interior space that's a class-size larger than their exterior dimensions; the I.D. CROZZ can pack Atlas-type space in a Tiguan-size wrapper".
- All engineered to be either rear-wheel or all-wheel drive, "via one or two electric motors, for more optimal weight distribution and handling".
- Battery pack located in the floor, "can be easily redesigned for different sizes and types of batteries, allowing for driving ranges from about 200 miles up to more than 340 miles on the WLTP (Worldwide Harmonized Light Vehicles Test Procedure) cycle".
- MEB "can be designed to help make advanced technologies commonplace, such as over-the-air software update capabilities and 125-kW charging".

## Quotes

- Christian Senger, Head of the Volkswagen E-Mobility product line: with the MEB "we have developed a platform designed specifically for electric cars"; "The I.D. models will not be combustion engine versions that have been converted, they will be designed to be 100 percent, thoroughbred electric vehicles. And they will be engineered to be online, upgradeable- and update-compatible."
- Thomas Ulbrich: "The platform that Volkswagen is developing is more consistent and innovative than many of the other platforms"; "The MEB modular electric drive matrix is probably the most important project in Volkswagen's history."
- Ulbrich compares the launch of the MEB to the transition VW made in the 1970s from the Beetle to the Golf.

## Images / disclaimers

- "ID. BUZZ study charged at a IONITY high power charging station. Concept vehicle shown; not available for sale. Specifications may change."
- "Concept vehicle chassis shown. Specifications may change."

wikis.title: Benchmark's December 2019 lithium ion battery megafactory assessment: 115 plants in the pipeline
wikis.summary: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's release reporting 115 lithium ion battery megafactories in the pipeline to 2029, Europe's planned capacity surging to 348GWh, and the launch of its Battery Megafactories Europe 2020 conference.
wikis.body:
## Headline figures

- The number of lithium ion battery megafactories in the pipeline "has reached 115", according to Benchmark Minerals' Lithium ion Battery Megafactory December 2019 Assessment.
- "This is a significant increase on December 2018's assessment of 63 electric vehicle (EV) battery plants" - plants "colloquially know as megafactories (a term created by Benchmark) or gigafactories (a brand name created by Tesla)".
- Europe's planned lithium ion cell battery capacity surges in 2019 to 348GWh.
- China "continues to dominate adding 564GWh by 2028".
- "Total lithium ion battery capacity in pipeline equals 39m EVs by 2029" (bullet); the body states China's 2019 addition of 564GWh brought "a global total of 2068.3GWh or the equivalent of 40m EVs by 2028".
- Note on the charts: "data changes on a monthly basis".

## Europe

- Europe's increase "was led by new plants in Germany including CATL in Erfurt, Farasis in Saxony-Anhalt, Northvolt and Volkswagen Group (VW) in Salzgitter, and most recently, Tesla's Gigafactory 4 in Berlin".
- "Combined, these battery megafactories increased Germany's pipeline capacity over the next decade by 432% to 133GWh and Europe's to 348GWh."
- "This marked the emergence of a mass EV battery production blueprint being built on the continent."
- Elsewhere the release says Europe now hosts "plans for 14 battery megafactories with a cumulative total of 369GWh cell capacity by 2029".

## Regional shares

- China accounted for 69% of total capacity; Europe increased its share to 17%; North America lagged at 8%, "despite new plants from Korean manufacturer, SK Innovation, Chinese producer, Farasis, and expected expansions at Tesla and LG Chem".
- "China is now home to 88 of 115 lithium ion battery megafactories in the pipeline to 2029."

## Quotes

- Caspar Rawles, Head of Price Assessments, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence: "There is little doubt that the global trend of 2019 is Europe stepping up its role in the global battery arms race"; "While China remains the powerhouse, there are major concerns from Europe's automotive industry over availability of high quality, tier one lithium ion battery cells at a mass scale as a major blocker to EV acceleration."
- Simon Moores, Managing Director, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence: "Battery Megafactories Europe 2020 will be the first ever event to specialise in mass scale commercialisation of lithium ion batteries and their supply chains on the continent"; "Not only is speed and scale of the essence for the European EV revolution to take hold, but quality and sustainability are crucial to every link in the chain, from lithium and cobalt mining through to the battery cell."; "As we have done in the US, this Benchmark Mineral Intelligence conference will bring the industrial and political communities together to solve the biggest supply chain challenges that we face."

## Battery Megafactories Europe 2020

- Benchmark launches Battery Megafactories Europe 2020 Conference, 17-18 June 2020, Berlin, Germany.
- Will hear from "the major cell manufacturers building capacity on the continent, the consuming automotive OEMs, and every link in the mid-stream from lithium, cobalt, graphite, nickel and manganese through to the cathodes and anodes".
- "It will be a private event for industry participants and government and will not be open to media."
- Charts referenced: "The World's Lithium ion Battery Capacity in 2029", "Where will Europe's Battery Megafactories be located in 2029?" (lithium ion battery plants >5GWh/year capacity), and "Who had the world's biggest battery plant in 2019 (GWh)?".

wikis.title: TSMC's 5nm (N5) process at IEDM 2019: 80% test-chip yield, high volume production in H1 2020
wikis.summary: AnandTech's report on TSMC's IEDM 2019 paper disclosing its 5nm EUV process: density and power gains, test-chip yields, CPU/GPU frequency plots, PAM-4 IO, mask count, transistor types and DTCO.
wikis.body:
## The disclosure

- "Today at the IEEE IEDM Conference, TSMC is presenting a paper giving an overview of the initial results it has achieved on its 5nm process."
- N5 "is going to be the next step for any customer currently on the N7 or N7P processes as it shares a number design rules between the two".
- "The new N5 process is set to offer a full node increase over the 7nm variants, and uses EUV technology extensively over 10+ layers, reducing the total steps in production over 7nm." It implements TSMC's next generation (5th gen) of FinFET technology.
- Paper reference given: "36.7 5nm CMOS Production Technology Platform featuring full-fledged EUV, and High Mobility Channel FinFETs with Densest 0.021 um2 SRAM Cells for Mobile SoC and High Performance Computing Applications, IEEE IEDM 2019".

## Headline numbers

- "~1.84x logic density increase, a 15% power gain, or a 30% power reduction."
- Current test chip, with 256 Mb of SRAM and some logic, "is yielding 80% on average and 90%+ in peak, although scaled back to the size of a modern mobile chip, the yield is a lot lower".
- "The technology is currently in risk production, with high volume production scheduled for the first half of 2020. This means that chips built on 5nm should be ready in the latter half of 2020."
- Density comparison (from WikiChip): TSMC's 7nm "currently yields just shy of 100 million transistors per square millimeter (mTr/mm2) when using dense libraries, about 96.27 mTr/mm2. This means that the new 5nm process should be around 177.14 mTr/mm2."

## Yield detail

- Two test chips disclosed: one built on SRAM, and one combining SRAM, logic and IO.
- SRAM chip: high current (HC) and high density (HD) SRAM cells at 25000 nm2 and 21000 nm2 respectively; TSMC "is actively promoting its HD SRAM cells as the smallest ever reported".
- Combined chip: 30% SRAM, 60% Logic (CPU/GPU), 10% IO, with 256 mega-bits of SRAM. At 21000 nm2 that gives a die area of 5.376 mm2; with SRAM at 30%, "the whole chip should be around 17.92 mm2". The chip "does not include self-repair circuitry".
- Published average yield ~80%, peak yield per wafer >90%.
- Author's extrapolation: a 300 mm wafer with a 17.92 mm2 die would produce 3252 dies per wafer; 80% yield means 2602 good dies, corresponding to "a defect rate of 1.271 per sq cm".
- Taking a 100 mm2 die ("the Kirin 990 5G built on 7nm EUV is over 100 mm2, closer to 110 mm2"), that defect rate "would afford a yield of 32.0%", described as "pretty good for a process in the middle of risk production".
- AMD's Zen 2 chiplet at 10.35x7.37mm "equates to 41.0% yield".
- Author's note: reading it as the 5.376 mm2 SRAM-only die would have implied "a defect rate of 4.26, or a 100mm2 yield of 5.40%"; "The paper is a little ambiguous as to which test chip the yields are referring to." David Schor of Wikichip "says that even the 32.0% yield for 100 mm2 calculated is a little low for risk production, unless you're happy taking a lot of risk."

## CPU and GPU frequency (shmoo plots)

- CPU: 1.5 GHz at 0.7 volts up to 3.25 GHz at 1.2 volts.
- GPU: 0.66 GHz at 0.65 volts up to 1.43 GHz at 1.2 volts.
- TSMC does not disclose what it uses as an example CPU/GPU, "although the CPU part is usually expected to be an Arm core".

## IO: PAM-4

- Test chip includes a transceiver designed to enable high-speed PAM-4.
- 112 Gb/s at 0.76 pJ/bit energy efficiency; 130 Gb/s "still within tolerances in the eye diagram, but at a 0.96 pJ/bit efficiency".
- "This bodes well for any PAM-4 based technologies, such as PCIe 6.0."

## Mask count and EUV

- "What used to be 30-40 masks on 28 nm is now going above 70 masks on 14nm/10nm, with reports that some leading edge process technologies are already above 100 masks."
- Extensive EUV over 10 layers will, "for the first time, reduce the number of process masks with a new process node".
- EUV can replace four or five standard non-EUV masking steps with one EUV step. Throughput of a single EUV machine is 175 wafers per hour per mask versus 300 for non-EUV, "however the EUV's speed should be multiplied by 4-5 to get a comparison throughput".
- Estimates given: ~60 masks for 16FFC, 80-85 for 10FF, 90-95 for 7FF; "With 5FF and EUV, that number goes back down to the 75-80 number, compared to the 110+ that it might have been without EUV."
- "Recent reports state that ASML is behind in shipping its 2019 orders, and plans to build another 25-27 in 2020 with demand for at least 50 machines."

## Transistor types

- The paper describes seven different types of transistor, "eVT at the high end and SVT-LL at the low end".
- "The three main types are uLVT, LVT and SVT, which all three have low leakage (LL) variants. Then eLVT sits on the top, with quite a big jump from uLVT to eLVT."

## DTCO

- DTCO (Design-Technology Co-Optimization) is "one arm of process optimization that occurs as a result of chip design".
- The 5nm test chip "has an element of DTCO applied, rather than brute-forcing the design rules, which has enabled scaling of the design rules for an overall 40% chip size reduction".
- Without it the test chip "would have been more like 25.1 mm2, with a yield of 73%, rather than 80%".
- "With this element of DTCO, it enables TSMC to quote the 1.84x increase in density for 15+% speed increase/30% power reduction."

## Not disclosed

- "One obvious data point that TSMC hasn't disclosed is the exact details on its fin pitch sizes, or contacted poly pitch (cpp)."

## Byline

- by Dr. Ian Cutress on December 11, 2019 7:05 PM EST. Posted in CPUs, TSMC, 5nm, IEDM, IEDM 2019, HVM, DTCO.

wikis.title: Dell Precision M3800 mobile workstation launch
wikis.summary: Report on Dell's announcement of the Precision M3800, a thin 15-inch mobile workstation, with its specifications and on-sale date.
wikis.body:
## Announcement
- "Today, Dell has announced a brand new Prevision workstation" [sic] - the Dell Precision M3800.
- Source given as Microsoft.

## Design
- 15-inch workstation with "a thin 0.7 Inch form factor".
- "The unit is composed of an aluminum frame, carbon fiber chassis, and topped off with a Gorilla Glass display."

## Specifications
- Display: ultra-high 3200 x 1800 multitouch.
- Processor: "Intel's latest 4th generation Core i7 processing chip with four cores and a speed of up to 3.2 GHz".
- Graphics: "NVidia's Quad K1100M with 2 GB of RAM".
- Storage: options for dual storage drives - "one 2.5 inch drive and one mini-card mSATA drive".
- Battery: "said to bring more than 10 hours of battery life".

## Availability and price
- "Will be offered with an optional USB 3.0 docking station when it goes on sale this November 14th."
- "There is currently no word on pricing."

## Byline
- By Michael Archambault, Tuesday, Oct 22, 2013 at 3:39 pm. Tagged: dell, windows, OEM, laptop, Precision M3800.

wikis.title: Nokia Lumia 2520 pricing and availability on AT&T
wikis.summary: Report that Nokia confirmed the Lumia 2520 tablet will cost $399.99 on AT&T with a two-year contract and go on sale in stores and online on November 22.
wikis.body:
## Price and availability
- "Nokia has now confirmed pricing and availability for its first Windows 8.1 RT tablet in the US on AT&T."
- "Much like Verizon's Lumia 2520, this tablet will be on sale on November 22nd in AT&T stores, as well as online."
- "The price will set you back $399.99 with a two-year contract agreement."
- Bundle offer: taken with a Lumia 925, Lumia 1020 or Lumia 1520, "the price comes down to $199.99".
- "There's a sweet little deal for those who purchase and activate a Nokia Lumia 2520 between November 22 and January 9. You'll be eligible for a $20 app voucher for the Windows Store."

## Specifications recapped
- 10.1-inch display with full 1080p support, wide viewing angles and ClearBlack technology.
- 6.7MP camera with Zeiss optics.
- 4G LTE connectivity.
- Qualcomm Snapdragon 800 (2.2GHz Quad Core).
- 8,000mAh battery with "ultra-fast charging" built-in (charges to 80 percent in one hour).

## Context given
- "It's going to be quite the busy couple of days next week, particularly around and on November 22nd": the Xbox One launches that day, "alongside the Lumia 1520 and Lumia 2520 from Nokia".

## Byline
- By Rich Edmonds, Friday, Nov 15, 2013 at 10:24 am; via Nokia Conversations. Tagged: at&T, Lumia 2520, nokia, Availability.

wikis.title: LA Motor Show 2013 preview: cars expected to debut
wikis.summary: Auto Express's manufacturer-by-manufacturer preview of the cars expected to be unveiled at the LA Motor Show 2013, which begins on 19 November.
wikis.body:
## The show
- "The LA Motor Show 2013 begins on 19 November and we've created a handy preview of what you can expect to see".
- The show "will host over 20 new cars' world debuts" and is described as "one of the biggest motor shows of the year".
- Headline unveilings listed: the Mercedes S65 AMG, new MINI and Porsche's new baby SUV, the Macan.
- The round-up is "categorised by manufacturer" and the writer says the page will be "regularly updating it with all the latest information on what's to be revealed".

## Manufacturers covered
- Audi, BMW, Ford, Jaguar, Land Rover, MINI, Mercedes, Nissan, Porsche, Subaru.
- Honda, Chevrolet and Volkswagen "will all be at the LA Motor Show in November but what they'll be unveiling remains a mystery".

## Headline figures
- BMW 4 Series Convertible prices start from GBP 35,650 for the 420d SE, "£4,075 more than its Coupe counterpart".
- Porsche Macan prices "are expected to start at around £32,000 rising to £46,500".
- Mercedes S65 AMG power "is rumoured to be in the region of 630bhp"; the S63 is priced at GBP 120,000.
- Audi Nanuk Concept: 5.0-litre twin-turbocharged V10 TDI, 536hp and 1,000Nm.

## Author
- Jonathan Burn, 18 Oct, 2013 5:06pm.

wikis.title: Audi Nanuk Concept and BMW 4 Series Convertible
wikis.summary: The single debut each from Audi and BMW at the LA Motor Show 2013.
wikis.body:
## Audi
- "Audi will be relatively quiet at the LA Motor Show next month, with only the supercar-cum-SUV Nanuk Concept being showcased."
- The Nanuk was first seen at the Frankfurt Motor Show 2013 in September.
- Engine: 5.0-litre twin-turbocharged V10 TDi diesel producing 536hp and 1,000Nm of torque.
- "It's doubtful the Nanuk will ever make it into production."

## BMW
- The BMW 4 Series Convertible will be BMW's "only debutant" in LA.
- Larger than the 3 Series Convertible it replaces; retains the three-piece folding hardtop, "which takes 20 seconds to retract".
- BMW claims it is 40 per cent stiffer and 20kg lighter than the outgoing 3 Series.
- Prices start from GBP 35,650 for the 420d SE model, GBP 4,075 more than the Coupe.

wikis.title: Ford Global SUV (believed to be the Edge)
wikis.summary: Ford's new full-size SUV expected to be unveiled at the LA Motor Show 2013.
wikis.body:
- Ford "will be unveiling a new Global SUV at LA next month, believed to be called the Ford Edge".
- "A full-size SUV is currently missing from Ford's line-up".
- The Edge "is likely to be based on the Mondeo platform, placing it above the EcoSport and Kuga in the SUV range".
- Expected rivals: Volvo XC90 and VW Touareg.
- "More specific details are still unknown."

wikis.title: Jaguar F-Type Coupe and long-wheelbase Range Rover
wikis.summary: Two rumoured or expected reveals from Jaguar and Land Rover at the LA Motor Show 2013.
wikis.body:
## Jaguar F-Type Coupe
- Auto Express has "previously brought you spy shots"; "rumours suggest the svelte Porsche 911 rival could be revealed at the LA Motor Show".
- "A hot 700bhp version, which will go up against the Porsche 911 Turbo, has also been suggested, although nothing official has yet been announced."

## Range Rover LWB
- Land Rover "is expected to reveal a long wheelbase (LWB) version of the new Range Rover".
- "Little is expected to change over the standard model other than a likely 15cm increase in length, which will make for increased interior space for rear passengers."

wikis.title: Third-generation MINI Cooper
wikis.summary: The new MINI, to be unveiled at the LA Motor Show 2013, with its new engines and platform.
wikis.body:
- "The third-generation model will finally be unveiled at the LA Motor Show."
- Subtle exterior changes including new headlights and bumpers; "the biggest changes are hidden under its curvaceous body".
- Two new 1.5-litre three-cylinder turbo engines: 134bhp in the Cooper and 114bhp in the Cooper D.
- A new 189bhp 2.0-litre engine powers the Cooper S; a tuned version of the same engine is used in the 220bhp John Cooper Works model.
- Underpinned by BMW's new lightweight UKL1 front-wheel drive platform.

wikis.title: Mercedes S65 AMG, S63 AMG and GLA
wikis.summary: Mercedes' LA Motor Show 2013 stand, led by the V12-powered S65 AMG.
wikis.body:
- The twin-turbocharged V8 powered S63 AMG has "already been revealed"; Mercedes has announced "the more powerful V12-engined Mercedes S65 AMG will debut at LA".
- "Figures are yet to be confirmed but power is rumoured to be in the region of 630bhp and the sprint from 0-62mph covered in less than four seconds."
- The S65 AMG "is also likely to demand a substantial premium over the smaller £120,000 S63, which will also be on display".
- The Mercedes GLA "will rival the likes of the Audi Q3 and BMW X1" and will also be on the Mercedes stand.

wikis.title: Nissan Juke Nismo RS, GT-R Nismo and X-Trail
wikis.summary: Nissan's expected Nismo debuts and the North American debut of the X-Trail at the LA Motor Show 2013.
wikis.body:
- Nissan "is set to unveil two new Nismo models at LA, one of which being the Nissan Juke Nismo RS".
- Of the Juke Nismo RS: "Little is known about the model but it is expected to receive track-focused handling upgrades and the 1.6-litre turbocharged engine tuned to produce 230bhp."
- "The other Nismo model is yet to be confirmed but reports suggest it could be the long-awaited Nissan GT-R Nismo."
- The Nissan X-Trail "called the Rogue in the US" will make its North American debut, after first being unveiled at the Frankfurt Motor Show in September.

wikis.title: Porsche Macan and 911 Turbo / Turbo S Cabriolet
wikis.summary: Porsche's LA Motor Show 2013 debuts: the Macan SUV and the open-top 911 Turbo models.
wikis.body:
## Macan
- "One of the biggest attractions at the LA Motor Show will undoubtedly be Porsche's new baby SUV, the Macan."
- Information so far has come "through leaked information, renderings, spy shots and even a passenger ride"; "the official unveiling is only weeks away".
- "Prices are expected to start at around £32,000 rising to £46,500 with two six-cylinder turbo engines available from launch. Power outputs, however, are yet to be officially announced."

## 911 Turbo and Turbo S Cabriolet
- Both have been tested overseas but "they'll make their public debuts at LA".
- Both feature "a folding magnesium frame roof designed to replicate the arched shape of the coupe when it's in place".
- Power from the same 3.8-litre flat-six as the coupe: 514bhp in the Turbo and 552bhp in the Turbo S.

wikis.title: Subaru WRX STI Concept
wikis.summary: Subaru's returning WRX concept, shown again at the LA Motor Show 2013.
wikis.body:
- "The Subaru WRX concept made its debut at the New York Motor Show earlier in the year, and Subaru plans to showcase the model again at the LA Motor Show 2013."
- It previews the next-generation WRX STi, "which Subaru wants to separate completely from the Impreza range".
- "There's no word on what engine the WRX will use but an uprated version of the firm's 2.0-litre Boxer engine producing around 300bhp has been rumoured."
- "It could also make its way to the UK if Subaru is able to price it competitively at below £30,000."

wikis.title: Windows Phone Central's MWC 2014 live page
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central announces its dedicated live page for Mobile World Congress 2014 and says what Nokia and Microsoft are expected to do at the show.
wikis.body:
## The show
- "Mobile World Congress 2014 kicks off this Monday, February 24 in Barcelona."
- "Nokia will be there. Microsoft will be there. We'll be there."

## Nokia (reported/rumoured)
- Nokia "will reportedly announce the Nokia X (aka Normandy) Android device, a rumored refresh of the Nokia 105 and a new low-end Asha".
- "While no new Lumias will be revealed, this is Nokia. They always have some cool things to reveal, including new apps and accessories."

## Microsoft
- "Microsoft will be present, but in a limited capacity."
- The site is attending a 'Media and Analyst' event by Microsoft on Sunday, "with some presentations by executives discussing current devices and strategy".
- "We don't expect major news, but you never know what may turn up."

## The live page
- Readers are told to bookmark www.wpcentral.com/mwclive, which "will pull in all of our MWC content, including our Instagram feeds and stories from Android Central and more".
- "If you want to just see our coverage, hit the site toolbar and it will auto-filter."

## Byline
- Daniel Rubino, Editor-in-chief, Friday, Feb 21, 2014 at 1:07 pm.

wikis.title: Microsoft announces Office for iPad and free Office Mobile
wikis.summary: Microsoft's Office Blogs post announcing Word, Excel and PowerPoint for iPad and making Office Mobile free on iPhone and Android phones.
wikis.body:
## The announcement
- "Today in San Francisco, we made some exciting announcements about our company's mobile first, cloud first approach."
- "Today, we unveiled Office for iPad - specifically Word, PowerPoint and Excel."
- "In the future, we will bring Office apps to the Windows Store and other popular platforms."
- "Over a billion people on the planet use Microsoft Office to get more done at work and at home."
- Also announced: "like Windows Phone, we've now made Office Mobile for iPhone and Android phones available for free".

## Pricing and availability
- The iPad apps are free to download; free versions let you "read your Word documents, view your Excel data and present with PowerPoint".
- "To get the full editing and creation experience, you need an Office 365 subscription."
- A free 30 day Office 365 trial is offered at www.office.com/try.
- An Office 365 subscription covers Office for iPad on up to 5 tablets, "but also 5 copies across Office for your PCs and Macs".
- Qualifying plans: Office 365 Home, Small Business Premium, Midsize Business, E3 and E4 (Enterprise and Government), Education A3 and A4, ProPlus, and University. "The new Office 365 Personal will also qualify when it becomes available later this spring."
- System requirement: "You need an iPad running iOS 7.0 or later."
- Available in 29 languages and, "as of today", in 135 markets.

## Byline
- By John Case, March 27, 2014.

wikis.title: Word, Excel and PowerPoint for iPad
wikis.summary: The new touch-first Office apps for iPad, their features, cloud integration and requirements.
wikis.body:
## Availability
- "Starting today, you can download Word, Excel and PowerPoint for iPad from the App Store."
- Free versions read/view/present; editing and creating new documents requires an Office 365 subscription.
- Requires "an iPad running iOS 7.0 or later".
- 29 languages: Catalan, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian.
- 135 markets as of the announcement day.

## Fidelity and features
- "Documents will look exactly how you intended in Office on PC, Mac, tablet and phone - regardless of which device you used to make the edits."
- Word: "images, tables, SmartArt, footnotes, equations are all there, perfectly formatted"; track changes, threaded comments, accept or reject edits on the iPad.
- Excel: formulas, charts, sparklines, conditional formatting and filters.
- PowerPoint: transitions, animations, speaker notes, and when presenting "a built-in laser pointer, pens and highlighters".

## Touch design
- "These apps were created from the ground up for iPad."
- Familiar Ribbon layout "with the most common commands under Home, and Chart commands automatically show up when you select a chart".
- Large touch areas on the Ribbon and overlay menus; touch-friendly handles to resize and rotate pictures, with text flowing around them. "No keyboard and mouse required."
- Supports iPad features such as voice dictation for drafting a Word document and AirPlay to project a presentation wirelessly to a TV.

## Cloud
- Access to documents in OneDrive, OneDrive for Business and SharePoint; the apps "know what documents you were working on last, no matter what device you were using".
- Sharing via OneDrive allows working "simultaneously with multiple people on the same document or presentation".
- "Even if you don't have an Internet connection for a while, you'll still be able to work on the documents you've recently used on the iPad."

wikis.title: Office Mobile free for iPhone and Android phones
wikis.summary: Microsoft makes Office Mobile free for everyone on iPhone and Android phones, as it already is on Windows Phone.
wikis.body:
- "Just like Office Mobile for Windows Phone, we are making Office Mobile for iPhone and Android phones free for everyone."
- "With Office Mobile, you have the ability to view and edit your Office content on the go."
- "Office Mobile is available in the App Store and Google Play."

wikis.title: Windows 8.1 Store update: persistent nav bar, Collections and cross-device downloads
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central reports Microsoft pushing an update to the Windows 8.1 Store on 13 May 2014, with four main changes aimed at app discovery and mouse-and-keyboard users.
wikis.body:
## What happened

- "This morning, Microsoft is pushing out another serious update for Windows 8.1 consumers that will greatly improve the Store experience."
- The Store had already been redone for 8.1, but "there were still many refinements needed that were missed with the spring update a few weeks back".
- The updates "concentrate on usability, mouse and keyboard users and bring some parity with Windows Phone".
- The four main changes are "as detailed on the Windows Experience Blog" (given as the source).

## The four changes

- Persistent navigation bar with Top charts, Categories and Collections
- Collections on the Store landing page
- Multiple Featured titles "at your fingertips (or mouse pointer)"
- Get once & download on compatible Windows devices

## Detail

- Previously users had to swipe down from the top to reach the navigation bar; "Now, the green bar will always be there for users."
- Collections "have been a part of the Windows Phone Store since 8.0" and now come to Windows 8.1.
- Featured titles bring "new, trending and rising stars" to the forefront; on-sale titles "will have a strike-through of the original price with the sale price in red".
- The new Windows/Windows Phone icon, marking an app or game as also available on Windows Phone, was present in the web-store but missing from the Store app; "That has now been remedied." The icon was highlighted earlier in the site's discussion of Universal Apps.

## Context given

- "Just a few weeks ago" Microsoft released the 'spring update' for Windows 8.1, which improved things for traditional mouse and keyboard users.
- "Later this fall, they're expected to re-do the Start Menu too."

## How to get it

- Settings (swipe from the right edge of the screen) > Change PC Settings > Update & Recovery > Check Now.
- "Like all 'live' updates, it can take some time before your server sees it, so just don't be surprised if it takes a few hours."

## Byline

- By Daniel Rubino, Editor-in-chief, Tuesday, May 13, 2014 at 1:11 pm. Filed in: Windows. Tags: windows 8.1, Windows Store.

wikis.title: Windows Phone and Windows developer resources merge; 21 new payout markets
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central reports Microsoft merging its Windows Phone and Windows 8 developer resources onto dev.windows.com, adding 21 new developer payout markets and highlighting the Kinect for Windows 2.0 SDK.
wikis.body:
## What changed

- Microsoft is "merging developer resources for Windows and Windows Phone", adding twenty one new payout markets and highlighting the new Kinect for Windows 2.0 SDK.

## Unified developer site

- dev.windowsphone.com, previously the "one-stop shop for all things Windows Phone development", now redirects to dev.windows.com.
- The new site is where developers get resources for making both Windows Phone and Windows 8 apps: "This isn't just simple web redirect, instead you'll now find a unified site with content and guidance for both platforms."
- Unified documentation: "a comprehensive, combined documentation set to help learn app development for Windows devices across phone, tablet and PC".
- Single location for code samples, "easily accessible directly from one Dev Center page".
- Single location for developer forums: the Windows Store apps and Windows Phone developer forums "have been merged into one set of forums".
- The Windows Phone Store and Windows Store dashboards "haven't merged yet and remain separate" - you pick one on clicking Dashboard and can switch using the left-hand navigation pane.

## Kinect for Windows 2.0 SDK

- Apps created with the new SDK "may be released to the Windows Store once the final, RTM version of the SDK is available later this year".
- In the meantime developers are encouraged to download the public preview of the SDK "to get an early start on development".

## New payout markets

- "Starting this week" the number of markets in which developers can submit paid apps increases by 21, for both the Windows Phone Store and the Windows Store.
- The 21: Albania, Antigua and Barbuda, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Botswana, Comoros, Dominica, Fiji Islands, Georgia, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Mauritius, Monaco, Mongolia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Tajikistan, Tonga, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan.
- "The new total of available markets for Windows Phone and Windows 8 developers to earn revenue is now up to 149."

## Links and byline

- Links given: Dev Center portal, Dev Center UserVoice, Kinect for Windows SDK 2.0 Public Preview. Source: Microsoft.
- By Sam Sabri, Managing Editor, Wednesday, Jul 16, 2014 at 6:15 pm EDT. Filed in: Developers. Tags: Dev Center, Windows Phone Dev Center.

wikis.title: Microsoft to cut up to 18,000 jobs over the next year
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's report on Microsoft's 17 July 2014 announcement that it will lay off up to 18,000 workers in the next year, 12,500 of them tied to the Nokia Devices and Services acquisition.
wikis.body:
## The announcement

- "Microsoft has announced that it will lay off up to 18,000 workers in the next year, in what is by far the largest number of employees that will be cut by the company in its history."
- Announced in a letter sent to employees "earlier this morning" that Microsoft also released to the public.
- CEO Satya Nadella confirmed 12,500 of the job losses "will be due to the company's acquisition of Nokia's Devices and Services division in April, when it added 25,000 new workers".

## Nadella's words

- "We are moving now to start reducing the first 13,000 positions, and the vast majority of employees whose jobs will be eliminated will be notified over the next six months."
- "It's important to note that while we are eliminating roles in some areas, we are adding roles in certain other strategic areas."
- He promises to "go through this process in the most thoughtful and transparent way possible", with severance to all impacted employees "as well as job transition help in many locations".
- Nadella also indicated Microsoft will "have fewer layers of management, both top down and sideways, to accelerate the flow of information and decision making."

## Figures and comparison

- The 18,000 figure "dwarfs the 5,800 job cuts that Microsoft announced in 2009, at the height of the worldwide economic recession".
- In a separate press release Microsoft said it expects pre-tax charges totalling between $1.1 billion and $1.6 billion over the next year, including "$750 million to $800 million for severance and related benefit costs, and $350 million to $800 million of asset-related charges".

## What comes next

- "More information on these decisions will likely be revealed on July 22, when Microsoft announces its latest quarterly financial results."

## Byline

- By John Callaham, Thursday, Jul 17, 2014 at 8:14 am EDT. Filed in: Microsoft News. Tags: microsoft, job cuts. Source: Microsoft, Microsoft.

wikis.title: OneDrive free storage raised from 7GB to 15GB
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central reports that on 17 July 2014 Microsoft switched on the previously announced increase of free OneDrive storage from 7GB to 15GB, alongside new paid tiers and the 1TB Office 365 allowance.
wikis.body:
## What happened

- "As promised last month, Microsoft has now turned on the switch and has expanded the free storage space on its OneDrive service from 7GB to 15GB for everyone who has an account."
- The decision to double the free space "was announced back in June but was not implemented at the time".
- "Today's move means that anyone with a free Microsoft Account can access 15GB of space for storing documents, photos and videos and share them with others."

## Paid tiers

- 100GB of OneDrive space for $1.99 a month.
- 200GB of space for $3.99 a month.

## Related move

- Follows "Microsoft's decision on Wednesday to activate the promised 1TB of free OneDrive storage space for anyone who has a paid Office 365 subscription".

## Byline

- By John Callaham, Thursday, Jul 17, 2014 at 9:22 am EDT. Filed in: Apps. Tags: OneDrive. Tip credited to akak84.

wikis.title: Wellograph fitness watch with Windows Phone 8.1 app
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's 20 May 2014 report on the Wellograph premium fitness watch, its heart rate sensor and specs, its $349 pre-order price and its official Windows Phone 8.1 app.
wikis.body:
## The device

- "Wellograph watches are a new line of premium fitness watches that features a heart rate monitor, activity tracker, pedometer as well as the date and time."
- "The wearable device is due to ship sometime in June with an official app being available for Windows Phone 8.1."
- The watch "has a Pebble look about it but incorporates a Tri-LED Heart Rate Sensor into the soft spherical surface of the watch". "The sensor replicates the action of a doctor using their fingertip to register your pulse."
- Waterproof up to 50 meters; battery rated at two weeks of use per charge.

## Windows Phone app

- The Windows Phone app "will have Live Tile support to allow users to see data such as total steps and exercise scores on the Start Screen".
- "The app itself will reflect your activity synchronized over Bluetooth from the Wellograph watch and offer expanded analysis."

## Price and availability

- Currently available for pre-orders at $349 for the silver satin or black chrome models, "with shipping expected sometime in July".
- Details and pre-ordering information are on the Wellograph Website.

## Byline

- By George Ponder, Reviews Editor, Tuesday, May 20, 2014 at 1:39 pm EDT. Filed in: General Accessories. Tags: Wellograph, Fitness, watches, smartwatch, windows phone 8.1, wearables.
- The piece notes Mobile Nations "has launched a new site dedicated to connected technology", Connectedly, for wearable news and reviews.

wikis.title: Diablo III: Ultimate Evil Edition for Xbox One and Xbox 360
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's 13 May 2014 report that Blizzard's Diablo III: Ultimate Evil Edition, bundling the base game and the Reaper of Souls expansion, is due on Xbox One, Xbox 360 and PlayStation on Tuesday, August 19, with prices, transfers and console-exclusive features.
wikis.body:
## The announcement

- "Diablo III is coming to Xbox One!" - the Diablo III Ultimate Evil Edition "will come to Xbox One, Xbox 360, and Playstation systems this August".
- "The Diablo III Ultimate Evil Edition is due out on Tuesday, August 19."
- It collects the main Diablo III game (reviewed by the site for Xbox 360 "back in September") and the "Reaper of Souls" expansion pack "that landed on PC in March".
- The article frames it against the same day's Xbox news: the Xbox One becoming available without a bundled Kinect, Games with Gold and weekly deals coming to Xbox One, and video apps no longer requiring Xbox Live Gold on One or 360.

## Reaper of Souls contents

- Adds "a whole fifth act to the game, with a brand new story taking place after the main game's conclusion": as the Order attempts to seal away the Black Soulstone, Malthael the Angel of Death arrives and steals the stone, and the player(s) must get it back.
- Crusader: "A sixth character class who wields large weapons (like axes and the new flails) and holy magic."
- Adventure Mode: freely explore every unlocked area without starting a new game; holds Bounties, Nephalim Rifts and the Mystic NPC.
- Bounties: random optional missions with "sizable rewards".
- Nephalim Rifts: randomized dungeons "that can only be opened with items gained from Bounties".
- The Mystic: a new NPC who can Enchant items and Transmogrify player characters.
- Level cap raised to 70.

## Pricing and transfers

- $39.99 on Xbox 360; $59.99 on Xbox One.
- "The 'Reaper of Souls' expansion pack will not be sold separately on consoles", so Xbox 360 owners of Diablo III "have no choice but to get the Ultimate Evil Edition"; the expansion costs $39.99 on PC anyway.
- Blizzard "has announced that Xbox 360 players will be able to transfer their progress to the Xbox One version (and Playstation 3 gamers can transfer to Playstation 4)".

## Console-exclusive additions

- Apprentice mode: "allows low-level players to boost their stats while adventuring with high-level friends".
- A new in-game mail system to send items to friends, including "mysterious Player Gifts containing rare loot for the adventurer whose name they bear."
- Multiplayer as in the first 360 game: four-player local co-op, four-player online co-op, and any mixture of the two.

## Pre-order bonus

- Pre-ordering gives the exclusive Infernal Pauldrons in-game item, "a unique set of shoulder plates that provide Health, Life regeneration, and Cool-down Reduction effects".
- Amazon pre-order links listed: Xbox One $59.99, Xbox 360 $39.99.

## Byline

- By Paul Acevedo, Games Editor, Tuesday, May 13, 2014 at 5:56 pm EDT. Filed in: Games, Xbox. Tags: diablo iii, xbox one, xbox 360, diablo iii ultimate evil edition.

wikis.title: Broadcom BCM4358 Wi-Fi and Bluetooth combo chip
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's 3 September 2014 report on Broadcom's newly announced BCM4358 combo chip, which the company says doubles wireless networking performance for high-end smartphones and tablets.
wikis.body:
## The announcement

- "Broadcom announced a new Wi-Fi and Bluetooth combo chip today that the manufacturer claims will double wireless networking performance of high-end smartphones and tablets."
- Broadcom claims users "spend an estimated four to five hours everyday on Wi-Fi", and that with the new chipset they "will be able to download and stream content twice as fast as current-gen devices and with less lag".

## BCM4358 key features

- Improved Wi-Fi data throughput at 650 Mbps.
- Enhanced Wi-Fi and Bluetooth coexistence performance.
- Second-generation 2x2 MIMO.
- Transmit beamforming, "which pinpoints a device's location within a network to provide better throughput to that location".
- Supports Android, Windows and Chrome operating systems.
- "the highest-performing 5G 802.11ac Wi-Fi and Bluetooth combo chip in the market, according to Broadcom".

## Availability

- "Broadcom has mentioned that the BCM4358 is in production, with consumer devices featuring the chipset set to be available later this quarter."

## Byline

- By Harish Jonnalagadda, Wednesday, Sep 3, 2014 at 9:17 am EDT. Filed in: General News. Tags: Broadcom. Source: Broadcom.

wikis.title: Xbox One China launch on September 23, priced at 3,699 RMB
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's 30 July 2014 report, with an update, that Microsoft will launch the Xbox One in China on September 23 at 3,699 RMB, plus a 4,299 RMB limited edition and the bundle contents.
wikis.body:
## Launch date

- Yusuf Mehdi, head of marketing and strategy for Microsoft's Xbox division, stated "that the console will be launching in China on September 23".
- The article notes details had been "trickling out over the last few weeks" but an official launch date from Microsoft was missing until this announcement.

## Price and contents (update)

- "Xbox Wire has made the Xbox One launch in China announcement official, which includes pricing info for the console in the region. Priced at 3,699 RMB ($600)".
- Standard bundle extras:
  - Powerstar Golf and Neverwinter Online with a Special Edition Pack
  - The BesTV entertainment experience
  - Free access to Xbox Live Gold through March 2015
  - A localized Chinese interface, translated content and local payment methods
  - A two-year warranty and local customer service support from Microsoft and BesTV

## Limited edition

- A limited edition console retails for 4,299 RMB ($700) and comes with the Kinect sensor. It includes:
  - A limited-edition commemorative China Day One controller
  - Day One Achievement for your Xbox Live profile
  - Kinect Sports Rivals, Forza Motorsport 5: Racing Game of the Year, the Neverwinter Online Commemorative Edition Pack, and Powerstar Golf with in-game credit

## BesTV

- "Microsoft has collaborated with BesTV in bringing hundreds of TV shows, movies and documentaries in high definition to the Chinese audience."

## Earlier leaks (original story)

- Mehdi did not announce pricing at the time.
- "an earlier leak from June suggested a retail price of 4,999 RMB (which comes out to around $803)".
- "a recent leak mentioned that the console would cost 3,499 RMB ($565)"; according to that leak the bundle would come with a "customized" controller, coupons for e-commerce websites and three blockbuster games.
- "It is likely that the $565 bundle will not feature a Kinect controller, as there wasn't any mention of it in the leaked promotional material."

## Byline

- By Harish Jonnalagadda, Wednesday, Jul 30, 2014 at 7:31 am EDT. Filed in: Xbox. Tags: xbox one, China. Source: Reuters.

wikis.title: Stand-alone Xbox One Kinect sensor, October 7 for $149.99
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's 27 August 2014 report, updated with Microsoft's official announcement, that the stand-alone Kinect sensor for Xbox One goes on sale October 7 for $149.99 with a free Dance Central Spotlight download code.
wikis.body:
## Update (official)

- "Microsoft has issued the official announcement on the stand alone Kinect sensor for the Xbox One going on sale for $149.99, but with a slight date change to October 7."
- "The company also says it will come with a code to download a free game, the upcoming Dance Central Spotlight from developer Harmonix."

## Original story

- Since Microsoft decoupled the Kinect sensor from the Xbox One, "the one lingering question was when would they sell it as a stand-alone unit?" Until now "there was no option to do so".
- "Windows Phone Central has now learned that Microsoft is planning to sell the stand-alone Kinect sensor for $149 beginning on or around October 6."
- The timing "leads well into the holiday season in the US and other countries, making the add-on an excellent gift for those who already own an Xbox One without the next-gen accessory".
- "Presumably, you should be able to pick up the stand-alone version from stores like Best Buy, Target, and Microsoft, just like buying an Xbox console."
- "Regional availability for the stand-alone Kinect is not known at this time, though the US market is definitely the first to get it."

## Pricing background

- "Microsoft took a gamble with a $499 price mark for the Xbox One with Kinect sensor bundle when compared to the Sony PlayStation 4 assessed at $399."
- "Priced equally, sans Kinect, and early numbers reflect the Xbox One recouping some lost ground, although it remains to be seen if Microsoft's console can ever catch up to - let alone surpass - Sony."

## Byline

- By Daniel Rubino, Editor-in-chief, Wednesday, Aug 27, 2014 at 12:04 pm EDT. Filed in: Xbox. Tags: kinect, xbox one.

wikis.title: Killer Instinct Season 2 on Xbox One, starting October 15
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's 12 August 2014 report that Killer Instinct Season 2 begins on Xbox One on October 15, with eight new characters, its developer Iron Galaxy, and the pricing of its editions.
wikis.body:
## The announcement

- "The second 'season' for Microsoft's Xbox One revival of the Killer Instinct fighting game franchise will begin on October 15 and will eventually add eight new characters to its ranks."
- Season 2 is being developed by Iron Galaxy, "the creators of the cult hit indie fighting game Divekick".

## Contents

- Starts with two new fighters "out of the box", TJ Combo and Maya.
- "the developer will add one new character every month for the next six months".
- Also includes new gameplay modes and accessory packs for the fighters.

## Pricing

- As with Season 1, each fighter can be bought separately for $4.99.
- Combo Breaker bundle: $19.99, giving access to all eight new fighters.
- Killer Instinct: Season 2 - Ultra Edition: $39.99, offering all eight new characters, "a selection of alternate fighter costumes and accessory packs" and the Xbox One port of Killer Instinct 2 Classic, "first released in 1996 and now adding support for online multiplayer".

## Early access offer

- "Gamers who purchase the Ultra Edition between September 23 and October 14 will be able to get TJ Combo early, along with access to Killer Instinct 2 Classic."

## Byline

- By John Callaham, Tuesday, Aug 12, 2014 at 3:43 pm EDT. Filed in: Games, Xbox. Tags: xbox one, killer instinct. Source: Killer Instinct forums.

wikis.title: Rumour: two Microsoft phones with 3D Touch
wikis.summary: Windows Phone Central's 7 July 2014 rumour report, citing Neowin, that Microsoft is allegedly considering two handsets with 3D Touch - the McLaren and a 6-inch device possibly the Lumia 1525.
wikis.body:
## The rumour

- "Microsoft has been heavily rumored to launch a device with a 3D user interface later this year, with the device allegedly slated for a launch in the month of November."
- "However, a report out of Neowin suggests that Microsoft is considering launching two handsets that come with the 3D Touch feature enabled."

## 3D Touch

- "3D Touch is said to be the first major hardware/software innovation that Microsoft will inculcate into the high-end Lumia devices."
- Microsoft "is said to include APIs for gestures, side interactions and heat maps so that third-party devs can access the 3D Touch technology for their apps".

## McLaren

- "the latest rumors indicate a 5.2-inch full-HD screen, 20MP camera along with a 64 GB internal storage variant".

## The second device

- "In addition to McLaren, Microsoft is allegedly working on a 6-inch device that will also feature a 3D Touch interface."
- "Earlier today, a leak revealed that Microsoft was mulling a Lumia 1525 for later this year with updated hardware that includes a Snapdragon 801. So it is possible that the Lumia 1525 is the second device to feature the 3D Touch interface."

## Caveat

- "As for now, we only have rumors to go by, but as we move closer to an official unveil, we will have more information on how Microsoft intends to implement this technology."

## Byline

- By Harish Jonnalagadda, Monday, Jul 7, 2014 at 10:13 am EDT. Filed in: Rumors. Tags: McLaren, 3D Touch. Source: Neowin.

wikis.title: KONE reopens its renewed high-rise elevator test laboratory in Tytyri, Finland
wikis.summary: KONE press release of March 29, 2017 announcing the reopening of its renovated high-rise elevator test laboratory in the Tytyri limestone mine in Finland, at 350 metres deep.
wikis.body:
## What was announced
- "KONE Corporation, press release, March 29, 2017": KONE "has unveiled its renewed high-rise elevator testing facility in Tytyri, Finland, after extensive renovations."
- The test lab "reaches a depth of 350 meters" and is "an integral part of a working limestone mine". It is described as "Unique in the world" and as hosting "the world's deepest elevator test shaft".
- KONE is described as "one of the global leaders in the elevator and escalator industry".

## Testing capability
- Tests are carried out "under extreme conditions, which are much harsher than in regular buildings".
- Shaft depth allows testing of elevator speeds "of up to 70 km/hour, or around 19 meters per second at conventional acceleration rates".
- With KONE's "unique free-fall tests", speeds "of up to 90 km/hour, or 26 meters per second, can be reached".
- Named technology developed and tested there: "the revolutionary carbon fiber hoisting technology, KONE UltraRope(R)".
- Other work cited: "sophisticated analysis of ride comfort and aerodynamics" and "robot-aided solutions for precision installation, resulting in faster installation times and better ride comfort".

## Site figures
- The transformed Tytyri site "comprises of 11 elevator shafts with a combined length of 1.6 kilometers".
- "Seven shafts are dedicated for super-tall and mega-tall testing, with the remaining four shafts available for mid- and low-rise testing."

## Quotes
- Tomio Pihkala, Chief Technology Officer, KONE Corporation: "At Tytyri we can push the limits of elevator physics like at no other place in the world. With the extreme tests such as the free-fall test, we can drop an elevator frame weighing 10,000 kilograms into a 200 meter shaft and test safety gear performance, bringing the elevator to a controlled stop."
- Pihkala also: "As plans for tall and mega-tall buildings reach new heights, we will be able to use new materials to simulate the demands of tomorrow's buildings, today. With the deepest and tallest facility of its kind in the world, we are excited to bring together design, engineering and technology, specifically to meet and exceed the needs of our customers."

## History and wider network
- "KONE's high-rise laboratory at Tytyri was first opened in 1997."
- It is "part of the company's global testing network, located at seven different R&D sites in Finland, Italy, China, USA, Mexico, and India."
- The Tytyri R&D team "works in close collaboration with KONE's existing high-rise laboratory researchers in Hyvinkaa, Finland, and in Kunshan, China."
- "The Kunshan test tower was opened in late 2015, and ranks as one of the tallest test towers in the world, reaching a height of 235.6 meters."

## Earlier press releases listed
- October 13, 2016: "The first KONE UltraRope(R) in China to be installed in Beijing's tallest building, China Zun"
- September 2, 2016: KONE listed as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies by Forbes "for the sixth year running"
- March 16, 2016: KONE wins order for Australia 108 luxury apartment building in Melbourne
- April 2, 2015: KONE wins order to equip Beijing's tallest building to be
- December 22, 2015: KONE to deliver passenger elevator to reach 400m deep underground nuclear waste storage in Finland
- June 5, 2014: KONE wins order for Saudi Arabia's Kingdom Tower, "the world's tallest building"
- October 1, 2013: First KONE UltraRope(TM) installed at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore

## Company details given
- Media contact: Liisa Kivela, Director, Communications, KONE Corporation, tel. +358 204 75 4330, media@kone.com
- "In 2016, KONE had annual net sales of EUR 8.8 billion, and at the end of the year over 52,000 employees."
- "KONE class B shares are listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd. in Finland."

wikis.title: Leeza SOHO, Beijing opens 19 November 2019
wikis.summary: Zaha Hadid Architects news item of 17-09-19 announcing that Leeza SOHO in Beijing opens 19 November 2019, with its 194m atrium, split-volume form over a subway tunnel and LEED Gold core and shell.
wikis.body:
## The announcement
- "Leeza SOHO, Beijing opens 19 November 2019" (item dated 17-09-19 on the Zaha Hadid Architects news archive; the same opening date was also carried on 03-09-19 and 25-07-19).

## The building
- "Straddling the new subway tunnel that diagonally divides its site, the Leeza SOHO tower rises as a single volume divided into two halves on either side of the tunnel."
- "A central atrium - the world's tallest - extends 194m through the full height of the building and connects with the metro station below, creating a fantastic new public space for the city."
- The atrium is "twisted" through 45 degrees as the tower rises, "to orientate the atrium's higher floors with the historic north-south / east-west axis on which the city was founded".
- The site is "on Lize Road in southwest Beijing"; the tower "anchors the new Fengtai business" district.
- Earlier items in the same archive describe it as "a 46-storey (207m) mixed-use tower with the world's tallest atrium" (16-02-17) and say it "will top-out at 207m in September" (26-07-17).

## Sustainability
- "The core and shell development of Leeza SOHO was awarded LEED Gold certification by the U.S. Green Building Council" (also reported 30-05-19).
- The "double-insulated, unitised glass curtain-wall system steps the glazing units on each floor at an angle, allowing ventilating registers to draw outside air through an operable cavity when required".
- "Leeza SOHO is ZHA's fourth collaboration with SOHO China to achieve LEED certification, totalling 15 million square feet (1.4 million m2) of mixed-use urban space in Beijing and Shanghai."

## Quote
- Zhang Xin, Soho China's CEO, at the ground-breaking: "China attracts the best talent from around the world. It's important to work with architects who understand what the next generation requires; connecting communities and traditions with innovative new technologies to embrace the future."

## After the opening
- 19-11-19: "Leeza SOHO opens with the world's tallest atrium".
- 06-12-19: "Leeza SOHO receives two Awards for Excellence from CTBUH" (Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat).

## Rest of the page
- Most of the capture is the site's news archive listing - roughly 650 dated headlines with truncated teasers running from 11-12-19 back to 22-10-09 - rather than article text.

wikis.title: Temporary Myrtha pools for the 2019 International Swimming League Championship Grand Final, Las Vegas
wikis.summary: Myrtha Pools project page describing the two temporary pools it built at the Mandalay Bay hotel in Las Vegas for the International Swimming League Championship Grand Final on December 20 & 21.
wikis.body:
## The event
- "December 20 & 21: The International Swimming League Grand Final in Las Vegas is taking place in a stunning pool with acrylic wall installed at the Mandalay Bay hotel."
- The pools were built "in the arena space, where the hotel usually hosts grand events and boxing matches".
- Feature list gives YEAR: 2019; TYPE: "Special Events & Temporary Pools"; LOCATION: Indoor.

## The pools
- Two temporary pools: a warm-up pool and a competition pool.
- Sizes given under SURFACE: "25 x 11 m warm-up pool" and "25 x 21 m competition pool".
- "The competition pool is designed with a 21 m acrylic wall with a vanishing edge: something no one's ever seen before during such important events."
- TECHNOLOGY: "Myrtha overflow gutter - classic competition".

## Installation
- "The two temporary pools have been installed in just 10 days by Myrtha Pools certified installation teams along with local contracting and union support using Myrtha's unique technology."
- The pool was built "above the usual 'stage'", "causing no disruption to the hotel's daily activities and no reconstruction of the existing arena".
- The "self-supporting and modular structure" allows temporary pools inside existing stadiums, arenas or buildings "without the need to anchor the pools to the facility floor".

## Sustainability claims
- Myrtha "promotes sustainability by being eco-friendly, emitting less than 50% of CO2 emissions than a traditional concrete pool".
- "the majority of the materials used for this event have been used at two previous temporary events", and after the ISL Grand Final "these pools will then be permanently reinstalled at another location".

## Equipment
- "skid mounted defender filtration system", which "reduces water loss".
- "Strahlenturbulenz (STZ) inlet system", which "optimizes the use of chlorine and pool chemicals because of great circulation in the pool".

wikis.title: Cadbury in Claremont, Tasmania - 100 years of the factory
wikis.summary: Glenorchy City Council article marking 100 years of the Cadbury factory at Claremont, Tasmania, covering why the site was chosen, its 1921-1922 opening and figures about the plant in 2022.
wikis.body:
## How Cadbury came to Claremont
- "The chocolate house of Cadbury was founded in Birmingham, England in 1830 and began exports to Australia in 1881."
- "After the First World War a period of global expansion began, and the parent company took the decision to establish a factory in Australia."
- The Cadbury delegation visited Melbourne and Sydney "before a chance meeting with the Tasmanian Premier, Sir Walter Lee, saw members travel south, to Hobart."
- In Hobart they found "a ready workforce, plentiful hydro-power, access to international and interstate shipping routes and a temperate climate."
- They purchased "a former military camp site at Claremont", giving space for "an antipodean version of the Bournville 'factory in a garden' - the Quaker vision for modern industry, complete with housing estate and recreational facilities."

## Dates
- "In 1921 construction commenced at the Claremont site."
- "An official opening took place on 21 October and production commenced in January 1922 under the guidance of British confectioners who settled in the adjacent garden suburb with access to a school and playing fields."
- "With innovations in plant and processes, production of the famous Dairy Milk Chocolate line commenced at Claremont in 1928."

## Place in Glenorchy
- "Along with the Electrolytic Zinc Company and Titan Nail and Wire Company, Cadbury was a key cornerstone in Glenorchy's reputation as an industrial hub in the first decades of the 20th century."
- Over the past 100 years the company is described as "an employer, supporter and sponsor of local groups, charities and events".

## "Fun facts about Cadbury Claremont in 2022"
- "48 dairy farms in Tasmania's north-west" supply the milk; "Some have been supplying Cadbury with their milk for over 50 years!"
- The factory "employs over 450 staff and runs 24 hours a day".
- "Claremont is the largest Cadbury factory in Australia AND the Southern Hemisphere."
- Claremont "produces all Cadbury Dairy Milk blocks, as well as iconic novelty products like Cadbury Freddo and Caramello Koalas."
- "Over 200 million blocks are produced annually - 60 000 tonnes of chocolate!"

## Centenary
- "Mayor Bec Thomas takes a tour of the Cadbury factory to celebrate 100 years of Cadbury in Claremont".
- Images credited to the GCC collection (Mr C. Dennison; Mr H Moore), including a view of the Cadbury factory and estate houses from the air, c1930.

wikis.title: Yenikapi shipwrecks and the Harbour of Theodosius, Istanbul
wikis.summary: Article describing the 2004-2013 Yenikapi excavation in Istanbul and the Byzantine Harbour of Theodosius it uncovered, including the 37 shipwrecks found there.
wikis.body:
## The excavation
- "Between 2004 and 2013, one of the world's largest archaeological excavations took place at the Yenikap site", in the neighbourhood of the same name in Istanbul.
- "Hundreds of laborers and archaeologists from the Istanbul Archaeological Museums exposed remains of over 8,000 years of the city's history, ranging from Neolithic dwelling foundations and burials to Ottoman cisterns and workshops".
- The work took place "during the construction of a new underground rail line linking Europe and Asia".

## The harbour
- Most artifacts were found in "Constantinople's Theodosian Harbour, an artificial commercial harbor created during Byzantine Emperor Theodosius I. (AD 379-395)".
- Also called "The Harbour of Eleutherios"; it lay "underneath Istanbul's contemporary Yenikap neighborhood" and was "constructed near the confluence of the Lycus and Propontis rivers" (Marmara Sea).
- "From the 4th to the 11th century AD, the harbor was heavily utilized." Progressive siltation then left it "only accessible to tiny vessels".
- "The harbor had been fully filled in by the 16th century, and its ruins had been forgotten for years."

## Finds
- Waterlogged anaerobic sediments preserved "organic items made of wood, rope, and leather, as well as ceramics, bones, glass, coins, and other metals".
- "Archaeologists discovered 37 highly well-preserved shipwrecks dating from the 5th to late 10th or early 11th century AD, in addition to hundreds of anchors and other ship equipment."
- Among them are "the first archaeological examples of Byzantine rowed ships or galleys - almost probably warships - as well as commerce ships, some with undamaged amphora contents".

## Later history
- A settlement is said to have overflowed the south walls of the Marmara "between Mustafa Kemal and Namik Kemal streets", inhabited by Jews "beginning in the 13th century".
- "Although the grain trade from Egypt ended in the mid-seventh century, the Theodosius Harbour was still utilized as a harbor, as evidenced by shipwrecks discovered in the excavations spanning from the seventh to the eleventh centuries", mostly "as a port for short-distance freight ships and fishing boats".
- "The harbor was abandoned after the 12th century as a result of alluvium dirt delivered by Lykos (Bayrampasa) Creek, and it became a piling debris dump."
- Petrus Gyllius, who visited the city in the 16th century, on the filling: "Harbour is filled, greenery is planted on the broad vegetable gardens, very few arbores (tree) is planted."
